metadata.title: 分组展开 Accordion
metadata.description: 按各项名称主动展开内容。
metadata.descriptionEn: Reveal content from each item's named trigger.
metadata.decisions: 标题、触发与内容保持同一项关系；关闭不删除输入或宣告业务取消。
metadata.decisionsEn: Keep heading, trigger and content related to the same item; closing neither removes inputs nor declares business cancellation.

api.name: Accordion
api.description: 同组展开的状态与保留策略。
api.descriptionEn: Expansion state and retention policy for one group.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: 应用控制或原语持有展开项；事件可取消。
props.descriptionEn: Application-controlled or primitive-owned expanded items; the event can be canceled.

props.name: multiple
props.description: 允许多项共同展开。
props.descriptionEn: Allow several items to remain expanded together.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: 保留关闭内容和原生字段；需要移除时显式关闭。
props.descriptionEn: Retain closed content and native fields; explicitly opt out when removal is required.

props.name: disabled
props.description: 禁用整组。
props.descriptionEn: Disable the whole group.

props.name: hiddenUntilFound
props.description: 收起的内容用 hidden="until-found" 留在文档里：浏览器的页内查找（Ctrl/Cmd+F）命中其中的文字，或地址栏片段指向其中的元素时，自动展开该项。Chrome 102+、Firefox 148+ 支持，Safari 不支持；不支持的浏览器上与默认相同（命中不到，需手动展开）。开启后 keepMounted 无效（必须保留挂载）。收起内容的高度过渡与 opacity 过渡由 motion.css 照常处理，命中时由原语直接展开、不播放过渡。
props.descriptionEn: Closed content stays in the document as hidden="until-found": the browser's find-in-page (Ctrl/Cmd+F) matching text inside it, or a URL fragment pointing at an element inside it, opens the item automatically. Supported in Chrome 102+ and Firefox 148+, not Safari; where unsupported it behaves as the default (no match, open manually). keepMounted is ignored while it is on, since the panel must stay mounted. motion.css handles the opacity transition as usual; a find match opens the item immediately without the transition.

api.name: AccordionItem
api.description: 一项的身份与禁用。
api.descriptionEn: One item's identity and disabled state.

props.name: value / disabled
props.description: 稳定项标识与单项禁用。
props.descriptionEn: A stable item identifier and per-item disabling.

api.name: AccordionHeader / AccordionTrigger / AccordionPanel
api.description: 原生 heading、Button 组合与关联内容；支持 render/ref/事件和状态 className。标题层级由调用方 render 调整。
api.descriptionEn: Native heading, Button composition, and associated content. Forward render, refs, events, and state className. The caller sets the heading level through render.

keyboard.description: 切换当前项。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Toggle the current item.

keyboard.description: 访问启用触发与展开内容中的控件。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach enabled triggers and controls in expanded content.

notes: 名称必须说明被展开的内容。
单段内容使用 Collapsible；不得用隐藏内容暗示已经阅读或完成。
keepMounted 保留真实表单字段，应用决定是否禁用隐藏字段。
notesEn: Names must identify the content being disclosed.
Use Collapsible for a single section. Hidden content does not imply reading or completion.
keepMounted retains actual form fields; the application determines whether hidden fields are disabled.

whenToUse: 有限的同组内容需要主动选择展开。
avoid: 唯一关键后果仅存在于默认隐藏内容。
composition: Item 包含 Header/Trigger 与 Panel；默认 Trigger 复用 Button。

library: 展开状态、ARIA 关联与原语键盘。
application: 项内容、稳定标识、输入和业务事实。

responsive: 长名称与内容换行；不以固定高度裁去文字。
customization: 使用现有 field gap 和文字角色，入退归 motion.css。

whenToUse: A finite group of content needs deliberate disclosure.
avoid: Putting the only critical consequence in initially hidden content.
composition: Item contains Header/Trigger and Panel; the default Trigger uses Button.

library: Expansion state, ARIA associations, and primitive keyboard behavior.
application: Item content, stable identifiers, inputs, and business facts.

responsive: Long names and content wrap instead of being cut by a fixed height.
customization: Existing field gaps and text roles; motion.css owns entry and exit.

metadata.title: 决定对话框 AlertDialog
metadata.description: 阻断整个工作面，要求对当前对象作出明确选择。
metadata.descriptionEn: Block the work surface for an explicit decision about the current object.
metadata.decisions: 点遮罩不关闭，默认聚焦面板。Esc 与返回按钮只关闭对话框；继续动作由调用方处理。
metadata.decisionsEn: Backdrop presses do not dismiss it; focus starts on the panel. Escape and the return button only close the dialog. The caller handles the affirmative action.

api.name: AlertDialog
api.description: 保留 open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange/handle；原语固定阻断并禁止外部指针关闭。
api.descriptionEn: Keep open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange/handle; the primitive enforces modality and prevents outside-pointer dismissal.

api.name: AlertDialogPopup
api.description: 与 Dialog 同样的承载结构与内容尺寸关系，默认聚焦面板。
api.descriptionEn: Use the same structure and content-driven sizing as Dialog, defaulting focus to the panel.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: 可指定保留动作、确认字段或可聚焦标题；危险按钮不得作为默认落点。
props.descriptionEn: Choose a protective action, confirmation field or focusable heading. Avoid initial focus on a danger action.

props.name: finalFocus
props.description: 触发者移除后由应用指定有意义的上级。
props.descriptionEn: Specify a meaningful surviving parent when the trigger is removed.

props.name: portalProps / backdropProps / viewportProps
props.description: 透传承载层的容器、样式、render、ref 与原生属性。
props.descriptionEn: Forward containers, styles, render, refs and native attributes to structural layers.

api.name: AlertDialogTitle / AlertDialogDescription
api.description: 说明当前选择与必要后果，建立可访问关联。后果写在 Description 里，按钮不承载。
api.descriptionEn: Name the decision and its consequences with accessible associations. The consequence belongs in Description; buttons carry none.

api.name: AlertDialogTrigger / AlertDialogClose
api.description: 默认组合 Button。Close 离开提示、不执行继续动作；不给 children 时名称是「返回」（不叫「取消」：它不撤销已发生的事），给了就用调用方的，如“保留”。
api.descriptionEn: Compose Button by default. Close leaves the prompt and does not run the affirmative action. Without children its name is Back (not Cancel: it undoes nothing); children override it, such as Keep.

api.name: AlertDialogHeader / AlertDialogPanel / AlertDialogFooter
api.description: 复用 Dialog 的名称、工作内容与动作分组，具有各自 data-slot。
api.descriptionEn: Reuse Dialog's title, working-content and action groups with distinct data-slot hooks.

api.name: AlertDialogCreateHandle / AlertDialogPrimitive
api.description: 共享触发 handle 和所用 Base UI 原语命名空间。
api.descriptionEn: Shared-trigger handle and the Base UI primitive namespace.

keyboard.description: 打开决定。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Open the decision.

keyboard.description: 在最上层决定内循环，背景不可操作。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Cycle within the topmost decision while the background is unavailable.

keyboard.description: 离开这次决定并返回；危险动作不执行。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Leave this decision and return without executing the danger action.

notes: 普通编辑使用 Dialog；不需要中断时用就地确认或面板。
后果必须在对话框里可见（Description）；说明较长时放进 AlertDialogPanel，页眉与页脚固定，只有它滚动。
关闭与继续动作分别处理。
必须提供明确的返回选择，不能只依赖 Esc。
共享层级按真实开启顺序使新工作面高于旧面候选；调用方覆盖 zIndex 可破坏默认关系。
ARIA实测驱动的契约收窄：Portal固定keepMounted=false，JS传true也不保留关闭DOM。应用显式持有草稿；Primitive自行组合未修复该原语缺陷。
notesEn: Use Dialog for ordinary edits, or inline confirmation when interruption is unnecessary.
Keep the consequence visible in the dialog (Description); put long explanations in AlertDialogPanel so the header and footer stay fixed and only it scrolls.
Handle closing and the affirmative action separately.
Provide an explicit return choice; Escape alone is insufficient.
Shared layers put a newly opened surface above older owned popups. Caller zIndex overrides can break that relationship.
ARIA evidence narrows the contract: Portal forces keepMounted=false, even for JavaScript callers passing true. The application holds drafts explicitly; direct Primitive composition remains affected.

whenToUse: 必须在继续前回应的决定。
avoid: 通知、成功反馈、可就地编辑的内容。
composition: 返回与继续动作同处，必要后果可关联。

library: open、焦点困住、滚动锁、背景阻断和返回。
application: 决定内容、后果与继续动作。

responsive: 内容决定宽度，视口限制上限；本批只验桌面。
customization: 与 Dialog 复用圆角、表面、遮罩及阴影角色。
默认进入面板；入退只由 motion.css 提供。

whenToUse: A decision requiring a response before proceeding.
avoid: Notifications, success feedback, or content that can be edited in place.
composition: Return and continue actions appear together, with necessary consequences associated.

library: Open state, focus trapping, scroll lock, background blocking, and return.
application: Decision content, consequences, and continuing actions.

responsive: Content determines width within viewport limits; this batch checked desktop only.
customization: Shares Dialog radius, surfaces, backdrop, and shadow roles.
Focus enters the panel by default; motion.css alone supplies entry and exit.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 就地说明 Alert
metadata.description: 静态就地说明，按实际需要显式宣告。
metadata.descriptionEn: Static local information, with announcements only when requested.
metadata.decisions: 不要为每段静态说明自动添加 assertive 宣告。
metadata.decisionsEn: Static explanations should not automatically make assertive announcements.

whenToUse: 说明当前对象的条件、后果或已知结果。
avoid: 不要为每段静态说明自动添加 assertive 宣告。
composition: Title / Description 可与现有 Button 组合；默认无 live 角色。

library: 原生语义、公共组合与集中角色。
application: 对象、内容、值、状态与请求结果。

responsive: 标题与说明开放排布；长中英文允许换行。
customization: 使用公开 render/ref、ARIA、事件与样式；不混用主题三轴。

whenToUse: Explain conditions, consequences, or known results for the current object.
avoid: Automatically making assertive announcements for static explanations.
composition: Compose Title/Description with existing Button controls; there is no default live role.

library: Native semantics, public composition, and centralized roles.
application: Objects, content, values, states, and request outcomes.

responsive: Titles and explanations use open layout; long text in either language wraps.
customization: Public render/refs, ARIA, events, and styles; keep theme axes independent.

api.name: Alert
api.description: Title / Description 可与现有 Button 组合；默认无 live 角色。
api.descriptionEn: Compose Title/Description with existing Button controls; there is no default live role.

props.name: tone
props.description: 已声明事实的类别。色相之外还有形状不同的默认图标，与只给读屏的类别前缀（「警告：」等，随语言）；neutral 无类别，两者都没有。去掉图标不去掉前缀。
props.descriptionEn: The declared kind of fact. Besides hue there is a default icon of a distinct shape and a screen-reader-only category prefix ("Warning: " and so on, per locale); neutral has no category and neither. Removing the icon does not remove the prefix.

props.name: icon
props.description: 类别图标。省略时 info、warning、danger、success 各有形状不同的默认图标（圆、三角、八角、圆加勾），neutral 没有；传节点则替换；false 不放图标。
props.descriptionEn: Category icon. Omitted: info, warning, danger and success each get a default icon of a different shape (circle, triangle, octagon, circle with check); neutral has none. A node replaces it; false places no icon.

props.name: role
props.description: 仅确有宣告需求时由调用方显式传入。
props.descriptionEn: The caller supplies these only when an announcement is needed.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 属性、事件与ref透传实际元素；样式由className/style调整。
props.descriptionEn: Forward attributes, events, and refs to the actual element; adjust presentation through className/style.

api.name: AlertTitle
api.description: 就地说明标题；可透传 render 与原生属性。
api.descriptionEn: An in-place explanatory title; forwards render and native props.

api.name: AlertDescription
api.description: 就地说明正文；长文本允许换行。
api.descriptionEn: In-place explanatory text that permits long content to wrap.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 异步内容 AsyncContent
metadata.description: 分别呈现请求状态与仍然有效的内容。
metadata.descriptionEn: Present request status separately from content that remains valid.
metadata.decisions: status 是最近请求的事实，hasContent 是应用对现有内容有效性的判断。首次加载没有内容；后台刷新和刷新失败保留内容及其组件身份。只有 success 且 hasContent=false 呈现空态。权限变化若使旧内容失效，应用须同时撤下它。
metadata.decisionsEn: status describes the latest request; hasContent says whether existing content is still valid. Initial loading has no content; refresh and refresh failure retain content and component identity. Only success with hasContent=false shows an empty state. Applications must remove content if a permission change invalidates it.

api.name: AsyncContent
api.description: 不发请求的内容状态组合。
api.descriptionEn: A content-state composition that makes no requests.

props.name: status
props.description: 应用声明请求事实，不用超时猜测失败。
props.descriptionEn: Application-declared request fact; elapsed time never implies failure.

props.name: hasContent / children
props.description: 有效内容保持挂载；不会自动禁用、清空草稿或移动焦点。
props.descriptionEn: Valid content stays mounted without automatic disabling, draft clearing or focus movement.

props.name: emptyContent / loadingContent / errorContent
props.description: emptyContent 必填；error 状态必须提供 errorContent。加载默认读 locale。重试动作由应用提供。
props.descriptionEn: emptyContent is required; error requires errorContent. Loading defaults to the locale. The app supplies retry actions.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 实际根节点的语义与属性；根节点本身不是 live region，只有 error 反馈带 role=alert。
props.descriptionEn: Semantics and props for the actual root; the root is not a live region, only error feedback carries role=alert.

whenToUse: 首次加载、零结果、失败和保留有效内容的刷新。
avoid: 把权限、只读或局部失败塞进互斥的整页请求状态。
用本组件管理请求、缓存或查询竞态。
composition: 权限与只读说明放在 children 的相应部位；局部失败使用局部 AsyncContent 或 Alert。

library: 反馈与内容的稳定结构，pending 时保留内容区的 aria-busy；加载提示作为它的兄弟节点，避免播报被 busy 祖先延迟。
application: 请求、取消、迟到结果隔离、数据有效性、权限、草稿与重试。

responsive: 不创建滚动区；长反馈和恢复动作由所组合组件换行。

whenToUse: Initial loading, confirmed empty results, failure and refresh with retained valid content.
avoid: Collapsing permission, read-only or partial failure into a mutually exclusive page request state.
Managing requests, caches or query races here.
composition: Place permission and read-only notices next to relevant content; use a local AsyncContent or Alert for partial failures.

library: Stable feedback/content structure, aria-busy on retained content while pending; loading feedback is a sibling so a busy ancestor does not defer its announcement.
application: Requests, cancellation, stale response isolation, validity, permissions, drafts and retries.

responsive: Adds no scroll owner; composed feedback and recovery controls handle wrapping.

notes: error 状态的反馈由组件包在 role=alert 里宣告，errorContent 不必再自带 role=alert（嵌套会重复播报）；有效内容不设为 live region。
反馈固定排在内容之后：刷新与失败时正在阅读的内容不被推动，只有其后的元素随反馈占位而移动。
hasContent 表示当前可呈现的内容，不等同于曾经成功过；筛选范围或权限变化后，由应用判断旧内容是否仍有效。
notesEn: Error feedback is wrapped in role=alert by the component, so errorContent need not add its own (nesting announces twice); retained content is never made live.
Feedback always follows the content: refresh and failure do not push the content being read, only elements after it move with the feedback.
hasContent means content is currently usable, not that a past request once succeeded. The app re-evaluates validity after scope or permission changes.

metadata.title: 建议输入 Autocomplete
metadata.description: 编辑自由文本，候选作为可接受的建议。
metadata.descriptionEn: Edit free text with optional suggestions.
metadata.decisions: 输入文字本身就是值。移动候选高亮不改变文本；确认建议才请求替换，文本无需匹配候选也可提交。
metadata.decisionsEn: The text itself is the value. Highlighting does not change it; accepting a suggestion requests replacement. Text can submit without matching a suggestion.

api.name: Autocomplete
api.description: Base UI 文本建议上下文，固定 list 模式。
api.descriptionEn: A Base UI text-suggestion context fixed to list mode.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: 受控或非受控自由文本；details.cancel() 可拒绝编辑或接受建议请求。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or uncontrolled free text. details.cancel() can reject edits or suggestion requests.

props.name: items / itemToStringValue / filter
props.type: readonly Value[] / Base UI public props
props.description: 提供平坦建议数组、建议文字与过滤规则；对象建议显式定义文本。分组建议用 { value: 组名, items } 形态，配合 AutocompleteGroup。
props.descriptionEn: Provide flat suggestions, their text, and filtering. Define text for object suggestions. Group suggestions with the { value: label, items } shape and AutocompleteGroup.

props.name: name / form / required / disabled / readOnly
props.description: 实际 Input 与 Field 注册一次，FormData 提交自由文本；只读提交、禁用排除。
props.descriptionEn: The actual input registers Field once and submits free text. Read-only submits; disabled is excluded.

props.name: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: 展开可控；文本、动作与建议项共用一套几何，跟随密度轴。
props.descriptionEn: Opening is controllable. Input, actions, and suggestions share one geometry that follows the density axis.

api.name: AutocompleteInput / AutocompleteTrigger / AutocompleteClear
api.description: 共享 Input/Button 的真实出口，透传 ref/render/ARIA/events；清除请求空文本。
api.descriptionEn: Real Input/Button outlets forwarding refs, render, ARIA, and events. Clear requests empty text.

api.name: AutocompletePopup
api.description: 公开候选 Portal/Positioner/Popup；container/positionerProps 透传并消费共享浮层层级。
api.descriptionEn: Public candidate Portal/Positioner/Popup forwarding container and positionerProps with shared layer order.

api.name: AutocompleteList / AutocompleteItem / AutocompleteEmpty
api.description: 建议集合、文字建议与调用方真实空内容。
api.descriptionEn: Suggestion list, text suggestions, and caller-provided real empty content.

api.name: AutocompleteGroup / AutocompleteGroupLabel / AutocompleteSeparator / AutocompleteCollection
api.description: 分组建议，与 Combobox 同一套：items 用 { value: 组名, items }，列表以函数子级逐组渲染，组内用 AutocompleteCollection。画法与 Select、Combobox 的分组同一来源。
api.descriptionEn: Grouped suggestions, the same set as Combobox: items use { value: label, items }; the list renders group by group with AutocompleteCollection inside. Drawn like Select and Combobox groups.

api.name: AutocompleteStatus
api.description: 列表自身状态的读屏播报（loading、count 或 children），与 ComboboxStatus 同一规则：保持挂载、默认只给读屏；「没有结果」归 AutocompleteEmpty。
api.descriptionEn: Screen-reader announcements about the list itself (loading, count, or children), with the same rule as ComboboxStatus: stay mounted, screen-reader only by default; "no results" belongs to AutocompleteEmpty.

props.name: loading / count / visible
props.description: 加载中、结果数、是否同时显示。
props.descriptionEn: Loading, result count, and whether to also show it.

api.name: AutocompletePrimitive
api.description: 安装版 Base UI Autocomplete 命名空间。
api.descriptionEn: The installed Base UI Autocomplete namespace.

keyboard.description: 高亮建议，输入文字与 FormData 保持当前文本。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Highlight suggestions while text and FormData retain the current value.

keyboard.description: 请求接受高亮建议的文字。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Request the highlighted suggestion text.

keyboard.description: 退出列表，输入仍可编辑与提交。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Leave the list; text remains editable and submittable.

notes: 需要只能确认候选中的一个值时用 Combobox。
空集合不代表错误或服务失败；空提示由调用方根据真实情况提供；省略 children 时用内置的「没有可选项」。
caller 定位 style 最后合并；颜色、圆角、高亮与焦点读取现有主题角色。
命令面板用 Command。
notesEn: Use Combobox when a value must be confirmed from candidates.
An empty set does not imply an error or service failure. Supply empty content from real facts; an empty AutocompleteEmpty uses the built-in "No options".
Caller positioning style merges last; colors, corners, highlights, and focus use existing theme roles.
Use Command for a command palette.

composition: Field + FieldLabel + Autocomplete / Input / actions / Popup / List / Item

library: 建议高亮、焦点、非受控文本
application: 受控文本、建议数据、错误与提交结果

responsive: 一套几何，跟随密度轴，紧凑不缩小文字；浮层受可用空间约束
customization: 公开 parts/原语、render/ref/ARIA/events 与共享浮层

composition: Field + FieldLabel + Autocomplete / Input / actions / Popup / List / Item

library: Suggestion highlighting, focus, and uncontrolled text.
application: Controlled text, suggestion data, errors, and submission outcomes.

responsive: One geometry following the density axis; compact tightens the container, never the text; the popup is constrained by available space.
customization: Public parts/primitives, render/refs/ARIA/events, and shared floating layers.

metadata.title: 身份图像 Avatar
metadata.description: 同一身份视觉样本的图片与回退。
metadata.descriptionEn: An image with one named identity and a fallback.
metadata.decisions: 不要虚构姓名或让 initials 代替可访问名称。
metadata.decisionsEn: Do not invent a name or let initials replace an accessible name.

whenToUse: 需要一张有名称的身份图像或明确回退。
avoid: 不要虚构姓名或让 initials 代替可访问名称。
composition: Image / Fallback 使用 Base UI 加载事实；label 命名同一对象。

library: 原生语义、公共组合与集中角色。
application: 对象、内容、值、状态与请求结果。

responsive: 五档图像样本采用独立尺寸角色及同名文字档；Fallback 是短内容，完整身份由根的可访问名称提供。
customization: 使用公开 render/ref、ARIA、事件与样式；不混用主题三轴。

whenToUse: A named identity image or explicit fallback is needed.
avoid: Inventing names or replacing an accessible name with initials.
composition: Image/Fallback use Base UI loading facts; label names the same object.

library: Native semantics, public composition, and centralized roles.
application: Objects, content, values, states, and request outcomes.

customization: Public render/refs, ARIA, events, and styles; keep theme axes independent.

api.description: Image / Fallback 使用 Base UI 加载事实；label 命名同一对象。

props.name: Image src / alt / onLoadingStatusChange

props.name: Fallback children / delay

api.name: AvatarImage
api.description: 实际图片元素；透传 src、alt 与加载状态事件。

api.name: AvatarFallback
api.description: 真实缺图、加载失败时的调用方短回退内容；delay 仅控制显示时机。

metadata.decisions: 状态事实使用 StatusDot，不让标记宣布成功。

avoid: 状态事实使用 StatusDot，不让标记宣布成功。
composition: className、style 与 render 属于标记；标记没有尺寸档，与它标注的那段文字同大。

library: 原生语义、公共组合与集中角色。
application: 对象、内容、值、状态与请求结果。

responsive: 标记随所处文字缩放；短标记可换行，不吞掉内容。
customization: 使用公开 render/ref、ARIA、事件与样式；不混用主题三轴。

whenToUse: Short categories, annotations, or emphasis markers.
avoid: Use StatusDot for actual states; a badge cannot establish success.
composition: className, style, and render belong to the marker; a marker has no size scale and matches the text it annotates.

library: Native semantics, public composition, and centralized roles.
application: Objects, content, values, states, and request outcomes.

responsive: The marker scales with the text it sits in; short markers may wrap without losing content.
customization: Public render/refs, ARIA, events, and styles; keep theme axes independent.

api.name: Badge
api.description: className、style 与 render 属于标记；标记没有尺寸档，与它标注的那段文字同大。

props.name: variant
props.description: neutral 是浓墨的字；emphasis 是焦墨加中等字重，要读者注意但不归入状态类别，所以不用色相。
props.descriptionEn: neutral is medium-ink text; emphasis is full ink with medium weight, drawing attention without a state category, so it uses no hue.

props.name: tone
props.description: 调用方声明的状态类别：该状态的文字色加中等字重。组件不从文字猜类别。
props.descriptionEn: A state category declared by the caller: that state's text color with medium weight. The component never infers the category from text.

metadata.title: 路径 Breadcrumb
metadata.description: 父级链接与明确的当前位置。
metadata.descriptionEn: Parent links and an explicit current location.
metadata.decisions: 有序列表表达路径；Current 显式标记应用当前位置，分隔符不进入可访问名称。
metadata.decisionsEn: An ordered list expresses the path; Current identifies the supplied location and separators are decorative.

whenToUse: 对象有明确父级路径，直达后仍需识别位置。
avoid: 平级目的地切换用 NavigationMenu 或普通导航链接，不虚构父级。

library: 原生导航、列表、当前页语义与焦点。
application: 真实父级路径、当前位置及导航目标。

responsive: 长路径换行，保留完整位置名称。

whenToUse: An object has an actual parent path and direct arrivals need to identify their location.
avoid: Use NavigationMenu or ordinary links for peer destinations; do not invent parents.

library: Native navigation, lists, current-page semantics, and focus.
application: Actual parent paths, current location, and navigation targets.

responsive: Long paths wrap while retaining full location names.

api.name: Breadcrumb
api.description: 有名称的 nav。
api.descriptionEn: A named nav.

props.name: aria-label / render / ref / native props
props.description: 默认名称来自 locale，属性转发实际导航。
props.descriptionEn: The default name is localized; props reach actual navigation.

api.name: BreadcrumbList / BreadcrumbItem
api.description: ol / li 保留路径顺序。
api.descriptionEn: ol / li preserve ancestor order.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: 仅 BreadcrumbList。整数，≥ 3；路径项数超过它时保留第一项与最后 maxItems − 2 项，中间折叠成一个「更多」按钮（名称取 locale 的「更多」），点开是 Menu，被折叠项里的 BreadcrumbLink 成为菜单里的链接（href、render、事件原样转发），键盘与读屏可达。被折叠的项必须含 BreadcrumbLink。只按项数折叠，不按宽度：宽度驱动的折叠会让同一页面在不同窗口下露出不同路径，且需要测量，留作观察。不设置则完整显示。
props.descriptionEn: BreadcrumbList only. An integer of at least 3. When the path has more items, the first and the last maxItems − 2 stay and the middle folds into one More button (named from the locale), which opens a Menu whose entries are the folded items' BreadcrumbLinks (href, render and events forwarded), reachable by keyboard and screen reader. Folded items must hold a BreadcrumbLink. Folding follows the item count, not the width: width-driven folding would show different paths in different windows and needs measuring, so it stays under observation. Unset shows the full path.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 替换元素须保留列表语义。
props.descriptionEn: Rendered replacements must retain list semantics.

api.name: BreadcrumbLink
api.description: 真实链接。
api.descriptionEn: A real anchor.

props.name: href / render / ref / native props
props.description: 导航目的、事件与 ref 属于实际链接。
props.descriptionEn: Destination, events and ref belong to the actual link.

api.name: BreadcrumbCurrent
api.description: 默认 span，aria-current=page。
api.descriptionEn: A span with aria-current=page.

props.name: children / render / native props
props.description: 需要当前页链接时可 render 为 a。
props.descriptionEn: Render an anchor when the current location must remain a link.

api.name: BreadcrumbSeparator
api.description: 装饰分隔符。
api.descriptionEn: A decorative separator.

props.name: children / render / native props
props.description: 默认斜线是预设；只放在 li 内。
props.descriptionEn: The slash is a preset; place it inside a li.

keyboard.description: 原生链接聚焦与导航。

keyboard.description: 打开折叠项菜单，方向键移动，Enter 前往，Esc 关闭并回到按钮。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Open the folded-items menu; arrows move, Enter follows, Esc closes and returns to the button.

notes: 不读取 URL、历史或自动创建父级；ol 直接子项必须是 li。
dir="rtl" 下分隔箭头随阅读方向翻转。
notesEn: Does not read URLs or history or create ancestors; direct ol children must be li.
Under dir="rtl" the separator arrow flips with the reading direction.

metadata.title: 批量操作 BulkActionBar
metadata.description: 明确对象、版本与范围的共同动作。
metadata.descriptionEn: Shared actions with explicit targets, versions and scope.
metadata.decisions: targets 与 scope 必填；执行传递当前对象版本快照，零选择禁止执行。
metadata.decisionsEn: Targets and scope are required; execution receives the current target/version snapshot, and zero selection prevents execution.

api.name: BulkActionBar
api.description: 可识别的作用对象与范围。
api.descriptionEn: Identifiable operation targets and scope.

props.name: targets / scope
props.description: 每项 id/label/version 必填，id 唯一；version=0 合法；scope 非空。
props.descriptionEn: Each target requires id, label and version; IDs are unique, version=0 is valid and scope is nonempty.

props.name: extent
props.description: 应用定义的整个集合（count 为正整数、label 非空）；显示计数与 label 而不列对象，targets 可为空，快照带 extent，由应用按自己持有的查询执行。
props.descriptionEn: An application-defined whole set (positive integer count, nonempty label); shows count and label instead of listing targets, targets may be empty, and the snapshot carries extent for the application to execute against its own query.

props.name: sticky
props.description: 吸附在最近的滚动容器顶端（Workspace 中为 WorkspaceContent），不能放进带 overflow 的中间容器；吸住且有内容滚过时才出现分界线（data-stuck）。
props.descriptionEn: Sticks to the nearest scroll container (WorkspaceContent in a Workspace); do not place it inside an intermediate overflow container. The divider appears only while stuck with content scrolling beneath (data-stuck).

props.name: disabled / onClear
props.description: 清除收到当前快照，不取消服务或自行清空应用状态。
props.descriptionEn: Clear receives the current snapshot; it never cancels a service or clears application state itself.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: BulkActionBarExtend
api.description: 把本页选择扩展为整个集合的入口；仅在调用方渲染时出现，不推断是否还有更多。
api.descriptionEn: Entry that extends the page selection to the whole set; it appears only when rendered and never infers whether more exist.

props.name: count / onExtend
props.description: 默认文字「选择全部 N 项」，数字按界面语言分组；onClick.preventDefault() 取消。
props.descriptionEn: Default text is Select all N items with locale-grouped digits; onClick.preventDefault() cancels.

api.name: BulkActionBarActions / BulkActionBarAction / BulkActionBarClear
api.description: 同组动作与清除选择。
api.descriptionEn: Related actions and selection clearing.

props.name: onExecute
props.description: onClick.preventDefault() 取消；危险操作需另外提供后果保护。
props.descriptionEn: onClick.preventDefault() cancels execution; dangerous actions require separate consequence protection.

props.name: Button props
props.description: 尺寸、ref、render 与真实禁用消费当前 Button。
props.descriptionEn: Sizes, refs, render and actual disabled behavior use the current Button.

notes: 库显示对象版本而不推断新旧；应用在执行边界复核实际版本。
notesEn: The library displays versions without judging freshness; applications revalidate actual versions at execution.

whenToUse: 已明确选择对象的共同操作。
avoid: 工具组 Toolbar 不能推断对象或版本；不造后端确认。

library: 快照传递、范围呈现与零选择禁用。
application: 对象、版本、范围、权限、后果与执行结果。

responsive: 桌面保持真实结构；菜单受可用空间限制，表格保留完整比较列。
customization: 控件档案、间距和浮层表面消费现有角色；具体外观是预设。

whenToUse: Shared actions for explicitly selected objects.
avoid: Toolbar cannot infer objects or versions; do not invent backend confirmation.

library: Snapshot delivery, scope presentation, and disabling zero-selection actions.
application: Objects, versions, scope, permissions, consequences, and execution outcomes.

responsive: Keep actual desktop structure; menus fit available space and tables retain complete comparison columns.
customization: Control profiles, spacing, and popup surfaces consume existing roles; their appearance is a preset.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 动作组 ButtonGroup
metadata.description: 为同一范围的动作提供共同名称与间隔。
metadata.descriptionEn: Give actions in one scope a shared name and spacing.
metadata.decisions: 共同名称说明范围，每个按钮仍说明自己的动作。ButtonGroup 不选择按钮、不传播禁用，也不建立工具栏键盘行为。
metadata.decisionsEn: The shared name identifies the scope; each button still names its action. ButtonGroup adds no selection, disabled propagation or toolbar keyboard behavior.

whenToUse: 几个动作属于同一可命名的范围。
avoid: 用动作组替代单选、多选或工具栏。
composition: 复用 Group 和 action-gap；成员使用 Button，真实状态仍在成员处表达。

library: 原生 group 角色与动作间隔。
application: 范围、名称与各动作状态。

responsive: 横向默认换行，也可纵向；不合并成员轮廓。
customization: className 与 render 属于组；不统一改写子按钮。

whenToUse: Several actions share a named scope.
avoid: Replacing single/multiple selection or a toolbar with an action group.
composition: Use Group and action-gap; Button members retain their own actual states.

library: Native group semantics and action spacing.
application: Scope, name, and each action's state.

responsive: Horizontal groups wrap by default; vertical groups are available. Member contours stay independent.
customization: className and render belong to the group; do not rewrite every child Button.

api.name: ButtonGroup
api.description: 默认 role=group 的开放动作关系。
api.descriptionEn: An open action relationship with role=group by default.

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby
props.description: 必填其一：动作范围的共同名称，不替代按钮名称；缺失或为空时抛错。
props.descriptionEn: One is required: the shared scope name, separate from action names. A missing or blank name throws.

props.name: orientation
props.description: 布局方向。
props.descriptionEn: Layout direction.

props.name: align / wrap / render / ref / 原生属性
props.nameEn: align / wrap / render / ref / native props
props.description: 沿用 Group 的组合入口，间隔默认 action-gap。
props.descriptionEn: Uses Group composition props with action spacing.

keyboard.description: 依次访问每个可用按钮，禁用按钮不进入焦点顺序。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Visit each available action; disabled actions leave the tab order.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 按钮 Button
metadata.description: 触发有明确对象与后果的动作；状态由调用方持有。
metadata.descriptionEn: Trigger a named action with a clear object and consequence. The caller owns its state.
metadata.decisions: 按钮只触发动作，忙碌是它唯一的状态：忙碌时保留焦点并阻止重复触发。成功、失败与结果未知是另一件事实，由提示组件表达（就地说明用 Alert，短暂反馈用 Toast，字段错误用 FieldError）；后果与确认属于 AlertDialog。色调不代表授权。
metadata.decisionsEn: A button only triggers an action, and busy is its only state: while busy it retains focus and blocks repeated activation. Success, failure and an unknown result are separate facts expressed by feedback components (Alert in place, Toast for brief feedback, FieldError for a field); consequences and confirmation belong to AlertDialog. Tone never grants permission.

whenToUse: 执行有对象与后果的命令、提交表单或停止当前任务。
avoid: 导航用原生链接。
把结果写进按钮：忙碌结束不等于成功，失败与结果未知用 Alert、Toast 或 FieldError 表达。
composition: 有不可逆后果的动作：按钮只是入口，打开 AlertDialog（或 ConfirmAction），后果写在对话框的说明里；确认条件、权限与远端核实属于应用。
按下后保持的二态（已选中、已开启）用 Toggle；几个里选一个用 SegmentedControl，可多选用 ToggleGroup。Button 只触发动作，不持有选中。

library: 原生与非原生命令语义、焦点、忙碌时的激活保护与读屏说法。
application: 对象、范围、后果、权限、请求事实、核实、恢复与取消后台任务。

responsive: 尺寸按位置选择；长标签可换行增高，图标形态保留同档几何；触摸命中区独立于外观。
customization: variant、tone、size 与 shape 分别选择呈现、后果、尺寸与内容形态。

whenToUse: Run a command with an object and consequence, submit a form, or stop the current task.
avoid: Use native links for navigation.
Writing the result into the button: the end of busy does not establish success; express failure and unknown results with Alert, Toast or FieldError.
composition: For an irreversible action the button is only the entry: it opens AlertDialog (or ConfirmAction), whose description states the consequence. Applications own confirmation criteria, permissions, and remote verification.
A two-state fact that persists after pressing (selected, on) is a Toggle; one of several is SegmentedControl, several of several is ToggleGroup. Button triggers an action and holds no selection.

library: Native and non-native command semantics, focus, and the activation guard and screen-reader wording while busy.
application: Objects, scope, consequences, permissions, request facts, verification, recovery, and background cancellation.

responsive: Choose dimensions for position; long labels may wrap and grow, icons retain matching geometry, and touch targets remain separate from appearance.
customization: variant, tone, size, and shape independently select presentation, consequence, dimensions, and content form.

api.name: Button
api.description: 默认渲染 type=button 的原生按钮，透传原生属性、ref、事件和派生 data-slot。状态不会自行推进。
api.descriptionEn: Renders a native type=button control by default and forwards native attributes, refs, events, and derived data-slot values. It never advances its own operation state.

props.name: variant
props.description: 填充、边框或无边框的表达，不表示权限。
props.descriptionEn: Filled, bordered, or borderless presentation; it does not express permission.

props.name: tone
props.description: 色调。danger 表示动作有不可逆的后果，只改变颜色；后果说明与确认不由按钮承载，用 AlertDialog 或 ConfirmAction。
props.descriptionEn: Tone. danger marks an action with an irreversible consequence and changes color only; the consequence text and confirmation are not carried by the button. Use AlertDialog or ConfirmAction.

props.name: size
props.description: 按所在位置选尺寸，与强调独立。
props.descriptionEn: Choose by position, independently of emphasis.

props.name: shape
props.description: 图标是形态；icon 必须有 aria-label 或 aria-labelledby。
props.descriptionEn: Icon is a shape, not another size. Supply aria-label or aria-labelledby for it.

props.name: loading
props.description: 调用方持有的事实：这个动作正在执行。显示转动的记号、设置 aria-busy、保留焦点并阻止重复触发；按钮不启动请求，也不推断何时结束。
props.descriptionEn: A caller-owned fact: this action is running. Shows a spinning mark, sets aria-busy, retains focus and blocks repeat activation; the button starts no request and never infers when it ends.

props.name: disabled
props.description: 动作不可用，退出 Tab 顺序；可以与 loading 共存。
props.descriptionEn: Makes the action unavailable and removes it from the tab order. It may coexist with loading.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI 组合入口，可渲染其他命令载体或触发器；保留真实语义。
props.descriptionEn: The Base UI composition entry for another command carrier or trigger. Preserve its actual semantics.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description: 非 button 命令载体设为 false，仍使用按钮语义；导航使用原生 a + buttonVariants。
props.descriptionEn: Set false for a non-button command carrier; it retains button semantics. Use a native anchor with buttonVariants for navigation.

api.name: buttonVariants
api.description: 与 Button 同一套尺寸、形态、强调和色调，用于保留原生链接等元素语义的组合。
api.descriptionEn: The same size, shape, emphasis, and tone styles for compositions that retain native element semantics, such as links.

api.name: ButtonPrimitive
api.description: Base UI 无障碍原语；应用优先使用 Button。
api.descriptionEn: The Base UI accessibility primitive. Prefer Button in applications.

keyboard.description: 触发可用动作；忙碌时不触发。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Activate an available action. A busy action does not activate.

keyboard.description: 移入或移出焦点；忙碌时保留位置，disabled 退出 Tab 顺序。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move focus. A busy action retains its position; disabled actions leave the tab order.

keyboard.description: 组合菜单或列表触发器按原语操作；忙碌时阻止展开。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Follow the primitive's menu or list trigger behavior. A busy trigger does not open.

notes: 危险色调只是色调，不代表授权，也不替代确认；需要用户知道后果再决定时用 AlertDialog。
忙碌时动作的可访问名称不变；「进行中」通过 description 与不可见的 live region 告诉读屏，按钮旁没有可见的状态文字。忙碌不改变按钮的外缘尺寸：名称与图形留在原处占位（不可见，仍在无障碍树里），转动的记号叠放在中央。
state（waiting / in-progress / unknown / failed）已移除，改为 loading。原来写在按钮旁的失败与结果未知，改由 Alert、Toast、FieldError 或 StatusDot 表达。
导航使用原生 a / Link + buttonVariants；nativeButton=false 的 Button 仍是命令语义。
小控件通过 touch-target 扩大命中区到本库 44px 目标，密度与外观尺寸不改变这一目标。
实心入口与父表面对比不足时，消费组合通过 className 添加可辨认边界，并使用同档 padding-bordered；同底色边界示例展示这一入口，组件不读取 DOM 推断承载面。
notesEn: Danger is only a tone: it grants no permission and replaces no confirmation. Use AlertDialog when the user must know the consequence before deciding.

While busy the action's accessible name stays unchanged; “In progress” reaches screen readers through a description and an invisible live region, and no visible status text sits beside the button. Busy never changes the button's outer size: the name or glyph keeps its place, unseen but still in the accessibility tree, and the spinning mark is centered over it.

state (waiting / in-progress / unknown / failed) is removed in favour of loading. Failure and unknown results formerly written beside the button are expressed by Alert, Toast, FieldError or StatusDot.
Use a native anchor or router Link with buttonVariants for navigation. A nativeButton=false Button remains a command.
touch-target expands small controls to the library's 44px touch target without changing visual dimensions or shrinking it with density.

When a solid action lacks contrast with its parent, the consumer adds a visible boundary through className and uses the matching padding-bordered profile. The same-surface example demonstrates this entry; the component does not inspect the DOM to infer its surface.

metadata.title: 日历 Calendar
metadata.description: 在当地日历中导航年月，选择单日、多个日期或日期范围。
metadata.descriptionEn: Navigate a local calendar and select a day, multiple dates, or a range.
metadata.decisions: 日历的 Date 按当地年月日解释。范围是否允许同日、哪些日期不可选由调用方声明，库不添加业务时长规则。
metadata.decisionsEn: Dates use local year, month, and day. The caller declares same-day rules and unavailable dates; the library adds no business duration rules.

api.name: Calendar
api.description: 复用安装版 DayPicker 的日期、年月、键盘与选择语义。
api.descriptionEn: Uses the installed DayPicker date, month navigation, keyboard, and selection semantics.

props.name: mode / selected / onSelect / required
props.description: single、multiple、range 各按公开原语类型组合；选中值归调用方，required 限制原语取消选择。
props.descriptionEn: Use the public single, multiple, or range union. The caller owns selection; required limits deselection.

props.name: month / defaultMonth / onMonthChange
props.description: 受控或非受控年月导航；未指定时采用 DayPicker 当前月份默认值。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or uncontrolled month navigation; the primitive defaults to the current month.

props.name: disabled / hidden / startMonth / endMonth
props.description: 明确不可选日期、隐藏日期与导航范围。disabled 不替调用方纠正已有选中值。
props.descriptionEn: Declare unavailable days, hidden days, and navigation bounds. disabled does not repair an existing selection.

props.name: min / max / excludeDisabled
props.description: 范围长度与跨禁用日期的规则由调用方显式声明。默认允许同日完整范围。
props.descriptionEn: The caller declares range length and disabled-day rules. Same-day complete ranges are allowed by default.

props.name: locale / labels / formatters / weekStartsOn
props.description: 默认跟随 UILocale 的语言代码：中文与美式英文用 DayPicker 自带区域；其余语言的月名、星期名、数字由平台 Intl 按代码格式化，周起始日取 Intl.Locale 的周信息（平台没有时退回周日）。显式传入 locale 时全部归调用方；单独传 weekStartsOn 或 formatters 只覆盖那一项（2026-10-12）。
props.descriptionEn: Follows the UILocale code. Chinese and US English use the DayPicker locales; other languages format month names, weekday names, and digits with platform Intl and take the first day of the week from Intl.Locale week info (Sunday where the platform lacks it). An explicit locale prop hands all of this to the caller; weekStartsOn or formatters alone override only that part (2026-10-12).

props.name: captionLayout / startMonth / endMonth
props.description: dropdown 系列把月份或年份画成与 NativeSelect 同一套填值控件，选项范围由 startMonth / endMonth 给出；远日期（生日、证件日期）从这里直达。
props.descriptionEn: The dropdown layouts draw month and year as the same fill-control NativeSelect; startMonth and endMonth give the option range. Use them to reach distant dates such as birthdays.

props.name: render / ref / className / style / classNames / components
props.description: 根出口支持组合；classNames/components 显式覆写实际部位。替换 Root 时由调用方保留 ref 与语义。
props.descriptionEn: Compose the root and override public parts. A custom Root must preserve refs and semantics.

api.name: formatLocalDate / parseLocalDate
api.description: 本地年月日与 YYYY-MM-DD 互转；无效日期拒绝，不经 UTC 移日。
api.descriptionEn: Convert local date fields to and from YYYY-MM-DD. Reject invalid dates without UTC shifts.

api.name: CalendarPrimitive
api.description: 安装版 @daypicker/react 命名空间。
api.descriptionEn: The installed @daypicker/react namespace.

keyboard.description: 由日期原语在真实日历网格中移动焦点。
keyboard.descriptionEn: The date primitive moves focus through the calendar grid.

keyboard.description: 按日期原语规则导航年月。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Navigate months using the primitive's calendar rules.

keyboard.description: 选择聚焦日期，遵守 disabled 与当前选择模式。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Select the focused day within the declared mode and disabled rules.

notes: 本组件不生成原生表单值；用 DatePicker 或在调用方序列化选中日期。
一个月、caption label 与 nav after 是默认布局选择，可通过公共 props 改动。
表面、颜色、圆角与尺寸角色沿用当前主题预设；选中与焦点信号来自真实状态。
从右向左的语言下，翻页箭头镜像；方向取 dir 属性，其次 UILocale，再次祖先元素实际生效的方向。
notesEn: Calendar does not create native form fields. Use DatePicker or serialize selection in the application.
One month, label captions, and navigation after the caption are default layout choices exposed through public props.
Surfaces, colors, corners, and size roles use the current theme presets; selection and focus reflect real state.
In right-to-left languages the month arrows mirror. Direction comes from the dir prop, then UILocale, then the direction in effect on the ancestors.

whenToUse: 需要查看当地年月日并选择日期
avoid: 具有时区或时间点意义的值先在应用确定规则
composition: Calendar 或 Field + DatePicker

library: 日期网格、键盘、非受控导航
application: 选中日期、范围、年月约束与无效事实

responsive: 一套几何，跟随密度轴，紧凑不缩小文字；窄屏 +4px，粗指针实体单元命中
customization: CalendarProps、classNames、components 与集中主题角色

whenToUse: View local calendar dates and select a date.
avoid: The application must establish rules for zoned values or instants first.
composition: Calendar or Field + DatePicker.

library: Date grid, keyboard behavior, and uncontrolled navigation.
application: Selected dates, ranges, month/year constraints, and invalid facts.

responsive: One geometry following the density axis; compact tightens the container, never the text; narrow-screen +4px, and actual coarse-pointer cell targets.
customization: CalendarProps, classNames, components, and central theme roles.
