metadata.title: 卡片 Card
metadata.description: 为可独立识别的对象建立内容边界。
metadata.descriptionEn: Bound an independently identifiable object.

api.name: Card
api.description: 面板表面、边界与圆角。不生成标题、内容槽、内边距或排列方式。
api.descriptionEn: Panel surface, boundary and radius. It supplies no title, content slots, padding or layout.

props.name: render
props.description: 组合为 article、section 或原生链接，完整保留事件与 ref。
props.descriptionEn: Compose an article, section or native link while retaining handlers and refs.

props.name: className / style
props.description: 消费端按对象关系组合布局与内缘；外部类最后合并。
props.descriptionEn: Compose layout and content inset for this object. Caller classes are merged last.

props.name: 原生属性
props.description: 透传 id、aria-*、data-*、事件与 ref。
props.descriptionEn: Forward id, aria-*, data-*, events and ref.

metadata.decisions: 对象无需独立识别、排序或操作时，用标题与间距组织内容。整张 Card 是链接时，内部不能再嵌套按钮或其他链接。
metadata.decisionsEn: Use headings and spacing when content has no independent identity, ordering or actions. A Card rendered as a link cannot contain other links or buttons.
notes: 标题用 Heading 或真实 h2/h3；内容与动作由 Stack、Inline 和原生结构组合。
size、CardHeader/Title/Description/Action/Panel/Content/Footer 与 CardFrame* 已移除。
只有同一轮廓等距内缩时才计算内圆角；独立子控件保留自身圆角。
密度、方向与语言由容器继承；Card 不写入这些标记。
当前默认只有线、面与圆角，没有阴影；这是可逆外观选择，项目按实际关系组合阴影。
notesEn: Use Heading or a real h2/h3, and compose content and actions with Stack, Inline and native structure.
size, CardHeader/Title/Description/Action/Panel/Content/Footer and CardFrame* have been removed.
Calculate an inner radius only for an equally inset contour of the same surface. Independent controls keep their own radii.
Density, direction and language belong to the containing context. Card sets no such markers.
The current default uses a boundary, surface and radius without a shadow. This is a reversible appearance choice; projects can compose shadows where appropriate.

whenToUse: 对象需要独立识别、排序或操作，其边界参与任务关系。
avoid: 去掉边框关系不变的内容；整卡链接嵌套交互；用卡片代替所有分节。
composition: 仅消费 Card 边界；Heading、Stack、Inline、原生表单与列表负责内容关系。

library: 面板边界、表面、圆角与 render 透传。
application: 对象身份、标题级别、布局、草稿与异步事实。

responsive: 消费端允许长标题和动作换行；比较任务保留必要维度。
customization: 通过集中主题调整面板角色，内容布局由组合提供。

whenToUse: An object needs independent identification, ordering, or actions whose boundary supports the task.
avoid: Content whose relationships survive border removal; nested interaction inside a whole-card link; cards for every section.
composition: Consume Card's boundary only; Heading, Stack, Inline, native forms, and lists organize content relationships.

library: Panel boundary, surface, radius, and render forwarding.
application: Object identity, heading levels, layout, drafts, and asynchronous facts.

responsive: Consumers permit long titles and actions to wrap; comparisons retain necessary dimensions.
customization: Adjust panel roles through the central theme; composition supplies content layout.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 级联选择 Cascader
metadata.description: 沿「根到叶」的路径选一个值，每一级的候选各占一列。
metadata.descriptionEn: Choose one value along a root-to-leaf path, with each level's candidates in its own column.

api.name: Cascader
api.description: 触发器、列式候选面与表单值。触发器与 Select 同一套几何；候选面用 Popover 的面板。
api.descriptionEn: Trigger, column-wise candidate popup and form value. The trigger shares Select's geometry; the popup uses Popover's panel.

props.name: options
props.description: 第一列的候选。节点 { value, label, disabled?, children?, isLeaf? }：同一父项下 value 不重复；有 children 的是分支，没有则是叶子（配了 loadChildren 时除外）。
props.descriptionEn: Candidates of the first column. A node is { value, label, disabled?, children?, isLeaf? }; values are unique under one parent. A node with children is a branch, otherwise a leaf (unless loadChildren is set).

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: 从根到所选节点的路径，null 是未选择；省略初值不会选第一项。路径里尚未加载的节点，触发器退回显示它的 value。
props.descriptionEn: The path from the root to the chosen node; null is no selection, and omitting an initial value does not choose the first item. A path segment that is not loaded yet falls back to its value in the trigger.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: 提交了新的路径时调用；第二个参数是路径上各节点。提交相同路径不调用。
props.descriptionEn: Called when a new path is submitted; the second argument is the nodes on the path. Submitting the same path does not call it.

props.name: selectParent
props.description: 默认只有叶子可提交；true 时任意层级都可提交（对应 Ant Design 的 changeOnSelect）。
props.descriptionEn: Only leaves submit by default; with true any level can submit (Ant Design's changeOnSelect).

props.name: loadChildren
props.description: 展开一个没有 children、也没有标 isLeaf 的节点时调用。等待时该列显示「正在加载」，reject 时显示「加载失败」与重试；结果为空数组则该节点成为叶子。结果按路径缓存，组件不重复请求。
props.descriptionEn: Called when a node with neither children nor isLeaf is expanded. While waiting the column shows "Loading"; a rejection shows "Failed to load" with a retry; an empty result makes the node a leaf. Results are cached by path and not requested twice.

props.name: searchable
props.description: 弹层顶部出现搜索输入；有输入时改为一列扁平的匹配路径（用 locale 的路径分隔符连接）。只搜已知节点，未加载的分支不在其中。
props.descriptionEn: A search input appears at the top of the popup; with input the columns give way to one flat list of matching paths joined by the locale separator. Only known nodes are searched, so unloaded branches are not included.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: 仅未选择时显示；不能替代 FieldLabel。
props.descriptionEn: Shown only without selection; cannot replace FieldLabel.

props.name: disabled / readOnly / required
props.description: 只读保留当前值且不打开候选面；禁用的字段不提交；required 参与原生校验并标 aria-required。invalid 跟随 Field。
props.descriptionEn: Read-only keeps the value and never opens the popup; a disabled field is not submitted; required joins native validation and sets aria-required. invalid follows Field.

props.name: name / form
props.description: 隐藏输入的名称与所属表单。提交值是路径各段用 "/" 连接，例如 "zj/hz/xh"，未选择提交空字符串；所以 value 里不应含 "/"。
props.descriptionEn: Name and owning form of the hidden input. The submitted value is the path segments joined with "/", such as "zj/hz/xh"; an empty string when nothing is selected. Values should therefore not contain "/".

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby / id / className
props.description: 触发器的名称与样式入口。没有名称会抛错：用 aria-label、aria-labelledby，或放进带 FieldLabel 的 Field。
props.descriptionEn: Name and styling entries of the trigger. A missing name throws: use aria-label, aria-labelledby, or place it in a Field with a FieldLabel.

keyboard.description: 在触发器上打开候选面，焦点落在当前路径的末项（无值时是第一项）。
keyboard.descriptionEn: On the trigger, open the popup with focus on the last item of the current path (the first item when empty).

keyboard.description: 在当前列内移动。焦点即位置：深于它的列在离开所在项时收起。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move within the current column. Focus is the position: columns deeper than it close when focus leaves their item.

keyboard.description: 有子项时展开并进入下一列首项；子项正在加载时，加载完成后再进入。
keyboard.descriptionEn: With children, expand and enter the first item of the next column; while loading, enter once loading finishes.

keyboard.description: 回到上一列的父项并收起本列。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Return to the parent in the previous column and close this one.

keyboard.description: 可提交的项：提交并关闭，焦点回触发器；不可提交的分支：进入下一列。
keyboard.descriptionEn: On a submittable item, submit and close with focus back on the trigger; on a branch that cannot be submitted, enter the next column.

keyboard.description: 在当前列内按首字母跳转；快速连续输入则按前缀匹配。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Jump by first letter within the column; fast consecutive typing matches by prefix.

keyboard.description: 关闭并回到触发器，保留原值。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Close and return to the trigger, retaining the original value.

keyboard.description: 焦点留在输入里，方向键移动匹配路径的高亮，Enter 提交；输入为空时 ↓ 进入列。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Focus stays in the input; arrows move the highlight over matching paths and Enter submits. With an empty query ↓ enters the columns.

notes: 触发器的文字是完整路径，过长时用省略号截断，完整文字仍在 DOM 里，读屏读到全部。
鼠标点父项只展开；selectParent 时父项同时成为值，弹层保持打开以便继续往下选。键盘上这是两个键：Enter 提交并关闭，→ 展开。
焦点是真实 DOM 焦点（roving tabindex），每列是一个 listbox，名称是它的父项，第一列取触发器的名称。搜索结果例外：焦点留在输入里，用 aria-activedescendant。
选项上的 aria-haspopup 与 aria-expanded 表示「有下一列」与「下一列已展开」。
候选的可见字号与高度与 Select 的候选项相同；每列宽度由内容决定，下限由留白、尾部标记与最小文字区推出，列多时候选面横向滚动。
notesEn: The trigger text is the complete path, truncated with an ellipsis when long; the full text stays in the DOM so assistive technology reads all of it.

A mouse click on a parent only expands it; with selectParent the parent also becomes the value and the popup stays open so you can continue downward. On the keyboard these are two keys: Enter submits and closes, → expands.

Focus is real DOM focus (roving tabindex). Each column is a listbox named by its parent; the first column takes the trigger's name. Search results are the exception: focus stays in the input and aria-activedescendant points at the result.
aria-haspopup and aria-expanded on an option mean "has a next column" and "the next column is open".

Candidates share Select's text size and height. Column width follows content with a lower bound derived from padding, trailing marker and minimum text area; the popup scrolls horizontally when columns are many.
metadata.decisions: 选择的是一条路径，不是最后一项：同名的叶子（不同省的「市辖区」）靠路径区分，所以值、表单与回调都用路径。分支能不能提交由 selectParent 决定，而不是看有没有子项；加载与失败是应用告知之外、组件自己看得见的事实，不会被当成「没有子项」。
metadata.decisionsEn: What is chosen is a path, not the last node: leaves with the same name (a "city district" in different provinces) are told apart by their path, so the value, the form and the callback all use the path. Whether a branch can be submitted is decided by selectParent, not by whether it has children; loading and failure are facts the component sees for itself and are never taken for "no children".

whenToUse: 候选天然成层、要选到某一层的值：地区、类目、组织
avoid: 只有一层候选用 Select，候选很多需过滤用 Combobox
需要多选路径时用 Tree 的勾选形态
要并置比较的少量候选用 RadioGroup
composition: FieldLabel + Cascader + FieldDescription + FieldError

library: 焦点、展开的列、搜索草稿、未受控值、异步结果的缓存与重试
application: 受控值、候选数据、loadChildren 的实际请求、invalid 与保存事实

responsive: 列多时候选面横向滚动，不撑破视口；本批只做桌面检查
customization: 触发器 className、Popover 的面板与定位

whenToUse: Candidates that naturally nest and where a value at some level is wanted: regions, categories, organizations.
avoid: Use Select for a single level and Combobox when many candidates need filtering.
Use Tree's checkable form for choosing several paths.
Use RadioGroup for a few candidates that need side-by-side comparison.
composition: FieldLabel + Cascader + FieldDescription + FieldError.

library: Focus, open columns, the search draft, uncontrolled value, and the cache and retry of async results.
application: Controlled values, candidate data, the actual loadChildren request, invalid and save facts.

responsive: The popup scrolls horizontally when columns are many instead of overflowing the viewport; this batch checked desktop only.
customization: Trigger className, Popover's panel and positioning.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 图表 Chart
metadata.description: 九种由任务选定的形式——折线、柱状、面积、堆叠面积、占比面积、横向柱、堆叠柱、占比柱、环形；同源的图形、命名的轴与按需展开的数据表。
metadata.descriptionEn: Nine task-chosen forms—line, bar, area, area-stacked, area-share, bar-horizontal, bar-stacked, bar-share and donut—with a same-source plot, named axes and an on-demand data table.
metadata.decisions: 图只画数据。已知0、未知和不适用的单个值分别成立：未知值形成gap，表格保留其真实名称。整张图没有记录、结果未知或不适用时不渲染图，由调用方在原位放 Empty。图形不替代可达数值。参照（目标带、参照线）、背景系列与事件只帮读者定位数据，自己不是数据：用墨不用色，名称必填并出现在图例与数据表。量轴只有折线可以不从零起，柱与面积的长度、面积编码一旦截断，比例就是假的。状态色（series[].tone）由应用声明，组件不从数值猜好坏。阶梯（series[].interpolation: "step"）表达值在两次变化之间保持不变，取 step-after：记录是「这一刻起变成了这个值」，step-before 会把变化画到观测之前；不提供平滑曲线，曲线在两点之间画出数据里没有的值。占比构成（bar-share / area-share）读的是构成怎样变而不是多少：各行内归一到该行之和，量轴固定 0–100%，刻度 0/25/50/75/100；含未知或不适用值、或和为 0 的行整行不画（整体不可得，每一部分的占比都会是假的），已知原值在数据表里如实列出；负值抛错。柱上标值（valueLabels）只给单系列的 bar 与 bar-horizontal，标了值就不再画量轴刻度与网格（同一事实不说两遍）。堆叠与占比的读数和数据表给出合计；含缺项的行不合计，数据表里写明缺项。
metadata.decisionsEn: A chart only draws data. A known zero, an unknown value and a not-applicable value remain distinct: unavailable values form gaps and retain their actual names in the table. When the whole chart has no records, an unknown result or does not apply, the chart is not rendered and the caller puts Empty in its place. Plots do not replace reachable numbers. References (target bands and lines), context series and events help locate the data without being data: they are ink, not color, and their names are required and appear in the legend and the data table. Only a line may leave zero on the value axis; bars and areas encode by length or area, so truncating them misstates proportions. Status colors (series[].tone) are declared by the application; the component never guesses good from bad by value. A step (series[].interpolation: "step") says the value is held between two changes and is step-after: a record means "from this moment the value is this", and step-before would draw the change before it was observed; there are no smooth curves, which draw values the data does not contain. Share composition (bar-share / area-share) reads how a composition changes rather than how much: each row is normalised to its own sum, the value axis is fixed at 0–100% with ticks 0/25/50/75/100; a row with an unknown or not-applicable value, or a sum of zero, is not drawn at all (the whole is unavailable, so every share would be false) while its known original values stay in the data table; negative values throw. Value labels (valueLabels) are for single-series bar and bar-horizontal only, and once values are labelled the value-axis ticks and grid are no longer drawn (one fact is not said twice). Readouts and tables of stacked and share forms give a total; a row with a missing part is not totaled and the table says so.

api.name: Chart
api.description: figure名称、共同轴量纲、不同系列形态与同源可见Table。
api.descriptionEn: A named figure, shared axis units, distinct series shapes and a visible same-source Table.

props.name: label
props.description: 非空真实语义名称。
props.descriptionEn: A nonempty semantic name for the actual data.

props.name: framed
props.description: false：图放在已有的面上（无边框的 Section、Card、面板），不铺自己的纸——没有线、底、圆角与内缘，图的左右缘就是承载面的内容缘。与 TableContainer 的 framed 同义。是否显示图内标题与它无关。
props.descriptionEn: false: the chart sits on an existing surface (a borderless Section, Card or panel) and lays no paper of its own — no line, fill, radius or inner padding, so its edges are the host's content edges. Same meaning as TableContainer's framed. Whether the in-chart title shows is independent of it.

props.name: aria-labelledby / aria-label
props.description: 外部名称：传入非空的 aria-labelledby（如 SectionTitle 的 id）或 aria-label 时，figure 由它命名，图内不显示标题；图例与「查看数据」仍在图内、靠行尾，二者都没有时标题栏整行不渲染。不传时由图内标题命名。label 仍必填，是等价数据表的名字。
props.descriptionEn: Outside name: a nonempty aria-labelledby (such as a SectionTitle id) or aria-label names the figure and the in-chart title is not drawn; the legend and Show data stay inside the figure at the row end, and with neither the header row is not rendered. Without one the in-chart title names it. label stays required and names the equivalent data table.

props.name: type
props.description: 由任务选定的形式，不是外观偏好：line 随时间/次序的趋势；bar 类别间比较；area 随时间的量（单系列第一色淡面，多系列默认半透叠放）；area-stacked 随时间的构成（淡色带加足色上沿，彼此相切）；bar-horizontal 类别名长或按大小排序的排行；bar-stacked 类别间的构成比较；bar-share / area-share 构成的占比怎样变（各行归一到该行之和，量轴固定 0–100%，原值与占比同时在读数与数据表里；两个以上系列，值不得为负；含未知 / 不适用值或和为 0 的行不画，已知原值在数据表里如实列出；不接受 references 与 valueDomain）；donut 只用于 2–5 个部分、一眼占比的单个整体（rows 必须正好一行）。必填。
props.descriptionEn: The form chosen by the task, not an appearance preference: line for trends over time/order; bar for category comparison; area for a quantity over time (a first-color wash for one series, translucent overlap by default for several); area-stacked for composition over time (opaque light bands with full-color top edges, touching); bar-horizontal for long category names or size-ordered rankings; bar-stacked for composition comparison between categories; bar-share / area-share for how the share of a composition changes (each row is normalised to its own sum on a fixed 0–100% axis, with original value and share together in the readout and table; two or more series, no negative values; a row with an unknown / not-applicable value or a sum of zero is not drawn while its known original values stay in the data table; references and valueDomain are not accepted); donut only for an at-a-glance share of 2–5 parts in a single whole (rows must be exactly one). Required.

props.name: categoryLabel / valueLabel
props.description: 非空分类轴名与共享量纲/单位；donut 不画轴线，但两个名字仍用于等价数据表与中心读数的说明文字。
props.descriptionEn: Nonempty category axis name and shared value units; donut draws no axis lines, but both names still label the equivalent table and the center readout.

props.name: series
props.type: readonly { key: string; label: string; context?: boolean; tone?: Tone; interpolation?: "linear" | "step" }[]
props.description: 1至5个同量纲系列（donut 要求2至5个；背景系列不计入）。context: true 只用于 line，画成淡墨细线、不画标记、不占身份色与标记名额，另限 12 条；tone 取 danger / warning / success / info，全部非背景系列都声明或都不声明，同一类别不得重复（混用、重复抛错）。interpolation 取 linear（默认）或 step（阶梯，step-after：值从该点起保持到下一点），只对 line、area、area-stacked、area-share 生效，其他类型传入抛错；堆叠与占比的面各带共用边界，必须同一种。只有一个系列时取第一色（文字是墨，数据是色）、不显示图例；两个以上按 chart1..5 的校验顺序取色，并配不同标记形状或图例方块。
props.descriptionEn: One to five series in shared units (donut requires two to five; context series do not count). context: true is for line only: a faint ink hairline with no marker that takes no identity color or marker slot, at most 12; tone takes danger / warning / success / info, declared on every non-context series or none, with no repeated category (mixing or repeating throws). interpolation is linear (default) or step (a staircase, step-after: the value is held from that point to the next) and applies to line, area, area-stacked and area-share only, any other type throws; stacked and share areas share their boundaries, so every series must use the same one. A single series takes the first color (text is ink, data is color) without a legend; two or more take the validated chart1..5 order with distinct marker shapes or legend swatches.

props.name: rows
props.description: 稳定id、分类名称与values；值为finite number或{state:unknown|not-applicable,label}。必须有真实记录；donut 要求正好一行，且每个部分必须是已知的非负数。
props.descriptionEn: Stable ids, category names and values: finite numbers or explicitly named unknown/not-applicable values. ready requires actual records; donut requires exactly one row, with every part a known non-negative number.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: 有背景系列时必填：图例里合成一项的名字（淡墨线键 + 此名），例如「其余蚕室」。背景系列各自的名字只出现在等价数据表。缺失抛错。
props.descriptionEn: Required when there are context series: the one legend entry that stands for them (a faint ink key plus this name), e.g. "Other rooms". Their individual names appear only in the equivalent table. Throws when missing.

props.name: references
props.type: ({ kind: "band"; from: number; to: number; label: string } | { kind: "line"; value: number; label: string })[]
props.description: 量轴上的参照：目标带或参照线（纵向图是横带 / 横线，bar-horizontal 是竖带 / 竖线）。画成墨、在数据之后；量轴范围自动算入；label 必填，出现在图例与数据表下的表注；band 须 from < to，数值有限；donut 传入抛错。有带时悬停读数为每个数值多一行相对目标的位置（高于、低于多少，或在内）；多个带时只对第一个计算。
props.descriptionEn: References on the value axis: a target band or a reference line (horizontal for vertical charts, vertical for bar-horizontal). Drawn in ink behind the data; the value axis range includes them automatically. label is required and appears in the legend and in a note under the data table; a band needs from < to and finite values; a donut throws. With a band, the hover readout adds a line per value for its position against the target (above or below by how much, or within); with several bands only the first is used.

props.name: events
props.type: readonly { rowId: string; label: string; tone?: Tone }[]
props.description: 落在类别轴某一行上的事件：基线处一个圆点（给 tone 时用类别色，否则用墨）。事件名出现在该行的悬停读数，并作为数据表的「事件」一列。rowId 不存在或 donut 传入抛错。
props.descriptionEn: Events on a row of the category axis: a dot on the baseline (category color when tone is given, ink otherwise). The label appears in that row's hover readout and as an "Event" column of the data table. A missing rowId, or a donut, throws.

props.name: valueDomain
props.description: 量轴范围，只对 line 生效：位置编码可以不从零起，例如 80%–100% 的比率。其他类型传入即抛 RangeError（柱与面积用长度、面积编码，必须从零起）。min < max；任何已知值或参照落在范围外抛错——截掉数据与名实不符。刻度取 1、2、2.5、5 乘 10 的幂，最多 6 个。
props.descriptionEn: Value axis range, for line only: position encoding may leave zero, e.g. a ratio from 80% to 100%. Any other type throws a RangeError (bars and areas encode by length or area and must start at zero). min < max; a known value or reference outside the range throws, since cutting data off misstates it. Ticks are 1, 2, 2.5 or 5 times a power of ten, at most six.

props.name: total
props.description: 只用于 donut：整体的总量。省略时等于各部分之和；大于之和时，剩余部分并入「其余」（groove-surface，不是第六种色相）。
props.descriptionEn: Donut only: the whole's total. Defaults to the sum of its parts; a larger value folds the remainder into a neutral "rest" slice (groove-surface, not a sixth hue).

props.name: valueLabels
props.description: 把格式化后的值标在柱的数据端外侧（纵柱在柱顶上方，横柱在末端之后，负值在另一侧）；同时不再画量轴刻度与网格，基线保留。只对 bar 与 bar-horizontal 生效，且只允许单系列、至多 12 行（每根柱的类别带得放得下一个标签）；其他类型、多系列或行数超出抛错。文字用墨阶、dense 档、等宽数字；formatValue 只取字符串或数字结果，返回节点时退回默认数值格式。
props.descriptionEn: Put the formatted value just outside the data end of each bar (above a vertical bar, after the end of a horizontal one, on the other side for negative values); value-axis ticks and grid are then no longer drawn and the baseline stays. Only for bar and bar-horizontal, a single series and at most 12 rows (each category band must hold a label); any other type, several series or more rows throws. Text is ink, dense step, tabular figures; formatValue is read for strings or numbers only and falls back to the default number format when it returns a node.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: 格式化已知数值；默认按UILocale数值Intl，不改数据。合计、环形图例的数值与「其余」按第一个系列调用（堆叠与环形的系列共用一个量纲）；占比读数、柱上标值、环形图例只取字符串或数字结果。
props.descriptionEn: Format known values without changing data. Defaults to Intl number formatting for UILocale. Totals, donut legend values and the remainder call it with the first series (stacked and donut series share one unit); share readouts, value labels and the donut legend read strings or numbers only.

props.name: renderPlot
props.description: 替换同源图形；gap为null，默认LineChart不连接gap且不动画。名称、图例与可见Table始终保留。自定义图形承担自身交互/ARIA；projection 带有 references、events、valueDomain，系列带 context 与 tone，自定义图形应一并遵守（背景系列不画标记，参照画在数据后面）。
props.descriptionEn: Replace the same-source plot. Gaps project to null; the default LineChart neither connects gaps nor animates. Names, legend and visible Table remain. Custom plots own their interaction and ARIA; the projection carries references, events and valueDomain, and series carry context and tone, which a custom plot should honor (no markers on context series, references behind the data).

props.name: style / className / render / ref
props.description: 根style可覆写 --qy-chart-plot-height（默认 10 材）。线宽、标记与柱宽是图的法度，不开放逐个配置。
props.descriptionEn: Root style may override --qy-chart-plot-height (default 10 modules). Line width, markers and bar width are fixed by the chart's rules rather than configured individually.

notes: 系列的区分不只靠色相：折线的每个系列有自己的标记形状（圆、方、三角、菱形、叉，按系列顺序分配），图例的键与折线一致，图例文字、悬停读数和数据表里都有系列名。柱、堆叠与面积是填充形式，靠固定的系列顺序区分——图例、柱的左右次序、堆叠的上下次序、读数与数据表同一个次序，段间有 2px 纸色空隙；这类图不另加纹理。
没有记录时 Chart 抛错而不画空框。请求中的图用 AsyncContent 组合：先判空再渲染，`<AsyncContent status hasContent={rows.length > 0} emptyContent={<Empty />}>` 里只放 Chart，空结果由 Empty 在原位承担，加载与失败的反馈在内容之后；见「请求状态与空结果」。
null、NaN、Infinity、缺失键不能表示0；用显式unknown或not-applicable表达。
所有值均未知时不画虚假数值轴，名称、图例与表格保留。
默认图形为数据表的视觉补充，辅助技术使用展开后的数据表；悬停读数只增强，不替代数据表。
长名称在可见Table保留，图形轴的公共碰撞处理不表示记录丢失。
浅深必要图形对真实背景至少3:1、文字至少4.5:1，由浏览器owner核实。
折线上相邻两点的间距小于两个标记宽（16px）时，每个系列只画最后一个已知点的标记，形状照旧；点距足够时每点都画。
状态色（tone）之外必须另有名称、位置或数值承担同一事实：浅色主题下危险与警示的明度相近，红绿色觉缺陷下相邻时不易分辨，堆叠段之间 2px 的纸色空隙、图例次序、读数与数据表里的名称是兜底。
堆叠与占比的读数末尾与数据表末列给出「合计」；行内有未知或不适用值时不合计（已知部分的和不是合计），读数记「—」，数据表写明缺项。
环形图例每项给出名称、值与占比（含总量大于各部分之和时的「其余」），数值列右对齐并用等宽数字，写法与 Proportion 的图例一致。
donut 超过5个部分或需要精确比较时改用 Proportion 或 bar/bar-horizontal；两个量的关系用 ScatterChart，两个类别维度上的量用 Heatmap——它们数据形状不同，是独立组件而不是 Chart 的 type。
notesEn: Series are told apart by more than hue: each line series has its own marker shape (circle, square, triangle, diamond, cross, assigned in series order), the legend key matches the line, and the series name appears in the legend text, the hover readout and the data table. Bars, stacks and areas are filled forms and rely on a fixed series order: the legend, the left-to-right order of bars, the bottom-to-top order of stacks, the readout and the data table all share one order, with a 2px paper gap between segments; no texture is added to them.

With no rows Chart throws instead of drawing an empty frame. For a chart behind a request, compose it with AsyncContent and test emptiness first: `<AsyncContent status hasContent={rows.length > 0} emptyContent={<Empty />}>` holds only the Chart, an empty result is carried by Empty in its place, and loading or failure feedback follows the content; see "Request states and empty results".
null, NaN, Infinity and missing keys cannot stand for zero. Use explicit unknown or not-applicable values.
When every value is unavailable, no fabricated numeric axis is drawn; names, legend and table remain.
The default plot supplements the data table, which provides assistive access once expanded; hover readouts enhance but never replace it.
The visible Table retains full names. Axis collision handling does not mean records are missing.
The browser owner verifies light/dark contrast: necessary graphics at least 3:1 against the actual background and text at least 4.5:1.
When neighboring points on a line are closer than two marker widths (16px), only the last known point of each series keeps its marker, with its shape unchanged; with enough room every point is drawn.

A status color (tone) must be backed by a name, position or value that carries the same fact: in the light theme danger and warning have similar lightness and are hard to tell apart under red-green color deficiency when adjacent, so the 2px paper gap between stacked segments, the legend order, and the names in the readout and data table are the fallback.

Readouts of stacked and share forms end with a Total, and so does the data table; a row with an unknown or not-applicable value is not totaled (the sum of the known parts is not a total): the readout shows an em dash and the table says a part is missing.

Each donut legend entry gives name, value and share (including the remainder when the total exceeds the sum of the parts); the value column is right-aligned with tabular figures and written as in the Proportion legend.

Past five donut parts, or when precise comparison matters, use Proportion or bar/bar-horizontal instead. The relationship between two quantities is ScatterChart; a quantity over two categorical dimensions is Heatmap — both have a different data shape and are separate components, not a Chart type.

whenToUse: Real values in shared units need graphical comparison with reachable numeric equivalents.
Readers need to know whether a value is in range: use references for a target band or line rather than making them read it off the grid.
One quantity is read against its peers: make the other series context series so only the one in question takes a color.
A change has a known cause: mark it with events on the category axis; the name enters the readout and the data table.
A line reads change inside a narrow interval (a ratio from 80% to 100%): use valueDomain; bars and areas cannot.
The series are themselves status categories (succeeded, retrying, failed): use tone, declared by the application, never guessed from the value.
A value is held between two changes (a setpoint, a threshold, stock): use interpolation: "step" instead of a straight line that invents values in between.
How a composition changes matters more than how much: bar-share (across categories) or area-share (over time), with original value and share together in the readout and table.
Few bars whose exact values must be read: use valueLabels to put the numbers on the bars and drop the ticks and grid.
Switching the time range or metric: no prop for it — keep the range in application state, pick it with SegmentedControl, and let Chart only receive different rows.
avoid: Mixed units, guessed results, connecting unavailable values as a reliable trend, or relying on color alone.
A donut with more than five parts, or where share must be compared precisely rather than glanced at.
Truncating the value axis of bars or areas (valueDomain throws for them).
Using a reference, context line or event dot as the only carrier of data: they are ink and background, and the numbers are in the data table.
Mixing tone with ordered-color series, or two series of the same category.

Smooth curves between points (not offered: a curve draws values the data does not contain); reading absolute amounts off a share chart; labelling stacked segments or side-by-side bars (too narrow, labels crowd together; valueLabels does not accept them).
composition: Public Recharts primitives with the current Table; one rows/series projection. With nothing to plot, the caller renders Empty in place of the chart.

library: Same-source projection, visible equivalent table, series shapes and basic naming.
application: Data, units, truth, state content and custom plotting.

responsive: A centralized 12em plot height can be overridden. The table scrolls and wraps without cutting actual values.
customization: Existing chart1..5 semantic colors, local plot roles and public renderPlot; no separate chart palette. Series colors follow the fixed order, which is the color-vision-safe mechanism and is not freely configurable; status colors are only danger / warning / success / info.

whenToUse: 真实共享量纲数据需要图形比较，且等价值可达。
读者要知道「在不在范围内」：用 references 给目标带或参照线，不要靠网格线猜。
一个量要放在同类的“其余”里读：把其余几条设为背景系列（context），只有关注的一条取色。
数据的变化有已知的原因：用 events 在类别轴上标出，名称进读数与数据表。
折线读的是窄区间内的变化（比率 80%–100%）：用 valueDomain；柱与面积不行。
系列本身就是状态类别（成功、重试、失败）：用 tone，由应用声明哪个系列是哪一类，组件不从数值猜好坏。
值在两次变化之间保持不变（设定值、阈值、库存）：用 interpolation: "step"，不要用直线编造中间值。
读的是构成怎样变而不是多少：bar-share（各类别）、area-share（随时间），原值与占比同时在读数与数据表里。
柱少而要读准确值：用 valueLabels 把数标在柱上，不再画刻度与网格。
切换时间范围或指标：不加接口——把范围放在应用的状态里，用 SegmentedControl 选择，Chart 只按它换 rows。
avoid: 混合量纲、猜测结果、把缺值连成可靠趋势或仅靠颜色。
环形超过5个部分，或占比需要精确比较而不是一眼大小。
把柱或面积的量轴截断（valueDomain 对它们抛错）。
用参照、背景线或事件点承载唯一的数据：它们是墨、是背景，数值读数在数据表里。
tone 与按次序取色的系列混用，或两个系列同一类别。
用平滑曲线连接两点（不提供：曲线画出数据里没有的值）；用占比图读绝对量；把值标在堆叠段或多系列并排的柱上（段太窄、标签挤成一片，valueLabels 不接受）。
composition: Recharts公开原语 + 当前Table；同一rows/series投影。没有可画的数据时，调用方在原位改放 Empty。

library: 同源投影、可见等价表、系列形态和基础名称。
application: 数据、量纲、真实性、状态文字与自定义图形。

responsive: 图高集中12em可覆写，表格原生滚动/换行；不裁掉实际值。
customization: chart1..5语义角色；局部plot roles与公开renderPlot，不另造图表调色板。系列颜色按次序取，次序是色觉安全的机制，不开放自由配色；状态色只有 danger / warning / success / info 四类。

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 复选组 CheckboxGroup
metadata.description: 把复选项接入同一个集合与共同范围。
metadata.descriptionEn: Connect checkboxes to one collection and shared scope.

api.name: CheckboxGroup
api.description: 集合状态，不只是排列复选项。
api.descriptionEn: Collection state beyond checkbox layout.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: 受控集合或初始集合；空数组表示未选任何项。Checkbox.value 标识集合项。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or initial collection; an empty array means no selected items. Checkbox.value identifies members.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: 提供增删后的集合，可用 details.cancel() 取消本次变化。
props.descriptionEn: Supplies the changed collection; details.cancel() cancels this change.

props.name: allValues
props.description: 完整范围；配合 Checkbox parent 计算全选、未选和 mixed。由调用方给出，不从业务推断。
props.descriptionEn: The complete scope used with a parent Checkbox for all/none/mixed. Supplied by the caller rather than inferred from business data.

props.name: disabled
props.description: 真正禁用组内复选项；单项 readOnly 放在 Checkbox。
props.descriptionEn: Actually disables group checkboxes; per-item readOnly belongs on Checkbox.

props.name: aria-labelledby / aria-label
props.description: 共同名称；可引用 FieldTitle 或 FieldsetLegend。
props.descriptionEn: A shared name, optionally referencing FieldTitle or FieldsetLegend.

props.name: render / ref / className / style
props.description: 透传根部位、原生属性与事件；样式支持原语状态回调。
props.descriptionEn: Forward root/native props and events; styles support primitive state callbacks.

api.name: CheckboxGroupPrimitive
api.description: Base UI 集合原语公共出口。
api.descriptionEn: The public Base UI collection primitive.

keyboard.description: 逐个到达可用复选项。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach available checkboxes individually.

keyboard.description: 增删当前项；父项作用于 allValues 的完整范围。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Add/remove the current item; the parent operates on the complete allValues scope.

notes: Field.name 或各 Checkbox.name 决定表单字段；相同 name 提交多项值。
FieldItem/FieldLabel 必须放在 Field 内；组外也可使用原生 label。
只读是项的限制，disabled 是组的限制；不从空集合推断 invalid。
notesEn: Field.name or each Checkbox.name determines the form field; repeated names submit multiple values.
FieldItem/FieldLabel belong inside Field; native labels also work outside a group.
Read-only limits an item; disabled limits the group. An empty collection does not imply invalid.
metadata.decisions: CheckboxGroup 持有集合值。allValues 是父项操作的范围，改变它必须对应真实候选范围。
metadata.decisionsEn: CheckboxGroup owns a collection value. allValues defines the parent action's scope and must change with the actual candidate set.

whenToUse: 一组可同时选择的候选
父复选项控制明确的完整集合
avoid: 只排列内容时用布局组件
互斥候选用 RadioGroup
开关设置用 Switch
composition: FieldTitle 命名组；FieldItem + Checkbox + FieldLabel 命名单项；FieldDescription/FieldError 关联同一集合

library: 非受控集合、焦点、键盘、父项 mixed
application: 受控集合、allValues、候选、invalid、提交

responsive: 复用 Checkbox 尺寸与触摸目标；本批未运行浏览器几何验收
customization: 组内 field-gap；单项通过 Checkbox 的 size 和样式入口调整

whenToUse: Several candidates can be selected together.
A parent checkbox controls an explicit complete collection.
avoid: Use layout components when only arranging content.
Use RadioGroup for mutually exclusive candidates.
Use Switch for settings.
composition: FieldTitle names the group; FieldItem + Checkbox + FieldLabel name an item; FieldDescription/FieldError refer to the same collection.

library: Uncontrolled collection, focus, keyboard, and parent mixed state.
application: Controlled collection, allValues, candidates, invalid facts, and submission.

responsive: Uses Checkbox dimensions and touch targets; this batch did not run browser geometry acceptance.
customization: field-gap within the group; each Checkbox exposes size and styling.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 复选框 Checkbox
metadata.description: 选择独立的是/否或集合中的多个项。
metadata.descriptionEn: Choose an independent yes/no value or multiple items in a set.

api.name: Checkbox
api.description: Base UI 复选语义及混合状态。
api.descriptionEn: Base UI checkbox semantics and mixed state.

props.name: checked / defaultChecked
props.description: 受控选中值或非受控初值。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled checked value or uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: 集合部分选中的事实；aria-checked 为 mixed。
props.descriptionEn: Actual partial collection selection; aria-checked is mixed.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: 选择变化，可取消。集合更新由应用处理。
props.descriptionEn: Cancelable selection change; the application handles collection updates.

props.name: disabled / readOnly
props.description: 禁用跳过键盘并不提交；只读可聚焦、提交但不可切换。
props.descriptionEn: Disabled skips keyboard access and submission; read-only retains focus/submission without toggling.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: 显式无效事实；Field invalid 也可传入。
props.descriptionEn: An explicit invalid fact, also available through Field invalid.

props.name: name / value / uncheckedValue / form
props.description: 保留原语隐藏输入的真实表单提交语义。
props.descriptionEn: Preserve actual form submission through the primitive's hidden input.

props.name: render / ref / inputRef / className / style
props.description: 根部位与隐藏 input 的组合；渲染 button 时同时设置 nativeButton。
props.descriptionEn: Compose the root and hidden input; also set nativeButton when rendering a button.

api.name: CheckboxPrimitive
api.description: 完整 Base UI Checkbox 命名空间，包含 Root 与 Indicator。
api.descriptionEn: The complete Base UI Checkbox namespace, including Root and Indicator.

keyboard.description: 按文档顺序进入每项。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach each item in document order.

keyboard.description: 切换选中值；只读与禁用不切换。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Toggle selection; read-only and disabled items do not toggle.

notes: indeterminate 由真实集合计算，不是独立视觉变体。
FieldLabel 或真实 label 关联名称，说明和错误留在 Field 中。
选中与无效可以同时存在；错误不会清空选中值，选中态的填充改用危险填充色来表达无效。
notesEn: Compute indeterminate from the actual collection rather than choosing a visual variant.
FieldLabel or an actual label supplies the name; keep descriptions and errors within Field.
Selected and invalid may coexist; errors do not clear selection, and the checked fill switches to the danger fill to show invalid.
metadata.decisions: 多个独立选项用 Checkbox，立即切换设置用 Switch。部分选中由调用方根据子项计算。
metadata.decisionsEn: Use Checkbox for independent options and Switch for an immediate setting change. The caller calculates partial selection from the child values.

whenToUse: 独立二值、集合多选、待提交选择
avoid: 立即生效的设置用 Switch
互斥单选用 Radio
composition: Field 的名称、说明、错误结构

library: 焦点、键盘、非受控 checked
application: 受控 checked、indeterminate、集合范围、invalid

responsive: 可见几何与命中区分开；本批只验桌面
customization: 同名文字行高、marker圆角、主题颜色

whenToUse: Independent binary choices, multiple collection selection, or selections awaiting submission.
avoid: Use Switch for settings taking effect immediately.
Use Radio for mutually exclusive selection.
composition: Field supplies names, descriptions, and errors.

library: Focus, keyboard, and uncontrolled checked state.
application: Controlled checked state, indeterminate, collection scope, and invalid facts.

responsive: Visible geometry and hit areas are separate; this batch checked desktop only.
customization: Matching text line heights, marker radius, and theme colors.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 代码 CodeBlock
metadata.description: 文本原样展示、可选标题栏与真实复制结果。
metadata.descriptionEn: Literal text with an optional title bar and actual copy results.
metadata.decisions: pre/code 保留空白、字符与完整宽度，库自己不做语法高亮：已高亮的标记由调用方经 children 给出，复制的仍是 code。代码面只用一条清墨容器线划出范围，底只比所坐之处深半个清染。复制复用 useCopyToClipboard；只有写入成功才显示已复制，失败保留手动复制内容。
metadata.decisionsEn: pre/code retain whitespace, characters and full width; the library does no syntax highlighting itself: pre-highlighted markup comes from the caller through children, while code is still what is copied. The code surface is delimited by one ink container line and a ground only half a wash step deeper than what it sits on. useCopyToClipboard reports success only after writing; failure keeps manual-copy content.

whenToUse: 原样阅读和复制一段代码或预格式文本。
avoid: 可编辑文字使用 Textarea；不把语言标签当作语法高亮。

library: 文本容量与真实剪贴板成功/失败反馈。
application: 原始文本、语言名称与对复制结果的后续动作。

responsive: 完整代码默认横向滚动，不截断或改写字符；wrap 改为折行。

whenToUse: Read and copy code or preformatted text unchanged.
avoid: Use Textarea for editable text; a language label does not imply syntax highlighting.

library: Text capacity and actual clipboard success/failure feedback.
application: Original text, language names, and actions following a copy result.

responsive: Complete code scrolls horizontally by default without truncation or character changes; wrap switches to wrapping.

api.name: CodeBlock
api.description: 代码呈现与可选复制动作。
api.descriptionEn: Code presentation with an optional copy action.

props.name: code
props.description: 必填，原样渲染并复制，不 trim 或格式化。
props.descriptionEn: Required literal text, rendered and copied without trimming or formatting.

props.name: language
props.description: 可选名称，只作识别，不改变文本。
props.descriptionEn: Optional identifying label that never changes the text.

props.name: title
props.description: 标题栏的起始内容；给出才有标题栏（高 2 材，复制按钮移到栏尾）。字符串或数字按等宽辅助字显示，起始边与代码文字对齐；其他节点（如 SegmentedControl）原样放入，栏内的轨道面透明，显示代码面。
props.descriptionEn: Content at the start of the title bar; the bar exists only when given (2 modules tall, with the copy button moved to its end). A string or number is shown in mono support text aligned with the code's start edge; any other node, such as a SegmentedControl, is placed as given, and tracks inside the bar are transparent so they show the code surface.

props.name: children
props.description: 已高亮的标记，放进 code 元素代替纯文本显示；复制与可访问内容以 code 为准，两者文字应一致。
props.descriptionEn: Pre-highlighted markup placed inside the code element in place of the plain text; code remains what is copied, and the two should carry the same text.

props.name: wrap
props.description: 长行折行（在任意位置断开），而不是横向滚动。
props.descriptionEn: Wrap long lines at any position instead of scrolling horizontally.

props.name: maxLines
props.description: 代码面最多显示的行数（正整数），超出后纵向滚动。折行后按视觉行计。选行数而不是 CSS 长度：读代码的人数的是行，行高由系统的「材」决定（正文一行 = 1 材），字号或密度变了，行数不会悄悄变。滚动时代码面可聚焦、有名称（取标题，其次语言，再退到「代码」），复制按钮不随代码滚动。
props.descriptionEn: The most lines the code surface shows (a positive integer); more scroll vertically. Wrapped lines count as visual lines. Lines rather than a CSS length because readers count lines, and a line is one module of the system (one body line = 1 module), so a change of type size or density does not silently change the count. While scrolling the code surface is focusable and named (the title, then the language, then "Code"), and the copy button does not scroll with the code.

props.name: copyable
props.description: 是否提供复制按钮与真实反馈。
props.descriptionEn: Whether to provide the copy button and actual feedback.

props.name: onCopySuccess / onCopyError
props.description: 实际写入成功或失败后的回调；原生 onCopy 事件另行透传。
props.descriptionEn: Callbacks after actual write success or failure; the native onCopy event is forwarded independently.

props.name: render / ref / ARIA / className / style / native props
props.description: 属性属于外部 div（原生 title 属性被 title 槽取代）；复制的文本由 code 参数唯一提供。
props.descriptionEn: Props target the outer div (the native title attribute is replaced by the title slot); code is the single source of copied text.

keyboard.description: 代码溢出时可聚焦并用原生方向键滚动；Button 激活。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Overflowing code is focusable and scrolls with native arrow keys; Button activation.

notes: 语言名称不是语法解析；没有额外依赖、请求或剪贴板 fallback 伪成功。
标题栏里放 SegmentedControl 切换内容时，code 与 children 要随所选值一起换，复制的才是眼前这一条。
代码没有溢出时，代码面不进入 Tab 序列；溢出时它是一个有名称的 region，Tab 停在上面就能用方向键滚动。
notesEn: A language label is not parsing; no extra dependencies, fetching or false-success clipboard fallback.
When a SegmentedControl in the title bar switches the content, change code and children together so what is copied is what is shown.
When the code does not overflow, the code surface is not a tab stop; when it overflows it is a named region, and Tab stops on it so the arrow keys can scroll.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 单段展开 Collapsible
metadata.description: 主动展开同一对象的补充内容。
metadata.descriptionEn: Reveal additional content for the same object.
metadata.decisions: 触发名称与单段内容关联；默认保留输入，关闭只结束呈现。
metadata.decisionsEn: Relate the named trigger to one content region. Retain input by default; closing only ends its presentation.

api.name: Collapsible
api.description: 单段内容的展开状态。
api.descriptionEn: Expansion state for one section.

props.name: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: 真实展开状态与可取消变更请求。
props.descriptionEn: Actual open state and cancelable change requests.

props.name: disabled
props.description: 禁用切换。
props.descriptionEn: Disable toggling.

api.name: CollapsibleTrigger
api.description: 文字加尾部箭头的行内展开入口，支持原语 render/ref/事件。
api.descriptionEn: An inline expand entry of text plus a trailing arrow; supports primitive render, refs, and events.

props.name: indicator
props.description: 是否显示尾部箭头。false 时只剩文字，触发器的名称、键盘与 aria-expanded 不变；需要完全自定义外形时改用 render。
props.descriptionEn: Whether the trailing arrow shows. With false only the text remains; the trigger's name, keyboard behavior and aria-expanded are unchanged. Use render for a fully custom form.

api.name: CollapsiblePanel
api.description: 关联内容与保持策略。
api.descriptionEn: Associated content and retention policy.

props.name: hiddenUntilFound
props.description: 收起时用 hidden="until-found" 留在文档里：页内查找（Ctrl/Cmd+F）命中其中的文字，或地址栏片段指向其中的元素时自动展开。Chrome 102+、Firefox 148+ 支持，Safari 不支持；不支持的浏览器上与默认相同。开启后 keepMounted 无效。命中时由原语直接展开，不播放过渡。
props.descriptionEn: Closed, the content stays in the document as hidden="until-found": find-in-page (Ctrl/Cmd+F) matching text inside it, or a URL fragment pointing at an element inside it, opens it automatically. Supported in Chrome 102+ and Firefox 148+, not Safari; where unsupported it behaves as the default. keepMounted is ignored while it is on. A find match opens it immediately without the transition.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: 保留关闭内容和原生字段；应用决定隐藏字段是否禁用。
props.descriptionEn: Retain closed content and native fields; the application decides whether hidden fields are disabled.

props.name: render / ref / className / style
props.description: 透传呈现及原语状态。
props.descriptionEn: Forward presentation and primitive states.

keyboard.description: 展开或收起。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Expand or collapse.

keyboard.description: 访问触发者与展开内容。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach the trigger and expanded content.

notes: 多项同组展开使用 Accordion。
CollapsiblePanel 默认 keepMounted：关闭后内容仍在 DOM 里，其中输入的值与原生字段不会丢；代价是关闭的内容仍占文档树。内容不需要留值时可设 keepMounted={false}，需要让页内查找命中它时设 hiddenUntilFound。
关闭不声明取消、撤销或保存。
粗指针下触发区的命中范围扩大到触屏目标，可见尺寸不变。
notesEn: Use Accordion for a group of expandable sections.

CollapsiblePanel defaults to keepMounted: closed content stays in the DOM, so typed values and native fields are not lost; the cost is that closed content remains in the document tree. Set keepMounted={false} when the content need not retain values, and hiddenUntilFound when find-in-page should match it.
Closing establishes no cancellation, undo, or save result.
With a coarse pointer the hit area grows to the touch target; the visible size does not change.

whenToUse: 同一对象有可主动展开的补充内容。
avoid: 把必要后果只放在默认隐藏内容。
composition: Trigger 与 Panel 保留公共原语关联。

library: open、键盘和 ARIA。
application: 内容、输入和业务状态。

responsive: 内容换行且自然增长。
customization: field gap、Button 和 motion.css 共享角色。

whenToUse: One object has supplementary content to disclose deliberately.
avoid: Putting necessary consequences solely in initially hidden content.
composition: Trigger and Panel retain public primitive associations.

library: Open state, keyboard, and ARIA.
application: Content, inputs, and business states.

responsive: Content wraps and grows naturally.
customization: Shared field gap, Button, and motion.css roles.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 颜色选择 ColorPicker
metadata.description: 选取用户数据里的颜色：标签颜色、主题配置取值，得到一个 #rrggbb。
metadata.descriptionEn: Choose a colour that belongs to the user's data, such as a label colour or a theme setting, and get a #rrggbb string.
metadata.decisions: 它只产出用户数据，不改库的主题：色块显示的就是那份数据，别处的颜色仍来自语义 token。值只有 #rrggbb，不含透明度；把它存下来的是应用。
metadata.decisionsEn: It only produces user data and never changes the library theme: a swatch shows exactly that data, and every other colour still comes from semantic tokens. The value is #rrggbb only, with no transparency; storing it is the application's job.

api.name: ColorSwatchPicker
api.description: 从预设里选一个颜色，是一个单选组；每个色块是名称明确的单选项。
api.descriptionEn: Choose one colour from presets. It is a radio group and every swatch is a named radio.

props.name: swatches
props.description: 预设色。value 是 #rrggbb，label 是名称（如「靛蓝」）；缺名称、值格式不对或值重复都会抛错。
props.descriptionEn: Preset colours. value is #rrggbb and label is its name; a missing name, a malformed value or a duplicate throws.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: 当前颜色。值不在 swatches 里（例如来自自由取色）时没有色块被选中；输出一律小写。
props.descriptionEn: The current colour. A value outside swatches selects nothing. Output is always lowercase.

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby
props.description: 组的名称；放在带 FieldLabel 的 Field 内时可省略，否则缺名称抛错。
props.descriptionEn: The group name. May be omitted inside a Field with a FieldLabel; otherwise a missing name throws.

props.name: name / disabled / readOnly / required / form
props.description: 与 RadioGroup 相同，未选择时不提交该字段。
props.descriptionEn: Same as RadioGroup; nothing is submitted while no swatch is selected.

api.name: ColorPicker
api.description: 自由取色：按钮显示当前颜色与 hex，点开是饱和度与明度面、色相条、hex 输入和可选的预设行。
api.descriptionEn: Free choice: a button shows the current colour and its hex; it opens a saturation and brightness area, a hue slider, a hex input and an optional preset row.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: #rrggbb。传了 value 即受控；defaultValue 省略时为 #000000；格式不对抛错。onValueChange 在拖动中也每次变化都调用。
props.descriptionEn: #rrggbb. Passing value makes it controlled; defaultValue defaults to #000000; a malformed value throws. onValueChange fires on every change, including during a drag.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: 一次操作结束才调用：松开指针、键盘离键、确认 hex、选预设。保存放这里，不放 onValueChange。
props.descriptionEn: Called when an interaction ends: pointer release, key release, a confirmed hex, a chosen preset. Save here rather than in onValueChange.

props.name: swatches
props.description: 预设行，复用 ColorSwatchPicker，规则相同。
props.descriptionEn: A preset row using ColorSwatchPicker, with the same rules.

props.name: name / form / disabled
props.description: name 存在时随表单提交 #rrggbb；disabled 时不提交、不可打开。
props.descriptionEn: With name, #rrggbb is submitted with the form. When disabled it is neither submitted nor openable.

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby
props.description: 触发器的名称。放在带 FieldLabel 的 Field 内时来自标签，否则缺名称抛错。
props.descriptionEn: The trigger name. Inside a Field it comes from the FieldLabel; otherwise a missing name throws.

props.name: className / style / 其余 button 属性
props.description: 交给触发按钮。
props.descriptionEn: Passed to the trigger button.

keyboard.description: 饱和度 −1 / +1；Shift 为 10。Home / End 到饱和度 0 / 100。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Saturation −1 / +1; Shift uses 10. Home / End go to saturation 0 / 100.

keyboard.description: 明度 +1 / −1；Shift 为 10。PageUp / PageDown 明度 ±10。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Brightness +1 / −1; Shift uses 10. PageUp / PageDown change brightness by 10.

keyboard.description: 色相 ±1°；Shift 或 PageUp / PageDown 为 10°。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Hue ±1°; Shift or PageUp / PageDown uses 10°.

keyboard.description: 校验并整理成 #rrggbb；不合法时文字保留并提示格式。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Validate and normalise to #rrggbb. An invalid entry stays in the field with a format message.

keyboard.description: 移动并选中色块，整组只占一个 Tab 停靠点。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move to and select a swatch; the group takes one tab stop.

notes: 选中靠勾，不靠颜色；勾色取压在该色块上对比更高的黑或白。
色块外缘有一条与输入框同角色的边线，白色或近底色的色块在浅深主题里都有清楚的边界。
饱和度/明度面由两个隐藏的 range 承担无障碍，各有名称，aria-valuetext 读出通道与当前 hex。
不含透明度：值只有 #rrggbb。
notesEn: Selection is shown by a check, not by colour; the check is the black or white with more contrast against that swatch.
A swatch has a rim with the same role as an input border, so white or ground-coloured swatches keep a clear edge in light and dark themes.
The saturation and brightness area exposes two named hidden range inputs; aria-valuetext reads the channel and the current hex.
No transparency: the value is #rrggbb only.

whenToUse: 标签、分类、主题配置里需要用户指定一个颜色
候选少且固定时用 ColorSwatchPicker，需要任意取值时用 ColorPicker
avoid: 库自身的主题色不要用它改，主题由 token 决定
需要透明度的场景（不在范围内）
只是展示颜色时用普通元素，不用单选组
composition: Field + FieldLabel 命名触发器或色块组；放在 Form 里用 name 提交 #rrggbb；onValueCommit 里保存

library: 取色面、色相、hex 草稿与校验提示、焦点与键盘
application: 受控值、预设列表、保存与结果

responsive: 读填值控件与标记的既有尺寸角色；本批只做桌面检查
customization: 色块边长跟随填值控件高度（密度轴）；颜色数据经 CSS 变量进入样式

whenToUse: A label, category or theme setting needs a user-specified colour.
Use ColorSwatchPicker for a small fixed set and ColorPicker for any value.
avoid: Do not use it to change the library's own theme; tokens decide that.
Cases that need transparency (out of scope).
Use a plain element when only displaying a colour.
composition: Field + FieldLabel names the trigger or swatch group; name submits #rrggbb in a Form; save in onValueCommit.

library: The area, hue, hex draft and validation message, focus and keyboard.
application: Controlled value, preset list, saving and its outcome.

responsive: Reads the existing fill-control and marker size roles; this batch checked desktop only.
customization: Swatch edge follows the fill-control height (density axis); colour data enters styles through CSS variables.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 候选输入 Combobox
metadata.description: 筛选候选并确认一个或一组值，查询文字与选择事实分别持有。
metadata.descriptionEn: Filter candidates and confirm one value or a set, with query text separate from selection.
metadata.decisions: value 是确认候选，inputValue 是过滤草稿。清空过滤文字继续保留候选，明确清除选择才请求空值；自由文本值用 Autocomplete。候选很多且要选几个时用 multiple；候选少而需要一眼看全用 CheckboxGroup，值不来自候选用 TagInput。
metadata.decisionsEn: value is the confirmed candidate; inputValue is the filter draft. Emptying the query preserves selection. Explicit Clear requests an empty selection. Use Autocomplete for free text. Use multiple to pick several from many candidates; use CheckboxGroup when few options should all stay visible, and TagInput when values do not come from candidates.

api.name: ComboboxSelect
api.description: 平铺单选的便捷组合：编辑边界、输入、清除、展开与候选面；确认值与查询仍独立，可受控或非受控。分组、多选或不同解剖继续用公开部件。
api.descriptionEn: A convenient composition for flat single selection: edit boundary, input, clear, trigger, and popup. Confirmation and query remain independent and can be controlled or uncontrolled. Use the public parts for groups, multiple selection, or a different anatomy.

props.name: items / itemToStringLabel / renderItem
props.type: readonly Value[] / (item: Value) => string / (item: Value) => ReactNode
props.description: items 和 itemToStringLabel 必填，名称同时用于输入与过滤；renderItem 可丰富候选呈现。对象提交身份用既有 itemToStringValue，比较用 isItemEqualToValue。
props.descriptionEn: items and itemToStringLabel are required; labels serve both input and filtering. renderItem customizes candidate content. For objects, use the existing itemToStringValue for form identity and isItemEqualToValue for equality.

props.name: emptyContent / loading / clearable
props.description: emptyContent 必填；loading 只显示调用方的加载事实，此时不声称无匹配。请求、取消、迟到回包与有效候选由应用持有。clearable 控制是否提供明确清除选择的动作。
props.descriptionEn: emptyContent is required. loading only presents caller-supplied loading and suppresses no-match text. The application owns requests, cancellation, late responses, and valid candidates. clearable controls the explicit clear-selection action.

props.name: inputProps / controlProps / popupProps
props.description: 分别透传输入命名、ARIA、事件、render、ref，编辑边界与浮层定制。确认值、查询、表单、禁用及只读沿用 Combobox Root 属性。
props.descriptionEn: Forward input naming, ARIA, events, render, and ref, plus control and popup customization. Confirmation, query, form, disabled, and read-only retain Combobox Root props.

api.name: Combobox
api.description: 公开 Base UI 候选上下文，默认单值；不强加业务选项。
api.descriptionEn: A public Base UI candidate context, single-value by default, with caller-provided options.

props.name: multiple
props.description: 确认一组值：value 为数组，FormData 每个值一条；已选值在编辑边界内成为可单独移除的项。
props.descriptionEn: Confirm a set: value is an array with one FormData entry per value; each selected value becomes an individually removable chip inside the edit boundary.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.type: Value | null / Value | null / (value, details) => void
props.description: 受控或非受控确认值。details.cancel() 拒绝变更；回调不表示提交或持久化成功。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or uncontrolled confirmation. details.cancel() rejects changes. A callback does not mean submission or persistence.

props.name: inputValue / defaultInputValue / onInputValueChange
props.description: 独立过滤文字；不序列化成候选值，也不因清空查询清除确认候选。
props.descriptionEn: Independent query text. It is not serialized as selection and does not clear confirmation when emptied.

props.name: items / itemToStringLabel / itemToStringValue / isItemEqualToValue
props.description: 调用方提供候选、可读名称、表单值与身份比较；对象值须定义有意义的名称与提交表示。
props.descriptionEn: The caller provides candidates, readable labels, form strings, and identity equality. Define meaningful labels and submission values for objects.

props.name: name / form / required / disabled / readOnly
props.description: Field 命名与错误连接由原语承担；FormData 只提交确认候选。只读保留提交，禁用排除。
props.descriptionEn: The primitive connects Field naming and errors. FormData submits confirmed selection only. Read-only submits; disabled is excluded.

props.name: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: 展开可控；输入、动作、候选项共用一套几何，跟随密度轴。
props.descriptionEn: Opening is controllable. Input, actions, and items share one geometry following the density axis.

api.name: ComboboxInput / ComboboxTrigger / ComboboxClear
api.description: 公开原语复用 Input 原生出口与 Button；事件、ARIA、render 状态与 ref 透传，Field 注册一次。
api.descriptionEn: Public primitives compose the native Input outlet and Button. Events, ARIA, render state, and refs forward with one Field registration.

api.name: ComboboxControl
api.description: 输入、清除与展开共用的一条编辑边界，候选面以它为锚点；多选时可换行，装下已选项。
api.descriptionEn: One edit boundary shared by input, clear, and trigger, anchoring the popup; with multiple it wraps to hold the chips.

api.name: ComboboxChips / ComboboxChip / ComboboxValue
api.description: 多选的已选项。Chips 放在 Control 内，包住各项与 Input；Value 以函数子级给出已选数组；Chip 自带移除动作，只读时只显示值。几何与 TagInput 的标签相同。
api.descriptionEn: Selected values for multiple. Chips sits inside Control around the chips and Input; Value provides the selected array to a function child; Chip carries its own remove action and shows only the value when read-only. Geometry matches TagInput tags.

props.name: label (ComboboxChip)
props.description: 移除动作的对象名；children 是纯文字时取 children。
props.descriptionEn: The object name for the remove action; defaults to children when they are plain text.

api.name: ComboboxPopup
api.description: 候选专属 Portal/Positioner/Popup；positionerProps/container 可调整公开定位，层级消费共享 floating-layer。
api.descriptionEn: Candidate-specific Portal/Positioner/Popup. positionerProps and container customize positioning; layer order comes from shared floating-layer.

api.name: ComboboxList / ComboboxItem / ComboboxEmpty
api.description: 真实候选集合、可选项与调用方空内容；Item.value 是确认候选。
api.descriptionEn: Real candidate list, selectable items, and caller-provided empty content. Item.value is a confirmation candidate.

api.name: ComboboxGroup / ComboboxGroupLabel / ComboboxSeparator / ComboboxCollection
api.description: 分组候选：items 用 Base UI 的分组形态（{ value: 组名, items }），列表以函数子级逐组渲染，组内用 ComboboxCollection。组名画法与 SelectGroupLabel、分隔线与 MenuSeparator 同一来源；组名不可选、不入键盘序列。多选下同样成立。
api.descriptionEn: Grouped candidates: items use Base UI's group shape ({ value: label, items }); the list renders group by group with ComboboxCollection inside. The label matches SelectGroupLabel and the separator matches MenuSeparator. Labels are not selectable or part of the keyboard sequence. Works with multiple.

api.name: ComboboxStatus
api.description: 列表自身状态的读屏播报：loading 读「正在加载」，count 读「找到 N 项」，也可直接给 children。放进 ComboboxPopup 并保持挂载，变的是内容。默认只给读屏；visible 同时显示在 Empty 的位置。count 为 0 不出声：「没有结果」归 ComboboxEmpty，不重复播报。
api.descriptionEn: Screen-reader announcements about the list itself: loading says "Loading", count says "N results", or pass children. Put it in ComboboxPopup and keep it mounted; only its content changes. Screen-reader only by default; visible also shows it where Empty sits. A count of 0 stays silent: "no results" belongs to ComboboxEmpty.

props.name: loading / count / visible
props.description: 加载中、结果数、是否同时显示；children 优先于内置文案。
props.descriptionEn: Loading, result count, and whether to also show it; children win over built-in text.

api.name: ComboboxPrimitive
api.description: 安装版 Base UI Combobox 命名空间。
api.descriptionEn: The installed Base UI Combobox namespace.

keyboard.description: 多选：草稿为空时在已选项与输入之间移动；Backspace 或 Delete 移除聚焦的项。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Multiple: with an empty draft, move between chips and the input; Backspace or Delete removes the focused chip.

keyboard.description: 展开并移动候选高亮，尚未确认时不改变提交值。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Open and move candidate highlighting without changing the submitted value.

keyboard.description: 请求确认高亮候选。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Request confirmation of the highlighted candidate.

keyboard.description: 退出候选列表，遵守原语焦点与过滤文字恢复规则。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Leave the list using primitive focus and query restoration rules.

notes: 从当前查询到候选的过滤与空内容必须对应实际数据。
Popup 的 caller style 最后合并；覆写层级可能改变默认顺序。
候选浮层表面与高亮采用既有主题预设，焦点信号在盒内。
异步候选由应用持有请求、取消与失败；传 filter={null} 关闭内置过滤，用 ComboboxStatus 说明加载与结果数，用 ComboboxEmpty 说明没有结果（加载期间不要显示它）。ComboboxEmpty 省略 children 时用内置的「没有可选项」，与 Select 同一说法与画法。
notesEn: Filtering and empty content must reflect the real candidate data.
Popup caller style merges last; layer overrides can change the default order.
Popup surfaces and highlights use existing theme presets with internal focus signals.

For asynchronous candidates the application owns requests, cancellation, and failure: pass filter={null}, use ComboboxStatus for loading and counts, and ComboboxEmpty for no results (not while loading). An empty ComboboxEmpty uses the built-in "No options", worded and drawn like Select.

composition: Field + FieldLabel + Combobox / Input / actions / Popup / List / Item

library: 候选键盘、焦点、非受控查询/确认值
application: 候选数据、受控查询/值、错误与提交结果

responsive: 一套几何，跟随密度轴，紧凑不缩小文字；浮层按可用宽度与高度定位
customization: 每部位 render/ref/ARIA/events，公开原语与共享浮层角色

composition: Field + FieldLabel + Combobox / Input / actions / Popup / List / Item

library: Candidate keyboard behavior, focus, and uncontrolled query/confirmed value.
application: Candidate data, controlled query/value, errors, and submission outcomes.

responsive: One geometry following the density axis; compact tightens the container, never the text; popup positioning uses available width and height.
customization: Per-part render/refs/ARIA/events, public primitives, and shared popup roles.

metadata.title: 命令面板 Command
metadata.description: 输入框加一张常开的命令列表，用来跳到某处或执行某事。
metadata.descriptionEn: A search box over an always-open list of commands, for jumping somewhere or doing something.
metadata.decisions: 条目是命令（动作），不是填进输入框的值：选中只触发 onSelect，查询文字原样保留。全局快捷键（⌘K）由应用注册，库不监听按键。禁用项显示为不可用，但不参与高亮与方向键移动。
metadata.decisionsEn: Items are commands (actions), not values filled into the input: selecting only fires onSelect and the query text stays. The global shortcut (⌘K) is registered by the application; the library listens to no keys. Disabled items show as unavailable but take no part in highlighting or arrow-key movement.

api.name: Command
api.description: 命令列表本体：一个常开的 combobox + listbox，焦点始终留在输入框，高亮用 aria-activedescendant。可单独嵌在页面里。
api.descriptionEn: The list itself: an always-open combobox and listbox. Focus stays in the input and the highlight uses aria-activedescendant. Can sit directly in a page.

props.name: filter
props.type: (entry: { value, label, keywords }, query: string) => boolean
props.description: 覆盖默认过滤。默认：不区分大小写，value、文字子级、keywords 任一包含查询即匹配（中文直接包含匹配）。空查询不调用，恒显示。
props.descriptionEn: Replace the default filter. By default a case-insensitive match against value, text children, or any keyword; CJK text matches by containment. Not called for an empty query, which shows everything.

props.name: query / defaultQuery / onQueryChange
props.description: 查询文字，受控或非受控。
props.descriptionEn: The query text, controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onItemSelect
props.description: 任一条目被选中后调用，晚于条目自己的 onSelect。
props.descriptionEn: Called after any item is selected, after the item's own onSelect.

api.name: CommandInput
api.description: 查询框，共用 Input 的几何。缺 aria-label / aria-labelledby 时抛错。
api.descriptionEn: The search box, sharing Input's geometry. Throws without aria-label or aria-labelledby.

api.name: CommandList
api.description: listbox。内容多时在列表内滚动，输入框始终可见。需要名字时传 aria-label。
api.descriptionEn: The listbox. Long content scrolls inside it while the input stays visible. Pass aria-label to name it.

api.name: CommandGroup
api.description: 一组命令。组内没有匹配项时整组收起。
api.descriptionEn: A group of commands. It collapses when none of its items match.

props.name: heading
props.description: 必填。组名，也是读屏读到的 group 名称。
props.descriptionEn: Required. The group's title and the name a screen reader announces for the group.

api.name: CommandItem
api.description: 一条命令，外观与 MenuItem 同一几何。
api.descriptionEn: One command, with the same geometry as MenuItem.

props.name: value
props.description: 必填。命令的标识，参与匹配；onSelect 收到它。
props.descriptionEn: Required. The command's identity, used for matching and handed to onSelect.

props.name: keywords
props.description: 不显示的匹配词：别名、英文名、拼音。
props.descriptionEn: Hidden match terms: aliases, English names, pinyin.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Enter 或点击时调用。
props.descriptionEn: Called on Enter or click.

props.name: disabled
props.description: 显示为不可用，不参与高亮与方向键移动，不能被选中。
props.descriptionEn: Shown as unavailable; takes no part in highlighting or arrow-key movement and cannot be selected.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: 只显示快捷键，不注册。数组则每个键各一块。
props.descriptionEn: Displays a shortcut without registering it. An array shows one block per key.

api.name: CommandEmpty
api.description: 没有任何条目匹配时显示。省略 children 用内置缺省文案；元素常驻，内容变化时读屏才会播报。
api.descriptionEn: Shown when nothing matches. Omit children for the built-in text. The element stays mounted so that screen readers announce the change.

api.name: CommandSeparator
api.description: 组与组之间的分界。查询非空时不渲染，因为此时组会随结果收起。
api.descriptionEn: A divider between groups. Not rendered while the query is non-empty, since groups collapse with the results.

api.name: CommandDialog
api.description: Dialog 里放一份 Command。每次打开都是新的一份，查询自然清空。
api.descriptionEn: A Command inside a Dialog. Each opening is a fresh instance, so the query starts empty.

props.name: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: 打开状态，受控或非受控。
props.descriptionEn: Open state, controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby
props.description: 二选一必填，缺失抛错。
props.descriptionEn: One is required; omitting both throws.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: 选中条目后关闭。
props.descriptionEn: Close after an item is selected.

keyboard.description: 移动高亮；禁用项被跳过。列表挂载时第一项已高亮。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move the highlight, skipping disabled items. The first item is highlighted when the list mounts.

keyboard.description: 触发高亮项的 onSelect。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Run the highlighted item's onSelect.

keyboard.description: 在 CommandDialog 中关闭对话框。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Close the dialog in a CommandDialog.

notes: 组件不注册 ⌘K。应用自己监听 metaKey / ctrlKey + k 并控制 CommandDialog 的 open。
条目 value 是匹配用的文字；显示内容与 value 不同时，用 keywords 补上能被搜到的词。
命令的后果（删除、发布等）不在命令面板里说明：选中后应打开 AlertDialog 或 ConfirmAction。
按「候选值」选择文字用 Autocomplete 或 Combobox；命令面板选的是动作。
notesEn: The component does not register ⌘K. The application listens for metaKey / ctrlKey + k and controls the CommandDialog's open.
An item's value is the text it matches on. When the displayed content differs from the value, add keywords for terms that should find it.
Consequences of a command (delete, publish, …) are not explained in the palette: selecting one should open an AlertDialog or ConfirmAction.
Use Autocomplete or Combobox to choose a text value; a command palette chooses an action.

composition: CommandDialog + CommandInput + CommandList + CommandGroup / CommandItem + CommandEmpty

library: 查询文字、过滤、高亮、空态与组的收起
application: 命令清单、onSelect 的效果、全局快捷键与对话框的打开

responsive: 列表最高占视口高度的 60%，超出在列表内滚动；对话框宽度不超过容器
customization: filter、keywords、shortcut、CommandDialog 的 popupClassName

composition: CommandDialog + CommandInput + CommandList + CommandGroup / CommandItem + CommandEmpty

library: Query text, filtering, highlight, the empty state, and group collapse.
application: The list of commands, what onSelect does, the global shortcut, and opening the dialog.

responsive: The list is at most 60% of the viewport height and scrolls inside; the dialog is never wider than its container.
customization: filter, keywords, shortcut, CommandDialog's popupClassName.
