metadata.title: 确认动作 ConfirmAction
metadata.description: 确认具体对象、版本与变更，内容改变后重新阅读。
metadata.descriptionEn: Confirm a specific object, version, and change; review again when content changes.
metadata.decisions: 确认针对打开时的可读快照。任何对象、版本、变更或后果改变都使旧认可失效；重新阅读会清除旧确认文字。onConfirm 只是请求，Promise 完成不会推断成功或自动关闭。
metadata.decisionsEn: Confirmation targets the reviewed opening snapshot. Changed identity, version, change, or consequence invalidates prior approval. Reviewing again clears confirmation text. onConfirm is a request; resolving a Promise neither infers success nor closes the dialog.

api.name: ConfirmAction
api.description: AlertDialog 与可选 Field/Input 的确认组合；后果是对话框的说明。
api.descriptionEn: A confirmation composition of AlertDialog and optional Field/Input; the consequence is the dialog's description.

props.name: snapshot
props.type: { objectId: string; objectLabel: string; version: string | number; change: string; consequence: string }
props.description: 所有字段必需且有意义；比较包含全部字段。打开捕获不可变副本，确认回调只收到仍对应当前事实的已读副本。
props.descriptionEn: All fields are required and meaningful; comparisons include every field. Opening captures an immutable copy. Confirmation receives only a reviewed copy that still matches current facts.

props.name: title / triggerLabel / actionLabel
props.description: 调用方提供真实对象与动作文字。后果保持可见并关联实际确认按钮。
props.descriptionEn: The caller names the real object and action. Consequences remain visible and linked to confirmation.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: 仅请求动作，不发网络、不拥有结果、不自动关窗。应用通过 loading 表达请求中，通过 children 里的提示组件表达权限、失败或结果未知。
props.descriptionEn: Request only: no network, result ownership, or automatic closing. The application expresses a pending request through loading, and permissions, failure and unknown results through feedback components in children.

props.name: loading / disabled
props.description: loading 表示请求已发出、结果未到：入口与确认动作都显示忙碌并阻止再次请求，保留 Button 的可聚焦 ARIA 禁用；明确 disabled 用原生禁用。返回只关闭界面。
props.descriptionEn: loading means the request is sent and its result has not arrived: both the entry and the confirm action show busy and block another request, keeping Button's focusable ARIA-disabled behavior; explicit disabled is native. Back only closes this UI.

props.name: confirmationText / confirmationLabel
props.description: 可选准确匹配文字，必须同时给出可见标签；FieldDescription 显示需要的文字。重新阅读或重新打开清旧输入。
props.descriptionEn: Optional exact text match with a required visible label. FieldDescription shows the expected text. Reviewing or reopening clears prior input.

props.name: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: 受控或非受控展开，onOpenChange details.cancel() 可拒绝；受控调用方决定是否打开/关闭。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or uncontrolled opening. onOpenChange details.cancel() can reject it; the controlled caller decides opening and closing.

props.name: tone
props.description: 核对输入框读填值控件的一套几何（跟随密度轴）；动作按钮仍用 Button 的尺寸档，因为大小表达位置。tone 表达调用方后果，不赋予权限。
props.descriptionEn: The confirmation input follows the one fill-control geometry (density axis); action buttons keep Button size steps because size expresses position. Tone expresses consequences without granting permission.

props.name: triggerProps / confirmProps / inputProps / popupProps
props.description: 定制真实出口的 render/ref/ARIA/events；confirmProps.onClick 的事件取消阻止请求。入口只打开确认，后果在对话框里给出。
props.descriptionEn: Customize real outlets' render, refs, ARIA, and events. Canceling confirmProps.onClick blocks a request. The entry only opens the confirmation; the dialog states the consequence.

props.name: children
props.description: 附加真实核对内容或应用提供的状态/恢复入口，位于确认面板。
props.descriptionEn: Additional real review content or application-provided state and recovery outlets in the panel.

api.name: ConfirmActionPrimitive
api.description: 所用安装版 AlertDialog 原语命名空间。
api.descriptionEn: The installed AlertDialog primitive namespace.

keyboard.description: 打开确认或请求当前快照；失效与阻止状态不触发。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Open confirmation or request the current snapshot; invalidated and blocked states do not activate.

keyboard.description: 在真实模态与确认输入/动作间移动。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move through the real modal, confirmation input, and actions.

keyboard.description: 退出确认并返回触发入口，不表示取消后台操作。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Leave confirmation and return to its trigger without implying background cancellation.

notes: 内容恢复成旧值也不会自动复活旧认可；必须重新阅读。
确认次数与结果事实归应用；没有自建超时、假成功或自动重试。
浮层、尺寸、焦点与后果关联直接消费当前公共组件及集中预设。
一般 await 布尔决定使用 ConfirmProvider + useConfirm；对象、版本与变更保护继续使用本组件。
请求进行中确认框不可关闭（Esc、点外部、返回都不行）；结果一到，应用自己决定关闭。失败的对象与原因不由本组件保存，确认框关闭后也不会再出现：应用应在关闭前把它们写进页面（Alert 里列出哪些对象失败、原因，并提供重试或知道了），留到用户处理为止。见「失败结果留在页面上」。
notesEn: Restoring old content does not revive old approval; review again.
The application owns action attempts and outcomes. There is no custom timeout, fake success, or automatic retry.
Layering, sizes, focus, and consequence association use current public components and centralized presets.
Use ConfirmProvider + useConfirm for a general awaited boolean decision; retain this component for object, version, and change protection.

While a request is in flight the dialog cannot be closed (not by Esc, outside press or Back); once the result arrives, the application decides when to close it. This component does not keep failed objects or their reasons, and they do not return once the dialog closes: the application should write them to the page before closing (an Alert listing which objects failed and why, with retry or dismiss) and keep them until the user deals with them. See "Failures stay on the page".

composition: ConfirmAction + 明确 snapshot/文字 + 应用 loading/onConfirm；结果用 Alert 或 Toast 表达

library: 展开、已读快照、失效提示、可选确认输入
application: 对象、版本、变更、权限、动作状态与结果

responsive: 一套几何，跟随密度轴，紧凑不缩小文字；模态消费共享可用空间和焦点机制
customization: 各公共部件 props、children 与现有主题

composition: ConfirmAction + explicit snapshot/text + application loading/onConfirm; express the result with Alert or Toast.

library: Open state, reviewed snapshot, invalidation notice, and optional confirmation input.
application: Objects, versions, changes, permissions, action states, and outcomes.

responsive: Five matching control/text profiles; the modal consumes shared space and focus mechanisms.
customization: Public part props, children, and existing theme roles.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 异步确认 Confirm
metadata.description: 等待一次明确决定，再由调用方继续执行。
metadata.descriptionEn: Await one explicit decision, then let the caller continue.
metadata.decisions: await confirm(options) 只返回是否同意；true 不表示提交成功。已有决定在进行时，后续调用排队，前一个结束并退场后再依次打开，各自的 Promise 各自结算；false 只表示决定者拒绝。涉及对象、版本或变更失效时使用 ConfirmAction。
metadata.decisionsEn: await confirm(options) returns approval only; true does not mean a submission succeeded. While a decision is active or closing, later calls wait in order and open after the previous one has closed; each Promise settles on its own, and false only means the decision-maker declined. Use ConfirmAction when changes to an object, version, or change must invalidate approval.

api.name: ConfirmProvider
api.description: 为后代 useConfirm 承载一个模态决定，不额外渲染包裹元素。放在应用的 UILocaleProvider 内。
api.descriptionEn: Host one modal decision for descendant useConfirm calls without adding a wrapper element. Place it inside the application's UILocaleProvider.

props.name: children
props.description: 调用 useConfirm 的应用内容；Provider 卸载时未决 Promise 返回 false。
props.descriptionEn: Application content using useConfirm. Unmounting the provider resolves an outstanding decision to false.

api.name: useConfirm
api.description: 返回稳定的 confirm(options): Promise<boolean>；必须位于 ConfirmProvider 内。
api.descriptionEn: Return a stable confirm(options): Promise<boolean> function. Requires a ConfirmProvider.

props.name: title / description
props.description: 必需且非空；标题标识决定，说明持续显示必要后果并建立可访问关联。调用时捕获选项，之后修改原 options 不替换已读内容。
props.descriptionEn: Required and nonempty. The title names the decision; the description keeps necessary consequences visible and accessible. Options are captured per call; mutating the original options does not replace reviewed content.

props.name: confirmLabel / cancelLabel
props.description: confirmLabel 必填，写出这个决定具体做什么（「移出」「离开」），没有通用的「确认」默认；缺省或空白抛 TypeError。取消按钮和 Escape 都返回 false；点遮罩不关闭。
props.descriptionEn: confirmLabel is required and names what this decision does (Remove, Leave); there is no generic Confirm default, and a missing or blank value throws TypeError. Cancel and Escape resolve false; backdrop presses do not dismiss.

props.name: tone
props.description: 确认按钮的后果色调；需要危险色时显式传 danger，不赋予权限。
props.descriptionEn: The affirmative button's consequence tone. Pass danger explicitly when needed; tone grants no permission.

props.name: popupProps
props.description: 复用公共浮层的 render、ref、ARIA、承载层和焦点入口。默认聚焦安全面板，关闭回到调用时的活动元素；入口可能移除时用 finalFocus 指向仍在的上级。
props.descriptionEn: Reuse public popup render, refs, ARIA, structural layers, and focus targets. Focus starts on the safe panel and returns to the element active at the call. Supply finalFocus with a surviving parent when the entry may be removed.

props.name: signal
props.description: 已中止的调用直接 false；决定中中止会关闭并返回 false。只中止此次决定，不取消已开始的业务请求。
props.descriptionEn: An already-aborted call immediately resolves false. Aborting an active decision closes it and resolves false. This cancels the decision only, not a business request already started.

props.name: Promise<boolean>
props.description: 确认立即返回 true 并关窗；取消、中止、hook 调用方或 Provider 卸载均返回 false。业务执行不等待退场动画；应用用 Button loading、try/finally 和就地错误承接执行与恢复。
props.descriptionEn: Approval immediately resolves true and closes. Cancellation, abort, or unmounting the hook owner or provider resolves false. Business execution does not wait for an exit animation. The application owns execution and recovery through Button loading, try/finally, and inline errors.

keyboard.description: 在当前模态决定内循环；默认进入面板，不自动聚焦确认按钮。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Cycle within the active modal. Focus starts on the panel, never automatically on the affirmative action.

keyboard.description: 激活当前聚焦的明确选择。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Activate the focused explicit choice.

keyboard.description: 拒绝此次决定，返回调用入口或 finalFocus。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Decline this decision and return to the calling entry or finalFocus target.

notes: 同一 Provider 同刻只显示一个决定；其余按调用顺序排队，包含同一事件中的重复调用与退场期间。排队中的调用可被 signal 中止，所属 hook 卸载或 Provider 卸载时返回 false。
调用 useConfirm 的组件卸载会取消它自己的未决决定；保留的旧函数在卸载后也只返回 false。
授权与执行分开：组件不接收 onConfirm 请求函数，不显示提交中，不推断成功、失败或结果未知。
需要文字核对、对象与版本变化后重新审阅时使用 ConfirmAction；一般组合控制使用 AlertDialog。
notesEn: One decision shows per provider; the rest wait in call order, including repeated calls in one event and during closing. A waiting call can be aborted by its signal and resolves false when its hook owner or the provider unmounts.
Unmounting the useConfirm owner cancels its own pending decision. Retained functions also resolve false after the owner unmounts.
Approval and execution are separate: this component accepts no request callback, displays no submitting state, and infers no success, failure, or unknown outcome.
Use ConfirmAction for exact text checks and review after object or version changes; use AlertDialog for direct composition.

whenToUse: 一般流程需要在继续前等待一个明确决定。
avoid: 对象、版本或变更会改变而需要重新审阅；使用 ConfirmAction。
执行中进度、业务结果或通知；由应用和反馈组件承接。
composition: ConfirmProvider + useConfirm；确认后由应用 Button loading、try/finally 与错误恢复接续。

library: 单个未决决定、布尔结果、取消、中止、卸载清理与模态焦点。
application: 决定内容、对象版本、权限、提交状态、请求结果与恢复内容。

responsive: 直接消费 AlertDialog 的可用空间、几何与焦点机制。
customization: 明确动作名称、tone、公共 popupProps 与现有主题。

whenToUse: A general flow must await one explicit decision before proceeding.
avoid: Objects, versions, or changes can invalidate approval; use ConfirmAction.
Execution progress, business outcomes, or notifications belong to the application and feedback components.
composition: ConfirmProvider + useConfirm; the application continues with Button loading, try/finally, and error recovery.

library: One pending decision, its boolean result, cancel, abort, unmount cleanup, and modal focus.
application: Decision content, object versions, permissions, submission state, request outcomes, and recovery content.

responsive: Uses AlertDialog's available space, geometry, and focus mechanisms.
customization: Explicit action names, tone, public popupProps, and existing themes.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 上下文菜单 ContextMenu
metadata.description: 当前对象的右键增强命令入口。
metadata.descriptionEn: A context-menu enhancement for commands on the current object.
metadata.decisions: 右键不是唯一入口；应用同时提供可见 Menu，并复用同一组真实命令。
metadata.decisionsEn: Right click is an enhancement; applications also provide a visible Menu using the same real commands.

api.name: ContextMenu / ContextMenuTrigger
api.description: 同一对象的 Root 与可聚焦触发区域。
api.descriptionEn: Root and focusable trigger region for the same object.

props.name: disabled / onOpenChange
props.description: 禁用根不打开；details.cancel() 可拒绝变化。
props.descriptionEn: A disabled root never opens; details.cancel() may reject a change.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: ContextMenuPortal / ContextMenuPositioner / ContextMenuPopup
api.description: 上下文 Root 自己的浮层。
api.descriptionEn: Floating parts belonging to the context root.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: ContextMenuItem / ContextMenuLinkItem / ContextMenuCheckboxItem / ContextMenuRadioItem / ContextMenuSubmenuTrigger
api.description: 复用本库 Menu 的公开部位与尺寸。
api.descriptionEn: Reuses this library's public Menu parts and sizes.

props.name: size / disabled / choice props
props.description: 不跨 Root 套用 Popover；选择状态与事件保持真实。
props.descriptionEn: Never place another root's Popover parts here; preserve real choices and events.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: ContextMenuGroup / ContextMenuGroupLabel / ContextMenuSeparator / ContextMenuSubmenu / ContextMenuRadioGroup / ContextMenuPrimitive
api.description: 组、分隔与公开原语。
api.descriptionEn: Groups, separators and public primitives.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

notes: 演示中的可见 Menu 与右键区域共用动作；不模拟业务服务。
notesEn: The visible Menu and context region share commands; no business service is simulated.

whenToUse: 对象已有可见操作入口，可附加右键便捷方式。
avoid: 不要只给右键入口或用长按隐藏必须完成的操作。

library: 上下文打开、关闭与键盘命令。
application: 目标对象与同组可见入口。

responsive: 桌面保持真实结构；菜单受可用空间限制，表格保留完整比较列。
customization: 控件档案、间距和浮层表面消费现有角色；具体外观是预设。

whenToUse: An object already has visible actions and may add right-click shortcuts.
avoid: Right-click or long press must not be the sole entry for required actions.

library: Context opening, closing, and keyboard commands.
application: Target objects and corresponding visible actions.

responsive: Keep actual desktop structure; menus fit available space and tables retain complete comparison columns.
customization: Control profiles, spacing, and popup surfaces consume existing roles; their appearance is a preset.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 复制按钮 CopyButton
metadata.description: 复制给定文本，并呈现剪贴板实际写入结果。
metadata.descriptionEn: Copy supplied text and reflect the clipboard write result.

api.name: CopyButton
api.description: 继承 Button 的五档、强调、原生/非原生 render 与 ref。
api.descriptionEn: Inherits Button's five profiles, emphasis, native/non-native render, and refs.

props.name: value
props.description: 本次复制的真实文本；不从 DOM 或业务对象猜测。
props.descriptionEn: The actual text to copy; never inferred from DOM or business objects.

props.name: timeout
props.description: 清除成功反馈的毫秒预设，只清反馈，不建立成功。
props.descriptionEn: A millisecond preset for clearing success feedback; it clears feedback without establishing success.

props.name: onCopySuccess / onCopyError
props.description: writeText resolve 后成功回调；拒绝或 API 不可用走失败回调。
props.descriptionEn: Success callback after writeText resolves; rejection or an unavailable API invokes the error callback.

props.name: size / shape / variant
props.description: 五档继承同档 control/text；icon 形态仍有本地化动作名称。
props.descriptionEn: Five matching control/text profiles; icon shape retains a localized action name.

props.name: disabled / onClick / render / ref / ARIA
props.description: 事件取消阻止写入，等待时屏蔽重复激活；ref 与 render 对应真实按钮。
props.descriptionEn: Canceled events prevent writing; waiting blocks repeated activation. ref and render correspond to the actual button.

api.name: useCopyToClipboard
api.description: CopyButton 背后的 hook；需要自己的按钮外形或触发时机时直接用它。从包根或 @qingye_lab/ui/hooks/use-copy-to-clipboard 导入。返回 { copyToClipboard, isCopying, isCopied }：copyToClipboard(value) 写入 value，navigator.clipboard 不存在（如 http 页面）或被拒绝时回退到临时 textarea + execCommand("copy") 并把焦点还给原元素，回退也失败才走 onError；重复调用只认最后一次，卸载后不再更新状态。isCopying 在写入进行中；isCopied 在写入成功后的 timeout 内为 true；失败时两者都为 false。
api.descriptionEn: The hook behind CopyButton, for when you need your own button form or trigger. Import from the package root or @qingye_lab/ui/hooks/use-copy-to-clipboard. Returns { copyToClipboard, isCopying, isCopied }: copyToClipboard(value) writes value; when navigator.clipboard is absent (for example on an http page) or rejects, it falls back to a temporary textarea + execCommand("copy") and returns focus to the previous element, and onError runs only if the fallback also fails. Only the latest call counts; no state updates after unmount. isCopying is true while the write is in flight; isCopied is true for timeout after a successful write; both are false after a failure.

props.name: timeout
props.description: isCopied 保持为 true 的毫秒数，只清反馈，不建立成功。
props.descriptionEn: Milliseconds isCopied stays true; clears feedback only and never establishes success.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: 写入成功后调用一次（来自写入 Promise resolve 或选区复制返回成功）。
props.descriptionEn: Called once after a successful write (the write Promise resolved, or selection copy reported success).

props.name: onError
props.description: 所有写入路径都失败时调用，error 是 Clipboard API 的拒绝原因；不静默。
props.descriptionEn: Called when every write path failed; error is the Clipboard API rejection reason. Never silent.

keyboard.description: 可用时启动一次复制；等待期间不重复写入。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Start one copy when available; waiting never repeats the write.

notes: 剪贴板需要运行环境支持与权限；http 等非安全上下文没有 Clipboard API 时改用选区复制，两条路都失败才显示「复制失败，请手动复制」，不静默。
切换到「已复制」时按钮宽度不变：两条文字叠放，取较宽者。
onCopySuccess 只确认传入文本写入当前剪贴板，不表示保存或业务完成。
notesEn: Clipboard access needs environment support and permission. Without the Clipboard API (for example on http) the selection copy command is used; only when both fail does the manual-copy message show, never silently.
The button keeps its width when it switches to Copied: both labels share one cell and the wider sets the size.
onCopySuccess confirms only writing the supplied text to the current clipboard, not saving or business completion.
metadata.decisions: CopyButton 复用 useCopyToClipboard，成功从写入 Promise resolve 建立。反馈时间、quiet 默认和图标是选择/预设。
metadata.decisionsEn: CopyButton uses useCopyToClipboard; success comes from the write Promise resolving. Feedback duration, the quiet default, and icons are choices or presets.

whenToUse: 复制已知文本
avoid: 复制后直接宣称业务成功
composition: Button + 实际复制状态/失败恢复

library: 剪贴板等待/实际结果/反馈
application: 文本内容、复制后处理

customization: Button 五档/variant 与 timeout

whenToUse: Copy known text.
avoid: Announcing business success after copying.
composition: Button + actual copy state/failure recovery.

library: Clipboard waiting, actual outcome, and feedback.
application: Text content and subsequent handling.

customization: Button's five profiles/variant and timeout.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 角标 CornerMark
metadata.description: 钉在宿主一角的未读数或在线点，不是宿主内容本身。
metadata.descriptionEn: A count or presence dot anchored to a host's corner, never part of the host's own content.
metadata.decisions: 角标本身是装饰性的：数字必须经宿主的可访问名称，或 label（视觉隐藏文字）才能被读屏听到；零计数直接隐藏，不留空壳。与 Badge（正文里的一段字）、StatusDot（彩色圆点 + 墨色名称）各管各的边界。
metadata.decisionsEn: The mark is decorative on its own: a count only reaches assistive tech through the host's accessible name or the required label (visually hidden text); a zero count hides the mark entirely rather than leaving an empty shell. Kept distinct from Badge (inline text) and StatusDot (a colored dot with an ink label).

api.name: CornerMark
api.description: 包裹宿主内容，角标钉在宿主的右上角。
api.descriptionEn: Wraps the host content; the mark is pinned to the host's top-right corner.

props.name: count / max
props.description: 计数档；超过 max（默认 99）显示「max+」，真实数字仍在 label 里；count 为 0 时角标与 label 一起消失。
props.descriptionEn: The count variant; past max (default 99) it reads "max+" while the real number stays in label; a count of 0 hides the mark and its label together.

props.name: dot
props.description: 不显示数字的圆点档，与 count 互斥。
props.descriptionEn: A digit-free dot variant, mutually exclusive with count.

props.name: label
props.description: 角标本身 aria-hidden；这段视觉隐藏文字是数字或状态唯一确定能被读屏听到的途径，开发环境缺失时会抛错。
props.descriptionEn: The mark itself is aria-hidden; this visually hidden text is the only guaranteed path for the count or status to reach assistive technology. Missing it throws in development.

props.name: tone
props.description: 默认焦墨；success、danger 是已有语义类别，没有脱离类别的彩色。
props.descriptionEn: Defaults to ink; success and danger are existing semantic categories, never hue without meaning.

props.name: className / wrapperClassName
props.description: className 作用于角标本身（例如覆盖纸色圈，使其匹配实际承载面）；wrapperClassName 作用于外层定位容器。
props.descriptionEn: className targets the mark itself (for example overriding the paper-colored ring to match the actual surface); wrapperClassName targets the outer positioning wrapper.

notes: 纸色圈默认读 --qy-surface；宿主底色不是纸面时（例如侧栏行的 --qy-sidebar），用 className 覆盖——库不猜父背景。
notesEn: The paper-colored ring defaults to --qy-surface; when the host's own surface differs (for example a sidebar row's --qy-sidebar), override it via className — the library never guesses a parent background.

whenToUse: 窄处（图标、rail、头像）需要附加一个未读数或存在状态，而没有空间放一整行文字。
avoid: 正文里的一段标注文字用 Badge；要被直接读到的状态名称用 StatusDot。

library: 几何、墨色类别与装饰性标记本身。
application: 真实计数、在线等状态事实与可访问 label 的文字内容。

responsive: 同一个数字可以在不同容器宽度下切换成行内文字或角标——语义与数值必须一致（随境取度）。
customization: 尺寸与圈宽消费现有角色 token；具体墨阶为已验证默认。

whenToUse: A narrow host (an icon, a rail, an avatar) needs an attached unread count or presence fact with no room for a full text line.
avoid: Use Badge for an inline annotation in running text, and StatusDot for a status name meant to be read directly.

library: Geometry, ink categories, and the decorative mark itself.
application: The real count, presence facts such as online, and the accessible label's text.

responsive: The same number may switch between inline text and an anchored mark across container widths — semantics and the value itself must stay identical.
customization: Size and ring width consume existing role tokens; specific ink levels are a verified default.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 数据集合 DataTable
metadata.description: 调用方真实集合的比较、排序、范围选择与可选虚拟化。
metadata.descriptionEn: Comparison, sorting, scoped selection and optional virtualization for a caller-owned collection.
metadata.decisions: 常用集合用 DataTablePattern 配置数据、列与稳定 ID；高级 TanStack 组合继续使用 DataTable。服务端模式不排序或切片传入页；完整跨页选择保存在 rowSelection ID 映射中。虚拟化只改变当前行模型的渲染窗口，不改变全选与分页范围。
metadata.decisionsEn: Configure data, columns and stable IDs with DataTablePattern; retain DataTable for advanced TanStack composition. Server mode does not sort or slice supplied pages; the complete cross-page selection lives in the rowSelection ID map. Virtualization changes only the rendered window of the current row model, preserving selection and pagination scope.

api.name: DataTablePattern
api.description: 配置式排序、当页全选、活动行与分页组合，不发请求。
api.descriptionEn: Configured sorting, page selection, active rows and pagination without issuing requests.

props.name: data / columns / getRowId / emptyContent
props.description: 列显式配置 id、header、accessor、cell、sortable、rowHeader、numeric；可选 size、minSize、maxSize（px）与 ellipsis。写了 size 的列定宽，没写的列平分剩余空间。稳定 getRowId 必填。
props.descriptionEn: Columns configure id, header, accessor, cell, sortable, rowHeader and numeric, with optional size/minSize/maxSize in pixels and ellipsis. Columns with size are fixed; columns without it share the remaining width. Stable getRowId is required.

props.name: state / defaultState / onStateChange
props.description: sorting、pagination、rowSelection、activeRowId 共用快照；排序与回到第 1 页只通知一次。外部页码从 1 开始。
props.descriptionEn: A shared snapshot contains sorting, pagination, rowSelection and activeRowId; sorting and reset to page 1 produce one notification. Public page numbers start at 1.

props.name: mode / pagination
props.description: client 对完整数据排序切片并从 data.length 得到总数；server 只展示传入页，分页必须给 totalCount；未知 null 时还必须给 hasNextPage。
props.descriptionEn: Client mode sorts/slices complete data and derives totals from data.length; server mode presents supplied rows and requires totalCount, plus explicit hasNextPage when null.

props.name: selection
props.description: 启用选择列；全选只改当页可选行并保留范围外 ID。服务端完整选中范围读取 state.rowSelection，不读当前页的 getSelectedRowModel。
props.descriptionEn: Enables selection; select-all changes eligible rows on the current page while preserving outside IDs. Read state.rowSelection for the complete server selection, not the loaded-page getSelectedRowModel.

props.name: activeRow
props.type: ({ trigger?: 'cell', columnId: string } | { trigger: 'row' }) & { onActivate?: (row: T) => void }
props.description: 默认在指定列放激活按钮，cell 保持非交互内容；trigger=row 时点击行正文或聚焦行后按 Enter/Space。内部控件、链接、label 与编辑区不触发行激活；活动行与复选状态独立。
props.descriptionEn: By default the named column gets an activation button and its cell must be noninteractive. With trigger=row, click row content or focus the row and press Enter/Space. Nested controls, links, labels and editors do not activate the row; activation and selection remain independent.

props.name: selectionAppearance
props.description: checkbox 只取消选中行的底色，真实复选框仍保留；活动行的强调独立保留。
props.descriptionEn: Checkbox mode removes only selected-row fill, retaining actual checkboxes and independent active-row emphasis.

props.name: virtualization
props.type: { height: number, estimateRowHeight: number, overscan?: number }
props.description: 显式启用当前行模型的虚拟化；height 含 caption 与表头，实际行高自动测量。尺寸须有限且为正，overscan 为非负整数（默认 1）。
props.descriptionEn: Explicitly virtualizes the current row model. Height includes the caption and header; actual row heights are measured. Dimensions must be finite and positive; overscan is a nonnegative integer, defaulting to 1.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: 表头吸顶。只在表格自己的有界高度容器里生效：虚拟化视口，或 tableProps.containerProps 设了 height / max-height；无高度限制的表格不会吸在页面顶部。
props.descriptionEn: Sticks the header to the top of the table's own bounded-height container: the virtualization viewport, or a height / max-height set through tableProps.containerProps. An unbounded table does not stick to the page top.

props.name: columns[].pinned / columns[].empty
props.description: pinned 固定从第一列起连续的前导列（选择列自动一并固定，不连续时抛错），横向滚动后末端出现一条线。empty 是无 cell 的列在 null、undefined、空串时显示的内容，默认「—」加读屏的「无值」；0 照常显示。未知与不适用由调用方用 empty 区分。
props.descriptionEn: pinned fixes a contiguous run of leading columns (the selection column is pinned with them; non-contiguous pins throw) and draws an edge line once scrolled sideways. empty replaces the default dash plus screen-reader 'No value' for null, undefined or empty strings in columns without cell; zero still renders. Callers distinguish unknown from not applicable through empty.

props.name: caption / busy / error / tableProps / native div props
props.type: ReactNode / boolean / ReactNode / DataTableProps / HTML props
props.description: busy 时旧数据行不动，表格顶缘出现不定进度记号，分页暂时挡住翻页但焦点留在原按钮。error 由应用给出内容和重试动作，摆在表格上方并声明 role=alert，旧数据行同样保留。属性分别归属表格或组合外层，不推断请求成功或失败。
props.descriptionEn: While busy the old rows stay put, an indeterminate mark appears along the top edge and the pager blocks paging while keeping focus on the pressed button. error is application content with its own retry action, placed above the table as role=alert; old rows stay as well. Props target the table or composition root and never infer request outcomes.

api.name: DataTable
api.description: 原生二维集合。
api.descriptionEn: A native two-dimensional collection.

props.name: table / emptyContent / caption / busy / error / activeRowId / containerProps
props.description: getRowId 必填、至少一列；零值/caption 保留，busy 不删除有效 rows，也不变暗。数据行悬停读悬停面，选中与活动行保持更深的选中面。error 摆在表格上方（role=alert），应用自带重试动作。
props.descriptionEn: GetRowId and at least one visible column are required; zero and caption are retained, and busy keeps valid rows without dimming them. Data rows take the hover surface on pointer hover; selected and active rows keep the deeper selected surface. error is placed above the table as role=alert and carries its own retry action.

props.name: table.options.columns[].size / table.options.columns[].minSize / table.options.columns[].maxSize / table.options.state.columnSizing
props.description: 实际像素列宽，按 minSize/maxSize 钳制。显式配置任一尺寸或非空 columnSizing 时启用固定布局与 colgroup；未配置尺寸时保持原生自动布局。写了 size（或 defaultColumn.size，或 columnSizing 里有它）的列定宽，标记列取内容宽，其余列是弹性列：表宽 100%，弹性列平分剩余空间，minSize 是它的下限，未写 minSize 时下限为 150px（TanStack 默认 size）。表格最小宽度 = 定宽列之和 + 标记列之和 + 弹性列数 × 各弹性列下限的最大值，窄于此值时横向滚动。弹性列的 maxSize 不约束宽度，需要上限就写 size。没有弹性列时表宽等于各列之和，组合表头取可见叶列之和。不内置拖拽调宽。
props.descriptionEn: Actual pixel widths clamped by minSize/maxSize. Any explicit dimension or nonempty columnSizing opts into fixed layout with colgroup; otherwise native auto layout remains. A column with size (or defaultColumn.size, or an entry in columnSizing) is fixed, a marker column takes its content width, and every other column is flexible: the table is 100% wide, flexible columns split the remaining space, minSize is a flexible column's floor, and without minSize the floor is 150px (TanStack's default size). The table's minimum width is the fixed columns plus the marker columns plus the flexible column count times the largest flexible floor; below it the table scrolls horizontally. maxSize does not constrain a flexible column; write size when a cap is needed. Without flexible columns the table is as wide as its columns together, and grouped headers sum visible leaf widths. Drag resizing is not built in.

props.name: columnDef.meta.ellipsis
props.description: 对非交互的表头与单元格文字启用单行省略。完整文字始终在 DOM 与可访问名称里；真的被截断时这一格成为键盘停靠点，聚焦或悬停以 Tooltip 显示全文（不用原生 title：键盘与触屏读不到）。放得下的格不占 Tab 序列。含控件的内容不裁切。不省略时单元格默认折行显示全文；列宽决定容量，关键后果仍应直接可见。
props.descriptionEn: Ellipsizes noninteractive header/cell text on one line. The full text always stays in the DOM and accessible name; when actually truncated the cell becomes a keyboard stop and shows the full text in a Tooltip on focus or hover (not a native title, which keyboards and touch cannot read). Cells that fit stay out of the Tab sequence. Interactive content is not clipped. Without ellipsis cells wrap and show the full text; column widths determine capacity, so keep critical consequences visible.

props.name: columnDef.meta.numeric
props.description: 数值列由列定义声明，不由内容猜：表头与该列每个单元格同一对齐——行内末端（RTL 下在左）并用等宽数字。Pattern 的列配置同名。
props.descriptionEn: A numeric column is declared by the column definition, never guessed from content: header and every cell share one alignment, at the inline end (left in RTL), with tabular figures. The Pattern column config uses the same name.

props.name: selectionAppearance / onRowActivate / virtualization
props.description: 选择外观与虚拟化同 Pattern；行激活回调收到 TanStack Row，调用方持有 activeRowId。整张表只有一行在 Tab 序列里（最近聚焦的行，否则活动行，否则第一行），方向键在行间移动。点击内部交互元素不激活，data-row-activate-ignore 可排除自定义区域；不改变选择。需要一个可见的 meta.rowHeader 列给行命名，否则抛错。
props.descriptionEn: Selection appearance and virtualization match Pattern. Row activation receives a TanStack Row; the caller owns activeRowId. Only one row is in the Tab sequence (the last focused row, else the active row, else the first) and arrow keys move between rows. Nested interactive elements and custom data-row-activate-ignore regions are excluded, and activation never changes selection. A visible meta.rowHeader column is required to name the rows; without one it throws.

props.name: columnDef.meta.rowHeader
props.description: 实际行标题用 th scope=row；比较列不自动隐藏。有可见行标题列时，每一行的 aria-labelledby 指向该行所有行标题单元格，行的可访问名称即这些单元格的文字（多个行标题列按列序连接）。DataTableSelectionCell 用它给每个选择框命名为「选择“该行名称”」，没有行标题列时才用泛称。设置了 onRowActivate 却没有可见的行标题列时抛错。
props.descriptionEn: Actual row headers use th scope=row; comparison columns are never automatically hidden. With a visible row-header column, each row's aria-labelledby points at all of its row-header cells, so the row's accessible name is their text (several row-header columns join in column order). DataTableSelectionCell names each checkbox after this row, falling back to a generic name only without a row-header column. onRowActivate without a visible row-header column throws.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: DataTableSortButton
api.description: 应用实例的真实排序入口。
api.descriptionEn: A real sorting control for the caller instance.

props.name: column / Button props
props.description: 触发 TanStack sorter；仅主排序表头写 aria-sort，多重顺序由应用补充。
props.descriptionEn: Invokes TanStack sorting; only the primary header gets aria-sort, and applications explain secondary sort order.

api.name: DataTableSelectionCell / DataTableSelectAll
api.description: 行选择与显式范围选择。
api.descriptionEn: Row selection and explicit scope selection.

props.name: row / table / scope / aria-label
props.description: 全选的 aria-label 和 scope 必填；checked/mixed 只看该范围可选择 rows。aria-label 只写动作与对象（如「选择条目」），组件按 scope 把范围追加到可访问名称末尾（「仅本页」或「全部筛选结果」），读屏用户据此知道勾选的后果。
props.descriptionEn: Select-all requires aria-label and scope; checked/mixed considers only selectable rows in that scope. Write the action and object in aria-label (for example "Select entries"); the component appends the range to the accessible name ("this page only" or "all filtered results") so screen reader users know what checking it selects.

props.name: onCheckedChange / disabled / ref
props.description: 取消原语细节可阻止改变选择，禁用行不进入全选。
props.descriptionEn: Primitive cancellation prevents selection changes; disabled rows are excluded from select-all.

keyboard.description: 聚焦可激活行后执行行激活；内部控件保留自己的键盘行为。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Activate a focused actionable row; nested controls retain their own keyboard behavior.

keyboard.description: 行激活或虚拟化时，在行间移动焦点（虚拟化时也可从滚动容器出发，目标行先滚动渲染）；不会接管内部输入框的编辑键位。
keyboard.descriptionEn: With row activation or virtualization, move focus between rows (in virtual mode also from the viewport, scrolling the target row into render first) without intercepting editing keys in nested inputs.

notes: 标准组合从 components/data-table 导入 DataTablePattern；分页内置复用 PaginationPattern。跨页选择的对象内容、权限与批量执行范围仍由应用核实。
TanStack 为已声明的可选 peer；应用明确启用排序/筛选/分页模型。
只用排序与选择、不分页时，给 useReactTable 传 `autoResetAll: false`：它的自动重置在渲染之外排队更新状态，页面经 Suspense 懒加载时，被丢弃的那次渲染会让 React 报「未挂载组件更新状态」。
固定布局中未写 size 的文字列是弹性列，平分定宽列与标记列之外的剩余空间；标记列仍按已有 marker 与单元格内缘角色取宽。列宽过小不会裁掉交互控件，请给操作列留下真实容量。
虚拟化保留 table/thead/tbody/tr/th/td。aria-rowcount 与 aria-rowindex 描述当前表格页（含表头），不把服务端全局总数冒充已加载行；全选仍覆盖当前模型的完整范围。
虚拟行按稳定 ID 测量，支持实际可变行高；estimateRowHeight 应接近真实行高，未测量的远端行仍是估计。建议显式列宽，避免自动布局因窗口内容变化而重排；纯客户端页面需要查看或打印所有行时关闭虚拟化。
焦点所在的离屏行额外保留一行，输入草稿不因滚动丢失；该行移出当前模型时，焦点仍属于它才回到滚动容器。
notesEn: Import DataTablePattern from components/data-table; its pager reuses PaginationPattern. Applications still verify cross-page object data, permissions and bulk-action scope.
TanStack is a declared optional peer; applications explicitly enable sorting, filtering and pagination models.

With sorting and selection only and no pagination, pass `autoResetAll: false` to useReactTable: its automatic reset queues a state update outside render, and when the page loads lazily through Suspense a discarded render makes React warn about updating an unmounted component.

In fixed layout, text columns without size are flexible and split the width left over by fixed and marker columns; marker columns retain their marker and cell-inset roles. Interactive content is not clipped to force a narrow width: allow actual capacity for action columns.

Virtualization retains table/thead/tbody/tr/th/td. Aria-rowcount and aria-rowindex describe the current table page including headers, without presenting server totals as loaded rows. Select-all still covers the complete current model scope.

Virtual rows are measured by stable ID and support variable actual heights. Choose an estimateRowHeight close to actual rows: distant unmeasured heights remain estimates. Explicit column widths prevent window content from changing natural layout. Disable virtualization to view or print all client rows.
One extra offscreen row retains focus and editor drafts while scrolling. When it leaves the current model, focus returns to the viewport only if that row still owned focus.

whenToUse: 真实集合按共同维度比较并需要排序或选择。
avoid: 不请求服务、不猜总数、不把未知当空、不自动删列。

library: 表格语义、公共组合与范围选择。
application: 数据、稳定标识、服务端结果与业务范围；高级模式另持有 TanStack 实例。

responsive: 桌面保持真实结构；菜单受可用空间限制，表格保留完整比较列。
customization: 控件档案、间距和浮层表面消费现有角色；具体外观是预设。

whenToUse: Compare an actual collection along shared dimensions with sorting or selection.
avoid: Requesting services, guessing totals, treating unknown as empty, or automatically removing columns.

library: Table semantics, public composition, and scoped selection.
application: TanStack instance, data, stable identifiers, model configuration, and state.

responsive: Keep actual desktop structure; menus fit available space and tables retain complete comparison columns.
customization: Control profiles, spacing, and popup surfaces consume existing roles; their appearance is a preset.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 日期输入 DatePicker
metadata.description: 编辑一个当地日期，或展开日历选择。
metadata.descriptionEn: Edit one local date or choose it from a calendar.
metadata.decisions: value 是调用方持有的当地 Date。输入和日历选择只请求变更；清除请求 undefined，Escape 关闭日历并保留已接受值。
metadata.decisionsEn: The caller owns the local Date. Input and calendar selection request changes; clearing requests undefined. Escape closes the calendar and preserves accepted values.

api.name: DatePicker
api.description: 当前 Input、Button、Popover、Calendar 的单日期组合。
api.descriptionEn: A single-date composition of Input, Button, Popover, and Calendar.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.type: Date | undefined / Date | undefined / (value, event) => void
props.description: 传了 value 属性（含 value={undefined}，表示空）即受控：调用方接受回调才改变事实。不传 value 则非受控，defaultValue 是初值，原生表单 reset 回到它，onValueChange 可省。有效年份为 1–9999。
props.descriptionEn: Passing the value prop (including value={undefined} for empty) makes it controlled: only an accepted callback changes the value. Without it the component is uncontrolled, defaultValue is the initial value, native form reset returns to it, and onValueChange is optional. Valid years are 1–9999.

props.name: min / max
props.description: 一处声明最早 / 最晚日期，同时写入原生输入的 min / max 与日历的禁用范围和可翻到的月份。与 inputProps.min/max、calendarProps.disabled/startMonth/endMonth 并存，同时给出时取交集；交集为空时开发环境警告（2026-10-12）。
props.descriptionEn: Declare the earliest and latest date once; it sets the native min / max and the calendar's disabled range and reachable months. It coexists with inputProps.min/max and calendarProps.disabled/startMonth/endMonth, and the intersection applies when both are given. An empty intersection warns in development (2026-10-12).

props.name: name / form
props.description: 真实 date input 参与原生 FormData；Field name 可提供共同命名。序列化为当地 YYYY-MM-DD。
props.descriptionEn: The real date input submits local YYYY-MM-DD. Field can provide its name; form associates an external form.

props.name: disabled / readOnly
props.description: 阻止输入与附属选择/清除；Field 禁用同样约束动作。只读值提交，禁用值不提交；只读时边界内给出「只读」说明（与 Input 同一机制）。
props.descriptionEn: Block input and auxiliary changes. Field disabled also blocks actions. Read-only values submit; disabled values do not. Read-only shows a Read only note inside the boundary, the same as Input.

props.name: inputProps
props.description: ref/render/ARIA/events/min/max/step/required 属于真实 date input。onChange 的 preventDefault 或 preventBaseUIHandler 可取消请求。
props.descriptionEn: ref, render, ARIA, events, min, max, step, and required reach the real date input. onChange can cancel a request.

props.name: calendarProps
props.description: 控制日期禁用、导航边界、locale 等；mode 与确认值由组合持有。原生 step 仍在 inputProps；日期边界优先用顶层 min / max 一处声明。
props.descriptionEn: Configure disabled dates, navigation bounds, and locale. The composition owns mode and selection. Native step stays in inputProps; prefer the top-level min / max to declare date bounds once.

props.name: render / ref / className / style / ARIA / events
props.description: 属于组合根；实际输入出口放在 inputProps。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the composition root. Use inputProps for the actual input outlet.

keyboard.description: 经过日期输入、日历展开与清除动作。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move through the date input, calendar trigger, and clear action.

keyboard.description: 展开后由 Calendar 管理日期网格键盘。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Calendar owns date-grid keyboard interaction while open.

keyboard.description: 关闭展开并返回触发入口。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Close the popup and return to its trigger.

notes: 日期输入的本地显示格式由浏览器决定，提交值固定 YYYY-MM-DD。
日历选择完成后关闭；调用方拒绝变更时原日期仍保留。
没有自动修正越界值或推断提交成功；用 FieldError 表达调用方已知错误。
年份可键到 5–6 位、分段可只填一半：这些键入中间态不是值，不上报也不清空已有值，焦点离开后回到已接受的日期；只有所有分段都被清空才是清除。
notesEn: The browser chooses the displayed date format; submission uses YYYY-MM-DD.
Calendar selection closes the popup. Rejected controlled changes preserve the prior date.
The component does not repair bounds or infer submission success. Express known errors with FieldError.

The year can be typed to five or six digits and a segment can be left half-filled. These in-between entries are not values: they neither report nor clear the accepted date, and the input returns to it once focus leaves. Only emptying every segment clears.

composition: Field + FieldLabel + DatePicker + FieldDescription / FieldError

library: 展开、日历焦点
application: 日期、约束、错误、提交结果

responsive: 一套几何，跟随密度轴，紧凑不缩小文字，内部边框焦点；粗指针使用库内触摸目标
customization: inputProps、calendarProps、根 render/ref 和现有主题角色

composition: Field + FieldLabel + DatePicker + FieldDescription / FieldError

library: Opening and calendar focus.
application: Dates, constraints, errors, and submission outcomes.

responsive: Five matching control/text profiles with internal border focus; coarse pointers use the library's touch target.
customization: inputProps, calendarProps, root render/refs, and existing theme roles.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 日期范围 DateRangePicker
metadata.description: 键入或在日历中选择起止日期，完整且有序时才是确认值。
metadata.descriptionEn: Type or pick start and end dates; only a complete, ordered range is a confirmed value.
metadata.decisions: 只有完整且有序的 from/to 才是确认值。起止两个原生日期输入与弹层日历共用同一份草稿：键入得出完整有序的范围即请求变更；只填一端、反向或越界不提交，焦点离开后两个输入标 aria-invalid 并通过 onInvalid 交给应用说明，库不静默交换端点。日历里的选择与预设只写草稿，取消或 Escape 保留原确认值，应用才请求替换。
metadata.decisionsEn: Only a complete, ordered from/to is a confirmed value. The two native date inputs and the popup calendar share one draft: typing a complete ordered range requests the change at once; one endpoint alone, a reversed range, or one out of bounds is not submitted, and after focus leaves both inputs are marked aria-invalid and onInvalid hands the explanation to the application. Endpoints are never swapped silently. Calendar picks and presets only write the draft; Cancel or Escape keeps the confirmed value and Apply requests the replacement.

api.name: DateRangePicker
api.description: 起止两个原生日期输入、日历草稿、常用范围与明确应用动作的组合。
api.descriptionEn: A composition of two native date inputs, a calendar draft, presets, and an explicit Apply.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.type: { from: Date; to: Date } | undefined / same / (value, event) => void
props.description: 传了 value 属性（含 value={undefined}）即受控；不传则非受控，defaultValue 是初值，原生表单 reset 回到它，onValueChange 可省。起点须不晚于终点；清除请求 undefined，不生成缺端点提交值。
props.descriptionEn: Passing the value prop (including value={undefined}) makes it controlled; without it the component is uncontrolled, defaultValue is the initial value, native form reset returns to it, and onValueChange is optional. Endpoints must be ordered; clearing requests undefined and a partial range never submits.

props.name: onInvalid
props.type: (draft: { from?: Date; to?: Date }, reason: "incomplete" | "order" | "bounds" | "length" | "disabled") => void
props.description: 草稿无法提交：只填一端（incomplete）、起点晚于终点（order）、超出 min / max（bounds）、天数不合 calendarProps 的 min / max（length）、端点落在禁用日或 excludeDisabled 时跨过禁用日（disabled）——与日历点选执行同一组规则。只在焦点离开整个字段且弹层关闭后通知，同时两个输入标 aria-invalid；键入是逐段进行的，过程中的暂时状态不算。库不写文案，应用用 FieldError 说明。
props.descriptionEn: The draft cannot be submitted: one endpoint only (incomplete), start after end (order), outside min / max (bounds), an interval length outside calendarProps min / max (length), or an endpoint on a disabled day, or a disabled day inside the range with excludeDisabled (disabled) — the same rules the calendar applies. Reported only after focus has left the whole field and the popup is closed, with both inputs marked aria-invalid; typing is segment by segment, so transient states do not count. The library writes no copy; the application explains with FieldError.

props.name: min / max
props.description: 一处声明最早 / 最晚日期，同时写入两个原生输入与日历的禁用范围、可翻到的月份，并使超出范围的预设不可点。与 inputProps.min/max、calendarProps.disabled 并存，取交集；交集为空时开发环境警告。
props.descriptionEn: Declare the earliest and latest date once; it sets both native inputs, the calendar's disabled range and reachable months, and disables presets that fall outside. It coexists with inputProps.min/max and calendarProps.disabled; the intersection applies, and an empty one warns in development.

props.name: presets
props.type: readonly { label: string; value: DateRangeValue | (() => DateRangeValue) }[]
props.description: 常用范围，显示在日历旁。函数形式在每次打开弹层时求值（「近 7 日」不会因页面跨过午夜而陈旧）；点击只写入草稿并翻到该月，仍须应用。草稿恰等于某一项时该项为当前（aria-pressed）。库只接收应用算好的绝对区间，不自己算相对日期。
props.descriptionEn: Common ranges beside the calendar. A function value is evaluated every time the popup opens, so Last 7 days never goes stale across midnight. Clicking only writes the draft and moves to that month; Apply is still required. The preset equal to the draft is current (aria-pressed). The library receives absolute ranges computed by the application and never computes relative dates itself.

props.name: name / form
props.description: 确认端点序列化为 name.from 与 name.to 的当地 YYYY-MM-DD。Field 可提供 name；两个日期输入本身不提交，草稿不入表单。
props.descriptionEn: Confirmed endpoints submit local YYYY-MM-DD under name.from and name.to. Field may provide the name; the two date inputs do not submit and the draft never reaches the form.

props.name: disabled / readOnly
props.description: 禁用阻止一切；只读时两个输入可聚焦、读屏读出值，但不能改值，日历入口也不开（与 Select 一致）。Field 禁用同样约束附属动作。只读确认端点仍提交，禁用排除。只读时边界内给出「只读」说明。确认范围非空且可编辑时，边界内有清除动作，清除后焦点回到起点输入。
props.descriptionEn: Disabled blocks everything. Read-only keeps both inputs focusable and readable but the value cannot change and the calendar entry does not open (as in Select). Field disabled blocks the same actions. Read-only endpoints submit; disabled endpoints are excluded. Read-only shows a Read only note in the boundary. With a confirmed range and while editable, the boundary has a clear action; focus returns to the start input after clearing.

props.name: calendarProps
props.description: min/max 指日期间隔规则（天数，与顶层的日期 min / max 不同），excludeDisabled 约束跨禁用日期。默认同日范围合法；要跨日明确传 min。mode 固定 range。
props.descriptionEn: min/max here are day-interval rules (a count of days, unlike the top-level date min / max); excludeDisabled constrains disabled days. Same-day ranges are valid by default; require a cross-day range with min. Mode is range.

props.name: inputProps / endInputProps
props.description: 起点输入（Field 标签指向它）与终点输入的 ref/render/ARIA/events/step 等。两个输入默认名称是「Field 标签 + 开始日期 / 结束日期」。
props.descriptionEn: ref, render, ARIA, events, step, and so on for the start input (the one a Field label points to) and the end input. By default the two names are the Field label plus Start date / End date.

props.name: render / ref / className / style / ARIA / events
props.description: 属于组合根；输入命名与错误由 Field 公共组合提供。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the composition root; Field provides input naming and errors.

keyboard.description: 起点、终点、日历入口，展开后到常用范围、日历与应用、取消、清除；未完成草稿不能应用。键入不必经过日历。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Start, end, the calendar entry; once open, presets, the calendar, then Apply, Cancel, and Clear. An incomplete draft cannot be applied. Typing never needs the calendar.

keyboard.description: 在真实网格中选择范围草稿。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Select a range draft in the real calendar grid.

keyboard.description: 关闭草稿并返回触发入口，保留确认端点。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Close the draft and return to its trigger, preserving confirmed endpoints.

notes: 两个日期输入是原生输入，显示格式随浏览器；键入与日历共用一份草稿，互相同步。
每次打开从当前输入内容建立草稿；没有默认业务长度或自动纠正。
只读时不开弹层：值在、可聚焦、可读出，不能改。
notesEn: The two date inputs are native, so the display format follows the browser. Typing and the calendar share one draft and stay in step.
Each opening starts from what the inputs currently hold. There is no default business duration or automatic repair.
Read-only does not open the popup: the value is there, focusable and readable, but it cannot change.

metadata.title: 日期时间 DateTimePicker
metadata.description: 编辑完整的当地墙上日期与时间，或应用日历与时间草稿。
metadata.descriptionEn: Edit complete local wall-clock date/time, or apply calendar and time drafts.
metadata.decisions: value 是 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm[:ss] 的无时区 wall-clock 文本。它不表示 UTC 瞬间；时区、DST、业务可用时段由应用决定。空时间不会自动补当前时间。
metadata.decisionsEn: value is unzoned YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm[:ss] wall-clock text, not a UTC instant. The application owns timezone, DST, and availability rules. Empty time never becomes the current time automatically.

api.name: DateTimePicker
api.description: 真实 datetime-local Input 与日期/时间草稿组合。
api.descriptionEn: A real datetime-local input composed with calendar and time drafts.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.type: string | undefined / string | undefined / (value, event) => void
props.description: 传了 value 属性（含 value={undefined}）即受控；不传则非受控，defaultValue 是初值，原生表单 reset 回到它，onValueChange 可省。完整本地日期时间：有效年份 1–9999、时间 00:00–23:59，可带秒。带时区或不完整外部字符串拒绝；清除请求 undefined。
props.descriptionEn: Passing the value prop (including value={undefined}) makes it controlled; without it the component is uncontrolled, defaultValue is the initial value, native form reset returns to it, and onValueChange is optional. Complete local date/time: years 1–9999, time 00:00–23:59, optional seconds. Zoned or incomplete external strings are rejected; clearing requests undefined.

props.name: min / max
props.description: 同样的无时区文本。一处声明同时写入原生输入的 min / max、日历的禁用日期与可翻到的月份、边界当天时间输入的 min / max，并使超出范围的草稿不能应用。与 inputProps.min/max、calendarProps.disabled 并存，取交集；交集为空时开发环境警告（2026-10-12）。
props.descriptionEn: Unzoned text of the same form. Declare once: it sets the native min / max, the calendar's disabled days and reachable months, the time input's min / max on a boundary day, and blocks applying a draft outside the range. It coexists with inputProps.min/max and calendarProps.disabled; the intersection applies, and an empty one warns in development (2026-10-12).

props.name: name / form
props.description: 仅确认的 datetime-local input 参与 FormData；日历与时间草稿不具提交 name。Field 可提供 name。
props.descriptionEn: Only the confirmed datetime-local input submits. Calendar and time drafts have no submission names. Field may provide the name.

props.name: disabled / readOnly
props.description: 阻止原生编辑、清除与展开修改；Field disabled 同样约束动作。只读值提交，禁用值不提交；只读时边界内给出「只读」说明。非空且可编辑时，边界内有清除动作，清除后焦点回到输入。
props.descriptionEn: Block native editing, clearing and popup changes, including Field disabled. Read-only values submit; disabled values do not; read-only shows a Read only note in the boundary. With a value and while editable, the boundary has a clear action and focus returns to the input after clearing.

props.name: inputProps
props.description: 真实输入的 min/max/step/required/ARIA/events/ref/render；step 同时交给草稿 time Input。onChange 可取消原生编辑请求。
props.descriptionEn: Native min, max, step, required, ARIA, events, refs, and render. step also reaches the time draft. onChange can cancel native edit requests.

props.name: calendarProps
props.description: 声明日期禁用与导航边界。日期边界优先用顶层 min / max 一处声明；单独给 inputProps.min/max 时库不从中猜禁用日期。
props.descriptionEn: Declare disabled dates and navigation bounds. Prefer the top-level min / max to declare bounds once; inputProps.min/max alone does not imply disabled calendar days.

props.name: render / ref / className / style / ARIA / events
props.description: 组合根出口；实际输入出口通过 inputProps 定制。
props.descriptionEn: Composition root outlet; customize the actual input through inputProps.

keyboard.description: 经过真实日期时间输入与展开入口，展开后到日期、时间与动作。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move through the native input and trigger; while open, reach calendar, time, and actions.

keyboard.description: 仅改变日期草稿；时间保持真实输入值。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Change only the date draft; time retains its real input value.

keyboard.description: 退出本次草稿，回到触发入口。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Leave the current draft and return to its trigger.

notes: 应用仅在日期与时间完整时可用，点击后仍由调用方接受值。
原生 min/max/step 校验与业务可用性是独立事实；回调不是保存成功。
浏览器显示格式可随用户环境变化，提交保持无时区的本地文本。
notesEn: Apply is available only with complete date and time; the caller still accepts the value.
Native min/max/step validation and business availability are independent. A callback is not successful persistence.
The browser's display may vary by environment; submission remains unzoned local text.

metadata.title: 名称与值 DescriptionList
metadata.description: 名称和值的原生关系。
metadata.descriptionEn: Native relationships between names and values.
metadata.decisions: dl 中以 div 组织 dt/dd，值作为 children 原样呈现，不用真假判断替换零。
metadata.decisionsEn: A dl groups dt/dd in div elements; children render unchanged without replacing zero through truthiness checks.

whenToUse: 一个对象的名称与值需要对应呈现。
avoid: 多个对象跨维度比较使用 Table。

library: dl、dt、dd 及分组关系。
application: 名称、值、单位、零、未知与不适用文字。

responsive: columns 给出并排组数上限，容器按实宽自动退回更少列；长值完整换行。

whenToUse: Present corresponding names and values for one object.
avoid: Use Table to compare several objects across dimensions.

library: dl, dt, dd, and grouping relationships.
application: Names, values, units, zero, unknown, and not-applicable text.

responsive: columns sets the upper bound of side-by-side groups and the list falls back to fewer by its own measured width; long values wrap fully.

api.name: DescriptionList
api.description: 原生 dl。
api.descriptionEn: A native dl.

props.name: columns
props.description: 并排的「名称 · 值」组数上限，正整数。按 DOM 顺序逐行排开（先横后纵），读屏顺序与视觉顺序一致；同一列的名称共用一条值的起始线。容器放不下时按容器实宽（不看视口）退回更少列：一组至少 12 材（默认 240px，预设）。
props.descriptionEn: Upper bound of side-by-side name-and-value groups, a positive integer. Items flow row by row in DOM order, so reading order matches visual order, and names in one column share a value start line. When the container cannot hold them the list falls back to fewer columns by its own width, not the viewport: a group needs at least 12 modules (240px by default, a preset).

props.name: layout
props.description: stacked：名称在左、值在右成对。inline：每个条目是名称在上、值在下的一小块，块与块横排并随宽度换行（columns 给出时按列数分格，最小块宽 8 材，预设）。两者都是 dl > div > dt + dd。
props.descriptionEn: stacked: names on the left, values on the right. inline: each item is a small block with the name above the value, blocks flowing horizontally and wrapping with the width (with columns they are split into that many cells, at least 8 modules wide, a preset). Both are dl > div > dt + dd.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性与 ref 属于实际名称值列表。
props.descriptionEn: Props and ref reach the actual description list.

api.name: DescriptionListItem
api.description: div 成组名称与值。
api.descriptionEn: A div grouping names and values.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 名称与值的分组；排布由列表的 columns 与 layout 决定，关系不变。
props.descriptionEn: Groups a name and its value; placement follows the list's columns and layout without changing semantics.

api.name: DescriptionListTerm / DescriptionListDetail
api.description: 原生 dt / dd。
api.descriptionEn: Native dt / dd.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 0、未知、不适用由应用分别提供，可含合法链接。
props.descriptionEn: The application supplies zero, unknown and not applicable separately; valid links are supported.

notes: 需要跨多个对象比较同一维度时使用 Table。
notesEn: Use Table to compare the same dimension across multiple objects.

metadata.title: 对话框 Dialog
metadata.description: 接管整个工作面，完成当前编辑或决定后返回。
metadata.descriptionEn: Take over the work surface for an edit or decision, then return.
metadata.decisions: 关闭结束当前呈现并返回触发者，不代表保存。输入内容与后续动作由调用方持有。
metadata.decisionsEn: Closing ends the presentation and returns to the trigger; it does not imply saving. The caller owns input values and subsequent actions.

api.name: Dialog
api.description: 固定完整阻断模式，保留原语的受控、非受控与共享触发入口。
api.descriptionEn: Always fully modal, retaining controlled, uncontrolled and shared-trigger state.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: 应用控制状态 / 初始展开状态。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled state / initial uncontrolled state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: 收到打开/关闭请求及原因；不表示提交或取消业务。
props.descriptionEn: Receive state requests and reasons, without implying business submission or cancellation.

props.name: handle / triggerId / defaultTriggerId
props.description: 关联共享、受控或初始展开的触发者。
props.descriptionEn: Associate shared, controlled or initially open triggers.

props.name: disablePointerDismissal
props.description: 应用确需阻止点遮罩关闭时启用，仍须保留明确退出。
props.descriptionEn: Prevent backdrop dismissal when required, keeping an explicit exit.

api.name: DialogPopup
api.description: 组合 Portal、遮罩与视口，内容固有宽度受视口约束；不提供尺寸变体。
api.descriptionEn: Compose a portal, backdrop and viewport with content-driven width and no size variants.

props.name: initialFocus
props.type: true | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | (interaction) => HTMLElement | true | null
props.description: 默认首个控件；触摸进入面板。可指定字段、标题或面板；不支持 false。
props.descriptionEn: First control by default, or the panel on touch. A field, heading or panel can be specified; false is unsupported.

props.name: finalFocus
props.type: true | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | (interaction) => HTMLElement | true | null
props.description: 默认触发者；触发者会被移除时指定可聚焦上级，不能返回 false。
props.descriptionEn: Return to the trigger by default. Provide a focusable parent if it disappears; false is unsupported.

props.name: portalProps / backdropProps / viewportProps
props.description: 容器、ref、样式、事件与 render 透传；Portal 不支持保留关闭DOM，局部语言、密度、方向需明确容器。
props.descriptionEn: Forward containers, refs, styling, events and render. Retaining closed portal DOM is unsupported; set a container for local language, density or direction.

props.name: render / ref / className / style
props.description: 覆盖呈现与组合，className 支持原语状态函数。
props.descriptionEn: Compose or override presentation; className supports primitive state functions.

api.name: DialogTitle / DialogDescription
api.description: 原语建立可访问名称与说明的关联；说明不是重复标题。
api.descriptionEn: Primitive-managed accessible name and description; avoid repeating the title.

api.name: DialogTrigger / DialogClose
api.description: 默认复用 Button，支持 render/ref/事件；Close 缺少 children 时读取 locale.close。
api.descriptionEn: Use Button by default, with render/ref/events. An empty Close reads locale.close.

api.name: DialogHeader / DialogPanel / DialogFooter
api.description: 名称、工作内容、动作的分组关系。长内容时页眉与页脚固定，只有 DialogPanel 滚动。支持 useRender 组合；不产生另一层围合。
api.descriptionEn: Group names, working content and actions. With long content the header and footer stay fixed and only DialogPanel scrolls. Supports useRender composition and adds no extra enclosure.

api.name: DialogCreateHandle / DialogPrimitive
api.description: 类型化共享触发 handle 与所用 Base UI 原语命名空间。
api.descriptionEn: Typed shared-trigger handle and the Base UI primitive namespace.

keyboard.description: 从触发者进入对话框。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Open from the trigger.

keyboard.description: 在当前最上层对话框内循环。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Cycle within the topmost dialog.

keyboard.description: 关闭当前层并返回触发者或 finalFocus。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Close this layer and return to its trigger or finalFocus.

notes: 长内容放进 DialogPanel：主操作在页脚始终可见；不用 DialogPanel 的写法仍是整面板滚动。
不需要阻断时使用就地表单或 Popover；必须明确回应的危险决定使用 AlertDialog。
草稿策略由应用持有。关闭、放弃草稿、保存和撤销分别命名。
危险决定用 AlertDialog，后果写在它的说明里；按钮不承载后果。
无触发者的程序打开也须指定有意义的 finalFocus。
共享层级按真实开启顺序使新工作面高于旧面候选；调用方覆盖 zIndex 可破坏默认关系。
ARIA实测驱动的契约收窄：Portal固定keepMounted=false，JS传true也不保留关闭DOM。应用显式持有草稿；Primitive自行组合仍有原语keepMounted隔离缺陷。
notesEn: Put long content in DialogPanel so the primary action stays visible in the footer; without DialogPanel the whole panel still scrolls.
Use an inline form or Popover when interruption is unnecessary; use AlertDialog for an explicit consequential decision.
The application owns drafts. Name closing, discarding, saving and undo separately.
Use AlertDialog for consequential decisions and state the consequence in its description; buttons carry none.
Programmatic opening without a trigger needs a meaningful finalFocus target.
Shared layers put a newly opened surface above older owned popups. Caller zIndex overrides can break that relationship.

ARIA evidence narrows the contract: Portal forces keepMounted=false, even for JavaScript callers passing true. The application holds drafts explicitly. Direct Primitive composition still has the upstream retained-portal isolation defect.

whenToUse: 需要停下主线才能完成的编辑或决定。
avoid: 可就地完成的高频编辑。
必须明确回应的决定改用 AlertDialog。
composition: Title/Description 关联名称与必要说明。
Header/Panel/Footer 组织输入与动作，不提供业务状态。

library: open、焦点困住、滚动锁、背景阻断与返回。
application: 草稿、版本、保存、失败、放弃与持久化。

responsive: 内容固有宽度受视口限制；长内容在面板内滚动。
既有控件窄屏 token 与触摸目标仍由控件消费；本批演示只验桌面。
customization: 表面、圆角、遮罩、阴影读取既有角色。
入退唯一归 motion.css；不在调用点另写动画。

whenToUse: Editing or deciding requires pausing the main flow.
avoid: Frequent edits that can happen in place.
Use AlertDialog for decisions requiring an explicit response.
composition: Title/Description associate names and necessary explanations.
Header/Panel/Footer organize inputs and actions without supplying business states.

library: Open state, focus trapping, scroll lock, background blocking, and return.
application: Drafts, versions, saves, failures, abandonment, and persistence.

responsive: Intrinsic content width is constrained by the viewport; long content scrolls within the panel.
Controls retain their own narrow-screen tokens and touch targets; this batch's demos checked desktop only.
customization: Surfaces, radii, backdrop, and shadow consume existing roles.
motion.css alone owns entry/exit; no additional call-site animation.

metadata.title: 边缘工作面 Drawer
metadata.description: 从边缘进入工作面，再返回入口。

metadata.decisions: 方向由公开 swipeDirection 决定；实际 modal 决定焦点与背景阻断，关闭不代表撤销。

api.name: Drawer

props.name: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange

props.descriptionEn: Actual opening and cancelable requests; caller events run first and controlled refusal does not promote layers.

props.name: modal

props.descriptionEn: Full blocking, nonblocking, or focus trapping only. Only full blocking shows a backdrop and declares aria-modal.

props.name: swipeDirection

props.descriptionEn: Exit direction and owning edge; retains public primitive gestures, snapPoints, and activeSnapPoint.

api.name: DrawerPopup

props.name: initialFocus / finalFocus

props.descriptionEn: Defaults to the first control and trigger; callers may name meaningful focusable targets. false is not accepted.

props.name: portalProps / backdropProps / viewportProps
props.description: 原生 Portal、render/ref/事件与样式透传；调用方 style 后合并，可覆盖默认层级。
props.descriptionEn: Forwards native Portal, render, refs, events, and styles. Caller style merges last and can override default layers.

api.name: DrawerTitle / DrawerDescription / DrawerContent
api.description: 真实名称、必要说明和可滚动工作内容，不造业务状态。
api.descriptionEn: Actual names, necessary descriptions, and scrollable working content without invented business states.

api.name: DrawerTrigger / DrawerClose
api.description: 复用 Button；Close 无 children 时读取 locale.close。
api.descriptionEn: Use Button; Close reads locale.close when children are omitted.

keyboard.description: 从入口展开。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Open from the trigger.

keyboard.description: 按实际 modal 设置在工作面中导航。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Navigate the workspace according to its actual modal setting.

keyboard.description: 关闭当前层，再返回该层入口。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Close the current layer and return to its entry.

notes: 程序打开且无触发者时明确 finalFocus。
长内容时用 DrawerHeader / DrawerContent / DrawerFooter：页眉与页脚固定，只有 DrawerContent 滚动；不用 DrawerContent 的写法仍是整面板滚动。
草稿、保存、放弃与撤销由应用分别处理。
Popup 自然容量受视口限制；长内容滚动，左右边缘没有任意固定宽度。
共享 FloatingLayerScope/useFloatingLayer 为所属候选与嵌套工作面排序；调用方覆盖 zIndex 可破坏该关系。
ARIA实测驱动的契约收窄：Portal固定keepMounted=false，JS传true也不保留关闭DOM。应用显式持有草稿；Primitive自行组合仍有原语保留Portal隔离缺陷。
notesEn: Specify finalFocus when opening programmatically without a trigger.
For long content use DrawerHeader / DrawerContent / DrawerFooter: header and footer stay fixed and only DrawerContent scrolls; without DrawerContent the whole panel still scrolls.
Applications handle drafts, saving, abandonment, and undo separately.
Popup capacity is viewport constrained. Long content scrolls; left/right edges have no arbitrary fixed width.
Shared FloatingLayerScope/useFloatingLayer order associated candidates and nested workspaces. Overriding zIndex can break this relationship.

The contract was narrowed after actual ARIA checks: Portal fixes keepMounted=false even for JavaScript callers passing true. Applications explicitly retain drafts; custom Primitive composition still exposes the primitive's retained-Portal isolation defect.

whenToUse: 任务需要边缘工作面且保留真实退出入口。
avoid: 用抽出方向冒充不同阻断语义。
composition: Title/Description/Content 与既有 Button/Input/Popover 组合。

library: 实际 open、原语手势、焦点、背景阻断和共享层级。
application: 输入、草稿与结果。

responsive: 内容容量受视口限制；本批手势和桌面真实几何由浏览器 owner 验证。
customization: 共享面、线、padding、圆角与 motion.css；无独立尺寸变体。

whenToUse: A task requires an edge workspace with an actual exit.
avoid: Treating slide direction as a different blocking semantic.
composition: Title/Description/Content with existing Button/Input/Popover.

library: Actual open state, primitive gestures, focus, background blocking, and shared layers.
application: Inputs, drafts, and outcomes.

responsive: Content capacity is viewport constrained; the browser owner verifies this batch's gestures and actual desktop geometry.
customization: Shared surfaces, lines, padding, radii, and motion.css; no independent size variant.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 空与未知 Empty
metadata.description: 区分零结果、未知与不适用。
metadata.descriptionEn: Distinguish zero results, unknown and not applicable.
metadata.decisions: 调用方提供状态、名称和可执行入口；没有内容不自动建立卡片边界。
metadata.decisionsEn: The caller supplies state, names and real actions; missing content does not automatically require a card boundary.

whenToUse: 缺少内容时需要表达零、未知或不适用与可执行入口。
avoid: 等待中的内容使用适用的加载状态；刷新时保留已有内容。

library: 名称、说明与动作的关系结构。
application: 状态事实、原因、错误恢复与入口可用性。

responsive: 名称与恢复动作完整换行。

whenToUse: Missing content needs truthful zero, unknown, or not-applicable facts and actionable entries.
avoid: Use an appropriate waiting state for pending content; retain existing content during refresh.

library: Relationship structure for names, descriptions, and actions.
application: State facts, reasons, error recovery, and available entries.

responsive: Names and recovery actions wrap fully.

api.name: Empty
api.description: div，状态必填。
api.descriptionEn: A div with required state.

props.name: state
props.description: 零结果、结果未知或任务不适用。
props.descriptionEn: Zero results, unknown results, or a task that does not apply.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 应用提供内容；不会自动成为 alert。
props.descriptionEn: The caller supplies content; the component is not automatically an alert.

api.name: EmptyTitle
api.description: 复用 Heading，默认 h2。
api.descriptionEn: A Heading composition, defaulting to h2.

props.name: level / step / render / ref / Heading props
props.description: 标题层级由文档关系决定。
props.descriptionEn: Document relationships determine heading level.

api.name: EmptyDescription / EmptyActions
api.description: p 说明与 div 动作关系。
api.descriptionEn: p explanation and div action grouping.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 动作复用公共组件与合法原生语义。
props.descriptionEn: Compose public controls with valid native semantics.

notes: 保留刷新前的有效内容，不把尚未加载或不适用标成 0 条。
notesEn: Retain valid content while refreshing; do not label unloaded or inapplicable results as zero.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 字段 Field
metadata.description: 关联一个值的名称、控件、说明与调用方提供的错误。
metadata.descriptionEn: Connect one value's name, control, description, and caller-supplied errors.
metadata.decisions: invalid 与错误内容分别传入。Field 关联名称与错误，不自行校验或推断提交结果。
metadata.decisionsEn: Supply invalid and error content separately. Field connects names and errors without validating or inferring submission results.

whenToUse: 一个值需要持续名称、必要说明或就地错误。
avoid: placeholder 代替名称；Toast 代替字段错误；超时冒充格式错误。
composition: Input 自动注册；原生控件通过 FieldControl 注册。Fieldset 命名共同范围，FieldGroup 只组织间隔。

library: 名称、说明和错误的可访问连接；焦点、触及、禁用传播。
application: 值、规则、invalid、错误内容、草稿与送达结果。

responsive: 长名称与说明可换行；横向内容列可收缩；间距由字段角色决定。
customization: className 最后合并，原生属性、状态样式函数、ref 和 render 透传；FieldTitle 不注册成 label。

whenToUse: A value needs a persistent name, necessary explanation, or in-place error.
avoid: Placeholders instead of names, Toast instead of field errors, or timeouts presented as format errors.
composition: Input registers automatically; FieldControl registers native controls. Fieldset names a shared scope; FieldGroup organizes spacing only.

library: Accessible name/description/error associations; focus, touched state, and disabled propagation.
application: Values, rules, invalid facts, error content, drafts, and delivery outcomes.

responsive: Long names/descriptions wrap, horizontal content columns shrink, and field roles determine spacing.
customization: External classes merge last; native props, state styling callbacks, refs, and render forward. FieldTitle does not register as a label.

api.name: Field
api.description: Base UI Field.Root 的共同上下文；自动校验入口交给完整的 FieldPrimitive。
api.descriptionEn: Shared Base UI Field.Root context. Full automatic-validation APIs remain on FieldPrimitive.

props.name: orientation
props.description: 纵向编辑或横向选项，不改变关联。
props.descriptionEn: Vertical editing or a horizontal option; associations stay intact.

props.name: invalid
props.description: 由调用方声明。原生约束、失焦、错误内容不推断此状态。
props.descriptionEn: Declared by the caller. Native constraints, blur, and error content do not infer it.

props.name: validating
props.description: 应用持有的异步校验进行中：根部 data-validating 与 aria-busy，错误位置显示「正在校验」，本字段内 FieldError 不显示、控件不标无效（invalid 暂不生效）。
props.descriptionEn: An application-owned async validation is running: root data-validating and aria-busy, a validating status in the error position, FieldError in this field is hidden, and the control is not marked invalid (invalid is held until it ends).

props.name: disabled
props.description: 禁用关联控件，禁用值不参加原生提交。
props.descriptionEn: Disables registered controls; disabled values are omitted from native submission.

props.name: name / dirty / touched
props.description: 字段名及调用方管理的编辑事实。
props.descriptionEn: Field name and caller-managed editing facts.

props.name: className / style / render / ref
props.description: 作用于字段根；样式支持状态函数。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the field root; styles support state functions.

api.name: FieldLabel
api.description: 必须位于 Field 或 FieldPrimitive.Root 上下文内，自动命名注册控件；支持显式 htmlFor 与原语 nativeLabel/render。独立标签使用 components/label 的 Label。
api.descriptionEn: Requires a Field or FieldPrimitive.Root context and names a registered control; supports explicit htmlFor and primitive nativeLabel/render. For a standalone label, use Label from components/label.

props.name: requirement
props.description: required 在名称后画 aria-hidden 的 *，调用方须同时给控件 required；optional 显示「（选填）」，计入可访问名称。
props.descriptionEn: required adds an aria-hidden * after the name and the caller must also set required on the control; optional shows a visible optional note that is part of the accessible name.

api.name: FieldDescription
api.description: 必须位于 Field 或 FieldPrimitive.Root 上下文内，将辅助事实注册到 aria-describedby。独立说明使用带 id 的原生文本，并由控件显式引用。
api.descriptionEn: Requires a Field or FieldPrimitive.Root context to register supporting facts in aria-describedby. For standalone help, give native text an id and reference it explicitly from the control.

api.name: FieldError
api.description: 只显示调用方错误，显示时加入 aria-describedby。
api.descriptionEn: Shows caller-supplied errors and registers in aria-describedby when visible.

props.name: children
props.description: 显式内容优先；无内容不生成浏览器或 Form 错误。
props.descriptionEn: Explicit content takes precedence; no content means no browser or Form error is generated.

props.name: errors
props.description: 忽略空项、去重；多条用列表。
props.descriptionEn: Skips empty entries, deduplicates, and lists multiple messages.

props.name: match
props.description: 保留原语过滤接口；false 隐藏。内容与 invalid 分别由调用方决定。
props.descriptionEn: Primitive filtering interface; false hides the message. The caller supplies content and invalid separately.

api.name: FieldTitle
api.description: 普通事实标题；用于自命名控件或无输入事实，不是 label。
api.descriptionEn: A plain fact heading for self-named controls or facts without input; it is not a label.

api.name: FieldContent
api.description: 横向字段的名称、说明内容列。
api.descriptionEn: The name and description column of a horizontal field.

api.name: FieldGroup
api.description: 字段之间的关系间隔，没有 group 语义。
api.descriptionEn: Spacing between fields, without group semantics.

api.name: FieldSeparator
api.description: 字段组分界；有文字时两侧线为装饰。
api.descriptionEn: A boundary between field groups; flanking lines are decorative when text is supplied.

api.name: FieldItem
api.description: 同一 Field 内某个控件与标签的局部关联。一个 Field 只带一个控件；第二个控件（如滑块旁的精确输入）各用一个 FieldItem，否则它们共用同一个 id。
api.descriptionEn: Scopes a particular control and label within one Field. A Field carries one control; give each additional control (for example an exact-entry NumberField beside a Slider) its own FieldItem.

api.name: FieldControl / FieldValidity / FieldPrimitive
api.description: 直接的原语注册、状态读取与完整 API 出口。
api.descriptionEn: Direct primitive outlets for registration, state reading, and the full API.

keyboard.description: 按文档顺序进入控件；点击关联标签聚焦或切换控件。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Follow document order; activating an associated label focuses or toggles the control.

notes: Field 不接受 validate、validationMode、validationDebounceTime、actionsRef。应用用自己的校验过程把结果传入；需要原语自动校验时完整使用 FieldPrimitive。
FieldError 无内容时不渲染。字段外给定内容可以显示，但不会关联别处的控件。
未注册的自命名控件需要显式 aria-labelledby 和 aria-describedby；FieldTitle 不代替这一连接。
共同范围从 components/fieldset 导入 Fieldset / FieldsetLegend；FieldSet / FieldLegend 别名已删除。
样式消费 field-gap、field-group-gap 和文字档；具体数值是集中预设。
Field 只建立一个标签作用域：作用域里的每个控件拿到同一个 id 与同一个标签。单选项（Radio）与分段项（SegmentedControlItem）放在 Field 内会自己开作用域，不需要 FieldItem；已用 FieldItem 包住的项不再叠加，项旁的 FieldLabel 因此仍然有效。直接使用 FieldPrimitive.Item 的组合不被识别，不要再套一层。
notesEn: Field excludes validate, validationMode, validationDebounceTime, and actionsRef. Pass results from application validation; use the full FieldPrimitive composition for primitive-managed validation.
FieldError renders nothing without supplied content. Standalone content does not associate with another control.
Unregistered self-named controls need explicit aria-labelledby and aria-describedby. FieldTitle does not supply those connections.
Import Fieldset / FieldsetLegend from components/fieldset. FieldSet / FieldLegend aliases have been removed.
Styles consume field-gap, field-group-gap, and text profiles. Their numerical values are centralized presets.

A Field builds one labelable scope: every control in it receives the same id and the same label. Radio and SegmentedControlItem open their own scope inside a Field, so they need no FieldItem; an item already wrapped in FieldItem is not wrapped again, so the FieldLabel beside it still works. Compositions that use FieldPrimitive.Item directly are not detected; do not nest another scope.
