metadata.title: 字段组 Fieldset
metadata.description: 为一组相关字段提供共同名称与禁用范围。
metadata.descriptionEn: Give related fields a shared name and disabled scope.
metadata.decisions: 共同名称说明范围；每个字段仍由自己的标签命名。只有位置关系时用 FieldGroup。
metadata.decisionsEn: The shared name identifies the scope; every field keeps its own label. Use FieldGroup for placement alone.

whenToUse: 一组字段或选项需要共同名称。
avoid: 仅为排版创建语义分组；共同名称代替单项名称。
composition: Legend 命名组；Field 命名单值；原生控件同样保留字段组语义。

library: Base UI 分组命名、原生字段组与禁用传播。
application: 共同问题、成员和值。

responsive: 组与长 legend 可收缩换行；字段间消费 field-group-gap。
customization: 无额外围合；variant 改共同名称的文字档，render 可替换 legend 元素。

whenToUse: A group of fields or options needs a shared name.
avoid: Semantic groups for layout alone or a shared name replacing individual names.
composition: Legend names the group; Field names one value. Native controls retain fieldset semantics.

library: Base UI group naming, native fieldsets, and disabled propagation.
application: The shared question, members, and values.

responsive: Groups and long legends shrink/wrap; fields consume field-group-gap.
customization: No extra enclosure. variant chooses the shared name's text profile; render can replace the legend element.

api.name: Fieldset
api.description: Base UI Root，默认 fieldset；使用字段组间隔。
api.descriptionEn: Base UI Root, rendered as fieldset with field-group spacing.

props.name: disabled
props.description: 禁用整组控件。
props.descriptionEn: Disables controls throughout the group.

props.name: className / style / render / ref
props.description: 透传原生属性；样式支持状态函数。
props.descriptionEn: Native props are forwarded; styles support state functions.

api.name: FieldsetLegend
api.description: 默认真实 legend；Base UI 同时维护 aria-labelledby。
api.descriptionEn: A real legend by default; Base UI also maintains aria-labelledby.

props.name: variant
props.description: 分节名称用 heading 档，共同问题用 label 档。具体文字值是预设。
props.descriptionEn: Heading profile for a section name, label profile for a shared question. Text values are presets.

props.name: render
props.description: 可替换元素，命名关联仍保留。
props.descriptionEn: Replaces the element while retaining the naming association.

api.name: FieldsetPrimitive
api.description: Base UI 公共组合出口。
api.descriptionEn: Base UI public composition outlet.

keyboard.description: 按文档顺序访问组内控件；禁用控件不进入焦点顺序。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Visit controls in document order; disabled controls leave the tab order.

notes: Fieldset 不绘制额外卡片或边框。共同名称不能代替每个输入的名称。
FieldSet / FieldLegend 别名已删除，统一用 Fieldset / FieldsetLegend。
notesEn: Fieldset adds no card or border. A shared name does not replace individual input names.
FieldSet / FieldLegend aliases have been removed. Use Fieldset / FieldsetLegend.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 文件触发 FileTrigger
metadata.description: 点按钮选文件，选完立即交给应用，不保留选择。
metadata.descriptionEn: Press a button to choose files and hand them to the application at once, retaining no selection.
metadata.decisions: 只做「选完立即交给应用」：不保留选择、不显示列表、不显示拒绝。被拒绝的文件连同原因放在 details.rejected 交回，应用必须自己呈现，否则用户看不到为什么没有导入。需要列表、移除或随表单提交时用 FileUpload。
metadata.decisionsEn: It only hands the selection to the application as soon as it is made: no retained selection, no list, no rejection display. Rejected files and their reasons come back in details.rejected and the application must present them, otherwise the user cannot see why nothing was imported. Use FileUpload for a list, removal, or form submission.

api.name: FileTrigger
api.description: 本库 Button 加一个不可见的原生 file input；按钮是唯一入口，不参与表单提交。
api.descriptionEn: A Button plus an invisible native file input. The button is the only entry; it takes no part in form submission.

props.name: onSelect
props.type: (accepted: readonly File[], details: { rejected, event }) => void
props.description: 选择完成即调用。有文件被接受或被拒绝时都调用，全部被拒绝时 accepted 为空；用户取消（没有文件）不调用。rejected 与 FileUpload 的 onReject 同形：reason 为 type/size/count，或带 message 的 custom。
props.descriptionEn: Called as soon as a selection is made, whether files were accepted or rejected; accepted is empty when all are rejected. Not called when the user cancels (no files). rejected has the same shape as FileUpload's onReject: reason is type/size/count, or custom with a message.

props.name: accept / maxSize / maxFiles
props.description: 扩展名/MIME 规则、每文件字节数、单次选择的文件数。accept 同时交给原生选择框并用于判定实际选中的文件；maxFiles 只限单次选择。
props.descriptionEn: Extension/MIME rules, bytes per file, and files per selection. accept is given to the native chooser and also checked against the files actually chosen; maxFiles limits a single selection only.

props.name: multiple
props.description: 一次可选多个。默认单个：导入这类入口通常一次处理一个文件，与 FileUpload（默认多个）不同。
props.descriptionEn: Allow several files per selection. Defaults to one: an import entry usually handles one file, unlike FileUpload which defaults to a set.

props.name: validate
props.description: 返回文案即拒绝，在类型与大小之后、数量之前判断，文案在 rejected 里原样交回。
props.descriptionEn: Return a message to reject. Evaluated after type and size and before count; the message comes back unchanged in rejected.

props.name: disabled / ref / render / Button props
props.description: 其余属性（variant、size、tone、disabled、aria-* 等）和 ref 交给按钮。disabled 时按钮与原生 input 都禁用。不接受 name/form/value：它不参与表单提交。render 换成别的按钮元素时同样可用。
props.descriptionEn: Other props (variant, size, tone, disabled, aria-*, ...) and ref go to the button. disabled disables both the button and the native input. name, form and value are not accepted: it takes no part in form submission. render swaps the button element.

keyboard.description: 到按钮并打开系统文件选择框；原生 input 不在 Tab 序列里。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach the button and open the system file chooser; the native input is outside the tab order.

notes: 每次选择后原生 input 都被清空，所以可以连续选同一个文件；因此没有 reset 方法。
本组件没有地方显示拒绝，onSelect 的 details.rejected 必须由应用呈现（Toast、Alert 或 FieldError）。
文件内容校验、解析和上传属于应用；accept 只判断文件名与 MIME 类型，不读内容。
notesEn: The native input is cleared after every selection, so the same file can be chosen again; that is why there is no reset method.
The component has nowhere to show rejections, so the application must present details.rejected in onSelect (Toast, Alert, or FieldError).
Reading, parsing and uploading file contents belong to the application; accept checks only the file name and MIME type.

composition: Toolbar / PageHeader 动作区中的 FileTrigger + onSelect 里的 Toast

library: 打开选择框、按规则分出接受与拒绝、清空原生 input
application: 拿到文件后的解析与上传、拒绝原因的呈现

responsive: 与 Button 同一套几何，跟随尺寸与密度
customization: Button 的 variant/size/tone/render/ref/ARIA/events

composition: FileTrigger in a toolbar or PageHeader actions, with a Toast raised from onSelect

library: Opening the chooser, splitting accepted from rejected by the rules, clearing the native input.
application: Parsing and uploading the files, presenting rejection reasons.

responsive: Same geometry as Button, following size and density.
customization: Button variant/size/tone/render/ref/ARIA/events.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 文件输入 FileUpload
metadata.description: 选择或拖入本地文件，保留已接受集合与真实拒绝原因。
metadata.descriptionEn: Choose or drop local files, retaining accepted files and real rejection reasons.
metadata.decisions: 组件只管理本地文件选择。上传状态、进度分母、失败、结果未知与恢复由应用提供；它不发请求、不制造进度、不从 Promise 推断结果。
metadata.decisionsEn: The component manages local selection only. The application supplies upload states, progress denominators, failure, unknown results, and recovery. It sends no requests, invents no progress, and infers no result from a Promise.

api.name: FileUpload
api.description: 原生 file Input、拖放、已接受列表与真实规则验证的组合。
api.descriptionEn: A native file input composed with dropping, accepted files, and real rule validation.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.type: readonly File[] / readonly File[] / (files, details) => void
props.description: 受控或非受控接受集合，保留 File 引用。details 含 select/drop/paste/remove、added/removed/event/cancel()；受控拒绝或取消不改变提交集合。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or uncontrolled accepted files, retaining File references. details includes select/drop/paste/remove, added, removed, event, and cancel(). Refusal or cancellation preserves submitted files.

props.name: accept / maxSize / maxFiles
props.description: 扩展名/MIME规则、每文件字节数、集合数量。大小与数量为非负安全整数，省略不限制；按 type/size/count 的实际首个失败理由拒绝，已知外部集合不静默纠正。
props.descriptionEn: Extension/MIME rules, bytes per file, and collection count. Size and count are nonnegative safe integers; omitted means unlimited. Reject with the first actual type/size/count failure; external sets are not silently repaired.

props.name: multiple
props.description: 默认是集合选择；false 的集合容量最多1，已有文件须先移除才能加入另一个，不隐式替换。
props.descriptionEn: Defaults to collection selection. false limits capacity to one; remove an existing file before adding another, with no implicit replacement.

props.name: validate
props.description: 返回文案即拒绝，与类型、大小、数量走同一条通道（onReject，就地列出，reason 为 "custom" 并带 message）。在类型与大小之后、数量之前判断；只看 File 本身，内容校验与查重属于应用。
props.descriptionEn: Return a message to reject, through the same channel as type, size and count (onReject, listed in place, reason "custom" with a message). Evaluated after type and size and before count; it sees only the File, and content checks and de-duplication belong to the application.

props.name: onReject
props.description: 真实 type/size/count/directory 拒绝与 validate 的自定义拒绝；拒绝项可关闭提示，但不冒充已接受文件。拖入文件夹以 directory 拒绝（浏览器把文件夹作为大小 0、类型为空的伪文件放进 files，只有 webkitGetAsEntry 能识别）。
props.descriptionEn: Actual type/size/count/directory rejections and validate's custom ones. Dismissing feedback does not make rejected files accepted. A dropped folder is rejected as directory (browsers put it in files as a size-0, type-less pseudo file; only webkitGetAsEntry can recognise it).

props.name: name / form
props.description: chooser 不带最终 name；Field 可提供名称，公开 formdata 事件 append 已接受 File，不覆盖同名其它字段。显式 form 支持外部表单。
props.descriptionEn: The chooser has no final name. Field may supply it; the public formdata event appends accepted Files without replacing other same-name fields. form supports external forms.

props.name: required
props.description: 至少要有一个已接受的文件才能提交。不用原生 required（原生文件输入在每次选择后即清空，永远判为未填），而是按已接受集合是否为空设置输入的 customValidity：空则浏览器拦下提交并说明，选中文件后即满足；输入带 aria-required。只读与禁用不参与校验。无效的呈现仍由 Field 的 invalid 与 FieldError 表达。
props.descriptionEn: At least one accepted file is needed to submit. Native required is not used (the native file input is cleared after every selection and would always read as empty); the input's customValidity follows whether the accepted set is empty, so the browser stops the submit and says why, and choosing a file satisfies it. The input carries aria-required. Read-only and disabled skip validation. How invalid looks is still Field's invalid and FieldError.

props.name: disabled / readOnly
props.description: 阻止选择、拖放和移除；Field/原生 fieldset 禁用同样约束。只读文件继续提交，禁用排除。原生 reset 未取消时非受控恢复初始 defaultValue，受控值保留。
props.descriptionEn: Block selecting, dropping, and removing, including Field/native fieldset disabled. Read-only submits; disabled is excluded. Uncanceled native reset restores initial uncontrolled defaultValue and retains controlled values.

props.name: getStatus
props.description: 调用方真实 waiting/in-progress/failed/unknown/success 与可见 label。只有 in-progress 可提供 {value, min?, max}；max 是调用方已知分母，null 为不定进度。
props.descriptionEn: Caller-provided waiting/in-progress/failed/unknown/success and a visible label. Only in-progress accepts {value,min?,max}; max is a known denominator and null is indeterminate.

props.name: renderFileActions
props.description: 应用的实际恢复/核对入口，组件不自动执行；本地移除不表示取消上传或删除服务端对象。
props.descriptionEn: Real application recovery/check actions, never executed automatically. Local removal does not imply canceling an upload or deleting a server object.

props.name: inputProps / render / ref / ARIA / events
props.description: 选择动作与编辑边界共用一套几何（跟随密度轴）；Input 出口支持 render/ref/events。必填用上面的 required，不经 inputProps。
props.descriptionEn: The chooser shares one geometry with the editing boundary (density axis). Input supports render, refs, and events. For a required set use the required prop above, not inputProps.

api.name: FileUploadPrimitive
api.description: 所用安装版 Input 原语命名空间。
api.descriptionEn: The installed Input primitive namespace.

keyboard.description: 到真实原生文件入口并选择；只读阻止修改。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach and activate the real native file chooser; read-only blocks changes.

keyboard.description: 移除已接受本地文件或关闭拒绝提示；应用恢复入口遵守其自身事实。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Remove accepted local files or dismiss rejections; recovery actions follow application facts.

notes: 只需要「点一下选文件、选完立即交给应用」（如工具条上的导入）时用 FileTrigger；FileUpload 保留已接受集合并随表单提交。清空选择用受控 `value={[]}`，表单 reset 会自动清空——不另设 reset 方法。
粘贴文件：焦点在组件内（选择入口、移除按钮等）时，剪贴板里的文件与拖入同一条规则；组件内的文本框、纯文字粘贴、只读与禁用不受影响。不在 document 上全局监听。
拖偏时浏览器会直接打开文件并离开页面：文档级拖放守卫是全局副作用，不进组件，由应用在页面上对 dragover 与 drop 调用 preventDefault（落在 FileUpload 内的事件不受影响，组件自己处理）。
对象身份决定集合成员；不凭同名/大小猜文件内容相同。移除后可重新选择同一文件；聚焦行移除回相邻动作或 chooser，受控拒绝不夺焦点。
Field 保留 Label/error/disabled 连接；实际 chooser 的 name/value 隔离，避免提交草稿；必填不交给原生 required（会恒 invalid），见 required。
需要支持 formdata 的浏览器；jsdom 事件桥接不等于已验证原生 FormData 构造行为。
规则值是应用约束，列表/拖放布局是选择，样式读现有角色，无额外数值 token。拖放区即整个组件：常驻一条与 Input 同一 token 的边界，拖入时换成焦点色并铺底。
选择入口只显示操作名称，原生 chooser 清空用于重选；已接受文件事实以独立集合呈现。装饰 span 不创建第二交互入口。
notesEn: Use FileTrigger when you only need to press a button, choose files, and hand them to the application at once (such as an import in a toolbar); FileUpload retains the accepted set and submits with the form. To clear the selection, use controlled `value={[]}`; a form reset clears it automatically, so there is no reset method.

Pasted files: while focus is inside the component (chooser, remove buttons, ...) files on the clipboard follow the same rules as dropped ones; text inputs inside it, plain-text paste, read-only and disabled are unaffected. No listener is placed on the document.

A drop that misses opens the file in the browser and leaves the page. A document-level drop guard is a global side effect and stays out of the component: the application calls preventDefault on dragover and drop at page level (events landing in a FileUpload are handled by the component).

Object identity determines membership; equal names/sizes do not imply equal content. Removed files can be reselected. Removing a focused row returns to a neighboring action or chooser; controlled refusal preserves focus.

Field retains label/error/disabled links. The actual chooser isolates name and value to avoid draft submission; required is not left to native required (which would stay invalid), see the required prop.
Requires browser formdata support. A jsdom event bridge does not verify native FormData construction.

Rules are application constraints; list/drop layout is a choice. Styles use existing roles without new numeric tokens. The drop zone is the whole component: it carries a permanent boundary from the same token as Input, switching to the focus colour with a fill while a drag is over it.
The chooser displays its action name and clears for reselection. The separate list expresses accepted files. Its decorative span creates no second interaction entry.

composition: Field + FieldLabel + FileUpload + 实际规则说明/FieldError

library: 选择、拖放、非受控本地集合、真实拒绝
application: 受控集合、接受规则、上传状态/进度、恢复与结果

responsive: 原生 Input/Button 一套几何，跟随密度轴，紧凑不缩小文字，文件名按真实容量换行
customization: Input/根 render/ref/ARIA/events、getStatus、恢复入口及现有主题

composition: Field + FieldLabel + FileUpload + actual rule explanation/FieldError

library: Selection, drop, uncontrolled local collection, and actual rejection.
application: Controlled collection, acceptance rules, upload state/progress, recovery, and outcomes.

responsive: Native Input/Button use five matching text profiles; filenames wrap within actual capacity.
customization: Input/root render/refs/ARIA/events, getStatus, recovery entries, and existing theme.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 筛选条件 FilterBar
metadata.description: 分开显示草稿条件与已应用事实。
metadata.descriptionEn: Shows draft conditions separately from applied facts.
metadata.decisions: dirty 和 appliedSummary 是必填事实；点击应用只发出意图，库不修改条件或请求结果。
metadata.decisionsEn: Dirty and appliedSummary are required facts; Apply emits intent without changing conditions or requesting results.

api.name: FilterBar
api.description: 原生筛选 form 与事实上下文。
api.descriptionEn: A native filter form and fact context.

props.name: dirty / appliedSummary / disabled / canClear
props.description: 应用明确草稿差异、已应用摘要与是否可清除；零值保留。
props.descriptionEn: Applications supply draft differences, applied summary and clear availability; zero is retained.

props.name: sticky
props.description: 吸附在最近的滚动容器顶端（Workspace 中为 WorkspaceContent），不能放进带 overflow 的中间容器；吸住且有内容滚过时才出现分界线（data-stuck）。
props.descriptionEn: Sticks to the nearest scroll container (WorkspaceContent in a Workspace); do not place it inside an intermediate overflow container. The divider appears only while stuck with content scrolling beneath (data-stuck).

props.name: onApply / onCancel / onClear / onSubmit
props.description: onSubmit.preventDefault() 取消应用；Apply 阻止浏览器导航。
props.descriptionEn: onSubmit.preventDefault() cancels Apply; Apply prevents native navigation.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: FilterBarFields / FilterBarApplied / FilterBarStatus / FilterBarActions
api.description: fieldset、摘要、待应用状态与同组操作。
api.descriptionEn: Fieldset, summary, unapplied status and related actions.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: FilterBarApply / FilterBarCancel / FilterBarClear
api.description: 复用 Button 的真实意图入口。
api.descriptionEn: Real intent controls composed from Button.

props.name: children / disabled / onClick / ref
props.description: 按钮不自行更新草稿；缺少处理器或不可用事实时禁用。
props.descriptionEn: Buttons never edit drafts; missing handlers or unavailable facts disable actions.

notes: Field/Input 放在 Fields 中；清除是应用策略，不伪造结果。
notesEn: Place Field/Input inside Fields; clearing follows application policy and never fabricates results.

whenToUse: 多个条件需要明确应用/取消边界。
avoid: 不要把草稿数量当作已应用结果数量。

library: 原生提交、fieldset 禁用与状态标记。
application: 草稿、已应用条件、结果、计数和异步执行。

responsive: 桌面保持真实结构；菜单受可用空间限制，表格保留完整比较列。
customization: 控件档案、间距和浮层表面消费现有角色；具体外观是预设。

whenToUse: Several conditions need explicit apply/cancel boundaries.
avoid: Treating draft condition counts as applied result counts.

library: Native submission, fieldset disabling, and state markers.
application: Drafts, applied conditions, results, counts, and asynchronous execution.

responsive: Keep actual desktop structure; menus fit available space and tables retain complete comparison columns.
customization: Control profiles, spacing, and popup surfaces consume existing roles; their appearance is a preset.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 表单 Form
metadata.description: 原生字段提交范围与重置上下文。
metadata.descriptionEn: A native field submission scope and reset context.
metadata.decisions: Form 不推断校验或提交结果。应用使用原生 onSubmit 与 FormData，显式给 Field.invalid 和就地 FieldError；失败或取消不自动清空输入。
metadata.decisionsEn: Form infers no validation or submission outcome. Use native onSubmit and FormData, with explicit Field.invalid and local FieldError; failure or cancellation never clears input automatically.

whenToUse: 字段需要一个真实提交或重置范围。
avoid: 把容器当作保存服务、成功状态或自动校验上下文。
composition: Field / Fieldset 命名字段和范围；FieldGroup 或布局组件安排关系；Button 明确声明 type。

library: 原生表单元素与组合入口。
application: 草稿、显式校验、请求、外部错误与结果。

responsive: Form 不强加围合或字段布局。
customization: 原生属性与事件、render、className、style 和 ref 属于实际 form。

whenToUse: Fields need an actual submission or reset scope.
avoid: Treating a container as a saving service, success state, or automatic validation context.
composition: Field/Fieldset name fields and scopes; FieldGroup or layout components organize relationships. Button declares type explicitly.

library: The native form element and composition entry.
application: Drafts, explicit validation, requests, external errors, and outcomes.

responsive: Form imposes neither enclosure nor field layout.
customization: Native props/events, render, className, style, and refs belong to the actual form.

api.name: Form
api.description: 真实原生 form，无内置请求和错误聚合。
api.descriptionEn: A real native form with no request or error aggregation.

props.name: onSubmit / onReset
props.description: 原生事件，支持 preventDefault；提交值由应用使用 FormData 读取。
props.descriptionEn: Native events with preventDefault; the application reads values using FormData.

props.name: action / method / noValidate / id / name
props.description: 保留平台提交与约束校验；不默认关闭 constraint validation。
props.descriptionEn: Keeps platform submission and constraints; native validation remains enabled by default.

props.name: render / ref / ARIA / className / style
props.description: 保留原生组合。render 必须继续承载实际表单语义。
props.descriptionEn: Native composition props; render must keep actual form semantics.

api.name: focusFirstInvalid(form)
api.description: 纯函数：按文档顺序聚焦 form 里第一个无效字段并 scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" })，找到返回 true。无效 = aria-invalid="true" 或原生 :invalid 的 input/select/textarea；落点是用户看得见、键盘本来就能走到的部件（Select 触发器、Checkbox/Switch 的标记、Radio、Slider 滑块、OtpField 输入等），跳过禁用、aria-hidden、不可见与 tabindex=-1 的隐藏原生副本。由应用在设置完 Field.invalid 后调用（先让 aria-invalid 渲染，再调用，例如放进 effect）；Form 自身不调用它，默认行为不变。
api.descriptionEn: A pure function: focuses the first invalid field in document order and calls scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" }); returns true when found. Invalid means aria-invalid="true" or a native :invalid input/select/textarea. It lands on the part the user can see and reach by keyboard (Select trigger, Checkbox/Switch mark, Radio, Slider thumb, OtpField input, ...), skipping disabled, aria-hidden, invisible, and tabindex=-1 hidden native copies. The application calls it after setting Field.invalid (let aria-invalid render first, e.g. in an effect); Form never calls it, so default behaviour is unchanged.

keyboard.description: 按平台规则进行隐式提交；原生约束可阻止无效值提交。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Implicit submission follows platform rules; native constraints can block invalid values.

notes: FieldError.errors 是调用方给出的错误，Field.invalid 单独由调用方声明。
不提供 Form 的自动落焦点选项：Form 不知道应用何时设置了 invalid，也不推断校验；原生约束校验（未设 noValidate）本来就由浏览器聚焦第一个无效控件。应用自行校验时调用 focusFirstInvalid。
notesEn: FieldError.errors contains caller-provided messages; Field.invalid is separately declared by the caller.

Form has no auto-focus option: it cannot know when the application set invalid and infers no validation; native constraint validation (without noValidate) already makes the browser focus the first invalid control. Call focusFirstInvalid when the application validates itself.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 两维度的量 Heatmap
metadata.description: 两个类别维度上的量，例如「星期 × 时段」的同步热度；单色顺序色阶（第一色由淡到足）或应用声明的分档，可用键盘逐格读，另有按需展开的数据表。
metadata.descriptionEn: A quantity over two categorical dimensions, such as sync activity by weekday and hour; a single-hue sequential scale (the first series color, light to full) or application-declared levels, readable cell by cell from the keyboard, with an on-demand data table.
metadata.decisions: 行列都是类别轴，不是数据系列——没有身份要区分，只有量的大小，因此只用一种色相：数据是色，取第一色（花青）与纸调和的 12% 到足色。未知/不适用格用清墨斜线纹，不进色阶，避免与真实的小量值混淆。给出 levels 时改按档上色：档由应用声明，浓淡随档次递增，去掉色相仍读得出次序；档名进入格子的名称与读数。
metadata.decisionsEn: Rows and columns are both categorical axes, not data series — there is no identity to distinguish, only magnitude, so it uses one hue: data is color, the first series color (huaqing) mixed with paper from 12% to full. Unknown/not-applicable cells carry a diagonal ink hatch instead of a scale step, so they are never mistaken for a small real value. With levels, cells take the color of their level: the application declares the levels, depth grows with the level so the order survives without hue, and the level name joins each cell's name and the readout.

api.name: Heatmap
api.description: figure 名称、两个命名的类别轴、单色顺序色阶的网格与同源可见 Table。
api.descriptionEn: A named figure, two named categorical axes, a single-hue sequential grid and a visible same-source Table.

props.name: label
props.description: 非空真实语义名称。
props.descriptionEn: A nonempty semantic name for the actual data.

props.name: framed
props.description: false：图放在已有的面上（无边框的 Section、Card、面板），不铺自己的纸——没有线、底、圆角与内缘，图的左右缘就是承载面的内容缘。与 TableContainer 的 framed 同义。是否显示图内标题与它无关。
props.descriptionEn: false: the chart sits on an existing surface (a borderless Section, Card or panel) and lays no paper of its own — no line, fill, radius or inner padding, so its edges are the host's content edges. Same meaning as TableContainer's framed. Whether the in-chart title shows is independent of it.

props.name: aria-labelledby / aria-label
props.description: 外部名称：传入非空的 aria-labelledby（如 SectionTitle 的 id）或 aria-label 时，figure 由它命名，图内不显示标题；图例与「查看数据」仍在图内、靠行尾，二者都没有时标题栏整行不渲染。不传时由图内标题命名。label 仍必填，是等价数据表的名字。
props.descriptionEn: Outside name: a nonempty aria-labelledby (such as a SectionTitle id) or aria-label names the figure and the in-chart title is not drawn; the legend and Show data stay inside the figure at the row end, and with neither the header row is not rendered. Without one the in-chart title names it. label stays required and names the equivalent data table.

props.name: rowLabel / columnLabel / valueLabel
props.description: 行维度、列维度与量各自的名字，例如「时段」「星期」「同步次数」。
props.descriptionEn: Names for the row dimension, column dimension and the measured quantity, e.g. "hour", "weekday", "syncs".

props.name: columns
props.description: 列维度的取值，2 个以上——与数据系列不同，没有身份色上限。
props.descriptionEn: The column dimension's values, two or more — unlike a data series, there is no identity-color cap.

props.name: rows
props.description: 行维度的取值，2 个以上；每行必须对每个 column.key 给出 finite number 或 {state, label}。
props.descriptionEn: The row dimension's values, two or more; every row must supply a finite number or {state, label} for every column key.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: 格式化已知数值；默认按 UILocale 数值 Intl。可以返回节点用于读数与数据表；格子的可访问名称只取字符串或数字的结果，其余退回默认格式。
props.descriptionEn: Format known values; defaults to Intl number formatting for UILocale. May return a node for the readout and data table; a cell's accessible name uses only a string or number result and otherwise falls back to the default format.

props.name: levels
props.type: readonly { label: string; from?: number; tone?: Tone }[]
props.description: 分档，2 到 5 档。第一档不写 from（覆盖更小的值），其后每档 from 严格递增；档名非空且互不相同，违反抛错。给出后格子按所在的档上色，图例是各档的色块加档名；没有 tone 的档取墨，有 tone 的档取该类别色，浓淡随档次递增。未知格不属于任何一档。
props.descriptionEn: Two to five levels. The first omits from (it covers smaller values); each later from is strictly increasing; names are nonempty and distinct, otherwise it throws. Cells take the color of their level and the legend lists each level as a swatch and a name. A level without tone uses ink, a level with tone uses that category color, and depth grows with the level. Unknown cells belong to no level.

props.name: rowSummary
props.description: 行尾多出一列文字（等宽数字、右对齐），列头是 label，同时是等价数据表的最后一列。它是对这一行的汇总，由应用给出，组件不计算。
props.descriptionEn: Adds a trailing text column (tabular numerals, end-aligned) headed by label, also the last column of the equivalent data table. It summarizes the row; the application supplies it and the component computes nothing.

props.name: renderReadout
props.description: 替换悬停与聚焦读数里值的那一行；不给时显示值，有分档时在值后带档名。读数只是增强，格子的名称与数据表仍是完整信息。
props.descriptionEn: Replaces the value line of the hover and focus readout; by default it shows the value, followed by the level name when levels are set. The readout only enhances; cell names and the data table stay the complete information.

notes: 整张图是一个 grid，只有一个 Tab 停靠点；每个格是只读的 gridcell，aria-label 直接给出行、列、数值（有分档时再加档名）或未知原因，不依赖悬停就能读到。
悬停/聚焦读数只增强，不替代可聚焦格自身的名称与数据表。
相邻格之间 2px 纸色空隙，与柱状、堆叠柱同一机制。
少于两行或两列会抛出错误：那是 Chart 的 bar，不是网格。
分档的边界与好坏由应用声明；组件不从数值猜，也不计算行尾汇总。
notesEn: The chart is one grid with a single tab stop; every cell is a read-only gridcell whose aria-label states the row, column, value (plus the level name when levels are set) or unavailable reason, reachable without hovering.
Hover/focus readouts only enhance; they never replace the focusable cell's own name or the data table.
Adjacent cells carry the same 2px surface-color gap as bars and stacked bars.
Fewer than two rows or columns throws: that is a Chart bar, not a grid.
Level boundaries and what counts as bad are declared by the application; the component neither guesses from values nor computes the row summary.

keyboard.description: 在格间移动焦点（含行尾汇总格）；右到左书写方向下左右对调。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move focus between cells, including the row-summary cell; left and right swap in right-to-left writing.

keyboard.description: 到本行第一格 / 最后一格。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Go to the first / last cell of the row.

keyboard.description: 到整张图的第一格 / 最后一格。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Go to the first / last cell of the grid.

keyboard.description: 整张图只有一个停靠点；离开后再回来，焦点落在上次所在的格。
keyboard.descriptionEn: The grid is one tab stop; returning to it lands on the cell last focused.

keyboard.description: 收起读数，焦点不动。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Dismiss the readout; focus stays.

whenToUse: 两个类别维度组合出的量需要一眼看出热度分布，例如一周内各时段的同步次数。
avoid: 只有一个类别维度（用 Chart bar）；需要精确读出每个数值而不是找热点（用数据表或 Chart）。
composition: 手写 CSS 网格 + 当前 Table；复用 Chart 的 readValue 取值契约。没有可画的数据时，调用方在原位改放 Empty。

library: 网格着色、键盘移动与唯一的 Tab 停靠点、可聚焦名称、可见等价表与基础校验。
application: 数据、量纲与真实性；分档的边界与好坏；行尾汇总的内容与读数里的补充事实。

responsive: 网格随可用宽度收缩，超宽时横向滚动；表格原生滚动/换行。
customization: 第一色的顺序色阶或应用声明的分档；不另造热力图调色板。

whenToUse: A quantity formed by two categorical dimensions needs an at-a-glance heat pattern, e.g. sync counts by hour across a week.
avoid: Only one categorical dimension (use Chart bar); reading every exact value rather than spotting hot spots (use a data table or Chart).
composition: A hand-built CSS grid with the current Table; reuses Chart's readValue contract. With nothing to plot, the caller renders Empty in place of the heatmap.

library: Grid coloring, keyboard movement with a single tab stop, focusable naming, the visible equivalent table and basic validation.
application: Data, units and truth; level boundaries and what counts as bad; the content of the row summary and any extra facts in the readout.

responsive: The grid shrinks with available width and scrolls horizontally when it would overflow; the table scrolls and wraps natively.
customization: The first series color's sequential scale or application-declared levels; no separate heatmap palette.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 链接预览 HoverCard
metadata.description: 悬停与键盘焦点展开相同补充内容。
metadata.descriptionEn: Reveal the same supplemental content on hover and keyboard focus.
metadata.decisions: 默认触发是可到达链接；补充内容不唯一承载后果，Tab 主动离开时不抢回焦点。
metadata.decisionsEn: Use a reachable link by default. Supplemental content cannot carry the only consequence information; do not reclaim focus after deliberate navigation.

api.name: HoverCard
api.description: Base UI PreviewCard 公共 Root，保留 open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange、payload、handle 和 closeDelay。
api.descriptionEn: Public Base UI PreviewCard Root, retaining open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange, payload, handle, and closeDelay.

api.name: HoverCardTrigger
api.description: 真实可到达入口与键盘同源预览。
api.descriptionEn: An actual reachable entry with a keyboard-accessible preview from the same source.

props.name: href
props.description: 原生链接要求非空真实目标；自定义 render 须提供等价键盘可达性。
props.descriptionEn: Native links need nonblank real targets; custom render must provide equivalent keyboard access.

props.name: delay
props.description: 悬停进入时延；即时为当前选择，focus 仍由原语管理。
props.descriptionEn: Hover entry delay; immediate is the current choice, while the primitive still manages focus.

props.name: render / ref / className / style
props.description: 保留原语组合和状态回调。
props.descriptionEn: Retain primitive composition and state callbacks.

api.name: HoverCardPopup
api.description: 自身定位上下文的补充内容。
api.descriptionEn: Supplementary content with its own positioning context.

props.name: side / align / sideOffset / alignOffset / anchor
props.description: 采用自身公开定位上下文。
props.descriptionEn: Uses its own public positioning context.

props.name: portalProps / positionerProps
props.description: 容器、ref、render、事件和样式透传；共享 popup 层级先合并，调用方 style 最后合并。
props.descriptionEn: Forwards containers, refs, render, events, and styles; shared popup layers merge first, caller style last.

keyboard.description: 焦点到链接时展开；主动移开不抢回。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Focus on the link opens the preview; moving away never reclaims focus.

keyboard.description: 结束预览。
keyboard.descriptionEn: End the preview.

keyboard.description: 到达链接目标。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Follow the link target.

notes: 关键后果也必须在持续可见的位置可达。
需要执行局部动作时按任务选择 Popover。
透明边界、面、文字和入退复用公共角色；没有虚构对象或请求。
notesEn: Critical consequences must also remain reachable in a persistent location.
Choose Popover when the task needs local actions.
Transparent boundaries, surfaces, text, and motion use public roles; no invented objects or requests.

whenToUse: 链接需要同源、可键盘到达的补充预览。
avoid: 唯一重要信息只在 hover 时出现。
composition: 真实链接与补充内容；独立 Positioner 消费共享层级。

library: 悬停/focus 状态、定位与退出。
application: 链接目标、真实内容与后果。

responsive: 长内容换行，容量受原语 available width/height 限制。
customization: surface-raised、panel-padding-sm、文字角色与 motion.css。

whenToUse: A link needs a keyboard-accessible supplementary preview from the same source.
avoid: Important information available only on hover.
composition: An actual link with supplementary content; an independent Positioner consumes shared layers.

library: Hover/focus states, positioning, and exit.
application: Link targets, actual content, and consequences.

responsive: Long content wraps; primitive available width/height constrain capacity.
customization: surface-raised, panel-padding-sm, text roles, and motion.css.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 输入组合 InputGroup
metadata.description: 让输入与标记、单位或附属动作共用编辑边界。
metadata.descriptionEn: Give an input and its markers, units or actions one editing boundary.
metadata.decisions: InputGroupInput 复用 Input 的 unstyled 出口。静态附件不抢焦点；需要动作时用 InputGroupButton，它与输入共用同一条外边界、自己不画框，并保留动作自己的名称与状态。清空、显示密码这类动作不内置在输入框里，都由这里组合；SearchInput 与 PasswordInput 就是这样搭出来的。
metadata.decisionsEn: InputGroupInput uses Input's unstyled outlet. Static addons do not redirect focus; use InputGroupButton for actions: it shares the outer boundary, draws no frame of its own, and keeps its own name and state. Clearing and password visibility are not built into Input; they are composed here, which is how SearchInput and PasswordInput are built.

whenToUse: 输入与单位、标记或附属动作属于同一编辑范围。
avoid: 把无关动作附在输入上；只靠附件或 Placeholder 命名输入。
composition: FieldLabel 命名输入；附件的必要说明由 aria-describedby 显式关联。搜索与密码已有现成组合 SearchInput、PasswordInput。

library: 共同边界、几何接线及 Input 的原生交互。
application: 输入值、附件动作、名称及校验事实。

responsive: 输入占剩余宽度；边界与内部 Input 一套几何，跟随密度轴，紧凑不缩小文字，粗指针目标单独保持。
customization: root 样式属于共同边界，Input 的 className/style/render/ref 属于实际输入；附件有独立 render。

whenToUse: An input shares one editing scope with units, markers, or adjunct actions.
avoid: Unrelated actions attached to an input; naming the input through an adjunct or placeholder alone.
composition: FieldLabel names the input; aria-describedby explicitly associates necessary adjunct explanations. SearchInput and PasswordInput are ready-made compositions for search and passwords.

library: Shared boundary, geometry wiring, and Input's native interaction.
application: Input values, adjunct actions, names, and validation facts.

responsive: Input takes remaining width; boundary and inner Input share one geometry following the density axis, while coarse-pointer targets remain separate.
customization: Root styles own the shared boundary. Input className/style/render/refs own the actual input; adjuncts have independent render.

api.name: InputGroup
api.description: 共同编辑边界，不自动建立另一个字段角色。
api.descriptionEn: A shared editing boundary with no extra field role.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 共同边界组合入口。
props.descriptionEn: Composition props for the common boundary.

api.name: InputGroupInput
api.description: Input 的 unstyled 组合，尺寸来自组。
api.descriptionEn: Input's unstyled composition with the group's size.

props.name: InputProps（除 size / unstyled）
props.description: 保留原生输入、受控值、nativeInput 与实际输入 ref。
props.descriptionEn: Retains native input props, controlled values, nativeInput and the actual input ref.

api.name: InputGroupAddon
api.description: 默认静态 span；不添加 tabIndex、聚焦处理或自动名称。
api.descriptionEn: A static span by default, with no tabIndex, focus redirection or automatic name.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 单位、前缀、图标等静态内容的承载位。
props.descriptionEn: A position for static content: units, prefixes, icons.

api.name: InputGroupButton
api.description: 编辑边界内的动作：不画自己的框，铺满边界内高；图标形为内高见方。
api.descriptionEn: An action inside the editing boundary: no frame of its own, filling the inner height; the icon shape is an inner-height square.

props.name: shape
props.description: 图标形需要 aria-label。
props.descriptionEn: The icon shape requires aria-label.

props.name: variant
props.description: 边界内默认无框。
props.descriptionEn: Frameless inside the boundary by default.

props.name: 其余 ButtonProps
props.description: loading、disabled、onClick、render 等与 Button 相同。
props.descriptionEn: loading, disabled, onClick, render and the rest behave as on Button.

notes: FieldControl 注册组合时传 InputGroupInput nativeInput，避免重复注册。
禁用输入不意味着禁用任意附属动作；应用应声明每个动作的真实状态。
notesEn: Use InputGroupInput nativeInput when FieldControl registers the composition, avoiding duplicate registration.
Disabling the input does not disable arbitrary addon actions; the application declares each action's real state.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 输入方式 InputModalityProvider
metadata.description: 在应用根部记录输入方式，键盘操作跳过过渡。
metadata.descriptionEn: Record input modality at the application root and skip transitions for keyboard input.

api.name: InputModalityProvider
api.description: 无界面组件，只记录输入方式，不提供动效。挂载时把 data-ui-input 设为 pointer；捕获到 keydown 改为 keyboard，pointerdown 或 pointermove 改回 pointer；卸载时还原。属性写在 <html> 上，因此也覆盖传送到 body 的浮层。
api.descriptionEn: No visible UI; it only records input modality and provides no motion. Mount sets data-ui-input to pointer; captured keydown switches to keyboard, pointerdown/pointermove to pointer. Unmount restores the previous value. The html attribute also covers body Portals.

props.name: children
props.description: 应用内容。
props.descriptionEn: Application content.

notes: 只在应用根部挂载一次；示例复用本站根部的 InputModalityProvider。旧名 MotionProvider 作为已弃用别名保留，下一个主版本移除。
motion.css 读取 data-ui-input；键盘下过渡时长归零，指针下保留过渡。
系统减少动态效果由 motion.css 处理，独立于输入方式。
data-instant 让当前元素跳过过渡；自定义部位使用 data-slot 或 qy-pressable 接入公共策略。
notesEn: Mount once at the application root. These demos reuse the site's root InputModalityProvider. The old name MotionProvider remains as a deprecated alias and is removed in the next major version.
motion.css reads data-ui-input, skipping transitions for keyboard input and retaining them for pointer input.
motion.css handles the system reduced-motion preference independently of input modality.
data-instant skips an element's transition. Custom parts use data-slot or qy-pressable for the shared policy.
metadata.decisions: 键盘与减少动态效果会跳过部分过渡。状态直接更新，不依赖动画结束。
metadata.decisionsEn: Keyboard and reduced-motion policies skip some transitions. Update state directly, independently of animation completion.

whenToUse: 统一让键盘操作即时完成，并让指针操作保留必要过渡。
avoid: 在多个子树各挂一个 document owner；动画结束触发保存；减少动态效果后状态不可辨。
composition: 根部一次挂载，document 属性覆盖 Portal；组件通过 data-slot/data-motion 使用公共 motion.css。

library: 最近输入方式、监听清理与原文档属性恢复。
application: 业务状态时机、根部装配和程序变化是否需要动画。

responsive: 布局变化与动画可被打断；键盘与系统减少动态效果分别检验。
customization: 项目组合可使用 data-instant，但不再重复监听输入方式。

whenToUse: Keyboard actions complete immediately while pointer actions retain necessary transitions.
avoid: Multiple document owners in separate subtrees; saving on animation completion; indistinguishable states with reduced motion.
composition: Mount once at the root. Document attributes cover Portals; components use shared motion.css through data-slot/data-motion.

library: Recent input method, listener cleanup, and original document attribute restoration.
application: Business state timing, root assembly, and whether programmatic changes need animation.

responsive: Layouts and animation permit interruption; keyboard and system reduced motion are checked separately.
customization: Project compositions may use data-instant without registering another input-method listener.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 输入框 Input
metadata.description: 输入一个文本值。
metadata.descriptionEn: Enter one text value.
metadata.decisions: 输入框只做一件事：承载一个值的输入。清空、搜索图标与显示密码是附在编辑边界上的另一件事，由 SearchInput、PasswordInput 或 InputGroup 组合出来，输入框不内置。Placeholder 不能代替持续可见的名称。
metadata.decisionsEn: Input does one thing: it carries the entry of one value. Clearing, a search icon and password visibility are a separate matter on the editing boundary, composed by SearchInput, PasswordInput or InputGroup rather than built into Input. A placeholder does not replace a persistent visible name.

whenToUse: 输入一个文本值，原生 type 与内容匹配。
avoid: 搜索用 SearchInput，密码用 PasswordInput。
用 placeholder 代替名称；把超时变成无效；把未知转成空串或 0；校验失败清空草稿。
composition: 与 FieldLabel、FieldDescription、FieldError 共处；单位、标记与附属动作（清空、应用）交给 InputGroup + InputGroupButton。

library: 原生输入、Field 关联、焦点与只读标记。
application: 值的含义、校验事实、候选范围、未知/不适用及送达结果。

responsive: xs/sm/md/lg/xl 消费基础层档案；窄屏增加 4px，粗指针编辑区至少 44px。
customization: className、style、render 与 ref 属于真实 input；controlClassName 属于编辑边界。

whenToUse: Enter one text value with a matching native type.
avoid: Use SearchInput for search and PasswordInput for passwords.
Placeholders replacing names; timeouts treated as invalid; unknown converted to empty or zero; drafts cleared after validation failure.
composition: Keep FieldLabel, FieldDescription, and FieldError together; InputGroup + InputGroupButton supply units, markers, and adjunct actions such as clearing or applying.

library: Native input, Field associations, focus, and the read-only marker.
application: Value meaning, validation facts, candidate scope, unknown/not-applicable values, and delivery outcomes.

responsive: xs/sm/md/lg/xl use foundation profiles; narrow heights add 4px and coarse-pointer editing areas are at least 44px.
customization: className, style, render, and refs belong to the actual input; controlClassName belongs to its editing boundary.

api.name: Input
api.description: 真实边框界定编辑区；Base UI Input 保留 Field 注册和原生属性。
api.descriptionEn: A real border identifies the editable area. Base UI Input retains Field registration and native attributes.

props.name: type
props.description: 原生类型原样生效，不附带任何额外动作。搜索与密码用 SearchInput / PasswordInput。
props.descriptionEn: The native type applies as is, with no extra action attached. Use SearchInput / PasswordInput for search and passwords.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.type: 原生值 / 初始值 / (value, details) => void
props.typeEn: Native value / initial value / (value, details) => void
props.description: 支持受控与非受控值；onChange 同样透传。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled and uncontrolled values; onChange is also forwarded.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: 保留焦点、复制与表单提交，阻止编辑；默认显示只读标记。
props.descriptionEn: Retains focus, copying, and form submission while blocking edits. Shows a read-only marker.

props.name: className / style / render / ref
props.description: 全部作用于真实 input；className/style 支持状态函数。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the real input. className/style support state functions.

props.name: controlClassName
props.description: 调整共同编辑边界，例如宽度与所在布局；不替代原生属性。
props.descriptionEn: Styles the shared editable boundary, including its width and placement.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: 由 InputGroup 等公共组合承担边界；保留内高、档案与原生状态。
props.descriptionEn: Lets a public composition such as InputGroup supply the boundary while retaining inner geometry and native state.

props.name: nativeInput
props.description: 已由 FieldControl 或其他原语注册时使用原生出口；保留 render/ref/事件，避免重复注册。
props.descriptionEn: Native outlet for an input already registered by FieldControl or another primitive. Retains render, refs, and events without double registration.

keyboard.description: 进入与离开输入。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Enter and leave the input.

notes: aria-invalid 来自应用或浏览器校验；值的真伪与是否送达分开表达。
提供 FieldLabel、原生 label 或 aria-label。Placeholder 是输入提示，不是名称。
clearable / clearLabel / onClear 与 visibilityToggle / visible / defaultVisible / onVisibleChange / showLabel 已移除：搜索用 SearchInput，密码用 PasswordInput，其他附属动作用 InputGroup + InputGroupButton 组合。
type="file" 保留浏览器文件选择行为与语言；文件列表和业务校验由调用方提供。
notesEn: aria-invalid comes from application or browser validation. Value validity and delivery are separate facts.
Provide FieldLabel, a native label, or aria-label. A placeholder is a hint rather than a name.

clearable / clearLabel / onClear and visibilityToggle / visible / defaultVisible / onVisibleChange / showLabel are removed: use SearchInput for search, PasswordInput for passwords, and compose InputGroup + InputGroupButton for other adjunct actions.
type="file" retains browser behavior and language. The caller owns file lists and business validation.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 条目 Item
metadata.description: 内容、入口与附属动作的关系。
metadata.descriptionEn: Content, navigation and related actions.
metadata.decisions: 条目不内建业务对象。整体链接不包含其他交互动作；有附属动作时链接与按钮保持兄弟关系。
metadata.decisionsEn: Items contain no built-in business objects. A whole-item link cannot contain interactive controls; separate links and buttons when secondary actions exist.

whenToUse: 一个通用条目需要名称、补充内容与相关动作。
avoid: 多维比较使用 Table；不为没有目的的条目生成链接。
一行的主要动作不能藏进 reveal="hover"；触摸为主的界面不要用。

library: 条目关系、render 转发与焦点。
application: 条目内容、真实导航目标与操作状态。

responsive: 正文可换行，附属动作保留容量。

whenToUse: A general item needs a name, supplementary content, and related actions.
avoid: Use Table for multidimensional comparison; do not create links without an actual destination.
Never hide a row's primary action behind reveal="hover"; do not use it in touch-first interfaces.

library: Item relationships, render forwarding, and focus.
application: Item content, actual navigation targets, and action states.

responsive: Body text wraps while adjunct actions retain capacity.

api.name: Item
api.description: 默认 div，可 render 为 li 或独立 a。整行只通向一个去处且行内没有别的交互元素时 render 为 a：渲染为 a[href] 或 button 时整行有悬停与按下反馈，两侧伸出一个留白，文字仍与列缘对齐；div 与 li 没有反馈。
api.descriptionEn: A div that may render a li or standalone anchor. Render an a when the whole row leads to one destination and holds no other interactive element: rendered as a[href] or button the row gets hover and pressed feedback, and the fill bleeds one padding past each side while the text stays on the column edge; a div or li gets none.

props.name: render / ref / children / native props
props.description: 实际元素接收事件与 ref；列表中显式 render 为 li。
props.descriptionEn: Events and ref reach the actual element; explicitly render li inside a list.

api.name: ItemContent / ItemTitle / ItemDescription
api.description: div / div / p 关系槽。
api.descriptionEn: div / div / p relationship slots.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 标题不是默认章节标题。
props.descriptionEn: The title is not automatically a document heading.

api.name: ItemActions
api.description: 行内的附属动作，默认一直可见。
api.descriptionEn: Secondary actions on the row, always visible by default.

props.name: reveal
props.description: hover：操作平时淡出，行悬停、行内有焦点、行内有打开的菜单或浮层时显现；没有悬停能力的设备上恒显示。只改不透明度，按钮始终在 Tab 顺序与可访问树里。
props.descriptionEn: hover: the actions fade out at rest and appear while the row is hovered, holds focus, or holds an open menu or popup; on devices without hover they are always shown. Only opacity changes, so the buttons stay in tab order and the accessibility tree.

props.name: resting
props.description: 平时显示的内容，例如一个时间。与操作叠在同一格，格宽取两者中较宽者，显隐切换时这一行不发生位移；没有悬停能力的设备上与操作并排显示。
props.descriptionEn: Content shown at rest, such as a time. It shares one cell with the actions, sized to the wider of the two, so the row does not shift when they swap; on devices without hover it sits beside the actions.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 动作组合公共 Button。
props.descriptionEn: Compose public Button actions.

api.name: ItemLink
api.description: 名称就是入口的真实导航链接，用在行内另有操作的条目上，操作放 ItemActions；整行只有一个去处时改用 Item render={<a />}。
api.descriptionEn: A real navigation link where the name is the entry, for rows that have their own actions in ItemActions; when the whole row is one destination use Item render={<a />} instead.

props.name: href / render / ref / native props
props.description: 保留目标、ARIA 和消费者事件。
props.descriptionEn: Preserve destinations, ARIA and caller events.

keyboard.description: 实际链接与按钮沿用原生顺序；reveal="hover" 的操作聚焦时随之显现。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Actual links and buttons use native focus order; actions under reveal="hover" appear when focused.

notes: 不在 a 中嵌套按钮、链接或其他交互控件；无需动作时不生成假入口。
notesEn: Never nest buttons, links or interactive controls inside an anchor; absent actions generate no fake entry.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 键位 Kbd
metadata.description: 用原生键位元素显示真实快捷键。
metadata.descriptionEn: A native keyboard key display.
metadata.decisions: Kbd 不注册键盘监听，不是可点击入口。
metadata.decisionsEn: Kbd neither registers keyboard listeners nor provides a clickable entry.

whenToUse: 说明实际可用的键位。
avoid: Kbd 不注册键盘监听，不是可点击入口。
composition: 组合原生 kbd 内容；平台键位由应用确定。

library: 原生语义、公共组合与集中角色。
application: 对象、内容、值、状态与请求结果。

responsive: 实际键位保持原生展示，长键位名称允许换行；不建立点击或触摸入口。

avoid: 用通用 Label 替代 Field 内的注册标签。

library: 原生标签关联与 text-label 角色。
application: 名称、控件 id 与状态。

customization: className、style 与 render 属于标签。

avoid: Replacing Field's registered label with a general Label.
composition: htmlFor points to the actual id of Input or NativeSelect.

library: Native label association and the text-label role.
application: Names, control ids, and state.

customization: className, style, and render belong to the label.

api.name: Label

props.name: htmlFor

metadata.title: 布局 Layout

metadata.decisions: Stack 纵向排列，Inline 横向排列并默认换行。gap 选择字段、动作或分节关系；语义由 render 与内容提供。
metadata.decisionsEn: Stack flows vertically; Inline flows horizontally and wraps by default. Choose field, action or section spacing with gap; render and content supply semantics.

api.name: Stack
api.description: 按内容顺序纵向排列。
api.descriptionEn: Vertical content flow.

props.name: gap
props.description: 分别读取 field-gap、field-group-gap、action-gap、panel-gap、section-gap。

props.name: align
props.description: 横轴对齐。
props.descriptionEn: Cross-axis alignment.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 替换元素，透传事件、语言、方向、密度与原生属性。
props.descriptionEn: Replace the element and forward native props, events and environment attributes.

api.name: Inline
api.description: 相邻动作或内容，可换行。
api.descriptionEn: Adjacent actions or content with wrapping.

props.name: gap
props.description: 与 Stack 相同的关系角色。

props.name: align
props.description: 横排的垂直对齐。

props.name: wrap
props.description: 保留全部内容并允许折行。false 需由消费方验证容量。

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 默认 div；没有自动 group/toolbar 语义。

notes: 布局没有边框、表面、内边距或业务状态；独立对象边界用 Card。
角色数值是主题预设。确有特殊关系时在项目组合说明 className/style 覆写理由。
方向、语言与密度沿真实 DOM 继承；换行不改变内容顺序。
notesEn: Layout adds no border, surface, padding or business state; use Card for independent object boundaries.
Role values are theme presets. Explain special className/style overrides in the project composition.
Direction, language and density follow the DOM; wrapping does not reorder content.

avoid: 把布局当围合或页面骨架；用数字 gap 代替关系判断。

responsive: Default wrapping retains content; this batch's page checks were desktop only by decision.

metadata.title: 链接 Link
metadata.description: 去往一个地址的文字入口；全库文字链接共用这一种画法。
metadata.descriptionEn: A text entry that goes to an address; every text link in the library shares this one treatment.
metadata.decisions: 链接去往一个地方，按钮执行一个动作。下划线常在，平时是重墨，悬停与焦点时加深为文字本色；不加粗，不外扩焦点。行内链接不扩展命中区。
metadata.decisionsEn: A link goes somewhere; a button performs an action. The underline is always present, heavy ink at rest and full text color on hover or focus, without thickening or an outer focus ring. Inline links do not expand their hit area.

whenToUse: 正文或说明中去往另一页、另一处的入口。
avoid: 执行动作（保存、删除、提交）用 Button，不用链接。
成列的同等导航入口（导航菜单、侧栏、分页）由位置表明是导航，使用各自组件，不逐项加下划线。
composition: 路由链接通过 render 接入；Breadcrumb、Item、Toolbar、HoverCard 读取 linkClassName。

library: 下划线、悬停、焦点与可访问名称的画法。
application: 地址、路由、当前位置与权限。

responsive: 长链接文字随正文换行；独立成行的入口由调用方加 touch-target。
customization: 颜色读墨阶；品牌可通过主题改文字色，不改下划线常在的规则。

whenToUse: An entry within body text or descriptions that goes to another page or place.
avoid: Use Button for actions such as save, delete, or submit.
Rows or columns of equivalent navigation entries such as navigation menus, sidebars, or pagination are identified by position; use their components without per-item underlines.
composition: Route links connect through render; Breadcrumb, Item, Toolbar, and HoverCard read linkClassName.

library: Underline, hover, focus, and accessible-name treatment.
application: Addresses, routing, current location, and permissions.

responsive: Long link text wraps with body text; standalone entries add touch-target at the call site.
customization: Colors come from the ink ladder; a brand may change text color but not the always-present underline.

api.name: Link
api.description: 原生 a 元素；href、target、rel 等原生属性与 render/ref 透传。
api.descriptionEn: A native a element; native attributes such as href, target, and rel plus render/ref are forwarded.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 路由库的链接组件通过 render 接入。
props.descriptionEn: Connect a router's link component through render.

api.name: linkClassName
api.description: 同一画法的类名，供需要渲染原语自身链接部位的组件使用。
api.descriptionEn: The same treatment as a class name, for components that render a primitive's own link part.

metadata.title: 语言切换 LocaleSwitch
metadata.description: 请求切换应用语言，并显示 Provider 当前事实。
metadata.descriptionEn: Request an application locale change and show the current Provider value.

api.name: LocaleSwitch
api.description: 复用 NativeSelect；UILocaleProvider 是唯一当前值来源。
api.descriptionEn: Uses NativeSelect; UILocaleProvider alone supplies the current value.

props.name: options
props.type: readonly { locale: UILocale; label: string; disabled?: boolean }[]
props.description: 消费项目提供可选语言与名称，code 必须非空且唯一。当前 code 未列入时显示其禁用事实选项。
props.descriptionEn: The consumer supplies available languages and names. Codes must be nonblank and unique; an unlisted current code appears as a disabled factual option.

props.name: onLocaleChange
props.description: 请求新 locale；应用更新 Provider 后才改变选择事实，拒绝时保留原值。
props.descriptionEn: Requests a locale; selection changes only after the application updates Provider. Refusal retains the previous value.

props.name: name / form / disabled / render / ref / onChange / ARIA
props.description: 原生表单、禁用与出口；onChange preventDefault 可取消请求；默认名称读 messages.language。
props.descriptionEn: Native form, disabling, and composition. onChange preventDefault cancels a request; the default name reads messages.language.

keyboard.description: 保留原生 select 的方向、确认与移动选择器行为。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Retain native select direction, confirmation, and mobile-picker behavior.

notes: 不修改 document.lang、<html dir>、系统语言、存储或路由；这些属于应用。切换后 Provider 按新 locale 的代码重新推出 dir，应用须让 <html dir> 与它一致。
内置名 language 走 UI locale；选项可见名称由消费项目给出。
notesEn: No changes to document.lang, <html dir>, system language, storage, or routes; applications own these. After a switch, Provider derives dir again from the new locale code; the application must keep <html dir> consistent with it.
The built-in language name uses UI locale; consumers supply visible option names.

whenToUse: UILocaleProvider 的应用语言入口
avoid: 内部乐观切值却未改变 Provider
composition: Provider + NativeSelect + 应用接受变化

library: 呈现 Provider 当前值与请求
application: 可选语言、Provider、URL/文档语言

customization: NativeSelect 的公开出口与显式名称

whenToUse: An application-language entry for UILocaleProvider.
avoid: Optimistically switching the internal value without changing Provider.
composition: Provider + NativeSelect + application acceptance.

library: Presenting Provider's current value and requests.
application: Available languages, Provider, URLs, and document language.

customization: NativeSelect public composition and explicit names.

metadata.title: 命令菜单 Menu
metadata.description: 与当前任务相关的临时命令和选择。
metadata.descriptionEn: Temporary commands and choices related to the current task.
metadata.decisions: Menu 执行动作，LinkItem 导航。禁用不等于隐藏；原语可让禁用项聚焦，但禁止执行。
metadata.decisionsEn: Menu items execute commands; LinkItem navigates. Disabled items remain discoverable and may receive focus, but cannot execute.

api.name: Menu / MenuSubmenu
api.description: 公开 Base UI 命令根与子菜单。
api.descriptionEn: Public Base UI command roots and submenus.

props.name: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: 应用可控制打开；details.cancel() 保留原状态。
props.descriptionEn: Applications may control open state; details.cancel() retains the current state.

api.name: MenuItem
api.description: 一条命令；与 ContextMenuItem 共用。
api.descriptionEn: One command; shared with ContextMenuItem.

props.name: tone
props.description: 与 Button 的 tone 同义：danger 只标出这是一条危险类动作（字与图标用危险前景，悬停与高亮用危险柔底）。后果说明与确认不在菜单项里，激活后应打开 AlertDialog 或 ConfirmAction。
props.descriptionEn: Same meaning as Button's tone: danger only marks a dangerous class of action (danger foreground for text and icon, danger soft fill on hover and highlight). Consequences and confirmation do not live in the item; activating it should open AlertDialog or ConfirmAction.

props.name: size / inset / disabled / onClick
props.description: 尺寸档、与带前导标记的项对齐的缩进、禁用与命令。
props.descriptionEn: Size step, indent aligning with items that have leading markers, disabled state, and the command.

api.name: MenuTrigger / MenuPositioner / MenuPopup / MenuPortal
api.description: 触发器与同一 Root 所属的浮层。
api.descriptionEn: Trigger and floating parts owned by the same root.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

props.name: side / align / style
props.description: 共享 popup 层级写在 Positioner；调用方 style 最后合并。
props.descriptionEn: Shared popup layering targets the Positioner; caller style merges last.

api.name: MenuItem / MenuLinkItem / MenuCheckboxItem / MenuRadioItem / MenuSubmenuTrigger
api.description: 动作、真实导航、勾选、单选与下级命令。
api.descriptionEn: Commands, true navigation, checked choices, radio choices and submenus.

props.name: size
props.description: 复用 Button 五档；禁用项可聚焦但不能执行。
props.descriptionEn: Reuses all five Button sizes; disabled items may receive focus but cannot execute.

props.name: inset
props.description: 在逻辑起点为同档图标与字段间隔留位，使无图标命令与前导标记的文字列对齐；默认 false。MenuGroupLabel 也支持 size/inset。
props.descriptionEn: Reserves a same-size icon and field gap at the logical start, aligning unmarked commands with leading markers. Defaults to false; MenuGroupLabel also supports size/inset.

props.name: markerPosition
props.description: 仅勾选与单选项，控制实际标记的逻辑位置；默认 end 保持现有外观。状态与键盘语义不变。
props.descriptionEn: Checkbox and radio items only: controls the logical marker position. Defaults to end, preserving existing appearance, state and keyboard semantics.

props.name: checked / value / onCheckedChange
props.description: 勾选项读 checked，单选项读 value；选择由调用方事实与原语取消协议确认。
props.descriptionEn: Checkbox items read checked, radio items read value; choices follow caller facts and primitive cancellation.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: MenuGroup / MenuGroupLabel / MenuSeparator / MenuRadioGroup / MenuPrimitive
api.description: 组语义与底层公开原语。
api.descriptionEn: Group semantics and the public primitive namespace.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: 单选组的当前值在 MenuRadioGroup 上。
props.descriptionEn: The radio group's current value lives on MenuRadioGroup.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

notes: 危险操作需显式后果与独立保护；Root/Portal/Positioner/Popup 属于同一上下文。
tone="danger" 的项被激活后应打开确认对话框，由对话框写明后果；颜色只表示动作类别，不替代文字名称。
notesEn: Dangerous actions require explicit consequences and separate protection; Root, Portal, Positioner and Popup share one context.
Activating a tone="danger" item should open a confirmation dialog that states the consequence; color marks the action class and never replaces the text name.

whenToUse: 同一对象或工作面有一组临时命令。
avoid: 长期导航用 NavigationMenu 或 Sidebar；多个值输入用 Select。

library: 键盘、打开、焦点返回与取消。
application: 命令、选择值、禁用原因与危险后果。

responsive: 桌面保持真实结构；菜单受可用空间限制，表格保留完整比较列。
customization: 控件档案、间距和浮层表面消费现有角色；具体外观是预设。

whenToUse: One object or workspace has temporary commands.
avoid: Use NavigationMenu/Sidebar for persistent navigation and Select for value input.

library: Keyboard, opening, focus return, and cancellation.
application: Commands, selected values, disabled reasons, and danger consequences.

responsive: Keep actual desktop structure; menus fit available space and tables retain complete comparison columns.
customization: Control profiles, spacing, and popup surfaces consume existing roles; their appearance is a preset.

keyboard.description: 在菜单中移动焦点。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move focus within the menu.

keyboard.description: 执行可用命令或关闭并返回入口。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Execute an enabled command or close and return to the trigger.

metadata.title: 测量 Meter
metadata.description: 表达真实范围内的测量值。
metadata.descriptionEn: A real measurement over a valid range.
metadata.decisions: 任务完成比例使用 Progress；未知测量不要填0。级别是「几级里的第几级」，用 segments 分格；状态类别 tone 由调用方声明，色相之外格数仍读得出级别。
metadata.decisionsEn: Use Progress for task completion. Unknown measurements must not become zero. A level is "which of n steps", so use segments; tone is declared by the caller, and the cell count still reads without hue.

whenToUse: 表达测量值及单位。
avoid: 任务完成比例使用 Progress；未知测量不要填0。
composition: Label 关联名称，Value 展示实际读数，轨与指示不猜测好坏。
密集列表里的级别用 segments={3} 加 tone，不用 StatusDot：状态与程度是两件事。

library: 原生语义、公共组合与集中角色。
application: 对象、内容、值、状态与请求结果。

responsive: 测量名称与格式化读数允许换行；轨厚由独立测量角色控制。
customization: 使用公开 render/ref、ARIA、事件与样式；不混用主题三轴。

whenToUse: Present measured values and units.
avoid: Use Progress for task completion. Unknown measurements must not become zero.
composition: Label associates the name, Value presents the actual reading, and track/indicator infer no judgment.
A level in a dense list uses segments={3} with tone, not StatusDot: status and degree are two facts.

library: Native semantics, public composition, and centralized roles.
application: Objects, content, values, states, and request outcomes.

responsive: Measurement names and formatted readings wrap; an independent measurement role controls track thickness.
customization: Public render/refs, ARIA, events, and styles; keep theme axes independent.

api.name: Meter
api.description: Label 关联名称，Value 展示实际读数，轨与指示不猜测好坏。
api.descriptionEn: Label associates the name, Value presents the actual reading, and track/indicator infer no judgment.

props.name: value / min / max
props.description: 已知有限值及递增范围；越界、非有限或倒置范围抛 RangeError。
props.descriptionEn: A known finite value in an increasing range; out-of-range, nonfinite, or reversed inputs throw RangeError.

props.name: segments
props.description: 离散的 n 级：轨道按 n 个等宽格分开，格间留 2px 透明空隙。n 为 2 以上的整数；(value − min) 必须是 (max − min)/n 的整数倍，否则抛 RangeError。级别名用 getAriaValueText 给出。
props.descriptionEn: A discrete scale of n levels: the track splits into n equal cells with a 2px transparent gap. n is an integer of 2 or more; (value − min) must be a whole multiple of (max − min)/n, otherwise RangeError is thrown. Name levels with getAriaValueText.

props.name: tone
props.description: 指示的状态类别，由调用方声明，组件不从数值猜好坏；根上带 data-tone。不给时用主色。非法值抛 RangeError。
props.descriptionEn: The indicator's status category, declared by the caller; the component does not guess good or bad from the value. The root carries data-tone. Omitted, the primary color is used. An invalid value throws RangeError.

props.name: format / locale / getAriaValueText
props.description: 真实单位和可访问读数；locale 默认跟随 UILocale。
props.descriptionEn: Actual units and accessible readings; locale defaults to UILocale.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 属性、事件与ref透传实际元素；样式由className/style调整。
props.descriptionEn: Forward attributes, events, and refs to the actual element; adjust presentation through className/style.

api.name: MeterLabel
api.description: 登记测量对象的可访问名称。
api.descriptionEn: Registers the measured object's accessible name.

api.name: MeterValue
api.description: 真实测量读数及调用方格式化内容。
api.descriptionEn: Actual measurement and caller-formatted content.

api.name: MeterTrack
api.description: 测量范围的视觉轨道；消费独立轨厚角色。
api.descriptionEn: A visual measurement range using an independent track-thickness role.

api.name: MeterIndicator
api.description: 由公共 Meter 上下文计算实际测量比例。
api.descriptionEn: Computes the actual measurement ratio from public Meter context.

api.name: MeterPrimitive
api.description: Base UI Meter 公共原语。
api.descriptionEn: Public Base UI Meter primitive.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 原生选择 NativeSelect
metadata.description: 保留平台选择器、原生选项与表单值。
metadata.descriptionEn: Keep the platform picker, native options and form values.
metadata.decisions: 原生 size 只表示列表显示行数，不再与呈现几何同名混用；单值形态的几何跟随密度轴，全库一套。multiple 保留多值表单数据和平台列表容量。
metadata.decisionsEn: Native size names visible list rows only and no longer doubles as a geometry profile; the single-value form follows the density axis with one geometry library-wide. multiple keeps multi-value form data and platform list capacity.

whenToUse: 固定选项适合平台原生选择器。
avoid: 需要搜索、动态候选或命令菜单时仍用原生 select。
composition: 独立使用 Label；Field 中单值用 FieldControl render 组合。多值用显式原生名称关系。

library: 输入角色、几何接线与原生选项语义。
application: 选项、值、禁用与错误事实。

responsive: 单值形态一套几何，跟随密度轴；窄屏外高 +4px，粗指针最小外高读 touch-target；多行不固定单行高度。
customization: 保留平台箭头；className / style / render 属于真实 select。

whenToUse: Fixed options suit the platform's native picker.
avoid: Using native select when search, dynamic candidates, or command menus are required.
composition: Use Label independently; compose a single value through FieldControl render within Field. Multiple values use an explicit native naming relationship.

library: Input roles, geometry wiring, and native option semantics.
application: Options, values, disabled facts, and errors.

responsive: One geometry for the single-value form, following the density axis; narrow height adds 4px, coarse pointers read touch-target, and multiple rows are not fixed to a single-line height.
customization: Retain the platform arrow; className/style/render belong to the actual select.

api.name: NativeSelect
api.description: 真实 select，children 使用原生 option / optgroup。
api.descriptionEn: A real select with native option and optgroup children.

props.name: size / multiple / disabled / required / name
props.description: 原生显示行数、多值、禁用、约束与表单名。
props.descriptionEn: Native rows, multiple values, disabled state, constraints and form name.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onChange
props.description: 保留受控与非受控；多值是字符串数组。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled and uncontrolled values; multiple values use string arrays.

props.name: render / ref / ARIA / className / style
props.description: 属性、事件与 ref 属于实际 select；render 应保留可选值的原生元素。
props.descriptionEn: Props, events and ref reach the actual select; render must preserve a native value-selecting element.

keyboard.keys: Tab / 方向键 / 平台选择键
keyboard.keysEn: Tab / Arrow keys / Platform picker keys
keyboard.description: 沿用所在平台的原生选择行为。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Uses native selection behavior on the current platform.

notes: select 没有只读属性；不可改变的值由应用选择真实禁用或静态表达。
FieldControl 的值协议为单字符串；multiple 不走该输入注册协议。
notesEn: select has no read-only attribute; use actual disabled state or static output when a value cannot change.
FieldControl uses a single-string value protocol; multiple does not use that input registration protocol.

metadata.title: 导航菜单 NavigationMenu
metadata.description: 真实链接、可展开的导航分组与面板内的组名、说明。

metadata.decisions: active 是应用提供的页面事实，库不读 URL 或把命令推断成导航。
metadata.decisionsEn: Active is an application-owned page fact; the library never infers it from URLs or turns commands into navigation.

api.name: NavigationMenu / NavigationMenuList / NavigationMenuItem
api.description: nav、ul 与稳定 value 的导航项。
api.descriptionEn: A nav, ul and navigation items with stable values.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: 展开分组受控或非受控；取消保留当前值。
props.descriptionEn: Expanded groups may be controlled or uncontrolled; cancellation retains the current value.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: NavigationMenuTrigger / NavigationMenuLink
api.description: 组触发器与真实链接。
api.descriptionEn: Group triggers and real links.

props.name: href / active
props.description: href 指向真实位置；active 写 aria-current=page。

props.name: description（NavigationMenuLink，面板内使用）
props.description: 一行浓墨说明，只在能帮读者判断去留时给出；顶栏导航线的单行目的地不接受它。

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。

api.name: NavigationMenuGroup / NavigationMenuGroupLabel
api.description: 面板内的分组与不可操作的组名。

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 组名不是链接也不是按钮，只识别不操作；组间距比组内更松，没有分组时面板仍是一份紧凑列表。

api.name: NavigationMenuContent / NavigationMenuPortal / NavigationMenuPositioner / NavigationMenuPopup / NavigationMenuViewport / NavigationMenuPrimitive
api.description: 同一导航 Root 的内容与浮层。

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。

notes: 链接不因导航未展开而失去真实 href；不内置路由。

whenToUse: A finite set of destinations needs grouped disclosure.
avoid: Use Tabs for views of the current object and Menu for commands.

library: Navigation/disclosure primitives and popup positioning.
application: Route hrefs, active facts, and names.

responsive: Keep actual desktop structure; menus fit available space and tables retain complete comparison columns.
customization: Control profiles, spacing, and popup surfaces consume existing roles; their appearance is a preset.
