metadata.title: 数值输入 NumberField
metadata.description: 编辑可为空的数值，并按指定步长增减。
metadata.descriptionEn: Edit an optional number and adjust it by a declared step.
metadata.decisions: 直接编辑超出范围时保留原值，提交由浏览器范围约束检查；步进仍限制在 min/max。空、负号和未完成小数不会被替换为 0。
metadata.decisionsEn: Direct edits outside the range remain intact for native range validation. Stepping still respects min/max. Empty, minus, and partial decimal drafts are not replaced with zero.

api.name: NumberField
api.description: 数值与编辑文本的原语上下文。
api.descriptionEn: Primitive context for the numeric value and its editable text.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: null 表示空；受控值由调用方接受，details 支持 cancel()。
props.descriptionEn: null means empty. The caller accepts controlled changes; details supports cancel().

props.name: min / max / step
props.description: 范围约束直接编辑与表单校验，步进夹在范围内；step='any' 关闭步长校验，交互仍按 1 增减。显式 min 与 step 才始终启用步长提交校验。
props.descriptionEn: Native range validation preserves direct edits; stepping clamps to the range. step='any' disables step validation and steps by one. Explicit min with step always enables submission step validation.

props.name: snapOnStep / smallStep / largeStep
props.description: 是否吸附与 Alt/Shift 步长是独立的显式选项。
props.descriptionEn: Snapping and Alt/Shift step sizes are explicit independent options.

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: blur 或步进提交回调，只描述编辑结束，不代表已保存。
props.descriptionEn: A blur or stepping commit reports the end of editing, not persistence.

props.name: name / form / required / disabled / readOnly
props.description: 原生表单与语义入口；只读继续参与提交，禁用不提交。
props.descriptionEn: Native form semantics. Read-only values submit; disabled values do not.

props.name: locale / format
props.description: 显式数字格式；未指定精度时不因聚焦/失焦丢弃外部数值精度。
props.descriptionEn: Explicit number formatting. Without rounding options, focus and blur preserve external precision.

api.name: NumberFieldGroup
api.description: 输入与两个步进共享的边界；render/ref/样式与状态透传。
api.descriptionEn: Shared boundary for the input and two steppers; forwards render, refs, styling, and state.

api.name: NumberFieldInput
api.description: 复用 Input 的原生出口，由数值原语注册一次 Field。
api.descriptionEn: Composes the native Input outlet while the number primitive registers Field once.

props.name: render / ref / className / style / ARIA / events
props.description: 属于真实 input；render 状态保留数值、编辑文本等 NumberField 状态。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the real input. Render retains numeric value, draft text, and other NumberField state.

api.name: NumberFieldDecrement / NumberFieldIncrement
api.description: 减少/增加原语复用 quiet Button；内建名称来自 locale，按钮不提交表单。
api.descriptionEn: Decrease/increase primitives compose quiet Button. Locale names and non-submitting buttons.

api.name: NumberFieldPrimitive
api.description: 所用 Base UI NumberField 命名空间。
api.descriptionEn: The installed Base UI NumberField namespace.

keyboard.description: 按步长增减；不因直接编辑允许超范围而越过步进边界。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Step up or down within the stepping bounds.

keyboard.description: 使用 smallStep / largeStep。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Use smallStep / largeStep.

keyboard.description: 按文档顺序移动数值入口；步进按钮点击后保留输入焦点，键盘步进在输入上执行。只读仍可聚焦文本。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move among numeric inputs. Stepper clicks retain input focus; keyboard stepping acts on that input. Read-only text remains focusable.

notes: 默认宽度容纳两个步进与约 8 位数字（--qy-number-width）；要满宽给 NumberField className="w-full"，与 Select 同一写法。步进按钮边长等于控件内高，粗指针下随触摸目标高度同步。
只读时在控件下方给出「只读」说明，步进按钮隐藏但保留位置。
FieldLabel 命名真实输入，FieldDescription 明示范围与步长。
封装固定 allowOutOfRange=true；没有静默纠正直接编辑的入口。
不从范围外值自动判断保存失败；invalid 由应用提供。
新写的共同边界与五档样式是本次视觉变化，浏览器焦点/对比另验。
notesEn: The default width holds two steppers and about eight digits (--qy-number-width). Pass className="w-full" to NumberField to fill the container, the same way as Select. Stepper buttons are as wide as the control's inner height, following the touch-target height under coarse pointers.
Read-only shows a read-only note below the control; steppers are hidden but keep their place.
FieldLabel names the real input; FieldDescription states range and step.
The wrapper fixes allowOutOfRange=true and does not silently correct direct edits.
An out-of-range value is not a save failure. The caller provides invalid.
This rebuild changes the shared boundary and size profiles. Browser focus and contrast require separate checks.

whenToUse: 有数值含义并需要步进的值
avoid: 编号、验证码、前导零有意义的文本用 Input / OtpField
composition: Field + FieldLabel + NumberField / Group / Input / steppers + FieldDescription / Error

library: 编辑文本、步进、焦点、非受控数值
application: 受控数值、范围、无效事实与提交结果

responsive: 一套几何，跟随密度轴，紧凑不缩小文字与窄屏 +4px；粗指针编辑/步进采用库内触摸目标
customization: Root 与每部件支持 render/ref；集中角色决定表面与尺寸

whenToUse: A value has numeric meaning and needs stepping.
avoid: Use Input/OtpField for identifiers, verification codes, or text with meaningful leading zeros.
composition: Field + FieldLabel + NumberField / Group / Input / steppers + FieldDescription / Error

library: Editing text, stepping, focus, and uncontrolled numeric values.
application: Controlled numeric values, ranges, invalid facts, and submission outcomes.

responsive: Five matching text profiles and narrow-screen +4px; coarse-pointer editing/stepping use the library's touch target.
customization: Root and parts expose render/refs; central roles determine surfaces and dimensions.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 分段文本 OtpField
metadata.description: 分段呈现一个固定长度文本值。
metadata.descriptionEn: Present a fixed-length text value in segments.
metadata.decisions: 只有一个真实文本输入，分段跟随它的光标与选择。前导零保留，长度填满只说明文本长度；核对、请求和结果归应用。
metadata.decisionsEn: One real text input owns the caret and selection. Leading zeros remain intact. Filling the length reports no verification result; the application owns checking and requests.

api.name: OtpField
api.description: Input 的分段呈现，Field 注册一次。
api.descriptionEn: Segmented presentation of Input with one Field registration.

props.name: length
props.description: 必填正整数，以 Unicode code point 计。超长用户插入整次拒绝并说明；外部值完整呈现，不截断。
props.descriptionEn: Required positive integer, counted as Unicode code points. Over-capacity insertions are rejected whole with feedback. External values are shown in full.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: 受控或非受控文本，保留前导零。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or uncontrolled text; leading zeros remain.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: 请求文本变化；受控调用方拒绝更新时原值不变。输入法合成期间按输入原样回显，合成结束后才按长度校验。
props.descriptionEn: Requests a text change. A controlled caller may retain the previous value. During IME composition the text is echoed as typed; the length rule applies once composition ends.

props.name: normalizeValue
props.description: 键入与粘贴的文本先经它归一化，再按 length 校验；返回值就是写入的文本。验证码常以分组形式送达（123 456、123-456），WCAG 3.3.8 不允许靠拒绝粘贴来为难人，所以默认去掉分隔。限定字符集用 text => text.replace(/\D/g, "")；码本身含连字符时传 text => text。
props.descriptionEn: Typed and pasted text is normalised first, then checked against length; the result is what is written. Codes often arrive grouped (123 456, 123-456) and WCAG 3.3.8 forbids refusing a paste, so whitespace and hyphens are stripped by default. Restrict the character set with text => text.replace(/\D/g, ""); pass text => text when the code itself contains hyphens.

props.name: inputMode / autoComplete
props.description: inputMode 由真实字符范围决定；type 始终 text，不自动转换为数值。
props.descriptionEn: Choose inputMode for the character set. The input type remains text.

props.name: render / ref / className / style / ARIA / events
props.description: 全部属于真实 input；render 必须保持 input 语义、受控值和事件。分段本身固定 dir=ltr（验证码是数字或字母串），不随页面方向反转。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the real input. Render must retain input semantics, its controlled value, and events. The segments are fixed dir=ltr (a code is a digit or letter string) and do not mirror with the page.

props.name: controlClassName
props.description: 调整分段容器的位置与布局。
props.descriptionEn: Styles the segmented container's placement and layout.

props.name: disabled / readOnly / name / form / required
props.description: 禁用不提交；只读可聚焦、复制与提交。
props.descriptionEn: Disabled text does not submit. Read-only text remains focusable, copyable, and submitted.

keyboard.description: 替换原生选择并推进光标；粘贴超出容量时保留原文。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Replace the native selection and advance the caret; over-capacity paste preserves the original text.

keyboard.description: 移动原生文本光标；Shift 保留原生文本选择。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move the native caret; Shift extends native selection.

keyboard.description: 按原生光标或选择删除文本。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Delete according to the native caret or selection.

keyboard.description: 整个字段只有一个焦点入口。
keyboard.descriptionEn: The whole field has one focus stop.

notes: 点击一段选中该字符，后续输入替换它；空段将光标放在当前文本末尾。真实输入透明地覆盖在分段上接收指针，触屏长按可弹出系统的粘贴菜单。
与 FieldLabel、FieldDescription、FieldError 共处；分段本身对辅助技术隐藏。
本批采用单输入分段结构，不恢复旧分段 API。
真实移动端自动填充、IME、辅助技术与焦点对比仍需浏览器/设备验证。
notesEn: Clicking a segment selects its character. An empty segment places the caret at the end. The real input overlays the segments invisibly and receives the pointer, so a touch long-press can reach the system paste menu.
Compose with FieldLabel, FieldDescription, and FieldError. Visual segments are hidden from assistive tech.
This rebuild chooses one segmented input and does not restore a prior segmented API.
Mobile autofill, real IME, assistive tech, and focus contrast need browser/device verification.

whenToUse: 任务明确给出长度的短文本
avoid: 数值步进用 NumberField；不确定长度用 Input
composition: Field 持有持续名称、说明和错误；不内建登录业务

library: 文本草稿、光标、选择与容量拒绝提示
application: 长度、字符规则、受控值、核对与提交结果

responsive: 分段使用同档 control/text；超出外部值完整显示，容器可由项目调整
customization: 输入 props 属于真实 input；controlClassName 属于外容器

whenToUse: The task specifies a short text length.
avoid: Use NumberField for numeric stepping and Input for unspecified lengths.
composition: Field supplies persistent names, descriptions, and errors; no built-in sign-in business logic.

library: Text drafts, caret, selection, and capacity rejection feedback.
application: Length, character rules, controlled values, verification, and submission outcomes.

responsive: Segments use matching control/text profiles; over-capacity external values display fully, with consumer-adjustable containers.
customization: Input props belong to the actual input; controlClassName belongs to the outer container.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 页面标题 PageHeader
metadata.description: 页面名称、上下文与相关动作共置。
metadata.descriptionEn: Co-locate a page name, context and related actions.
metadata.decisions: header 按任务关系共置内容；无自动面包屑、路由或维护者标签。标题层级独立于视觉文字档。
metadata.decisionsEn: A header co-locates task-related content without automatic breadcrumbs, routing or maintainer labels. Heading level is independent of visual scale.

whenToUse: 页面名称和与本任务有关的动作需要共置。
avoid: 普通章节标题使用 Heading；持续的成组操作使用 Toolbar。

library: 标题、上下文与动作的关系布局。
application: 页面名称、标题层级、内容事实与动作可用性。

responsive: 标题与动作可换行，保留原生焦点顺序。

whenToUse: A page name and actions for its current task need to appear together.
avoid: Use Heading for ordinary section titles and Toolbar for persistent grouped operations.

library: Relationship layout for titles, context, and actions.
application: Page names, heading levels, content facts, and action availability.

responsive: Titles and actions wrap while retaining native focus order.

api.name: PageHeader
api.description: 原生 header。
api.descriptionEn: A native header.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 结构、ARIA、ref 与事件传入实际 header。
props.descriptionEn: Structure, ARIA, refs and events reach the actual header.

api.name: PageHeaderContent / PageHeaderDescription / PageHeaderActions
api.description: div / p / div 内容槽。
api.descriptionEn: div / p / div content slots.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 应用提供上下文与真实操作，动作使用公共 Button 或链接。
props.descriptionEn: The caller provides context and actual actions using public Button or links.

api.name: PageHeaderTitle
api.description: 复用 Heading。
api.descriptionEn: A Heading composition.

props.name: level / step / render / ref / Heading props
props.description: 嵌入章节时调整 level；文字尺度是既有预设。
props.descriptionEn: Adjust level for nested sections; text scale is an existing preset.

notes: 无需动作时省略动作槽；不复制已经明确的路径或操作说明。
notesEn: Omit absent actions; do not duplicate an already clear path or action instructions.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 分页 Pagination
metadata.description: 页位置、真实入口与明确的未知总数。
metadata.descriptionEn: Page position, real actions and explicit unknown totals.
metadata.decisions: PaginationPattern 提供页窗、条数选择和总数下降校正；页码与 pageSize 一次通知。未知总数必须显式提供 hasNextPage。链接导航或自定结构继续使用分页原语。
metadata.decisionsEn: PaginationPattern provides page windows, page-size selection and correction after totals decrease; page and pageSize change in one notification. Unknown totals require explicit hasNextPage. Retain the primitive parts for link navigation and custom anatomy.

whenToUse: 结果按页呈现，页位置和方向可用性已知。
avoid: 过程进度用 Steps；不确定结果总数时不伪造末页。

library: 页入口的导航、列表、当前页语义与真实禁用。
application: 页内容、当前页、总数或未知、前后页可用性与请求结果。

responsive: 动作可换行，保留当前页与总数状态。

whenToUse: Results are paged and positions/navigation availability are known.
avoid: Use Steps for process progression; never invent a last page when totals are unknown.

library: Navigation, lists, current-page semantics, and actual disabling of page entries.
application: Page content, current page, known/unknown totals, previous/next availability, and request outcomes.

responsive: Actions wrap while retaining current-page and total states.

api.name: PaginationPattern
api.description: 本地页动作的标准组合。
api.descriptionEn: Standard composition for local page actions.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: { page, pageSize } 原子更新；page 从 1 开始。reason 为 page、page-size 或 total-change。条数改变同时回到第 1 页。
props.descriptionEn: Atomically updates { page, pageSize }; page starts at 1. Reasons are page, page-size and total-change. A page-size change also returns to page 1.

props.name: totalCount / hasNextPage
props.description: 非负条数计算总页数，下降时校正当前页；0 条时内部 page=1 但不呈现当前页。未知 null 时必须显式给 hasNextPage，不推断末页。
props.descriptionEn: A nonnegative total determines pages and corrects the current page when it decreases. Zero results retain internal page=1 but present no current page. null requires explicit hasNextPage and never invents a final page.

props.name: pageSizeOptions / disabled / busy
props.description: 省略 options 时隐藏条数控件；候选为不重复正整数。disabled 只阻止本地操作，不推断请求状态。busy 同样挡住翻页，但按钮保持可聚焦（原生 disabled 会让刚按下的按钮丢掉焦点），条数控件改为只读；DataTablePattern 的 busy 会传给它。
props.descriptionEn: Omit options to hide the page-size control; candidates are distinct positive integers. disabled blocks local actions without inferring request state. busy also blocks paging but keeps buttons focusable (native disabled would drop focus from the button just pressed) and makes the page-size control read-only; DataTablePattern passes its busy to it.

props.name: aria-label / render / ref / native nav props
props.description: 转发到 nav；可访问页名、总数摘要与条数标签来自 locale。
props.descriptionEn: Forwarded to nav; accessible page names, total summaries and page-size labels come from locale.

api.name: Pagination
api.description: 有名称的 nav，不生成页码。
api.descriptionEn: A named nav without generated pages.

props.name: page

metadata.title: 密码输入 PasswordInput
metadata.description: 输入密码，并可切换为明文核对。
metadata.descriptionEn: Enter a password and switch to plain text to check it.
metadata.decisions: 密码输入是组合，不是 Input 的一个模式：编辑边界（InputGroup）里放输入与一个显示密码的开关，都是公开部件。输入框只承载值；开关是附在边界上的另一个动作，名称固定为「显示密码」，按下与否由 aria-pressed 表达。开关不改内容、不提交表单；强度、规则与校验由应用给出。
metadata.decisionsEn: PasswordInput is a composition, not a mode of Input: the input and a show-password toggle sit inside one editing boundary (InputGroup), both public parts. The input only holds the value; the toggle is a separate action on the boundary with the stable name “Show password”, its state expressed by aria-pressed. The toggle changes no content and submits no form; strength, rules and validation come from the application.

whenToUse: 登录、设置或修改密码。
avoid: 一次性验证码用 OtpField。
用 placeholder 写密码规则：规则写在 FieldDescription。
composition: 与 FieldLabel、FieldDescription、FieldError 共处；autoComplete 写 current-password 或 new-password。

library: 共同边界、开关的名称与按下状态、受控或非受控的可见性。
application: 密码值、规则说明、校验事实与提交结果。

responsive: 宽度由所在容器决定；几何与 Input 相同，跟随密度轴。
customization: className、style、render 与 ref 属于真实 input；controlClassName 属于编辑边界；showLabel 改写开关的名称。

whenToUse: Signing in, or setting or changing a password.
avoid: Use OtpField for one-time codes.
Password rules in a placeholder: write them in FieldDescription.
composition: Pair with FieldLabel, FieldDescription and FieldError; set autoComplete to current-password or new-password.

library: The shared boundary, the toggle's name and pressed state, and controlled or uncontrolled visibility.
application: The password value, rule text, validation facts and the submission outcome.

responsive: Width follows the container; geometry matches Input and follows the density axis.
customization: className, style, render and ref belong to the real input; controlClassName belongs to the editing boundary; showLabel renames the toggle.

api.name: PasswordInput
api.description: InputGroup + Input（type=password）+ 显示密码的开关。
api.descriptionEn: InputGroup + Input (type=password) + a show-password toggle.

props.name: visible / defaultVisible / onVisibleChange
props.description: 密码是否以明文显示；支持受控与非受控。
props.descriptionEn: Whether the password is shown as plain text; controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: 开关的稳定名称，默认从 locale 读取；aria-pressed 表达当前是否可见。
props.descriptionEn: Stable toggle name, read from the locale by default; aria-pressed reports visibility.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onChange / onValueChange
props.description: 受控与非受控值；切换可见性不改变值。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled and uncontrolled values; switching visibility never changes the value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: 输入禁用时开关一并禁用，同样服从 Field 与原生 fieldset。
props.descriptionEn: The toggle is disabled with the input, also following Field and a native fieldset.

props.name: className / style / render / ref
props.description: 全部作用于真实 input。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the real input.

props.name: controlClassName
props.description: 作用于编辑边界，例如宽度。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the editing boundary, e.g. its width.

props.name: 其余 InputProps（除 type / unstyled）
props.description: autoComplete、name、form、aria-* 等原样透传；默认关闭自动大写、自动更正与拼写检查。autoComplete 应写 current-password（登录）或 new-password（设置）；未传时开发环境在控制台警告，生产环境不提示。
props.descriptionEn: autoComplete, name, form, aria-* and the rest are forwarded; auto-capitalisation, auto-correction and spell checking are off by default. Set autoComplete to current-password (sign in) or new-password (set); when missing, development logs a console warning and production stays silent.

keyboard.description: 在输入与开关之间移动；禁用的开关不进入顺序。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move between the input and the toggle; a disabled toggle leaves the tab order.

keyboard.description: 焦点在开关上时切换可见性，不提交表单。
keyboard.descriptionEn: On the toggle: switch visibility without submitting the form.

notes: 不得阻止粘贴，也不得阻止密码管理器自动填充（WCAG 3.3.8 可访问认证）：组件没有任何 paste、drop 或关闭自动填充的处理；调用方不要通过 onPaste 的 preventDefault、autoComplete="off" 或把输入拆成多个字段来拦截。
此前写作 Input type="password" 的用法改为 PasswordInput；Input 的 visibilityToggle / visible / defaultVisible / onVisibleChange / showLabel 已移除。
notesEn: Never block pasting or password-manager autofill (WCAG 3.3.8, Accessible Authentication): the component has no paste, drop or autofill-disabling handling, and callers should not add one through onPaste preventDefault, autoComplete="off", or by splitting the input into several fields.
Replace Input type="password" with PasswordInput; Input's visibilityToggle / visible / defaultVisible / onVisibleChange / showLabel are removed.

metadata.title: 结果未知 PendingValue
metadata.description: 保留对象与原值，表达写入结果未知。
metadata.descriptionEn: An unresolved write result with its original value.
metadata.decisions: 不把未知当失败，不默认重试危险写入。
metadata.decisionsEn: Unknown is not failure; never retry a dangerous write by default.

whenToUse: 写入已发生但缺少可靠结果。
avoid: 不把未知当失败，不默认重试危险写入。
composition: 原值放 children，核实或恢复入口放 actions；都由应用提供。

library: 原生语义、公共组合与集中角色。
application: 对象、内容、值、状态与请求结果。

responsive: 对象、原值与未知结果文字允许换行；动作复用已有 Group 和调用方真实入口。
customization: 使用公开 render/ref、ARIA、事件与样式；不混用主题三轴。

whenToUse: A write occurred without a reliable outcome.
avoid: Unknown is not failure; never retry a dangerous write by default.
composition: Original value in children and verification/recovery entries in actions; applications supply both.

library: Native semantics, public composition, and centralized roles.
application: Objects, content, values, states, and request outcomes.

responsive: Objects, original values, and unknown-result text wrap; actions use existing Group and actual caller entries.
customization: Public render/refs, ARIA, events, and styles; keep theme axes independent.

api.name: PendingValue
api.description: 原值放 children，核实或恢复入口放 actions；都由应用提供。
api.descriptionEn: Put the original value in children and verification/recovery entries in actions; applications supply both.

props.name: label
props.description: 必填非空对象名称。
props.descriptionEn: A required nonblank object name.

props.name: children
props.description: 原值；0 保持0，缺席不代填0。
props.descriptionEn: The original value; zero remains zero and missing never becomes zero.

props.name: numeric
props.description: 原值是数字（金额、数量、计数）时设为 true，以等宽数字对齐；文本、日期等保持 false。
props.descriptionEn: Set to true when the original value is a number (amount, quantity, count) to align it with tabular figures; leave false for text, dates and other non-numeric values.

props.name: actions
props.description: 应用已有的核实/恢复入口，组件不发请求。
props.descriptionEn: Actual application verification/recovery entries; the component sends no request.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 属性、事件与ref透传实际元素；样式由className/style调整。
props.descriptionEn: Forward attributes, events, and refs to the actual element; adjust presentation through className/style.

metadata.title: 浮起面板 Popover
metadata.description: 与触发对象绑定的非阻断浮层，承载局部操作与补充信息。
metadata.descriptionEn: A trigger-bound non-modal popup for local actions and supplementary information.
metadata.decisions: 关闭只收起浮层，不代表提交或撤销完成。草稿与结果由应用持有；唯一的关键后果须留在持续工作面。
metadata.decisionsEn: Closing hides the popup; it does not complete submission or undo. The application owns drafts and results. Keep essential consequences on the persistent work surface.

api.name: Popover
api.description: 管理非阻断打开状态，完整继承 Base UI Root 的控制契约。modal 已移除。
api.descriptionEn: Manage non-modal open state with the Base UI Root contract. modal has been removed.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: 受控 / 非受控打开状态。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled / uncontrolled open state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: 原语报告请求及原因，应用决定受控状态。
props.descriptionEn: Receive the requested state and reason; the application owns controlled state.

props.name: handle / triggerId / defaultTriggerId
props.description: 共享触发器或受控初始打开时，建立明确关联。
props.descriptionEn: Associate shared triggers or a controlled/initially open popup.

api.name: PopoverTrigger / PopoverClose
api.description: 原生触发与关闭入口；支持 render、ref、style、事件及按状态求值的 className。
api.descriptionEn: Native trigger and close controls supporting render, ref, style, events and state class functions.

api.name: PopoverPopup
api.description: 浮起表面、定位与可滚动内容层；别名 PopoverContent。无日历或 tooltip 样式特判。
api.descriptionEn: Raised surface, positioning and scrollable content. Aliased as PopoverContent, with no calendar or tooltip-specific variant.

props.name: side / align
props.description: 相对触发者的方向与对齐；由原语处理碰撞。
props.descriptionEn: Anchor-relative side and alignment with primitive-owned collision handling.

props.name: sideOffset / alignOffset / anchor
props.description: 明确定位关系。默认间距沿用原语 0，不推断内容类型。
props.descriptionEn: Explicit positioning. Default offsets follow the primitive at zero.

props.name: initialFocus / finalFocus
props.description: 默认原语管理焦点与返回；触发者将被移除时，finalFocus 指定有意义上级。
props.descriptionEn: Primitive-managed focus and return. Set finalFocus to a meaningful parent when the trigger will disappear.

props.name: portalProps
props.description: 局部密度、方向、语言或主题需保留时，将 container 指向已挂载的上下文容器。
props.descriptionEn: Use a mounted context container to retain local density, direction, language or theme.

props.name: positionerProps / viewportProps
props.description: 透传 className、style、ref、render 和原生属性；Positioner 共享 popup 层级先合并，调用方 style 最后合并。
props.descriptionEn: Forward classes, styles, refs, render and native attributes. Shared popup layers are merged before caller Positioner styles.

api.name: PopoverTitle / PopoverDescription
api.description: 关联浮层的可访问名称与说明。
api.descriptionEn: Associate the popup's accessible name and description.

api.name: PopoverCreateHandle / PopoverPrimitive
api.description: 类型化共享触发器 handle 与 Base UI 原语命名空间。
api.descriptionEn: Typed shared-trigger handle and the Base UI primitive namespace.

keyboard.description: 在触发器上打开或关闭。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Open or close from the trigger.

keyboard.description: 关闭并返回触发者，或指定的 finalFocus。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Close and return to the trigger or finalFocus target.

keyboard.description: 遍历内容，允许离开浮层回到工作面。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Traverse content and leave the popup for the work surface.

notes: Popover 始终非阻断；需要阻断决定时用 Dialog 或 AlertDialog。
点击外部入口后保留该入口的焦点，键盘关闭则返回触发者。
默认 Portal 挂到 body，无法继承触发者局部 DOM 上下文；container 必须在打开前挂载。
开关、焦点与定位由 Base UI 管理；入退动效仅由 motion.css 管理。
触发器用 render={<Button />} 等已有边界的控件时，焦点与边框由那个控件负责，PopoverTrigger 只补命中区；裸触发器才自建边框与盒内焦点线。
notesEn: Popover is always non-modal. Use Dialog or AlertDialog for a blocking decision.
Outside clicks retain focus on the clicked control; keyboard dismissal returns to the trigger.
The default body portal cannot inherit the trigger's local DOM context. Mount container before opening.
Base UI owns open state, focus and positioning; motion.css owns entry and exit motion.

When the trigger renders an existing bounded control such as render={<Button />}, that control owns focus and border; PopoverTrigger only adds the hit area. Only a bare trigger draws its own border and inset focus line.

whenToUse: 在触发对象旁展开局部操作或补充信息，主工作面仍可使用。
avoid: 阻断式任务；唯一关键后果；把关闭当成保存或取消成功。
composition: Trigger 关联对象；Title/Description 建立名称；Close、Esc 与外部入口提供返回。

library: 本地打开请求、触发关联、定位、焦点与返回。
application: 草稿、业务动作、异步结果、受控 open 与触发器消失后的返回目标。

responsive: 在可用高度内滚动，保留焦点内缘；关闭方式与非阻断语义不变。
customization: 集中表面与浮层圆角；原生属性与定位层透传；不按子内容追加视觉特判。

whenToUse: Disclose local actions or supplementary information beside an object while the main workspace remains usable.
avoid: Blocking tasks, the only critical consequence, or treating closure as successful save/cancellation.
composition: Trigger associates the object; Title/Description establish names; Close, Escape, and external entries provide return.

library: Local open requests, trigger associations, positioning, focus, and return.
application: Drafts, business actions, asynchronous outcomes, controlled open, and return targets after the trigger disappears.

responsive: Scroll within available height with internal focus; exit mechanisms and nonblocking semantics remain unchanged.
customization: Central surfaces and popup radii; forward native and positioning props without child-specific visual exceptions.

metadata.title: 进度 Progress
metadata.description: 表达可靠分母的任务进度或明确不定状态。
metadata.descriptionEn: Confirmed task completion or an explicit indeterminate state.
metadata.decisions: 动画和时间不能提供完成事实；0 与 null 不同。离散的量用 segments 分格：空隙是遮罩切出的透明缝，不画底色；值必须落在格边界上，不显示半格。
metadata.decisionsEn: Animation and time establish no completion fact. Zero differs from null. A discrete quantity uses segments: the gaps are transparent cuts made by a mask, not a painted color, and the value must sit on a cell boundary, never half a cell.

whenToUse: 有可靠完成比例，或已知正在进行但缺少比例。
avoid: 动画和时间不能提供完成事实；0 与 null 不同。
composition: Label 关联任务；Value 默认按真实 null 显示已有 locale 的进行中，调用方格式化内容优先。
总共 n 级的阶段条用 segments={n}；阶段名由 getAriaValueText 或 aria-valuetext 给出，例如「四龄，第 4 / 7 阶段」。

library: 原生语义、公共组合与集中角色。
application: 对象、内容、值、状态与请求结果。

responsive: 任务名称与格式化读数允许换行；轨厚由独立进度角色控制。
customization: 使用公开 render/ref、ARIA、事件与样式；不混用主题三轴。

whenToUse: A reliable completion ratio exists, or work is known to be underway without a ratio.
avoid: Animation and time establish no completion fact. Zero differs from null.
composition: Label names the task; Value defaults to localized in-progress for actual null, with caller formatting taking precedence.
A stage bar of n levels uses segments={n}; stage names come from getAriaValueText or aria-valuetext, for example "Fourth instar, stage 4 of 7".

library: Native semantics, public composition, and centralized roles.
application: Objects, content, values, states, and request outcomes.

responsive: Task names and formatted readings wrap; an independent progress role controls track thickness.
customization: Public render/refs, ARIA, events, and styles; keep theme axes independent.

notes: 长任务按事实分阶段：已提交但无法计数用 value={null}，处理中数已确认的项，结束后用 Alert 说明完成或部分失败，列出失败项并给「重试失败项」。进度条不承担结果说明。
notesEn: Stage a long task by what is known: submitted but uncountable uses value={null}, processing counts confirmed items, and afterwards an Alert states completion or partial failure, lists the failed items and offers a retry. The bar does not carry the outcome.

api.name: Progress
api.description: Label 关联任务；Value 默认按真实 null 显示已有 locale 的进行中，调用方格式化内容优先。
api.descriptionEn: Label names the task; Value defaults to localized in-progress for actual null, with caller formatting taking precedence.

props.name: value
props.description: 已确认值；null 才是不定进度，不输出 aria-valuenow。
props.descriptionEn: Confirmed value; only null is indeterminate and omits aria-valuenow.

props.name: min / max
props.description: 有限递增范围且分母有限；越界或不合法输入抛 RangeError。
props.descriptionEn: A finite increasing range with a finite denominator; invalid or out-of-range values throw RangeError.

props.name: segments
props.description: 离散的 n 级：轨道按 n 个等宽格分开，格间留 2px 透明空隙。n 为 2 以上的整数；value 不能为 null，且 (value − min) 必须是 (max − min)/n 的整数倍，否则抛 RangeError。阶段名用 getAriaValueText 给出。
props.descriptionEn: A discrete scale of n levels: the track splits into n equal cells with a 2px transparent gap. n is an integer of 2 or more; value cannot be null and (value − min) must be a whole multiple of (max − min)/n, otherwise RangeError is thrown. Name stages with getAriaValueText.

props.name: format / locale / getAriaValueText
props.description: 数字格式跟随 locale（默认 UILocale）；真实 null 的默认 ARIA 文案使用现有 buttonInProgress，getAriaValueText 定制优先。
props.descriptionEn: Number formatting follows locale, defaulting to UILocale. Actual null uses existing buttonInProgress ARIA text; getAriaValueText takes precedence.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 属性、事件与ref透传实际元素；样式由className/style调整。
props.descriptionEn: Forward attributes, events, and refs to the actual element; adjust presentation through className/style.

api.name: ProgressLabel
api.description: 登记实际任务的可访问名称。
api.descriptionEn: Registers the actual task's accessible name.

api.name: ProgressValue
api.description: 已确认读数保留数字格式；真实 null 默认显示本地化进行中，children 回调定制优先。
api.descriptionEn: Confirmed readings retain number formatting; actual null defaults to localized in-progress, with a children callback taking precedence.

api.name: ProgressTrack
api.description: 实际进度的视觉轨道；消费独立轨厚角色。
api.descriptionEn: The visual progress track consumes an independent thickness role.

api.name: ProgressIndicator
api.description: 已确认进度的比例；不定状态是一段移动的窄带，与确定态同形，只是位置不可知。
api.descriptionEn: Confirmed progress ratio; the indeterminate state is a moving narrow band with the same form as determinate progress, only its position unknown.

api.name: ProgressPrimitive
api.description: Base UI Progress 公共原语。
api.descriptionEn: Public Base UI Progress primitive.

metadata.title: 构成 Proportion
metadata.description: 一个整体由哪几部分组成，各占多少。
metadata.descriptionEn: Which parts make up a whole and how much each takes.
metadata.decisions: 用长度而不是角度表达比例，所以不提供饼图；与 Meter 同一条凹槽。两到五个部分按校验过的系列顺序取色，剩余是凹槽本身。图例给出名称、数值与百分比，是完整的文字等价物；legend="hidden" 只把它从画面上移开（仅对辅助技术可见），不删。部分可以声明状态类别 tone：要么全有要么全无，同一类别不出现两次。
metadata.decisionsEn: Length rather than angle carries the share, so there is no pie; it uses the same groove as Meter. Two to five parts take the validated series order, and the remainder is the groove itself. The legend states names, values and percentages as the full text equivalent; legend="hidden" only moves it off screen (assistive technology still reads it), it is never removed. Parts may declare a status tone: all or none, and no tone twice.

api.name: Proportion
api.description: 整体的名称、部分与可选总量。
api.descriptionEn: The whole's name, its parts and an optional total.

props.name: label
props.description: 整体是什么。
props.descriptionEn: What the whole is.

props.name: items
props.description: 两到五个非负部分；更多时由调用方合并为「其他」。tone 为状态类别（danger、warning、success、info）：要么所有部分都声明，要么都不声明，混用或同一类别出现两次抛错；声明后各段与图例色块取类别色，不再按序取系列色。
props.descriptionEn: Two to five non-negative parts; fold more into one named part. tone is a status category (danger, warning, success, info): all parts declare one or none do; mixing, or repeating a tone, throws. Declared tones replace the ordered series colors in segments and legend swatches.

props.name: total
props.description: 整体总量；省略时等于各部分之和，大于时剩余显示为空槽。
props.descriptionEn: The whole; defaults to the sum, and any remainder shows as empty groove.

props.name: format
props.description: 图例中数值的格式。
props.descriptionEn: Formatting for values in the legend.

props.name: legend
props.description: 默认 visible。hidden 时图例仍在文档里、只对辅助技术可见，画面上只剩轨道；用于旁边已有数字（如 Stat）的位置。
props.descriptionEn: Defaults to visible. When hidden the legend stays in the document for assistive technology only and the screen shows the track alone; for places that already carry a number, such as a Stat.

whenToUse: 一个整体的构成需要一眼看出。
avoid: 只有一个部分对一个上限时用 Meter；比较各类别的大小用 Chart 柱状。
composition: 放在面板、读数旁；名称由调用方给出。
在 Stat 的数字下面时放进 StatDescription，并用 legend="hidden"。

library: 分段、空隙、取色与文字等价物。
application: 数值、总量与合并规则。

responsive: 条占满宽度，图例换行。
customization: 系列色来自 chart1..5，不另造调色板。

whenToUse: The make-up of a whole should read at a glance.
avoid: Use Meter for one part against a limit; use a bar Chart to compare category sizes.
composition: Place in panels or beside readings; the caller supplies the name.
Under a Stat number, place it in StatDescription with legend="hidden".

library: Segments, gaps, colors and the text equivalent.
application: Values, the total and folding rules.

responsive: The bar fills the width; the legend wraps.
customization: Series colors come from chart1..5 without a separate palette.

metadata.title: 长文 Prose
metadata.description: 给已渲染的 Markdown / 富文本排版：标题、段落、列表、引用、代码、表格读已有的文字档与墨阶。默认只排版、不带框；文章独自成篇、没有承载面时用 framed 给它一张阅读纸。
metadata.descriptionEn: Typesets already-rendered Markdown or rich text: headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code and tables read existing text tiers and ink roles. It only typesets by default, with no frame; give it a reading paper with framed when the article stands alone with no surface of its own.
metadata.decisions: Prose 不解析 Markdown、不内置渲染器：调用方用任意工具（react-markdown、MDX、服务端 HTML）产出原生元素，Prose 只给直接子块里的原生文本元素（header、h1–h4、p、ul/ol 含任务列表、blockquote、pre、table、figure、details、hr、img）以及这些子块之内的原生元素（strong/em、a、行内代码、kbd、figcaption、summary 等）排版，不改写它们的结构或属性。带 data-slot 的元素与它的内部不进入，所以文章里可以直接放组件与演示。标题三级取页面已有的文字档（h1 展示、h2 标题、h3 章节），与官网文档同一套（2026-10-12 裁决）。
metadata.decisionsEn: Prose neither parses Markdown nor bundles a renderer: callers use any tool (react-markdown, MDX, server-rendered HTML) to produce native elements, and Prose typesets only the native text blocks among its direct children (header, h1–h4, p, ul/ol including task lists, blockquote, pre, table, figure, details, hr, img) and the native elements inside them (strong/em, a, inline code, kbd, figcaption, summary and so on), without rewriting their structure or attributes. An element carrying data-slot, and everything inside it, is left alone, so components and live examples can sit directly in an article. The three heading ranks read the page's existing text tiers (h1 display, h2 title, h3 chapter), the same scale as the documentation site (ruling of 2026-10-12).

whenToUse: 展示一段已经渲染好的长文或 Markdown 结果：帮助文章、更新日志、AI 回复、文档正文。
avoid: Prose 不解析 Markdown 字符串；把原始文本交给具体渲染器，渲染结果再放进 Prose。
短小的字段说明或摘要用 Text；Prose 是给整段长文排版，不是通用的富文本容器。
composition: children 是渲染器产出的原生元素树，或经审查的 dangerouslySetInnerHTML；Prose 只加一层 className。
文章里直接放库组件：带 data-slot 的元素及其内部不排版。自己画的一段内容加上 data-slot，就声明了它不是正文。
div、section 这类容器子块不进入。要让容器里的标题与段落也成文，用 render 把这个容器本身做成一篇 Prose。
页面已经有承载面（Card、文档站的纸）时保持默认（不带框）：只排版，不再画第二张纸；栏宽与内缘读 --qy-prose-column、--qy-prose-inset，承载面可以取同一组值。文章独自成篇、没有承载面时才设 framed。
h1 与紧随的一段导语放进 header：两者相隔一个字段间距，导语读淡墨。
表格读与 Table 组件相同的视觉规则（清染表头/表尾、行高、数字列等宽），行内代码读 Typography 的 Code 规则，链接读 Link 的 linkClassName，不另起一套画法。

library: 标题、段落、列表、引用、代码、表格、分隔线、图片、键位、详情框的排版与墨阶。
application: Markdown 解析、内容本身、任务列表勾选框的完成事实、脚注与链接目标。

responsive: 栏宽 38 材（760px），不随视口拉宽；段落、列表与引用的行长止于 40 个正文字（640px），代码块与表格可以用满栏。纸的内缘 2 材，窄屏收紧到面板内缘。三个值都是预设，入口是 --qy-prose-column、--qy-prose-measure、--qy-prose-inset。
很宽的表格目前不会在 Prose 内独立横向滚动（纸的圆角需要 overflow-hidden 而非 overflow-x-auto），只能按单元格自然换行——已知缺口，非默认画法缺失。
customization: 使用公开 render/ref/className/style 与原生属性；不混用主题三轴。

whenToUse: Present an already-rendered long-form or Markdown result: a help article, a changelog entry, an AI reply, or documentation body copy.
avoid: Prose does not parse Markdown strings; hand raw text to an actual renderer first and place its output inside Prose.
Use Text for short field descriptions or summaries; Prose typesets a whole long-form passage, not a general rich-text container.
composition: Children are the renderer's native element tree, or reviewed dangerouslySetInnerHTML; Prose only adds one className.

Place library components directly in an article: an element carrying data-slot, and everything inside it, is not typeset. Put data-slot on a block you draw yourself to declare that it is not running text.
Container children such as div and section are not entered. To typeset the headings and paragraphs inside one, make that container itself a Prose through render.

Where the page already has a surface (a Card, the documentation paper) keep the default (no frame): it only typesets and draws no second paper; the column and inset come from --qy-prose-column and --qy-prose-inset, so the surface can read the same values. Set framed only when the article stands alone with no surface of its own.
Put the h1 and the lead paragraph that follows it in a header: they sit one field gap apart and the lead reads in muted ink.

Tables read the same visual rules as the Table component (washed header/footer bands, row height, tabular numeric cells); inline code reads Typography's Code rule; links read Link's linkClassName — none of these get a second drawing.

library: Typesetting and ink roles for headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code, tables, rules, images, keys and disclosure widgets.
application: Markdown parsing, the content itself, task-list completion facts, footnotes and link destinations.

responsive: The column is 38 材 (760px) and does not widen with the viewport; paragraphs, lists and quotes stop at a measure of 40 reading characters (640px), while code blocks and tables may use the whole column. The paper's inset is 2 材 and tightens to the panel padding on narrow screens. All three are presets, set through --qy-prose-column, --qy-prose-measure and --qy-prose-inset.

A very wide table does not yet scroll independently inside Prose (the paper's rounded corners need overflow-hidden rather than overflow-x-auto), so cells simply wrap — a known gap, not a missing default treatment.

api.name: Prose
api.description: 长文容器；默认渲染为 article。
api.descriptionEn: The long-form container; renders as article by default.

props.name: framed
props.description: 是否自带阅读纸（面、清墨线、圆角、内缘与栏宽上限）。默认 false，只排版，纸由所在的承载面负责（不要盒装样本、不要多余的框）；独自成篇时设为 true。
props.descriptionEn: Whether it brings its own reading paper (surface, hairline, radius, inset and column limit). False by default: it only typesets and the surrounding surface is the paper (no boxed specimens, no redundant frames); set true when the article stands alone.

props.name: render / ref / className / style / 原生属性
props.nameEn: render / ref / className / style / native props
props.description: 属性、事件与 ref 透传实际元素；children 是调用方已渲染好的内容。
props.descriptionEn: Forward attributes, events and refs to the actual element; children are content the caller has already rendered.

notes: 不内置任何文案字符串，不需要经过 useUILocale。
深浅主题下墨阶与纸自动互换，不需要调用方处理。
排版规则在样式的 components 层：给文章里的元素加任何工具类都能覆盖它，不需要 !important。
中文段落两端对齐并按严格规则断行；判断依据是元素的 lang，页面须正确声明语言。
已知边界：另一篇 Prose 若隔着组件嵌在外层 Prose 的原生文本块里（如 figure 里的 Card 里再放 Prose），内层的行内元素不排版；把它放进 div 或 section。
notesEn: Ships no built-in copy strings; does not go through useUILocale.
Ink roles and the paper swap automatically between light and dark; callers do not handle this.
The typesetting rules sit in the stylesheet's components layer: any utility class on an element in the article overrides them, with no !important.
Chinese paragraphs are justified and break lines under the strict rule; this follows the element's lang, so the page must declare its language correctly.

Known limit: a second Prose nested through a component inside a native text block of an outer Prose (a Prose in a Card in a figure, for example) does not get its inline elements typeset; place it in a div or section instead.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 单选组 RadioGroup
metadata.description: 从同时可见的少量候选中取一个值。
metadata.descriptionEn: Choose one value from a small set of visible options.

api.name: RadioGroup
api.description: 可见互斥候选的共同状态与组语义。
api.descriptionEn: Shared state and group semantics for visible mutually exclusive candidates.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: 受控值或真实初始选择。省略初值保持未选择；受控可用 null。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled value or actual initial selection. Omitting the initial value retains no selection; controlled null is allowed.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: 原语值变化，可通过 eventDetails.cancel() 取消。
props.descriptionEn: Primitive value changes can be canceled through eventDetails.cancel().

props.name: name / form / inputRef
props.description: 表单名、外部表单与隐藏 input 引用。未选不提交该字段。
props.descriptionEn: Form name, external form, and hidden input ref. An unselected field is not submitted.

props.name: disabled / readOnly / required
props.description: 禁用、只读与原生约束；required 不自行推断 invalid。
props.descriptionEn: Disabled, read-only, and native constraints; required does not infer invalid.

props.name: aria-labelledby / aria-label
props.description: 组的名称；FieldTitle 的 id 可作为 aria-labelledby。
props.descriptionEn: The group name; FieldTitle id may supply aria-labelledby.

props.name: render / ref / className / style
props.description: 组根元素与状态样式入口。
props.descriptionEn: Group root element and state styling.

api.name: Radio
api.description: 圆形单选入口与中心选中点。
api.descriptionEn: Circular single-choice entry with a central selected dot.

props.name: value
props.description: 组内唯一候选值；空字符串、0 与 null 未选择不同。
props.descriptionEn: A unique candidate value; empty string, zero, and null/no selection differ.

props.name: disabled / readOnly / required
props.description: 原语支持组与项的真实限制，Field disabled 也可传递。
props.descriptionEn: Primitive group/item limits are actual restrictions, including propagated Field disabled.

props.name: render / nativeButton / ref / inputRef
props.description: 默认原生 button，保留隐藏 radio input；改成非 button 时显式 nativeButton=false。
props.descriptionEn: Defaults to native button while retaining a hidden radio input. Set nativeButton=false for another element.

props.name: children / className / style
props.description: 替换指示部位或覆写样式；名称放在 FieldLabel 中。
props.descriptionEn: Replace the indicator or override styles; FieldLabel supplies the name.

api.name: RadioGroupPrimitive / RadioPrimitive
api.description: Base UI 组与 Radio 原语出口。
api.descriptionEn: Public Base UI group and Radio primitives.

keyboard.description: 组保留一个停靠点；已选项或第一个可用项获得焦点。
keyboard.descriptionEn: The group retains one tab stop; the selected or first available item receives focus.

keyboard.description: 移动并选择候选，跳过禁用项，在组内循环。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move and select candidates, skip disabled items, and wrap within the group.

keyboard.description: 选择当前候选。Home/End、类型搜索不属于此 Radio 原语契约。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Select the current candidate. Home/End and typeahead are outside this Radio primitive contract.

notes: RadioGroup 只读时在候选之后给出「只读」说明。
FieldTitle 命名组，FieldItem + FieldLabel 命名单项，FieldError 关联错误。
Radio 放在 Field 内不经 FieldItem 时自建标签作用域：每项有自己的 id，名称来自项自己；Field 的标签与描述仍落在整组。
未选择、0 与空字符串是不同的值。
禁用项退出 Tab 顺序；只读保留焦点与当前值。
notesEn: A read-only RadioGroup shows a read-only note after the candidates.
FieldTitle names the group, FieldItem + FieldLabel name each item, and FieldError associates errors.
A Radio placed in a Field without FieldItem opens its own label scope: each item has its own id and takes its name from itself, while the Field label and description stay on the group.
No selection, zero, and empty string are different values.
Disabled items leave tab order; read-only retains focus and current values.
metadata.decisions: 候选需要同时比较时用 RadioGroup；可以收起时用 Select。未选择不会自动变为第一项。
metadata.decisionsEn: Use RadioGroup when candidates must be compared together, and Select when they can collapse. No selection does not automatically choose the first item.

whenToUse: 少量互斥候选，必须同时看见才能比较
avoid: 可收起列表用 Select
多选用 Checkbox
命令用 Menu，视角切换用 Tabs
复杂属性比较用应用比较结构
composition: FieldTitle → RadioGroup aria-labelledby；FieldItem + FieldLabel 命名单项；FieldDescription + FieldError 保留关联

library: 焦点、方向键、非受控值
application: 受控值、候选、invalid、提交与结果

responsive: 读既有窄屏尺寸与粗指针命中角色；本批只做桌面检查
customization: 同档文字行高、圆形身份、主题表面与边框；不新增外围焦点圈

whenToUse: A small mutually exclusive set must remain visible for comparison.
avoid: Use Select for collapsible lists.
Use Checkbox for multiple selection.
Use Menu for commands and Tabs for views.
Applications supply structures for comparing complex properties.
composition: FieldTitle → RadioGroup aria-labelledby; FieldItem + FieldLabel name items; FieldDescription + FieldError retain associations.

library: Focus, arrows, and uncontrolled values.
application: Controlled values, candidates, invalid facts, submissions, and outcomes.

responsive: Uses existing narrow-screen and coarse-pointer roles; this batch checked desktop only.
customization: Matching text line height, circular identity, theme surfaces/borders, and no added outer focus ring.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 分栏 Resizable
metadata.description: 两个或多个面板之间放可拖动的分隔条，调整各自占比。
metadata.descriptionEn: Draggable separators between two or more panels that change how the space is shared.
metadata.decisions: 分隔条只改变它前后两个面板，其余面板不动，占比总和恒为 100。像素下限（"240px"）按组的实际长度换算，量不到长度时不生效。折叠是面板自己的状态，由指针越过折叠与最小值的中点、或分隔条上的 Enter 触发；内容是否随之隐藏、折叠后如何再打开由应用决定。
metadata.decisionsEn: A separator changes only the two panels around it; the rest stay put and the shares always add up to 100. Pixel limits ("240px") are converted with the measured group length and do not apply when no length can be measured. Collapsing belongs to the panel: it is triggered by the pointer passing the midpoint between collapsed and minimum size, or by Enter on the separator. What the content does when collapsed, and how it is reopened, is up to the application.

whenToUse: 左右（或上下）两块内容的占比需要由使用者调整，例如左列表、右详情。
avoid: 占比固定不变时用普通的 flex 或 grid；只需要一条分界线时用 Separator。
composition: 面板内放 ScrollArea、Tree、DataTable 等自己负责滚动的内容；分隔条的名称写它调整的主面板，如「列表」。

library: 各面板占比的求解与夹紧、拖动与按键、折叠状态、书写方向。
application: 占比是否持久化（onLayout / layout）、折叠后的入口、面板里的内容。

responsive: 占比相对分栏组；窄屏是否改成上下排列或单栏切换由应用决定，组件不替换布局。
customization: 线宽与墨色读系统线宽和墨阶；命中区、键盘步长为预设。className 最后合并，原生属性透传。

whenToUse: The share between two blocks side by side (or stacked) should be adjusted by the user, such as a list on the left and details on the right.
avoid: Use plain flex or grid when the shares are fixed, and Separator when only a dividing line is needed.
composition: Put content that scrolls itself in the panels (ScrollArea, Tree, DataTable). Name the separator after the main panel it resizes, for example "List".

library: Solving and clamping each panel's share, dragging and keys, collapse state, writing direction.
application: Whether the layout is persisted (onLayout / layout), how a collapsed panel is reopened, and the panel content.

responsive: Shares are relative to the group. Whether a narrow screen stacks the panels or switches to a single pane is up to the application; the component does not swap layouts.
customization: Line width and ink read the system line width and ink ladder; the hit area and the keyboard step are presets. className merges last and native attributes forward.

api.name: ResizablePanelGroup
api.description: 弹性容器，按 orientation 排列面板与分隔条，并量取自身长度以换算像素界限。
api.descriptionEn: A flex container that lays out panels and separators along orientation and measures its own length to convert pixel limits.

props.name: orientation
props.description: 面板的排列方向。horizontal 左右并排，分隔条是竖线。
props.descriptionEn: Direction the panels are laid out. Horizontal places them side by side with vertical separators.

props.name: onLayout
props.description: 一次拖动或一次按键调整结束时调用，参数是按面板顺序的百分比，和为 100。组长度变化引起的界限修正不调用。
props.descriptionEn: Called when a drag or a key press finishes, with the percentages in panel order adding up to 100. Not called for corrections caused by the group changing length.

props.name: layout
props.description: 受控布局，按面板顺序。长度与面板数不符时忽略。拖动中的中间值只用于显示，松手时才调用 onLayout。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled layout in panel order; ignored when its length differs from the panel count. Intermediate drag values are display-only; onLayout is called on release.

props.name: className / ref / div props
props.description: 作用于容器；默认撑满父元素，高度由父元素或 className 给出。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the container. It fills its parent by default; give it a height through the parent or className.

api.name: ResizablePanel
api.description: 一个面板，大小由分栏组决定；内容超出时被裁切。
api.descriptionEn: A panel whose size is decided by the group; overflowing content is clipped.

props.name: id
props.description: 面板 id，也是前一个分隔条的 aria-controls。省略时自动生成。
props.descriptionEn: Panel id, used as aria-controls of the separator before it. Generated when omitted.

props.name: defaultSize
props.description: 初始百分比；省略的面板均分其余部分。
props.descriptionEn: Initial percentage; panels without it share the rest equally.

props.name: minSize / maxSize
props.description: 数字是百分比，"240px" 是像素。像素按组的可用长度（扣除分隔条）换算。
props.descriptionEn: A number is a percentage, "240px" is pixels, converted with the group's usable length (separators excluded).

props.name: collapsible / collapsedSize
props.description: 允许折叠，折叠后保留的百分比。指针越过折叠值与最小值的中点吸附折叠；方向键不会折叠。
props.descriptionEn: Allow collapsing and the percentage kept when collapsed. The pointer snaps to collapsed past the midpoint between collapsed and minimum size; arrow keys never collapse.

props.name: onCollapse / onExpand
props.description: 折叠或还原时调用。折叠中的面板带 data-collapsed。
props.descriptionEn: Called when the panel collapses or is restored. A collapsed panel carries data-collapsed.

api.name: ResizableHandle
api.description: 分隔条，role="separator"，可聚焦，调整它前后两个面板。
api.descriptionEn: The separator: role="separator", focusable, resizing the panels before and after it.

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby
props.description: 必填其一，缺失时抛错。名称写它调整的主面板（前一个面板），如「列表」。
props.descriptionEn: One is required and a missing name throws. Name it after the main (previous) panel it resizes, for example "List".

props.name: className / ref / div props
props.description: 作用于分隔条；aria-orientation、aria-valuenow / min / max、aria-controls 由组件给出，valuenow 是前一个面板的百分比。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the separator. aria-orientation, aria-valuenow / min / max and aria-controls come from the component; valuenow is the previous panel's percentage.

keyboard.description: 横向分栏用左右键，纵向分栏用上下键，每次移动 10 个百分点；从右向左书写时左右键含义对调。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Left and right in a horizontal group, up and down in a vertical one, 10 percentage points at a time. Left and right swap in right-to-left text.

keyboard.description: 前一个面板取最小 / 最大（折叠面板计入）。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move the previous panel to its smallest or largest size, counting a collapsed state.

keyboard.description: 折叠或还原可折叠的相邻面板，优先前一个。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Collapse or restore the adjacent collapsible panel, the previous one first.

notes: 方向键的步长 10% 是预设；APG 没有规定步长。
分隔条的命中区在细指针下为 8px、粗指针下为 44px，可见的只是一条线。
面板裁切溢出：需要滚动的内容自己放进 ScrollArea。
notesEn: The 10% arrow step is a preset; APG does not prescribe one.
The hit area is 8px with a fine pointer and 44px with a coarse one; only a line is visible.
Panels clip overflow: put content that needs to scroll in a ScrollArea.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 两量关系 ScatterChart
metadata.description: 两个数值量之间的关系；全比较形式，1 至 3 个系列，同源的散点图、命名的双轴与按需展开的数据表。
metadata.descriptionEn: The relationship between two numeric quantities; an all-pairs form with one to three series, a same-source scatter plot, named axes and an on-demand data table.
metadata.decisions: x、y 都是数值轴——这是散点的任务定义，不是违反「永远一个数值轴」；该禁令禁止的是同一类别轴上叠两条不同量纲的 Y 轴制造虚假相关。全比较形式最多 3 个系列，超过应合并为「其他」或拆成多图。
metadata.decisionsEn: Both x and y are value axes by the task's own definition, not a violation of "always one value axis" — that ban targets stacking two different-unit Y-axes on one shared category axis, which fabricates correlation. As an all-pairs form it accepts at most three series; more should fold into "Other" or split into separate charts.

api.name: ScatterChart
api.description: figure 名称、命名的双轴、按系列着色的标记与同源可见 Table。
api.descriptionEn: A named figure, named x/y axes, series-colored markers and a visible same-source Table.

props.name: label
props.description: 非空真实语义名称。
props.descriptionEn: A nonempty semantic name for the actual data.

props.name: framed
props.description: false：图放在已有的面上（无边框的 Section、Card、面板），不铺自己的纸——没有线、底、圆角与内缘，图的左右缘就是承载面的内容缘。与 TableContainer 的 framed 同义。是否显示图内标题与它无关。
props.descriptionEn: false: the chart sits on an existing surface (a borderless Section, Card or panel) and lays no paper of its own — no line, fill, radius or inner padding, so its edges are the host's content edges. Same meaning as TableContainer's framed. Whether the in-chart title shows is independent of it.

props.name: aria-labelledby / aria-label
props.description: 外部名称：传入非空的 aria-labelledby（如 SectionTitle 的 id）或 aria-label 时，figure 由它命名，图内不显示标题；图例与「查看数据」仍在图内、靠行尾，二者都没有时标题栏整行不渲染。不传时由图内标题命名。label 仍必填，是等价数据表的名字。
props.descriptionEn: Outside name: a nonempty aria-labelledby (such as a SectionTitle id) or aria-label names the figure and the in-chart title is not drawn; the legend and Show data stay inside the figure at the row end, and with neither the header row is not rendered. Without one the in-chart title names it. label stays required and names the equivalent data table.

props.name: xLabel / yLabel
props.description: 横轴与纵轴量的是什么，例如「记录数」「失败率」。
props.descriptionEn: What the x and y axes measure, e.g. "records" and "failure rate".

props.name: series
props.type: readonly { key: string; label: string; points: readonly { id: string; label: string; x: number; y: number }[] }[]
props.description: 1 至 3 个系列。只有一个系列时取第一色、不显示图例；两个以上按 chart1..3 取色并配不同标记形状。每个点需要稳定 id 与非空名称。
props.descriptionEn: One to three series. A single series takes the first color without a legend; two or more take the chart1..3 order with distinct marker shapes. Every point needs a stable id and a nonempty name.

props.name: formatX / formatY
props.description: 格式化已知数值；默认按 UILocale 数值 Intl。
props.descriptionEn: Format known values; defaults to Intl number formatting for UILocale.

notes: 绘图区对读屏隐藏（aria-hidden）：标记只是形状，没有可读的名称与值；数据由「查看数据」展开的等价表承担，系列区分另有图例文字与标记形状，不只靠色相。
超过 3 个系列会抛出错误：全比较形式任意两点都可能相邻，色觉校验比相邻校验更严，更多系列应合并为「其他」或改用小图版面拆分。
点的命中区≥24px，大于 8px 的可见标记，指针不必正中标记。
x、y 轴域按实际数据范围加少量留白，不强制从零起——散点不是从基线生长的柱。
悬停读数只增强，不替代按需展开的等价数据表。
notesEn: The plot is hidden from assistive technology (aria-hidden): markers are only shapes with no readable name or value; the equivalent table opened by "View data" carries the data, and series are told apart by legend text and marker shape, not hue alone.

More than three series throws: as an all-pairs form any two points may sit adjacent, so its color-vision check is stricter than an adjacent check; fold extra series into "Other" or split into small multiples.
Each point's hit area is at least 24px, larger than its visible 8px marker; the pointer need not land dead-center.
The x and y domains pad slightly around the actual data range rather than forcing a zero baseline — a scatter point does not grow from a baseline like a bar.
Hover readouts only enhance; they never replace the on-demand equivalent data table.

whenToUse: 需要看两个数值量之间是否存在关系，例如记录数与失败率。
avoid: 只有一个数值要展示（用 Stat）；随时间的单一趋势（用 Chart line/area）；类别之间的比较（用 Chart bar）。
composition: Recharts 公开原语 + 当前 Table；复用 Chart 的 Marker 标记与悬停外壳。没有可画的点时，调用方在原位改放 Empty。

library: 同源投影、可见等价表、标记形态与基础名称。
application: 数据、量纲、真实性与状态文字。

responsive: 图高集中预设可覆写，表格原生滚动/换行。
customization: chart1..3 语义色；不另造散点调色板。

whenToUse: Checking whether two numeric quantities are related, e.g. record count and failure rate.
avoid: A single number to show (use Stat); a single trend over time (use Chart line/area); comparison between categories (use Chart bar).
composition: Public Recharts primitives with the current Table; reuses Chart's Marker shapes and hover shell. With no point to plot, the caller renders Empty in place of the chart.

library: Same-source projection, visible equivalent table, marker shapes and basic naming.
application: Data, units, truth and state content.

responsive: The centralized plot-height preset can be overridden; the table scrolls and wraps natively.
customization: chart1..3 semantic colors; no separate scatter palette.

metadata.title: 滚动区域 ScrollArea
metadata.description: 真实原生滚动，或显式组合可拖动滚动条。
metadata.descriptionEn: Native scrolling with an optional composition of draggable scrollbars.

api.name: ScrollArea
api.description: 真实可滚动 div；原生滚动条尊重平台设置。
api.descriptionEn: An actual scrollable div; native scrollbars respect platform settings.

props.name: children
props.description: 完整内容，不窗口化或隐藏集合项。
props.descriptionEn: Complete content without windowing or hiding collection items.

props.name: style / className
props.description: 消费布局给出 height/maxHeight 与宽度；默认 overflow:auto。
props.descriptionEn: Consumer layout supplies height/maxHeight and width; overflow defaults to auto.

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: 内容溢出时能从键盘到达，没有可滚动的内容就不进入 Tab 序列；原生方向/Page/Home/End 滚动保留。显式给出时以调用方为准。
props.descriptionEn: Keyboard-reachable while the content overflows and not a tab stop when nothing scrolls; retains native arrows/Page/Home/End scrolling. A value you pass is kept.

props.name: render / ref / ARIA / events
props.description: 真实视口的组合、名称、引用和原生滚动/键盘事件；有名称的独立区域可由调用方加 role=region。
props.descriptionEn: Actual viewport composition, names, refs, and native scroll/keyboard events. The caller may add role=region for a named independent area.

api.name: ScrollAreaRoot / ScrollAreaViewport / ScrollAreaContent
api.description: 自定义滚动条的显式组合；Root 拥有布局与溢出事实，Viewport 才是真实滚动元素，Content 用于测量内容。
api.descriptionEn: Explicit styled-scrollbar composition: Root owns layout/overflow facts, Viewport is the actual scroll element and Content supports measurement.

props.name: render / ref / className / style / native props
props.description: 各部位保留自身原语 props；滚动事件、scrollTop/scrollLeft 和聚焦均属于 Viewport，不能把旧视口 ref 直接接到 Root。
props.descriptionEn: Each part retains its primitive props. Scroll events, scrollTop/scrollLeft and focus belong to Viewport; do not move a legacy viewport ref to Root.

api.name: ScrollAreaScrollbar
api.description: 随实际溢出出现的可拖动轨道；未给 children 时内置真实 Thumb。
api.descriptionEn: A draggable track shown for actual overflow; includes a real Thumb when children are omitted.

props.name: orientation
props.description: 选择受控轴；双轴时组合两条轨道与 Corner。
props.descriptionEn: Chooses the controlled axis; compose two tracks and Corner for both axes.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: 无溢出时仍保留 DOM，但隐藏轨道，不制造不存在的滚动范围。
props.descriptionEn: Retains hidden DOM without inventing a scroll range when content does not overflow.

api.name: ScrollAreaThumb / ScrollAreaCorner / ScrollAreaPrimitive
api.description: 滑块长度/位置和轨道拖动由公开原语测量；Corner 留出双轴交会处，完整原语继续可用。
api.descriptionEn: The public primitive measures thumb extent/position and handles dragging; Corner reserves the two-axis intersection and the full primitive remains available.

keyboard.description: 进入内容溢出的滚动视口，或内容内入口。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach a viewport whose content overflows, or entries within its content.

keyboard.keys: 方向 / PageUp / PageDown / Home / End
keyboard.keysEn: Arrow keys / PageUp / PageDown / Home / End
keyboard.description: 按浏览器原生规则滚动，嵌套控件保留自己的键位。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Use native browser scrolling; nested controls retain their own keys.

notes: 分工：默认用 ScrollArea（一个元素，原生滚动条，尊重平台设置）；只有设计要求自绘滚动条时才用 ScrollAreaRoot / ScrollAreaViewport / ScrollAreaContent / ScrollAreaScrollbar / ScrollAreaThumb / ScrollAreaCorner 组合。两者互不嵌套，ScrollArea 不接受 Scrollbar 子部件。
ScrollArea 保持原有单一原生视口与 ref 契约；原生滚动条可见性尊重平台设置。
需要可控滚动条时用 Root > Viewport > Content，Scrollbar/Thumb 与 Viewport 并列；Viewport 继续保留原生滚轮、键盘与触摸滚动。
自定义轨道宽度为 3 分、内缩半分，是该组合的集中预设；滑块长度与移动范围共同由原语计算，不单独覆盖滑块最小长度。Content 默认为轨道留出末端空间。
尺寸由消费布局给出；内容需全量渲染时使用此组件，长集合可使用 VirtualList。
notesEn: Division of labor: use ScrollArea by default (one element, native scrollbars that follow platform settings); reach for ScrollAreaRoot / ScrollAreaViewport / ScrollAreaContent / ScrollAreaScrollbar / ScrollAreaThumb / ScrollAreaCorner only when the design requires drawn scrollbars. Do not nest one inside the other; ScrollArea does not accept Scrollbar parts.
ScrollArea retains its single native viewport and ref contract; native scrollbar visibility respects platform preferences.
For styled scrollbars use Root > Viewport > Content, with Scrollbar/Thumb alongside Viewport. Native wheel, keyboard and touch scrolling stays on Viewport.

The 3-unit track width and half-unit inset are composition presets. The primitive jointly calculates thumb extent and travel; do not independently override its minimum extent. Content reserves ending space for the tracks.
Consumer layout owns dimensions. Use ScrollArea for complete rendering and VirtualList for long collections.

whenToUse: 有限工作区内的完整内容
avoid: 隐藏必要滚动入口或吞掉文本编辑键位
composition: 有限视口 + 原生滚动内容

library: 默认键盘可达与盒内焦点
application: 视口尺寸与内容

customization: style/className 为消费布局入口，无新增尺寸角色

whenToUse: Complete content within a finite workspace.
avoid: Hiding necessary scroll access or consuming text-editing keys.
composition: Finite viewport with native scrolling content.

library: Default keyboard access and internal focus.
application: Viewport dimensions and content.

customization: style/className are consumer layout entries; no new dimension roles.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 搜索输入 SearchInput
metadata.description: 输入一个搜索词，并能一步清空。
metadata.descriptionEn: Enter a search term and clear it in one step.
metadata.decisions: 搜索输入是组合，不是 Input 的一个模式：编辑边界（InputGroup）里依次放搜索图标、输入、清空动作，三者都是公开部件。输入框只承载值；清空是附在边界上的另一个动作，有自己的名称与焦点。它只持有搜索词，不发请求、不决定何时搜索，也不显示结果。
metadata.decisionsEn: SearchInput is a composition, not a mode of Input: a search icon, the input, and a clear action sit inside one editing boundary (InputGroup), all public parts. The input only holds the value; clearing is a separate action on the boundary with its own name and focus. It holds the search term only: it sends no request, does not decide when to search, and shows no results.

whenToUse: 输入搜索词或就地筛选一个列表。
avoid: 普通文本字段用 Input；需要候选项时用 Autocomplete 或 Combobox。
只靠 placeholder 命名：提供 FieldLabel 或 aria-label。
composition: 与 FieldLabel 共处，或在工具条里以 aria-label 命名。需要别的附属动作时，用 InputGroup + InputGroupInput + InputGroupButton 自行组合。

library: 共同边界、搜索图标、清空动作的出现与焦点返回、首个 Escape 清空本字段。
application: 搜索词的含义、何时查询、结果、无结果与失败的表达。

responsive: 宽度由所在容器决定；几何与 Input 相同，跟随密度轴。
customization: className、style、render 与 ref 属于真实 input；controlClassName 属于编辑边界；clearLabel 改写清空动作的名称。

whenToUse: Entering a search term or filtering a list in place.
avoid: Use Input for an ordinary text field; use Autocomplete or Combobox when candidates are offered.
Naming it by placeholder alone: provide FieldLabel or aria-label.
composition: Pair with FieldLabel, or name it with aria-label in a toolbar. For other adjunct actions, compose InputGroup + InputGroupInput + InputGroupButton yourself.

library: The shared boundary, the search icon, when the clear action appears and where focus returns, and the first Escape clearing this field.
application: What the term means, when to query, and how results, no results and failure are expressed.

responsive: Width follows the container; geometry matches Input and follows the density axis.
customization: className, style, render and ref belong to the real input; controlClassName belongs to the editing boundary; clearLabel renames the clear action.

api.name: SearchInput
api.description: InputGroup + 搜索图标 + Input（type=search）+ 清空动作。
api.descriptionEn: InputGroup + search icon + Input (type=search) + a clear action.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onChange / onValueChange
props.description: 受控与非受控值；清空沿同一条原生事件链更新值。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled and uncontrolled values; clearing updates the value through the same native event path.

props.name: onClear
props.description: 清空之后调用；值的变化已由 onChange / onValueChange 送出。清空不提交表单。
props.descriptionEn: Called after clearing; the value change has already been sent through onChange / onValueChange. Clearing does not submit a form.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: 清空动作的名称，默认从 locale 读取。
props.descriptionEn: Name of the clear action, read from the locale by default.

props.name: loading
props.description: 搜索正在进行，事实由应用持有。搜索图标换成转动的记号（同一槽位，边界尺寸不变），输入标 aria-busy，读屏播报「正在搜索」；不阻止继续输入与清空。
props.descriptionEn: A search is in progress; the application owns that fact. The search icon becomes a spinning mark in the same slot (the boundary does not change size), the input is marked aria-busy, and screen readers hear Searching. Typing and clearing stay available.

props.name: readOnly / disabled
props.description: 只读与禁用时不出现清空动作；只读时边界内给出「只读」说明；禁用同样服从 Field 与原生 fieldset。
props.descriptionEn: No clear action when read only or disabled; read-only shows a Read only note in the boundary; disabling also follows Field and a native fieldset.

props.name: className / style / render / ref
props.description: 全部作用于真实 input。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the real input.

props.name: controlClassName
props.description: 作用于编辑边界，例如宽度。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the editing boundary, e.g. its width.

props.name: 其余 InputProps（除 type / unstyled）
props.description: placeholder、name、form、aria-* 等原样透传给输入。
props.descriptionEn: placeholder, name, form, aria-* and the rest are forwarded to the input.

keyboard.description: 在输入与清空动作之间移动。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move between the input and the clear action.

keyboard.description: 非空且可编辑时清空本字段，之后的 Escape 交给外层；输入法组字与调用方取消时保留草稿。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Clear this field when it is nonempty and editable; a later Escape reaches the parent. Composition and caller cancellation preserve the draft.

keyboard.description: 焦点在清空动作上时清空并把焦点还给输入，不提交表单。
keyboard.descriptionEn: On the clear action: clear, return focus to the input, and do not submit the form.

notes: 此前写作 Input type="search" 的用法改为 SearchInput；Input 的 clearable / clearLabel / onClear 已移除。普通字段需要清空时用 InputGroup + InputGroupButton 组合。
notesEn: Replace Input type="search" with SearchInput; Input's clearable / clearLabel / onClear are removed. For a clear action on an ordinary field, compose InputGroup + InputGroupButton.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 区块 Section
metadata.description: 不带边框的页面区块，由标题命名；标题与操作同一行。
metadata.descriptionEn: A page block without a border, named by its title; the title and its actions share one row.
metadata.decisions: 区块靠间距分组，自己不画线、不铺底、不加圆角；区块之间的距离由调用方用节间距排布，需要线时放 Separator。区块由标题命名：SectionTitle 把自己的 id 交给 Section 作 aria-labelledby，没有标题就不产生引用。计数不是独立部件，它是标题里的一段浓墨等宽数字。
metadata.decisionsEn: A section groups by spacing and draws no line, fill or radius; the caller spaces sections with the section gap and places a Separator when a line is wanted. A section is named by its title: SectionTitle hands its id to Section as aria-labelledby, and without a title no reference is made. A count is not a part of its own; it is a run of muted tabular digits inside the title.

whenToUse: 页面里一段内容需要名称，并可能在标题行右端放一个与它有关的操作。
avoid: 有独立边界、需要围合的内容用 Card；页面名称与页面级动作用 PageHeader。
标题没有内容可命名时不要放区块。
标题行右端只放一两个小号操作；成组的常驻操作用 Toolbar。
composition: 区块之间用 Stack gap="section"；需要线时在两个 Section 之间放 Separator。
右侧操作用 Link 或 Button variant="quiet" size="sm"。
计数写成标题里的一段 numeric text-muted-foreground。

library: 标题与区块的命名关联、标题行的行高与中线。
application: 标题内容、计数的含义、标题层级与操作的真实目标。

responsive: 标题与操作同一行；标题长到放不下时操作落到下一行，第一行的中线不动。
customization: className、style、render 与 ref 属于各自的部件；标题层级用 SectionTitle 的 level，不改字号。

whenToUse: A stretch of page content needs a name, and perhaps one related action at the right end of the title row.
avoid: Use Card for content that needs its own boundary; use PageHeader for a page's name and page-level actions.
Do not add a section whose title names nothing.
Keep one or two small actions at the right end; use Toolbar for a persistent group of actions.
composition: Space sections with Stack gap="section"; place a Separator between two Sections when a line is wanted.
Use Link or Button variant="quiet" size="sm" for the right-hand action.
Write a count as a numeric text-muted-foreground run inside the title.

library: The naming link between title and section, and the row height and midline of the title row.
application: The title, what a count means, the heading level and the real target of the action.

responsive: The title and actions share a row; when the title is too long the actions drop to the next row and the first row's midline stays.
customization: className, style, render and ref belong to each part; change the heading level with SectionTitle's level, never its size.

api.name: Section
api.description: 默认 section；内部有 SectionTitle 时自动用它的 id 作 aria-labelledby。
api.descriptionEn: A section by default; when it holds a SectionTitle, that title's id becomes aria-labelledby.

props.name: render / ref / children / native props
props.description: 显式传入 aria-label 或 aria-labelledby 时不再自动关联。
props.descriptionEn: An explicit aria-label or aria-labelledby disables the automatic link.

api.name: SectionHeader
api.description: 标题栏一行：标题在左，操作在右。
api.descriptionEn: The title row: title at the left, actions at the right.

props.name: render / ref / children / native props
props.description: 行高恒为一个小号控件高，与 ChartHeader 同一规则。
props.descriptionEn: Row height is always one small control, the same rule as ChartHeader.

api.name: SectionTitle
api.description: 区块标题，复用 Heading。
api.descriptionEn: The section title, built on Heading.

props.name: level
props.description: 文档大纲层级，独立于文字档。
props.descriptionEn: Document outline level, independent of the text step.

props.name: id / render / ref / Heading props
props.description: 传入 id 时区块用它作关联；文字档默认 heading（16/24）。
props.descriptionEn: A given id is the one the section links to; the text step defaults to heading (16/24).

api.name: SectionActions
api.description: 靠行尾的操作。
api.descriptionEn: Actions at the end of the row.

props.name: render / ref / children / native props
props.description: 放 Link 或 Button variant="quiet" size="sm"。
props.descriptionEn: Hold a Link or a Button variant="quiet" size="sm".

notes: 区块之间的距离、分界线由调用方决定；区块自己不画线。
notesEn: The caller decides the distance and any line between sections; a section draws none.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 分段控件 SegmentedControl
metadata.description: 从并列的少量候选中输入一个值。
metadata.descriptionEn: Enter one value from a small set of visible segments.

api.name: SegmentedControl
api.description: radio 值输入；不拥有面板或选项清单。
api.descriptionEn: Radio value input without owning panels or an option inventory.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: 受控值或初始选择；不传初值保持未选择，0 与空字符串可以是真实选项。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or initial selection; omitted initial values stay unselected. Zero and empty string may be actual options.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: 选择值，可取消。点击已选项不会取消到空状态。
props.descriptionEn: Cancelable selection; clicking a selected item does not clear it.

props.name: name / form / required / inputRef
props.description: 原生表单入口；required 不自动推断 invalid。
props.descriptionEn: Native form entry; required does not automatically infer invalid.

props.name: disabled / readOnly
props.description: 禁用退出操作；只读保持当前值和焦点。
props.descriptionEn: Disabled blocks operation; read-only retains the current value and focus.

props.name: size
props.description: 同档 control 与 text-control，由各项继承。
props.descriptionEn: Matching control/text-control profiles inherited by items.

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby / render / ref / className / style
props.description: 组的名称、部位与状态样式入口。
props.descriptionEn: Group names, parts, and state styling.

api.name: SegmentedControlItem
api.description: 带完整名称的 radio 候选。
api.descriptionEn: A radio candidate with its full name.

props.name: value
props.description: 候选的真实值，必填。
props.descriptionEn: The candidate's actual required value.

props.name: children / disabled / readOnly / size / render / nativeButton / ref
props.description: 默认原生 button；改变元素时说明 nativeButton，保留 ARIA 和原生事件。
props.descriptionEn: Native button by default; identify nativeButton for another element while retaining ARIA and native events.

api.name: SegmentedControlPrimitive / SegmentedControlItemPrimitive
api.description: Base UI RadioGroup 与 Radio 原语公共出口。
api.descriptionEn: Public Base UI RadioGroup and Radio primitives.

keyboard.description: 在组内保留一个停靠点。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Retain one tab stop within the group.

keyboard.description: 移动并选择候选，跳过禁用项。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move and select candidates, skipping disabled items.

keyboard.description: 选择当前项；Home/End 不属于 Radio 原语契约。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Select the current item; Home/End are outside the Radio primitive contract.

notes: 放在 Field 内时，整组的名称、描述与错误落在 radiogroup；每一段自己开标签作用域，id 各不相同，名称仍是段内文字，不会被 Field 的标签接管。
方向键遵循书写方向：UILocaleProvider 的 dir 为 rtl 时，→ 移向前一段。
notesEn: Inside a Field, the group's name, description, and error land on the radiogroup. Each segment opens its own label scope, so ids are distinct and its name stays the segment text instead of being taken over by the Field label.
Arrow keys follow writing direction: with UILocaleProvider dir="rtl", → moves to the previous segment.
metadata.decisions: SegmentedControl 产生一个新值。切换内容面板用 Tabs；允许全部取消的工具切换用 ToggleGroup。选中段是选中面（清染）加焦墨字，不用主操作的填充，所以品牌覆写 --qy-primary 不会改变它；要调整，改系统的选中面 --qy-surface-selected（全库的选中一起变；--qy-track-selected 只是它的别名）与 --qy-track-selected-foreground。
metadata.decisionsEn: SegmentedControl produces a value. Use Tabs for content panels and ToggleGroup for tools whose toggles may all be released. The selected segment is a light ink wash with ink text, not the primary action fill, so overriding --qy-primary does not change it. To adjust it, change the system selected surface --qy-surface-selected (every selected state follows; --qy-track-selected is only its alias) and --qy-track-selected-foreground.

whenToUse: 少量可并列比较的互斥值
avoid: 面板视角用 Tabs
候选较长或可收起用 Select
独立二态使用 Toggle
composition: FieldTitle 命名组；FieldDescription/FieldError 关联输入；候选 children 是名称

library: 非受控值、焦点、方向键
application: 受控值、候选、invalid、提交

responsive: 保留全部候选并允许换行；五档窄屏尺寸不改变语义
customization: 选中段读 --qy-track-selected 与 --qy-track-selected-foreground（默认清染 + 焦墨），未选段字为浓墨；与同档文字；不新增外围焦点圈

whenToUse: A few mutually exclusive values benefit from side-by-side comparison.
avoid: Use Tabs for panel views.
Use Select for longer or collapsible candidates.
Use Toggle for independent pressed states.
composition: FieldTitle names the group; FieldDescription/FieldError associate with the input; candidate children supply names.

library: Uncontrolled values, focus, and arrows.
application: Controlled values, candidates, invalid facts, and submission.

responsive: Retain all candidates and permit wrapping; five narrow-screen profiles preserve semantics.
customization: The selected segment reads --qy-track-selected and --qy-track-selected-foreground (light ink wash and ink text by default); unselected segments use muted ink; matching text, no outer focus ring.
