metadata.title: 选择器 Select
metadata.description: 从可收起的候选列表中取一个值。
metadata.descriptionEn: Choose one value from a collapsible set of options.

api.name: Select
api.description: 单值状态与表单语义。
api.descriptionEn: Single-value state and form semantics.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: 受控值或真实初值，null 是未选择。省略初值不会选第一项。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or actual initial value; null means no selection. Omitting an initial value does not choose the first item.

props.name: items
props.description: 值到名称的映射；显式空字符串候选也要提供可读 label。触发器宽度由其中最长的名称决定，选另一项时不会伸缩。
props.descriptionEn: Value-to-name mapping; an explicit empty-string candidate also needs a readable label. The trigger is as wide as the longest name, so choosing another item does not resize it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: 选择变化，可取消；不因高亮移动而改变值。
props.descriptionEn: Cancelable selection change; moving the highlight does not change the value.

props.name: name / form / inputRef / autoComplete
props.description: 保留原语隐藏输入、表单与自动填充入口。
props.descriptionEn: Retain primitive hidden inputs, form ownership, and autofill.

props.name: disabled / readOnly / required
props.description: 交互限制与原生约束；invalid 由 Field 或触发器显式 ARIA 声明。
props.descriptionEn: Interaction limits and native constraints; Field or explicit trigger ARIA declares invalid.

props.name: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: 受控或非受控展开，取消返回与选择值分开。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or uncontrolled opening; canceled return is separate from value selection.

props.name: loading
props.description: 应用正在取候选的事实：触发器与列表标 aria-busy，候选面显示等待记号与「正在加载」，不显示「没有可选项」。组件不发请求。
props.descriptionEn: The fact that the application is fetching candidates: trigger and list get aria-busy, the popup shows a wait marker and "Loading", and never "No options". The component sends no request.

props.name: error
props.description: 取候选失败时由应用给出的内容，可含说明与重试动作；候选面以 role="alert" 摆放。组件不推断失败，也不写原因。
props.descriptionEn: Application-supplied content when fetching failed, including an explanation and a retry action; the popup places it as role="alert". The component infers no failure and writes no reason.

props.name: modal
props.description: 默认允许其余字段交互；可按承载任务显式改变。
props.descriptionEn: Other fields remain interactive by default; change explicitly for the containing task.

props.name: itemToStringLabel / itemToStringValue / isItemEqualToValue
props.description: 对象候选的名称、序列化与相等关系。
props.descriptionEn: Names, serialization, and equality for object candidates.

api.name: SelectTrigger
api.description: 有边框的选择入口，与 Input 同档。
api.descriptionEn: A bordered selection entry matching Input's profile.

props.name: children
props.description: 省略时提供 SelectValue；内含展开图标。
props.descriptionEn: Defaults to SelectValue with a disclosure icon.

props.name: render / ref / className / style / ARIA
props.description: 保留真实触发器的事件、名称和样式入口。
props.descriptionEn: Retain actual trigger events, names, and styling entries.

api.name: SelectValue
api.description: 真实当前值名称与未选择占位。
api.descriptionEn: The actual current value name and no-selection placeholder.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: 仅未选择显示；不能替代 FieldLabel。
props.descriptionEn: Shown only without selection; cannot replace FieldLabel.

props.name: children
props.description: 显式值表达优先。
props.descriptionEn: Explicit value presentation takes precedence.

api.name: SelectPopup
api.description: Portal、定位、面板与可滚动 List 的共同组合。
api.descriptionEn: Shared composition of Portal, positioning, panel, and scrollable List.

props.name: side / align / sideOffset / alignOffset
props.description: 默认贴锚点，不覆盖触发器；由原语处理空间碰撞。
props.descriptionEn: Anchored by default without covering the trigger; the primitive handles space collisions.

props.name: emptyContent
props.description: 没有子项时的说法；候选来自查询时，说明查询对象。加载与失败时不显示。
props.descriptionEn: Wording when there are no children; for query-backed candidates, name the query. Not shown while loading or after failure.

props.name: alignItemWithTrigger
props.description: 显式选择是否以选中项对齐并覆盖触发器。
props.descriptionEn: Explicitly choose selected-item alignment that covers the trigger.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal 容器；局部主题、语言或密度需由调用方提供正确继承环境。
props.descriptionEn: Portal container; callers supply an appropriate inheritance environment for local themes, language, or density.

props.name: positionerProps
props.description: 自身公开定位层的 ref/render/事件/样式透传；调用方 style 最后合并。
props.descriptionEn: Forward its own public positioning refs/render/events/styles; caller style merges last.

props.name: finalFocus / render / ref / className / style
props.description: 默认取消回到触发器；入退场由 motion.css 拥有。
props.descriptionEn: Cancellation returns to the trigger by default; motion.css owns entry/exit.

api.name: SelectItem
api.description: 值候选；高亮表位置，勾标表选中。
api.descriptionEn: Value candidate; highlight marks position and a check marks selection.

props.name: value / label / disabled
props.description: 值、类型搜索名称、禁用事实。禁用项可高亮供辨认，但不能选取。
props.descriptionEn: Value, typeahead name, and disabled facts. Disabled items can be highlighted for identification without being selected.

props.name: children / render / ref / className / style
props.description: 名称内容自动进入 ItemText，选中勾标单独呈现。
props.descriptionEn: Name content enters ItemText automatically; the selection check is separate.

api.name: SelectGroup / SelectGroupLabel
api.description: 语义分组与组名称；组名画法与 ComboboxGroupLabel、AutocompleteGroupLabel 同一来源。
api.descriptionEn: Semantic grouping and group names; the label is drawn from the same source as ComboboxGroupLabel and AutocompleteGroupLabel.

api.name: SelectPrimitive
api.description: 完整 Base UI Select 原语出口；公共 Select 接口始终为单值。
api.descriptionEn: The complete public Base UI Select primitive; public Select remains single-value.

keyboard.description: 进入触发器。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach the trigger.

keyboard.description: 打开候选；展开后方向键移动高亮，Enter/Space 选择。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Open candidates; arrows move the highlight while open and Enter/Space select.

keyboard.description: 展开时移动到首/尾候选。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach the first/last candidate while open.

keyboard.description: 类型搜索；展开时高亮匹配项，关闭时原语可直接选择匹配值。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Typeahead highlights matches while open; the closed primitive may select a matching value directly.

keyboard.description: 关闭并回到触发器，保留原值。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Close and return to the trigger, retaining the original value.

notes: FieldLabel 命名触发器，FieldError 关联错误；SelectGroupLabel 命名候选分组。
null 是未选择，空字符串（""）和 0 都是合法的候选值。选了值为 "" 的候选，触发器显示它的 label，不显示占位，data-placeholder 也不出现；null 才显示占位。用 "" 表示「不限」「无」这类真实选项时，要在 items 里给它可读的 label。注意原生表单会把 null 与 "" 都序列化为空字符串，服务端需要区分时用别的值，或在应用侧另存选择与否。
只读保留当前值并在触发器上给出「只读」说明，禁用项不能选取。
触发器默认不拉满容器；要拉满时给 SelectTrigger className="w-full"。没有 items 时无法预知候选名称，宽度只随当前显示的内容。
候选来自请求时：用 loading 表示请求中，用 error 放入失败说明与重试动作；没有子项且二者皆无才显示「没有可选项」。
自身 Positioner 消费共享 popup 层级，父工作面内候选高于该工作面；positionerProps 保留调用方 style/ref/render。
notesEn: FieldLabel names the trigger, FieldError associates errors, and SelectGroupLabel names candidate groups.

null is no selection; the empty string ("") and zero are both valid candidate values. Selecting a candidate whose value is "" shows its label in the trigger, not the placeholder, and data-placeholder is absent; only null shows the placeholder. When "" stands for a real option such as "Any" or "None", give it a readable label in items. Native forms serialize both null and "" as an empty string; when the server must tell them apart, use another value or keep the has-chosen fact in the application.
Read-only retains the current value and shows a read-only note on the trigger; disabled candidates cannot be selected.
The trigger does not fill its container by default; pass className="w-full" to SelectTrigger to do so. Without items the candidate names are unknown, so the width follows only what is displayed.
For request-backed candidates, use loading while the request runs and error for the failure explanation and retry action; "No options" appears only with no children and neither state.
Its Positioner consumes shared popup layers; candidates inside a parent workspace sit above it. positionerProps retain caller styles/refs/render.
metadata.decisions: 高亮表示当前位置，选取才改变值。未选择不会自动变为第一项；需要并置比较时用 RadioGroup。
metadata.decisionsEn: Highlight marks position; selection changes the value. No selection does not choose the first item automatically. Use RadioGroup for side-by-side comparison.

whenToUse: 已知单值候选，平时只需辨认当前选择
avoid: 需要并置比较的少量候选用 RadioGroup
大量候选需过滤时用 Combobox
命令用 Menu，视角用 Tabs
关键原生选择行为用 NativeSelect
composition: FieldLabel + Select + FieldDescription + FieldError；SelectGroup 提供候选分组

library: 焦点、展开、高亮、非受控值
application: 受控值、候选、invalid、加载/失败/未知与保存事实

responsive: 组件保留 -narrow 与粗指针角色；本批只做桌面检查
customization: 同档文字和控件尺寸、bordered padding、角色颜色、Portal container

whenToUse: Known single-value candidates whose current choice usually suffices.
avoid: Use RadioGroup for small sets needing side-by-side comparison.
Use Combobox when many candidates need filtering.
Use Menu for commands and Tabs for views.
Use NativeSelect for essential native picker behavior.
composition: FieldLabel + Select + FieldDescription + FieldError; SelectGroup groups candidates.

library: Focus, opening, highlight, and uncontrolled values.
application: Controlled values, candidates, invalid facts, loading/failure/unknown states, and save facts.

responsive: Retains -narrow and coarse-pointer roles; this batch checked desktop only.
customization: Matching text/control dimensions, bordered padding, role colors, and Portal containers.

metadata.title: 分隔线 Separator
metadata.description: 在已有内容组之间表达分界，可选择语义分隔或装饰线。
metadata.descriptionEn: Express a boundary between content groups as a semantic separator or decorative line.
metadata.decisions: 标题与间距足够表达关系时不加线。Separator 没有拖动、按钮或面板调整行为。
metadata.decisionsEn: Omit a line when headings and spacing already express the relation. Separator has no drag, button, or panel-resizing behavior.

whenToUse: 两组内容确需可辨认分界。
avoid: 每两行画线；把静态分界当拖动入口。
composition: 标题说明内容范围；有文字的 FieldSeparator 使用装饰线避免重复语义。

library: Base UI 分隔原语、方向、装饰选择。
application: 分界位置与辅助技术是否需要感知。

responsive: 长轴跟随容器；竖线依实际行布局拉伸。
customization: 强边界颜色与 1px 线条为表达预设；className 最后合并，render 与原生属性透传。

whenToUse: Two content groups need a discernible boundary.
avoid: Lines between every pair of rows or static boundaries impersonating drag entries.
composition: Headings explain scope; text FieldSeparator uses decorative lines to avoid repeated semantics.

library: Base UI separator primitive, orientation, and decorative choice.
application: Boundary placement and whether assistive technology needs it.

responsive: The long axis follows its container; vertical lines stretch with actual row layout.
customization: Strong boundary color and 1px lines are presets. External classes merge last; render/native props forward.

api.name: Separator
api.description: 基于 Base UI Separator；默认 role=separator。
api.descriptionEn: Based on Base UI Separator; role=separator by default.

props.name: orientation
props.description: 横向跨容器；纵向在 flex 行里拉伸。
props.descriptionEn: Horizontal spans the container; vertical stretches in a flex row.

props.name: decorative
props.description: true 时 role=presentation 且 aria-hidden=true。
props.descriptionEn: When true, uses role=presentation and aria-hidden=true.

props.name: className / style / render / ref
props.description: 作用于分界本身；样式支持方向状态函数。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the separator; styles support orientation state functions.

api.name: SeparatorPrimitive
api.description: Base UI 原语出口。
api.descriptionEn: Base UI primitive outlet.

keyboard.description: 静态分隔不进入键盘焦点顺序。
keyboard.descriptionEn: A static separator does not enter the tab order.

notes: 装饰线不承担辅助技术语义。需要拖动改变尺寸时使用具有调整行为的控件。
必要非文本边界与真实承载面的对比至少 3:1；图片与未知承载面另行验证。
notesEn: Decorative lines carry no assistive-technology semantics. Use a control with resize behavior when dragging must change dimensions.
Necessary non-text boundaries need at least 3:1 contrast against the real carrier. Images and unknown carriers need separate checks.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 级别 SeverityMark
metadata.description: 用填了几格表达有次序的级别，名称由应用给出。
metadata.descriptionEn: An ordered level shown as a number of filled cells, named by the application.
metadata.decisions: 级别由填充的格数承担，tone 只是附带的类别：两个级别如果格数相同、只有色相不同，隐藏名称后就分不开，所以不同的级别要用不同的 level。库不内置任何级别用词，也不从数字推断名称；label 必填。没有级别时不放这个标记，level 没有 0。
metadata.decisionsEn: The level is carried by the number of filled cells and tone is only an accompanying category: two levels with the same cell count and different hues cannot be told apart once the name is hidden, so different levels take different level values. The library ships no level words and infers no name from the number; label is required. With no level, omit the mark: level has no 0.

whenToUse: 一行对象带有一个有次序的级别，需要不占一列文字就能比较高低。
avoid: 对象处于哪一种状态用 StatusDot：状态之间没有次序。
有单位的测量值用 Meter；任务完成比例用 Progress。
不用色相区分格数相同的两个级别。
composition: 同一列里的标记用同一个 max。
name="hidden" 时名称仍是可访问名称；同一行或表头要有文字让看得见的读者知道这一列是级别。
与 StatusDot 同行时两种标记同高、同一条行中线。

library: 格数与填充的对应、图形语义与可访问名称。
application: 级别的数值、一共几级、每一级的名称与类别。

responsive: 名称跟随所在那一行的字号，过长时换行；格不缩小。
customization: 使用公开 render/ref、ARIA、事件与样式；不混用主题三轴。

whenToUse: A row's object has an ordered level that must be comparable without spending a text column.
avoid: Use StatusDot for which state an object is in: states have no order.
Use Meter for a measurement with a unit and Progress for task completion.
Do not tell two levels with the same cell count apart by hue.
composition: Marks in one column share one max.
With name="hidden" the name remains the accessible name; the row or the column header must still tell sighted readers that the column is a level.
Beside a StatusDot both marks have the same height and share one row midline.

library: The mapping from level to filled cells, the image semantics and the accessible name.
application: The level value, the number of levels, and each level's name and category.

responsive: The name follows the text size of its row and wraps when long; cells do not shrink.
customization: Public render/refs, ARIA, events, and styles; keep theme axes independent.

api.name: SeverityMark
api.description: 一排格加一个名称；根是 role="img"，可访问名称就是 label。
api.descriptionEn: A row of cells and a name; the root is role="img" and its accessible name is label.

props.name: level
props.description: 第几级：填满的格数，1 到 max 的整数，必填。越界或非整数抛 RangeError，不取整。根上带 data-level。
props.descriptionEn: Required level: the number of filled cells, an integer from 1 to max. Out-of-range or non-integer values throw RangeError and are never rounded. The root carries data-level.

props.name: max
props.description: 一共几级：格的总数，2 到 5 的整数；否则抛 RangeError。未填的格保留为空格。
props.descriptionEn: The number of levels: total cells, an integer from 2 to 5; otherwise RangeError is thrown. Unfilled cells stay as empty cells.

props.name: tone
props.description: 已填格的状态类别，由调用方声明，组件不从级别猜好坏；根上带 data-tone。不给时用焦墨。非法值抛 RangeError。
props.descriptionEn: The status category of the filled cells, declared by the caller; the component does not guess good or bad from the level. The root carries data-tone. Omitted, the ink color is used. An invalid value throws RangeError.

props.name: label
props.description: 这一级的名称，必填；缺失或为空时抛错。它是可访问名称，也是可见名称。
props.descriptionEn: Required name of the level; a missing or blank value throws. It is the accessible name and the visible name.

props.name: name
props.description: hidden 时画面上只剩格，label 仍是可访问名称。
props.descriptionEn: With hidden only the cells remain on screen; label is still the accessible name.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 属性、事件与ref透传实际元素；样式由className/style调整。
props.descriptionEn: Forward attributes, events, and refs to the actual element; adjust presentation through className/style.

notes: 读屏只读一次名称：格与可见名称都不进可访问树。
级别不只靠颜色：去掉色相后，已填的实心格与未填的空格仍读得出第几级。
强制颜色下已填的格是 CanvasText 实心，未填的格是一圈线；tone 的色相收成同一色。
notesEn: A screen reader reads the name once: the cells and the visible name stay out of the accessibility tree.
The level does not rely on color: without hue, solid filled cells and outlined empty cells still give the level.
In forced colors filled cells are solid CanvasText and empty cells are an outline; tone hues collapse to one color.

metadata.title: 侧栏导航 Sidebar
metadata.description: 长期导航、收起为图标 rail 与二级子级。
metadata.descriptionEn: Persistent navigation, an icon rail when collapsed, and an expandable sub-level.
metadata.decisions: 收起是图标 rail，不是隐藏：导航与链接保持挂载，名称切到视觉隐藏（可访问名称不变），用 Tooltip 补足可见名称；二级子级展开态用内嵌面板，rail 态换成同一组内容的 Popover，开合记忆不因侧栏收起而改变。active 与路由由应用明确提供。
metadata.decisionsEn: Collapsing produces an icon rail, not a hidden panel: navigation and links stay mounted, names switch to visually hidden (accessible name unchanged) with a Tooltip restoring a visible name; a sub-level's inline panel becomes a Popover over the same content in the rail, and its open/closed memory survives collapsing. Active and routes are explicit application facts.

api.name: Sidebar / SidebarToggle
api.description: 侧栏容器（不产生地标，导航地标由内部的 nav 给出）与可逆开关。
api.descriptionEn: The sidebar container (no landmark of its own; the inner nav is the landmark) and a reversible toggle.

props.name: collapsed / defaultCollapsed / onCollapsedChange
props.description: 默认展开；details.cancel() 拒绝变化。
props.descriptionEn: Expanded by default; details.cancel() rejects a change.

props.name: drawer / drawerHandle
props.description: 窄屏（< 40rem）把侧栏收进从起始侧滑出的抽屉，由 SidebarDrawerTrigger 打开；更宽时仍在原位。抽屉里是同一份 children：当前项照常标出，点去往新页面的条目后关闭，SidebarToggle 换成关闭按钮。在 Workspace 里 handle 由外壳持有，省略 drawerHandle；不在 Workspace 里时用 DrawerCreateHandle() 创建并同时交给 Sidebar 与 SidebarDrawerTrigger。两者都没有会抛错。
props.descriptionEn: Below 40rem the sidebar moves into a drawer that slides in from the inline start, opened by SidebarDrawerTrigger; at wider widths it stays in place. The drawer holds the same children: the current item is marked as usual, navigating closes it, and SidebarToggle becomes a close button. Inside a Workspace the shell holds the handle, so omit drawerHandle; outside one, create it with DrawerCreateHandle() and give it to both Sidebar and SidebarDrawerTrigger. Missing both throws.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: SidebarDrawerTrigger
api.description: 窄屏打开侧栏抽屉的图标按钮，名称「打开工作区导航」。放在 Workspace 里任何位置（通常是 WorkspaceHeader 的第一项）；宽屏隐去，不占位也不进 Tab 顺序。
api.descriptionEn: The icon button that opens the sidebar drawer on narrow screens, named "Open workspace navigation". Place it anywhere inside a Workspace (usually first in WorkspaceHeader); it is hidden at wide widths and leaves neither space nor a Tab stop.

props.name: handle
props.description: 不在 Workspace 里时，与 Sidebar 的 drawerHandle 相同。
props.descriptionEn: Outside a Workspace, the same handle as Sidebar's drawerHandle.

props.name: render / native props
props.description: 默认渲染为 quiet 图标按钮；aria-expanded 由抽屉给出。
props.descriptionEn: Renders as a quiet icon button by default; aria-expanded comes from the drawer.

api.name: SidebarHeader / SidebarTitle
api.description: 第一行：身份在前，SidebarToggle 在后。收起为 rail 时上下叠放并居中，名称留给辅助技术。
api.descriptionEn: The first row: identity first, SidebarToggle last. In the rail they stack and centre, and the title stays for assistive technology.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: SidebarFooter
api.description: 末位槽，贴列底；放本人或账户入口。
api.descriptionEn: The end slot, pinned to the bottom of the column; holds the account entry.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: SidebarContent / SidebarGroup / SidebarGroupLabel
api.description: 原生 nav 与导航组。
api.descriptionEn: A native nav and navigation groups.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: SidebarLink
api.description: 真实页面链接。
api.descriptionEn: A real page link.

props.name: href / active
props.description: active 显式写 aria-current；焦点所在之处收起后真的不可达时，才会回退到 Toggle（例如焦点原本在一个二级子级里，侧栏收起换成 rail）。
props.descriptionEn: Active explicitly writes aria-current; focus only falls back to Toggle when its location truly becomes unreachable after collapsing (for example, focus was inside a sub-level that the rail replaces).

props.name: icon
props.description: 收起为 rail 时唯一可见的识别物；没有图标的条目收起后没有可展示的内容。名称（children）在 rail 下只是视觉隐藏（sr-only），可访问名称不变，并由 Tooltip 把名称重新摆给看得见的人。
props.descriptionEn: The only visible identifier in the rail; a link without an icon has nothing to show once collapsed. The name (children) is only visually hidden (sr-only) in the rail — the accessible name is unchanged, and a Tooltip restores a sighted label.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: SidebarSub / SidebarSubTrigger / SidebarSubContent
api.description: 可展开的二级目的地：展开态是内嵌面板，rail 态换成同一组链接的 Popover，悬停或聚焦都能打开。
api.descriptionEn: An expandable sub-level of destinations: an inline panel when expanded, and a Popover over the same links in the rail, reachable by hover or focus.

props.name: SidebarSub：open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: 展开态与 rail 态共用同一个开合状态；rail 下即使换成 Popover，用户的开合记忆也不因收起/展开侧栏而改变。
props.descriptionEn: The same open state serves both the expanded panel and the rail's Popover; the remembered open/closed state survives collapsing even though the rail swaps in a Popover.

props.name: SidebarSubTrigger：icon
props.description: 与 SidebarLink 的 icon 同一分工；rail 下按钮不再承担内嵌展开，只作为 Popover 入口，避免收起侧栏悄悄改变用户没点开过的展开记忆。
props.descriptionEn: Same split as SidebarLink's icon; in the rail the button no longer toggles the inline panel, only opening the Popover, so collapsing never silently changes an open state the user never chose.

notes: 展开宽度默认读 --qy-sidebar-width（两侧内缘 + 条目内缩 + 一枚图标 + 间隔 + 12 个汉字的标签容量；12 字是预设），调用方的 w-* 仍可覆盖；收起宽度由库按一个填值控件高加两侧内缩给出，始终保留可见 Toggle。
当前项用圆角的面标出，比悬停面深一级，并加中等字重：悬停是一级清染，当前是一级清墨，指针经过的行不会和当前项长得一样；字重是不靠颜色的第二信号。当前项不画线（用户裁决：直线与圆角面不在同一项上并用）；二级条目左侧的引导线只表达归属，当前项不加深它。
二级入口的展开记号收起时朝内、展开时朝下，与 Tree 的分支同一画法；父项没有图标时，引导线从父项文字的起笔垂下。
当前项是选中面（--qy-sidebar-current = --qy-surface-selected）：墨的透明叠合，叠在侧栏自己的底上总深一级，项目改 --qy-sidebar 时不必另设。
末位的账户入口不另设部件：MenuTrigger 的 render 交给 SidebarLink，SidebarLink 再 render 为 button（icon 放 Avatar，名称写在 MenuTrigger 的 children）。名称是按钮的可访问名称，所以 Avatar 加 aria-hidden；收起时只剩头像，名称由 Tooltip 摆出。
收起的窄轨里，二级子级与条目名称的浮层朝内联结束侧（inline-end）打开：ltr 在右，rtl 在左；窄轨二级入口与展开态一样把传入的 aria-*、data-*、事件交给触发元素。侧栏本身贴哪一边由应用的布局决定，切换按钮的图标在 rtl 下水平镜像。
侧栏最多两级（SidebarSub 下一层），第三级不进侧栏：在 SidebarSub 里再放 SidebarSub 会在开发期直接抛错（与本库其他结构契约一致，而不是悄悄多缩进一层）。第三级放在内容区，用 Tabs 或页内次级导航承载，必要时用 Breadcrumb 交代位置。见「二级导航与内容区 Tabs」。
带 SidebarGroupLabel 的 SidebarGroup 成为 role=group，名称取自标签；没有标签的分组只是排布。调用方自己给 aria-label 或 aria-labelledby 时以调用方为准。
窄屏用 drawer：同一份 children 在窄屏进入抽屉，由 SidebarDrawerTrigger 打开；抽屉里当前项照常标出，点去往新页面的条目（含客户端路由里 preventDefault 的链接）后关闭，不关的是带 aria-haspopup 的条目（如账户菜单）。服务端渲染按「够宽」输出，窄屏客户端挂载后换成抽屉。见「窄屏：抽屉承载侧栏」。
notesEn: The expanded width defaults to --qy-sidebar-width (side insets + item padding + one icon + the gap + room for a 12-character label; 12 is a preset), and a caller's w-* still overrides it; the collapsed rail's width is one fill control height plus insets on both sides, and a visible Toggle is always available.

The current item is marked by a rounded surface one step deeper than the hover surface, plus medium weight: hover is one wash step, current is one ink step, so a row under the pointer never looks like the current one, and the weight is a second cue that does not rely on colour. The current item carries no line (user ruling: a straight line and a rounded surface are never combined on one item); the guide line beside a sub-level only expresses membership and the current item does not deepen it.
The sub-level chevron points inward when closed and down when open, the same mark as a Tree branch; when the parent has no icon, the guide line drops from the start of its text.

The current item uses the selected surface (--qy-sidebar-current = --qy-surface-selected): a translucent ink wash that always sits one step darker than the sidebar's own ground, so a project that changes --qy-sidebar need not set it.

The account entry at the end needs no part of its own: MenuTrigger renders a SidebarLink, and the SidebarLink renders a button (an Avatar as icon, the name as the MenuTrigger's children). The name is the button's accessible name, so the Avatar is aria-hidden; in the rail only the avatar remains and a Tooltip restores the name.

In the collapsed rail, the sub-level and item-name overlays open toward the inline end: right in ltr, left in rtl. The rail's sub-level entry forwards passed aria-*, data-*, and events to its trigger just as the expanded one does. The application's layout decides which edge the sidebar sits on; the toggle icon mirrors horizontally in rtl.

A sidebar has at most two levels (one under SidebarSub); the third level does not go in the sidebar. A SidebarSub inside another SidebarSub throws during development (matching the library's other structural contracts, rather than quietly indenting one more level). Put the third level in the content area, carried by Tabs or an in-page secondary nav, with a Breadcrumb to say where you are. See "Sub-level navigation with Tabs in the content".
A SidebarGroup with a SidebarGroupLabel is a role=group named by that label; a group without one is only layout. A caller's aria-label or aria-labelledby takes precedence.

Narrow screens use drawer: the same children move into a drawer opened by SidebarDrawerTrigger; the current item is marked there as usual, and activating an item that goes to a new page (including client-router links that preventDefault) closes it, except items with aria-haspopup (such as an account menu). Server rendering outputs the wide form and a narrow client swaps in the drawer after mounting. See "Narrow screens: a drawer carries the sidebar".

whenToUse: 工作面旁的长期导航。
avoid: 不内置业务目录；第三级导航不进侧栏，放在内容区的 Tabs。

library: 收起、nav 语义与焦点返回。
application: 真实目的地、active 和布局宽度。

responsive: 宽屏侧栏在原位，可收起为图标 rail；窄屏（< 40rem）用 drawer 收进抽屉，由 WorkspaceHeader 里的 SidebarDrawerTrigger 打开。
customization: 控件档案、间距和浮层表面消费现有角色；具体外观是预设。

whenToUse: Persistent navigation beside a workspace.
avoid: No built-in business directory; third-level navigation goes in content-area Tabs, not the sidebar.

library: Collapsing, nav semantics, and focus return.
application: Actual destinations, active state, and layout width.

responsive: Keep actual desktop structure; menus fit available space and tables retain complete comparison columns.
customization: Control profiles, spacing, and popup surfaces consume existing roles; their appearance is a preset.

metadata.title: 骨架屏 Skeleton
metadata.description: 内容到达之前，先摆出它将占的位置与行数。
metadata.descriptionEn: Hold the place and row count content will take until it arrives.
metadata.decisions: 骨架只表达「正在加载」，不表达进度，也不替应用决定何时结束，更不自行超时；到达、失败或为空时换成真内容或 Empty，不让占位一直留着。正文行高是一材，一行骨架占一材、行间不留缝，所以 N 行骨架恰是 N 行正文，内容到达版面不动。填充是清染（大面）与清墨（小条）的透明墨，不脉动：等待没有「变化」可说，循环明灭只是装饰。
metadata.decisionsEn: A skeleton says only that content is loading; it carries no progress, does not decide when loading ends, and never times out by itself. On arrival, failure or an empty result it is replaced by the real content or Empty, never left in place. Body leading is one module, so a skeleton row takes one module with no gap between rows: N rows are exactly N lines of text and the page does not move on arrival. Fills are transparent ink (a faint wash for large areas, a faint ink for small bars) and do not pulse: waiting has no change to report, and a looping fade is decoration.

whenToUse: 首次加载的内容区域，形状已知、几行几块可预期。
avoid: 刷新时保留仍然有效的工作面，不退回骨架；等待由发起它的 Button（loading）与一条 Progress 表达，二者共用一个等待周期。
加载失败或结果为空时改用 Empty，不让占位冒充内容。
不确定形状或时间极短的等待，用按钮的 loading。
composition: Skeleton 包住一组 SkeletonLine / SkeletonBlock，摆成真实内容的版式；到达后整体换掉，版面不跳。

library: 一句名称（跟随语言）、形状对辅助技术隐藏、以材为度的行高与墨色。
application: 何时开始与结束、久等的处置、内容的真实形状、失败与为空的处置。

responsive: 宽度由所在容器决定，行宽用 className 表达；行高固定为一材。
customization: className 调整行宽与块高；label 写明对象，如「正在加载成员」。

whenToUse: The first load of a region whose shape is known: how many rows and blocks to expect.
avoid: Refreshing keeps the content that is still valid and does not fall back to a skeleton; the wait is shown on the Button that started it (loading) and on a Progress band, both of which share one wait period.
A failed or empty result uses Empty; a placeholder never stands in for content.
A wait of unknown shape or very short duration uses a Button's loading.
composition: Skeleton wraps SkeletonLine / SkeletonBlock laid out like the real content; on arrival the whole is replaced and the page does not jump.

library: One localized name, shapes hidden from assistive technology, row height and ink derived from the module.
application: When loading starts and ends, how a long wait is handled, the real shape of the content, and how failure and emptiness are handled.

responsive: Width follows the container; express row width with className. Row height is one module.
customization: className adjusts row width and block height; label names the object, e.g. “Loading members”.

api.name: Skeleton
api.description: 外层 status，内含一句名称；形状放在其中。
api.descriptionEn: The outer status, holding one name; shapes sit inside.

props.name: label
props.description: 替代默认的「正在加载」，写明对象。
props.descriptionEn: Replaces the default “Loading”, naming the object.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 属性、事件与 ref 透传实际元素；样式由 className/style 调整。
props.descriptionEn: Forward attributes, events and refs to the actual element; adjust presentation through className/style.

api.name: SkeletonLine
api.description: 一行文字的位置，占一材；宽度由 className 给出。
api.descriptionEn: The place of one text line, one module high; width comes from className.

props.name: className
props.description: 行宽，例如 w-2/3。
props.descriptionEn: Row width, e.g. w-2/3.

api.name: SkeletonBlock
api.description: 整块内容（图、图表、表格）的位置；高度由 className 给出。
api.descriptionEn: The place of a whole block (image, chart, table); height comes from className.

props.name: className
props.description: 块高，例如 h-40。
props.descriptionEn: Block height, e.g. h-40.

metadata.title: 滑块 Slider
metadata.description: 在明确区间内输入数值或有序范围。
metadata.descriptionEn: Enter a number or an ordered range within explicit bounds.

api.name: Slider
api.description: 数值与范围状态，公开各部位供组合。
api.descriptionEn: Value and range state with public parts for composition.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: 受控值或非受控初值；未传时从 min 开始。数组每项对应一个带 index 的 Thumb。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or uncontrolled initial value; omission starts at min. Each array entry corresponds to an indexed Thumb.

props.name: min / max / step / largeStep
props.description: 有限 min<max，正步进；min 是步进原点，max 必须落在步进上。越界、非有限或未对齐的显式值抛 RangeError，不静默纠正。
props.descriptionEn: Finite min<max and positive steps; min is the origin and max must align. Explicit out-of-range, nonfinite, or misaligned values throw RangeError without silent correction.

props.name: minStepsBetweenValues / thumbCollisionBehavior
props.description: 有序范围的最小间距和指针碰撞策略；显式数组必须满足间距。
props.descriptionEn: Minimum separation and pointer collision strategy for an ordered range; explicit arrays must satisfy spacing.

props.name: onValueChange / onValueCommitted
props.description: 即时值与本次操作提交；details.reason 对应 keyboard/drag/track-press/input-change，可取消变化。提交不等于持久化成功。
props.descriptionEn: Immediate changes and the current interaction's commit. details.reason identifies keyboard/drag/track-press/input-change; changes are cancelable. Commit does not establish successful persistence.

props.name: disabled / readOnly
props.description: 禁用不提交表单；只读保留名称、焦点、值和提交，取消所有原语变化。
props.descriptionEn: Disabled excludes form submission. Read-only retains names, focus, values, and submission while canceling primitive changes.

props.name: name / form
props.description: 表单名与外部 form；多个 Thumb 以同名字段重复序列化。
props.descriptionEn: Form name and external form; multiple Thumbs serialize repeated fields under the same name.

props.name: orientation / thumbAlignment
props.description: 工作高度跟随填值控件的一套几何；抓手跟随标签文字，密度不改它。edge 让端点位于工作范围内。
props.descriptionEn: The working height follows the one fill-control geometry; the thumb follows its label text and is untouched by density. edge keeps endpoints within the workspace.

props.name: format / locale / render / ref / className / style
props.description: 数值格式、语言、根部位和原语状态样式；主题轴独立。
props.descriptionEn: Number formatting, locale, root composition, and primitive state styles; theme axes remain independent.

api.name: SliderControl / SliderTrack / SliderIndicator
api.description: 交互工作区、完整范围与实际输入区间。
api.descriptionEn: Interactive workspace, complete range, and actual input interval.

props.name: render / ref / className / style
props.description: 各部位透传 ARIA、data 与原生事件；轨道厚度读 slider-track-size，纵向工作长度读 slider-vertical-length。
props.descriptionEn: Parts forward ARIA, data, and native events. Track thickness reads slider-track-size and vertical extent reads slider-vertical-length.

api.name: SliderThumb
api.description: 可拖动部位，包含真实 range input。
api.descriptionEn: Draggable part containing an actual range input.

props.name: index / aria-label / getAriaLabel
props.description: 区间每个 Thumb 指定 index，并给出能区分上下限的名称。
props.descriptionEn: Specify each range Thumb's index and a name distinguishing its lower/upper meaning.

props.name: getAriaValueText / aria-valuetext / inputRef
props.description: 默认读屏值是格式化数值，不添加英语上下限文案。可传单位与读屏值；inputRef、onKeyDown/onFocus/onBlur 对应真实 input。
props.descriptionEn: The default accessible value is a formatted number without added English bound labels. Supply units/value text as needed; inputRef and onKeyDown/onFocus/onBlur target the actual input.

props.name: disabled / render / ref / className / style
props.description: 单项禁用与公开部位组合；readOnly 和 Field invalid 接到真实 input 的 ARIA。
props.descriptionEn: Per-item disabling and public composition; readOnly and Field invalid reach actual input ARIA.

api.name: SliderLabel / SliderValue
api.description: 关联所有 Thumb 的名称与实际数值 output。Value 的 children 接收 formattedValues/values。
api.descriptionEn: Names associated with all Thumbs and actual numeric output. Value children receives formattedValues/values.

api.name: SliderPrimitive
api.description: Base UI Slider 原语命名空间。
api.descriptionEn: Base UI Slider primitive namespace.

keyboard.description: 依次到达可用滑块。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach available thumbs in sequence.

keyboard.description: 按 step 改值；方向与 orientation/RTL 一致。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Change by step, respecting orientation/RTL.

keyboard.description: 到达允许的起止端点。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach permitted starting/ending bounds.

keyboard.description: 按 largeStep 改值，受区间与相邻值约束。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Change by largeStep within range and neighboring-value constraints.

notes: 无效由 Field 或 SliderThumb 的 aria-invalid 声明：已填充段与抓手改为危险填充色，值不变。只读时在滑块下方给出「只读」说明。
必须给 SliderLabel 或每个 Thumb 的名称，多滑块名称需要区分。
原语交互按步进吸附；显式无效值会抛 RangeError。
4px 轨道厚度和 10rem 纵向长度是集中预设，修改 tokens/components.css 或项目主题；浏览器对比与几何仍需验收。
Field 内滑块旁放精确输入（NumberField）时，给它一个 FieldItem 并把名称写在 NumberFieldInput 上；Field 的标签名的是滑块，两个控件不能共用一个 id。
notesEn: Invalid comes from Field or aria-invalid on a SliderThumb: the filled segment and thumb switch to the danger fill and the value is unchanged. Read-only shows a read-only note below the slider.
Provide SliderLabel or a name for each Thumb; multiple-thumb names must differ.
Primitive interaction snaps to steps; explicit invalid values throw RangeError.
4px track thickness and 10rem vertical length are central presets, adjustable in tokens/components.css or project themes. Actual browser contrast/geometry still require acceptance.
When an exact-entry NumberField sits beside a Slider inside a Field, give it a FieldItem and put its name on NumberFieldInput. The Field label names the Slider; two controls cannot share one id.
metadata.decisions: Slider 输入真实数值。进度使用 Progress，测量结果使用 Meter；onValueCommitted 只表示当前交互提交。
metadata.decisionsEn: Slider inputs actual numeric values. Use Progress for progress and Meter for measurements; onValueCommitted indicates only the current interaction's commit.

whenToUse: 有明确有限范围与步进的数值
需要拖动调整的数值区间
avoid: 精确键入使用 NumberField
进度或未知任务状态不用 Slider
composition: Label/Value + Control → Track → Indicator/Thumb；FieldDescription/FieldError 继续关联同一输入

library: 拖动、焦点、键盘、非受控值
application: 受控值、区间与步进、invalid、持久化

responsive: 控制高跟随密度轴，抓手跟随标签文字；窄屏增量照旧，触摸与真实拖动未在本子任务浏览器验收
customization: 具名轨道厚度与纵向长度预设，项目可覆写；Thumb 边框聚焦只变色

whenToUse: Numeric values with explicit finite ranges and steps.
Numeric intervals needing drag adjustment.
avoid: Use NumberField for precise typing.
Do not use Slider for progress or unknown task states.
composition: Label/Value + Control → Track → Indicator/Thumb; FieldDescription/FieldError continue referring to the same input.

library: Dragging, focus, keyboard, and uncontrolled values.
application: Controlled values, ranges/steps, invalid facts, and persistence.

responsive: Control/thumb profiles retain five narrow-screen increments; this subtask did not browser-accept touch or actual dragging.
customization: Named track-thickness/vertical-length presets are project-overridable; Thumb focus changes border color only.

metadata.title: 行内趋势 Sparkline
metadata.description: 坐在文字行里的小型折线，说明一个读数最近怎样变化。
metadata.descriptionEn: A small line set in a line of text, showing how a reading has recently changed.
metadata.decisions: 高一材，线用浓墨、当前一点用焦墨，默认不用色相；未知点断开而不当作零；可访问名称给出起止与最高最低。目标带是参照，用清墨画在线后面，纵向范围把它算进去，摘要补上当前值在目标之上、之下或之内。状态类别由调用方声明，组件不因越出目标带而自己变色。逐点读数显式启用：悬停取最近点，单一焦点入口用左右方向键与 Home / End 遍历，轻点显示或关闭；Escape、失焦与外部按下可关闭。提示复用公共 Tooltip 的 Portal 和悬停保持，未知值仍显示未知。
metadata.decisionsEn: One module tall, the line in medium ink and the current point in full ink, without hue by default. Unknown points break the line rather than becoming zero. The accessible name states the endpoints and the range. A target band is a reference: it is drawn behind the line in light ink, the vertical range includes it, and the summary adds whether the current value is above, below or within the target. The tone is declared by the caller; the component never recolors itself for leaving the band. Point readouts are opt-in: hover finds the nearest point; one focus target traverses with Left/Right and Home/End; a tap shows or dismisses the reading. Escape, blur and an outside press dismiss it. The public Tooltip provides a portal and hoverable content; unknown values remain unknown.

api.name: Sparkline
api.description: 按顺序的数值与它量的是什么。
api.descriptionEn: Ordered values and what they measure.

props.name: label
props.description: 这条线量的是什么；是可访问名称的一部分。
props.descriptionEn: What the line measures; part of the accessible name.

props.name: values
props.description: 按顺序的数值；null 表示未知，画成断开。
props.descriptionEn: Ordered values; null is unknown and breaks the line.

props.name: format
props.description: 可访问摘要和逐点提示里的读数格式；未知值不调用它。
props.descriptionEn: Formatting for values in the accessible summary and point readouts; never called for unknown values.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: 开启逐点读数。悬停显示最近点；焦点进入即显示，左右方向键、Home / End 遍历；Enter / 空格或轻点切换显示。Escape、失焦或外部按下关闭，不因仍在原位的焦点或悬停立即重开。提示显示类别、数值与点序号。默认保留静态图片摘要；空数组没有逐点入口。
props.descriptionEn: Enable point readouts. Hover shows the nearest point; focus opens it; Left/Right and Home/End traverse; Enter/Space or a tap toggles it. Escape, blur or an outside press dismiss it without immediately reopening from retained focus or hover. The hint states the category, value and point index. The default remains a static image summary; an empty array has no point target.

props.name: getPointLabel
props.description: 逐点提示的时间或类别名称，index 从 0 开始；省略或空白时使用本地化点序号。仅 tooltip 开启且有数据点时调用。
props.descriptionEn: Time or category for a point, with a zero-based index. Omitted or blank labels fall back to a localized point number. Called only when tooltip is enabled and points exist.

props.name: appearance
props.description: line 是行内趋势；area 是独立成块的趋势，取第一色并带淡面。
props.descriptionEn: line is the inline trend; area is a block trend in the first color with a soft fill.

props.name: height
props.description: 仅 area：坐标高度（px）。
props.descriptionEn: area only: plot height in px.

props.name: band
props.type: { from: number; to: number; label: string }
props.description: 目标区间，画成线后面横贯整个宽度的清墨带；from 须小于 to，label 命名目标并进入摘要。纵向范围包含它。
props.descriptionEn: Target range, drawn as a light-ink band across the full width behind the line; from must be below to, and label names the target in the summary. The vertical range includes it.

props.name: tone
props.description: 状态类别，由调用方声明；线、孤立点与当前点（area 的淡面）改用该类别色。不给则保持墨色。
props.descriptionEn: Status category declared by the caller; the line, isolated points and current point (and the area fill) take its color. Omit it to stay in ink.

props.name: width
props.description: 坐标宽度（px），默认 5 材；line 的高度固定一材。
props.descriptionEn: Plot width in px, five modules by default; a line is always one module tall.

whenToUse: 读数旁需要「最近在变好还是变坏」的形状。
有明确的目标区间时用 band：读者要看的是线在区间之内还是之外。没有区间就不画带。
tone 由应用决定：越出目标是好是坏只有应用知道（延迟高了是坏，产量高了未必）；组件不会自己变色。
卡片或表格中的短趋势需要偶尔核对某一点时显式开启 tooltip，并用 getPointLabel 命名时间或类别。
avoid: 需要坐标轴、多个系列或持续可见的逐点明细时用 Chart 或数据表。
composition: 放在 StatValue、表格单元格或正文旁；名称与读数由调用方给出。
逐点入口有一个 Tab 停靠点；可访问提示保留类别、真实数值或未知与点序号。调用方为触屏命中区留出空间，不将 Sparkline 嵌入另一个按钮或链接。

library: 形状、未知点的断开、纵向范围对目标带的并集、含目标位置的可访问摘要，以及启用后的当前点、提示和关闭行为。
application: 数值、时间范围、类别名称、格式、目标区间与状态类别。

responsive: line 宽度固定，随文字换行；area 未给 width 时铺满容器。
逐点提示通过 Portal 脱离卡片和滚动容器裁切，靠近视口边缘时由公共浮层避让。
customization: 颜色读墨阶；色相只经 tone 表达状态类别，不开放任意颜色。

whenToUse: A reading needs a shape showing whether it has recently improved or worsened.
Use band when there is a real target range: the reader needs to see whether the line is inside or outside it. Without a range, draw no band.
The application decides tone: only it knows whether leaving the target is good or bad (higher latency is bad, higher output may not be); the component never recolors itself.
Enable tooltip when a short card or table trend needs occasional point inspection, and name its time or category with getPointLabel.
avoid: Use Chart or a data table for axes, multiple series or persistently visible point details.
composition: Place beside StatValue, in a table cell, or in text; the caller supplies the name and reading.

Point inspection has one Tab stop. Accessible hints retain the category, real value or unknown state, and point index. Leave room for the touch target and avoid nesting Sparkline in another button or link.

library: Shape, gaps at unknown points, the data/band domain, the accessible summary, and opt-in active point, readout and dismissal behavior.
application: Values, time range, category names, formatting, target range and tone.

responsive: line has a fixed width and wraps with text; area fills its container when width is omitted.
Point hints use a portal to escape card and scroll-container clipping; the shared floating layer handles viewport collisions.
customization: Colors come from the ink ladder; hue appears only through tone as a status category, never as an arbitrary color.

metadata.title: 度量 Stat
metadata.description: 数值、单位与说明分别提供。
metadata.descriptionEn: Values, units and explanations supplied independently.
metadata.decisions: dl/dt/dd 保留度量关系；零值不消失，未知和不适用必由应用说明。变化量必须说明参照期，方向由箭头与文字表达；好坏只由应用声明，未声明时用墨色。
metadata.decisionsEn: dl/dt/dd preserve metric relationships; zero remains visible and the application explains unknown and inapplicable values. A change names its reference period and shows direction with an arrow and text; only the application declares good or bad, otherwise it stays in ink.

whenToUse: 需要识别一个度量的名称、值和单位。
页面顶部的概览读数用 size="lg"：只有读数本身按它在页面上的位置选大小。
avoid: 跨对象比较使用 Table；趋势图形由具备真实数据的应用组合。
同一排读数用同一个 size；没有 36 与 28 两档。

library: 度量名称、值、单位与说明的语义关系。
application: 统计口径、数值状态、更新时间与变化事实。

responsive: 数值与单位可换行，未知状态不缩为零。

whenToUse: Identify a metric's name, value, and unit.
Use size="lg" for overview readings at the top of a page: only the reading itself is sized by its position.
avoid: Use Table for cross-object comparison; applications with actual data compose trend graphics.
Give one row of readings the same size; there are no 36 or 28 steps.

library: Semantic relationships among metric names, values, units, and explanations.
application: Measurement definitions, numeric states, update times, and change facts.

responsive: Values/units wrap; unknown never shrinks to zero.

api.name: StatDelta
api.description: 与参照期相比的变化量（dd）。
api.descriptionEn: Change against a reference period (dd).

props.name: value
props.description: 带符号的变化量。
props.descriptionEn: The signed change.

props.name: period
props.description: 参照期，例如「较上周」；必填。
props.descriptionEn: The reference period such as "vs last week"; required.

props.name: format
props.description: 绝对值的显示，例如百分比。
props.descriptionEn: How the absolute value is shown, such as a percentage.

props.name: sentiment
props.description: 应用声明的好坏；不声明时用墨色。
props.descriptionEn: Good or bad as declared by the application; otherwise ink.

api.name: Stat
api.description: dl，状态必填。
api.descriptionEn: A dl with required state.

props.name: state
props.description: 应用确认的度量状态，不产生替代数值。unknown 和 not-applicable 的读数退为浓墨，记在 StatValue 的 data-state 上。
props.descriptionEn: An application-owned metric state that generates no replacement value. An unknown or not-applicable reading steps back to medium ink and is recorded as data-state on StatValue.

props.name: size
props.description: 读数的尺寸档，记在根的 data-size 上。lg 把 StatValue 放大到 32/40（md 是 24/28），用于页面顶部的概览读数；标签、单位、说明与变化量的字号不随它变。
props.descriptionEn: The reading's size step, recorded as data-size on the root. lg raises StatValue to 32/40 (md is 24/28) for overview readings at the top of a page; the label, unit, description and change keep their size.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 传入标题和值；属性属于实际 dl。
props.descriptionEn: Supply labels and values; props reach the actual dl.

api.name: StatLabel / StatValue / StatDescription
api.description: dt / dd / dd。
api.descriptionEn: dt / dd / dd parts.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 值可为数字或状态文字，0 原样保留。
props.descriptionEn: Values may be numbers or state text; zero is preserved.

api.name: StatUnit
api.description: StatValue 中的 span。
api.descriptionEn: A span inside StatValue.

props.name: children / render / native props
props.description: 单位由应用提供，不猜测量纲。
props.descriptionEn: The caller supplies units; the component infers no dimension.

notes: 统计口径、更新时间和变化判断属于应用事实；说明可省略。
未知和不适用的读数退为浓墨，不施彩，字号不变；文字由应用给出，不画成 0。没有可比较的数时不放变化量。
notesEn: Definitions, update times and changes are application facts; descriptions are optional.

An unknown or not-applicable reading steps back to medium ink with no hue and keeps its size; the application supplies the words, and it is never drawn as 0. Without a number to compare there is no change to show.

metadata.title: 状态 StatusDot
metadata.description: 让状态色与可见名称同时表达事实。
metadata.descriptionEn: A state graphic and its visible name.
metadata.decisions: 不把等待、进行中或结果未知混成同一事实。
metadata.decisionsEn: Waiting, in-progress, and unknown results remain distinct facts.

whenToUse: 表达对象的真实状态。
avoid: 不把等待、进行中或结果未知混成同一事实。
composition: 名称默认走 locale；label 可附上明确对象，图形不单独成为 Spinner。

library: 原生语义、公共组合与集中角色。
application: 对象、内容、值、状态与请求结果。

responsive: 状态名称允许长中英文换行；图形尺寸独立，不代替名称。
customization: 使用公开 render/ref、ARIA、事件与样式；不混用主题三轴。

whenToUse: Present an object's actual state.
avoid: Waiting, in-progress, and unknown results remain distinct facts.
composition: Default names use locale; label may identify a specific object. The glyph is not a standalone Spinner.

library: Native semantics, public composition, and centralized roles.
application: Objects, content, values, states, and request outcomes.

responsive: Long status names in either language wrap; independent glyph dimensions do not replace names.
customization: Public render/refs, ARIA, events, and styles; keep theme axes independent.

notes: 状态名对应固定的类别：在线是成功，异常是危险，警告和结果未知是警示，提示、等待中、进行中是信息；离线和 neutral 不施彩。同一类别在 Badge 里是同一色相。
结果未知要读者去核实，归警示：它既不是失败，也不是成功。neutral 是没有归类的状态，用 label 写出它到底是什么。
notesEn: Each state belongs to one fixed category: online is success, error is danger, warning and unknown are warning, and info, pending and in-progress are info; offline and neutral carry no hue. The same category has the same hue in Badge.
An unknown outcome needs the reader to verify it, so it is a warning: neither a failure nor a success. neutral is a state with no category; use label to say what it is.

api.name: StatusDot
api.description: 名称默认走 locale；label 可附上明确对象，图形不单独成为 Spinner。
api.descriptionEn: Default names use locale; label may identify a specific object. The glyph is not a standalone Spinner.

props.name: status
props.description: 应用给出的实际状态，必填。
props.descriptionEn: Required actual application state.

props.name: label
props.description: 替代默认 locale 名称，需继续表达对象状态。
props.descriptionEn: Replaces the default localized name while still describing the object's state.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 属性、事件与ref透传实际元素；样式由className/style调整。
props.descriptionEn: Forward attributes, events, and refs to the actual element; adjust presentation through className/style.

metadata.title: 步骤 Steps
metadata.description: 应用事实决定的有序过程。
metadata.descriptionEn: An ordered process with application-owned progress.
metadata.decisions: 序号不证明完成；每项状态显式传入，只有 current 获得 aria-current=step。
metadata.decisionsEn: Order does not establish completion. Every state is explicit; only current receives aria-current=step.

whenToUse: 有明确顺序和状态事实的过程。
avoid: 时间事件用 Timeline；平级页面入口用导航链接。

library: 顺序语义、可见状态名称与当前步骤标记。
application: 每一步的完成、当前位置、错误与恢复动作。

responsive: 内容纵向排列并换行，不隐藏状态。

whenToUse: A process has an explicit order and actual states.
avoid: Use Timeline for events and navigation links for peer page destinations.

library: Order semantics, visible state names, and current-step markers.
application: Each step's completion, current position, errors, and recovery actions.

responsive: Content stacks and wraps without hiding states.

api.name: Steps
api.description: 有名称的 ol。
api.descriptionEn: A named ordered list.

props.name: aria-label / render / ref / native props
props.description: 默认名称来自 locale。
props.descriptionEn: The default name comes from locale.

api.name: Step
api.description: 一个 li，状态独立于前后位置。
api.descriptionEn: A li with state independent of preceding positions.

props.name: state
props.description: 必填的应用事实，提供本地化辅助名称。
props.descriptionEn: Required application fact with a localized assistive label.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 状态不自动产生导航。
props.descriptionEn: State does not generate navigation.

api.name: StepTitle / StepDescription
api.description: div / p 内容槽。
api.descriptionEn: div / p content slots.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 应用提供标题、解释和恢复链接。
props.descriptionEn: The application provides titles, explanation and recovery links.

notes: 不能由当前索引把之前各项自动标记完成。
notesEn: Do not automatically complete earlier items from a current index.

metadata.title: 开关 Switch
metadata.description: 立即改变当前设置的开/关状态。
metadata.descriptionEn: Immediately change the on/off state of a current setting.

api.name: Switch
api.description: 保持名称稳定，用 aria-checked 表达开与关。
api.descriptionEn: Keep names stable and use aria-checked for on/off.

props.name: checked / defaultChecked
props.description: 受控设置值或非受控初值。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled setting or uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: 立即设置的变化入口；请求与持久化由应用承担。
props.descriptionEn: An immediate setting change; the application owns requests and persistence.

props.name: disabled / readOnly
props.description: 禁用不参与 Tab/提交；只读仍可聚焦、提交但不可改变。
props.descriptionEn: Disabled excludes tabbing/submission; read-only retains focus/submission without changes.

props.name: pending
props.description: 已发出请求、结果未到：不可再切换（readOnly）、aria-busy、data-pending；抓手停在 checked，抓手内出现与 Button loading 同一种等待记号。
props.descriptionEn: A request is out and the result has not arrived: no further toggling (readOnly), aria-busy, data-pending; the thumb stays at checked and carries the same waiting mark as Button loading.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: 调用方或 Field 声明无效，保留当前开/关事实；开启时槽的填充改为危险填充色，关闭时槽的边线改为危险色。
props.descriptionEn: Caller or Field declares invalid while retaining the actual on/off state. When on, the track fill becomes the danger fill; when off, the track outline turns danger.

props.name: name / value / uncheckedValue / form
props.description: 原语隐藏输入的提交入口；不代表必须等待表单提交才生效。
props.descriptionEn: Primitive hidden input submission; this does not require waiting for form submission before taking effect.

props.name: render / ref / inputRef / className / style
props.description: 根部位与隐藏 input 的组合；渲染 button 时设置 nativeButton。
props.descriptionEn: Root and hidden input composition; set nativeButton when rendering a button.

api.name: SwitchPrimitive
api.description: 完整 Base UI Switch 命名空间，包含 Root 与 Thumb。
api.descriptionEn: The complete Base UI Switch namespace, including Root and Thumb.

keyboard.description: 进入或离开开关。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Enter or leave the switch.

keyboard.description: 立即切换当前设置。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Change the current setting immediately.

notes: 名称不随开关状态改变。
不支持部分选中；多选或待提交选择用 Checkbox。
异步保存的等待、未知和失败属于应用，不能用滑块动画表示请求成功。
notesEn: Names stay stable across on/off states.
No partial selection; use Checkbox for multiple or pending selections.
Applications own asynchronous save waiting, unknown, and failure; thumb animation cannot establish request success.
metadata.decisions: 只有当前设置立即改变时才用 Switch。条款同意、待提交选择和不可逆命令分别使用 Checkbox 或明确的动作与结果反馈。
metadata.decisionsEn: Use Switch only when the current setting changes immediately. Consent, pending selections, and irreversible commands use Checkbox or explicit actions and outcome feedback.

whenToUse: 立即生效的二值设置
avoid: 待提交选择用 Checkbox
不可逆命令用 Button
结果未知时先核实
composition: Field + FieldLabel + Switch + FieldDescription / FieldError

library: 焦点、键盘、非受控 checked
application: 当前设置、请求与保存结果、invalid

responsive: 窄屏保留控件高+4px，命中区不随密度缩小；本批只验桌面
customization: 主题填充及前景、同名文字行高、focus宽度

whenToUse: Binary settings taking effect immediately.
avoid: Use Checkbox for pending selections.
Use Button for irreversible commands.
Verify unknown results first.
composition: Field + FieldLabel + Switch + FieldDescription / FieldError

library: Focus, keyboard, and uncontrolled checked state.
application: Current settings, request/save outcomes, and invalid facts.

responsive: Narrow heights retain +4px and density never shrinks hit areas; this batch checked desktop only.
customization: Theme fills/foregrounds, matching text line heights, and focus widths.
