metadata.title: 比较表 Table
metadata.description: 原生二维关系与完整比较列。
metadata.descriptionEn: Native two-dimensional relationships with complete comparison columns.
metadata.decisions: 原生表格保留比较关系，外部容器承接横向容量。行占位与单元格内距消费独立角色；疏密取值是预设。
metadata.decisionsEn: Native table structure preserves comparison; the container handles horizontal capacity. Row occupancy and cell padding consume independent roles; density values are presets.

whenToUse: 多个对象需要按共同维度比较。
avoid: 单一对象名称值关系用 DescriptionList；长阅读正文用 Typography。

library: 原生二维结构、表头关系与滚动容量。
application: 数据、表名、排序、错误、未知与空结果。

responsive: 横向滚动保留完整比较列，不改成丢维度的卡片。

whenToUse: Compare multiple objects along shared dimensions.
avoid: Use DescriptionList for one object's names/values and Typography for long reading.

library: Native two-dimensional structure, header relationships, and scrolling capacity.
application: Data, table names, sorting, errors, unknown, and empty results.

responsive: Horizontal scrolling retains complete comparison columns instead of cards losing dimensions.

api.name: TableContainer
api.description: 表格的纸与横向滚动容器。
api.descriptionEn: The table's surface and horizontal scroll container.

props.name: framed
props.description: false：表格放在已有的一张纸上（Card、面板），不再铺线、底与圆角；贴着承载面的边放置，由承载面裁切圆角。
props.descriptionEn: false places the table on an existing surface such as a Card, without its own line, fill, or radius. Set it flush with the host, which clips the corners.

props.name: tabIndex / aria-label / render / ref / native props
props.description: 内容真的超出（横向或纵向）时才可聚焦（tabIndex=0），用于键盘滚动，并成为具名区域：取 aria-label / aria-labelledby，否则沿用表的 caption 或 aria-label；放得下时不进 Tab 序列。ref 属于容器；显式传入的 tabIndex 优先。
props.descriptionEn: Focusable (tabIndex=0) only while the content actually overflows horizontally or vertically, so the keyboard can scroll it; it then becomes a named region from aria-label / aria-labelledby, else the table's caption or aria-label. A container whose content fits stays out of the Tab sequence. Ref targets the container; an explicit tabIndex wins.

api.name: Table / TableCaption / TableHeader / TableBody / TableFooter / TableRow
api.description: table / caption / thead / tbody / tfoot / tr。
api.descriptionEn: Native table / caption / thead / tbody / tfoot / tr.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性属于真实元素；caption 命名整张表。
props.descriptionEn: Props reach actual elements; caption names the table.

api.name: TableHead
api.description: th；应用提供排序状态。
api.descriptionEn: A th with application-owned sort state.

props.name: scope
props.description: 行标题用 row；复杂表格可用 id/headers。
props.descriptionEn: Use row for row headers; complex tables may use id/headers.

props.name: numeric
props.description: 数值列由调用方声明，不由内容猜：表头与该列单元格同时声明，行内末端对齐（RTL 下在左）并用等宽数字；排序按钮内容反向排列，列名紧贴末端。读 data-numeric。
props.descriptionEn: A numeric column is declared by the caller, never guessed from content: declare it on the header and its cells alike for inline-end alignment (left in RTL) and tabular figures; sort button content is reversed so the label meets the end edge. Readable as data-numeric.

props.name: aria-sort / children / native props
props.description: 排序交应用 Button 组合，库不重排 rows。
props.descriptionEn: Compose an application Button to sort; the library never reorders rows.

api.name: TableCell
api.description: td，零值原样呈现。
api.descriptionEn: A td that preserves zero.

props.name: numeric
props.description: 数值列的单元格，与同列表头的 numeric 配对。
props.descriptionEn: A cell of a numeric column, paired with numeric on the column's header.

props.name: colSpan / rowSpan / headers / render / ref / native props
props.description: 显式提供跨列和关联表头，不隐藏比较列。
props.descriptionEn: Supply spans and header associations explicitly; comparison columns are not hidden.

notes: 空结果可在完整表头下提供跨列单元格；数据与排序由应用提供。
一个范围只铺一张纸：表格进 Card 时用 framed={false}，不要在卡片里再套一层边框。
数据格与行标题允许在任意位置折行，长标识符不会把列撑出纸外；列标题保持单行。
可滚动由 ResizeObserver 实测决定；服务端与首帧按「不可滚动」输出（服务端没有布局可测，猜可滚动会让多数放得下的表带一个假停靠点），客户端在首次绘制前即更新。
notesEn: Empty results may use a spanning cell below complete headers; data and sorting belong to the application.
One region, one surface: inside a Card use framed={false} rather than nesting a second border.
Data cells and row headers wrap anywhere, so a long identifier cannot push a column off the surface; column headers stay on one line.

Scrollability is measured with a ResizeObserver. The server and first frame render as not scrollable (the server has no layout to measure, and guessing would give most fitting tables a false Tab stop); the client updates before first paint.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 视角标签 Tabs
metadata.description: 同一对象的不同视角，保留面板草稿。
metadata.descriptionEn: Different views of one object with panel drafts retained.
metadata.decisions: 默认手动激活、面板保留挂载；切换视角不等于批准或保存草稿。
metadata.decisionsEn: Manual activation and mounted panels are defaults; switching views does not approve or save a draft.

api.name: Tabs / TabsList
api.description: 当前视角与手动激活列表。
api.descriptionEn: The current view and a manually activated list.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange / orientation
props.description: 值由应用或原语持有；取消不切换。
props.descriptionEn: The application or primitive owns the value; cancellation prevents a switch.

props.name: activateOnFocus
props.description: 默认焦点移动不自动切换；消费者可明确选择自动激活。
props.descriptionEn: Focus movement does not activate by default; consumers may explicitly opt in.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: TabsTab
api.description: 具有关联面板的 tab。
api.descriptionEn: A tab associated with a panel.

props.name: value / disabled
props.description: value 稳定；禁用标签可聚焦但不能激活。
props.descriptionEn: Value is stable; disabled tabs may receive focus but cannot activate.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: TabsPanel / TabsPrimitive
api.description: 原生 tabpanel 与公开原语。
api.descriptionEn: A tabpanel and public primitives.

props.name: value / keepMounted
props.description: visited：第一次到达才挂载，之后保留输入与已取回的内容，没到过的面板不发请求。true：一开始全部挂载，跨标签页一起提交的原生表单字段用它。false：离开即卸载，由应用承担后果。
props.descriptionEn: visited mounts a panel on first arrival and keeps its input and loaded content afterwards, so unvisited panels make no requests. true mounts every panel up front; use it for native form fields submitted together across tabs. false unmounts on leaving, and the application owns the effects.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

notes: 到达过的隐藏面板仍挂载但退出可访问树；没到达过的面板不在 DOM 里。不要把切换当成保存成功。
notesEn: Visited hidden panels remain mounted but leave the accessibility tree; unvisited panels are not in the DOM. Switching is never reported as saving.

whenToUse: 同一对象多种视角需要保留编辑连续性。
avoid: 步骤进度用 Steps，真实目的地用链接。

library: 标签关联、键盘和面板可见性。
application: value、草稿、保存与批准。

responsive: 桌面保持真实结构；菜单受可用空间限制，表格保留完整比较列。
customization: 控件档案、间距和浮层表面消费现有角色；具体外观是预设。

whenToUse: Multiple views of one object need editing continuity.
avoid: Use Steps for progression and links for actual destinations.

library: Tab associations, keyboard, and panel visibility.
application: value, drafts, saving, and approval.

responsive: Keep actual desktop structure; menus fit available space and tables retain complete comparison columns.
customization: Control profiles, spacing, and popup surfaces consume existing roles; their appearance is a preset.

keyboard.description: 移动标签焦点。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move tab focus.

keyboard.description: 手动激活可用标签。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Manually activate an enabled tab.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 标签集合 TagInput
metadata.description: 确认字符串集合，保留尚未确认的编辑草稿。
metadata.descriptionEn: Confirm a string collection while keeping its unconfirmed draft.
metadata.decisions: Enter 或添加按钮才确认；两端空白去除，精确字符串去重且区分大小写。空项、重复项及受控拒绝不会清空草稿。
metadata.decisionsEn: Only Enter or Add confirms a tag. Confirmation trims surrounding whitespace and deduplicates exact case-sensitive strings. Empty, duplicate, and rejected changes retain the draft.

api.name: TagInput
api.description: 已确认项、草稿输入与非提交动作的公共组合。
api.descriptionEn: Public composition of confirmed items, a draft input, and non-submitting actions.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: 已确认集合；外部事实不重新去重、裁切或清理。
props.descriptionEn: Confirmed collection. External facts are not re-deduplicated, truncated, or cleaned.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: details 有 add/remove、tag、event、cancel() 与 isCanceled；受控添加接受前保留草稿。
props.descriptionEn: Details includes add/remove, tag, event, cancel(), and isCanceled. Controlled additions retain the draft until accepted.

props.name: draft / defaultDraft / onDraftChange
props.description: 独立的待确认编辑文本；刷新集合不清草稿。
props.descriptionEn: Independent unconfirmed text. Refreshing the collection retains the draft.

props.name: name / form
props.description: 只提交确认项，使用同名表单键；草稿不提交为集合项。
props.descriptionEn: Submit confirmed items as repeated form keys; the draft does not become a collection item.

props.name: required
props.description: 至少一个已确认标签。草稿输入只在没有任何标签时带原生 required，有标签而草稿为空不算缺失；aria-required 始终跟随。inputProps.required 被忽略，开发环境警告。
props.descriptionEn: At least one confirmed tag. The draft input carries native required only while there are no tags, so tags with an empty draft are not missing; aria-required always follows. inputProps.required is ignored with a development warning.

props.name: splitOn
props.description: 键入分隔符时，其前的部分被收下；粘贴时全部收下。被拒绝的片段留在草稿里并说明原因。默认不拆（逗号与空格有时就是标签的一部分）。正则不要带捕获组。
props.descriptionEn: Typing a separator takes in what precedes it; pasting takes in every part. Rejected parts stay in the draft with the reason. Off by default, since commas and spaces are sometimes part of a tag. Avoid capture groups in a RegExp.

props.name: max
props.description: 标签数量上限（正整数，否则抛 RangeError）。达到后草稿输入与添加按钮禁用，说明写入描述（“最多 N 个标签”）；已确认标签与同名表单项不受影响，已有集合超出上限时完整呈现。
props.descriptionEn: Maximum number of tags (positive integer, otherwise RangeError). At the limit the draft and Add are disabled and the reason is in the description; confirmed tags and their form fields are unaffected, and an existing larger collection is shown in full.

props.name: addOnBlur
props.description: 草稿输入失焦时把非空草稿当作一次 Enter；焦点只是移到添加或移除按钮时不触发，不合规则的草稿保留并说明。
props.descriptionEn: Treat a non-empty draft as Enter when the draft input loses focus. Moving to Add or Remove does not trigger it; a draft that fails the rules is kept with the reason.

props.name: validate
props.type: (tag: string, tags: readonly string[]) => string | undefined
props.description: 返回文案即拒绝：文案就地显示并进入草稿输入的可访问描述，草稿保留。在空值、重复与数量判断之后调用。
props.descriptionEn: Return a message to reject: it is shown in place, joins the draft input's accessible description, and the draft is kept. Called after the empty, duplicate and limit checks.

props.name: inputProps
props.description: 真实草稿 Input 的 render/ref/ARIA/事件/样式；FieldLabel 注册此入口。
props.descriptionEn: The real draft Input's render, refs, ARIA, events, and styling. FieldLabel registers this input.

props.name: disabled / readOnly
props.description: 同时约束草稿与确认项操作；只读仍提交确认项，禁用不提交。
props.descriptionEn: Constrain the draft and item actions together. Read-only confirmed items submit; disabled items do not.

props.name: render / ref / className / style / native props
props.description: 属于根容器；改渲染元素须保持结构与子控件。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the root container. Render must retain its structure and children.

keyboard.description: 非组字时确认草稿，阻止表单提交；组字中的 Enter 不添加。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Confirm the draft outside composition without submitting a form. Composition Enter does not add.

keyboard.keys: Backspace / ArrowLeft（草稿起点，RTL 为 ArrowRight）
keyboard.keysEn: Backspace / ArrowLeft (start of draft; ArrowRight under RTL)
keyboard.description: 空草稿的 Backspace 或起点的左箭头先聚焦最后一项，不立即删除。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Backspace on an empty draft or Left at its start focuses the last item without deleting it.

keyboard.description: 移除已聚焦项，保留相邻焦点位置。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Remove the focused item and preserve an adjacent focus position.

keyboard.description: 在确认项间移动，边界返回草稿；方向随实际排版，RTL 下对调。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move among confirmed items; boundaries return to the draft. The direction follows the rendered layout and swaps under RTL.

notes: FieldLabel 命名草稿入口，FieldDescription 可明示确认和去重规则。
提交表单时草稿里若有字，先按 Enter 的规则收下；收不下（重复、validate 拒绝、受控调用方不接受）就拦住提交并在字段旁说明。拦住的是 submit 事件本身，onSubmit 不会执行。
粘贴默认只编辑草稿；设了 splitOn 才拆分并批量收下。
添加/移除不是保存结果；库不发请求、不清失败草稿。
模拟 composition 已验证，真实中文输入法与辅助技术另验。
notesEn: FieldLabel names the draft; FieldDescription may state confirmation and duplicate rules.

On form submit a non-empty draft is first taken in by the Enter rule; if it cannot be (duplicate, rejected by validate, not accepted by a controlled caller) the submit is stopped and the reason is shown beside the field. The submit event itself is stopped, so onSubmit does not run.
Paste only edits the draft by default; with splitOn it splits and takes in every part.
Adding/removing is not persistence. The library sends no requests and retains failed drafts.
Synthetic composition is checked; real IME and assistive tech need separate verification.

whenToUse: 由用户逐项确认的短字符串集合
avoid: 只能从候选选择时用 Select/Combobox；单值用 Input
composition: Field + FieldLabel + TagInput + FieldDescription / Error

library: 非受控集合与草稿、焦点、约束提示
application: 受控集合/草稿、权限、刷新、失败与持久化

responsive: 确认项允许换行，草稿取剩余宽度；一套几何，跟随密度轴，紧凑不缩小文字
customization: root render/ref 与 inputProps 的真实输入出口分开

whenToUse: Short strings confirmed individually by the user.
avoid: Use Select/Combobox when values must come from candidates, and Input for a single value.
composition: Field + FieldLabel + TagInput + FieldDescription / Error

library: Uncontrolled collection/draft, focus, and constraint feedback.
application: Controlled collection/draft, permissions, refresh, failure, and persistence.

responsive: Confirmed items wrap and drafts take remaining width; five matching control/text profiles.
customization: Root render/refs stay separate from inputProps for the actual input.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 多行输入 Textarea
metadata.description: 编辑备注、消息等多行文本。
metadata.descriptionEn: Edit multiline notes and messages.

api.name: Textarea
api.description: 可与 Field 组合的原生 textarea。
api.descriptionEn: A native textarea composable with Field.

props.name: rows
props.description: 最小起始行数；内容可自动增高，仍可手工调整高度。
props.descriptionEn: Minimum starting rows; content may grow automatically and still be resized manually.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: 受控值或非受控初值。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled value or uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: 原语的值变化回调，可调用 eventDetails.cancel()。
props.descriptionEn: Primitive value callback, cancelable with eventDetails.cancel().

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: 调用方声明的错误事实；也可由 Field invalid 传入。
props.descriptionEn: Caller-declared error fact, also available from Field invalid.

props.name: disabled / readOnly
props.description: 禁用不参与 Tab/提交；只读仍可聚焦和提交，显示已有 locale 的只读文案。
props.descriptionEn: Disabled excludes tabbing/submission; read-only retains focus/submission and existing localized read-only text.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: 浏览器执行的字符长度上限，不由计数文案实施限制。
props.descriptionEn: Browser-enforced maximum text length; count text does not enforce it.

props.name: render / ref / className / style
props.type: Base UI render / textarea ref / state-aware styling
props.description: 真实 textarea 的组合与样式入口；render 必须保留 textarea 语义、属性及事件。
props.descriptionEn: Actual textarea composition/styling; render must retain textarea semantics, attributes, and events.

api.name: TextareaPrimitive
api.description: Base UI Field 命名空间；Textarea 使用其 Control 的 textarea render 出口。
api.descriptionEn: The Base UI Field namespace; Textarea uses its Control's textarea render outlet.

keyboard.description: 按文档顺序移动焦点。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move focus in document order.

keyboard.description: 插入换行，不提交表单。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Insert a newline without form submission.

notes: 名称使用 FieldLabel 或真实 label；placeholder 不代替名称。
自动增高使用 CSS field-sizing:content；不支持时保留 rows 与原生手工调整。
错误、提交与持久化事实由应用提供，失败后保留草稿。
默认表面与尺寸是集中预设；聚焦只变边框颜色。
notesEn: FieldLabel or an actual label supplies names; placeholders cannot replace them.
Automatic growth uses CSS field-sizing:content. Unsupported environments retain rows and native manual resizing.
Applications supply error, submission, and persistence facts; retain drafts after failure.
Default surfaces/dimensions are central presets; focus changes border color only.
metadata.decisions: 字符计数只描述当前值。限制由 maxLength 或应用规则执行；错误内容不会让 Textarea 自行判定 invalid。
metadata.decisionsEn: Character counts describe the current value only. maxLength or application rules enforce limits; error text does not make Textarea infer invalid.

whenToUse: 多行纯文本、备注、消息
avoid: 单行值用 Input
富文本编辑需编辑器
composition: Field + FieldLabel + Textarea + FieldDescription / FieldError

library: 焦点、原生编辑、非受控值
application: 受控值、invalid、保存与错误事实

responsive: 同名文字档及 -narrow 尺寸已接线；本批只验桌面
customization: 已有控制档 token；className/style 属于实际 textarea

whenToUse: Multiline plain text, notes, or messages.
avoid: Use Input for single-line values.
Rich text needs an editor.
composition: Field + FieldLabel + Textarea + FieldDescription / FieldError

library: Focus, native editing, and uncontrolled values.
application: Controlled values, invalid, save, and error facts.

responsive: Matching text profiles and -narrow dimensions are wired; this batch checked desktop only.
customization: Existing control-profile tokens; className/style belong to the actual textarea.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 主题 ThemeProvider
metadata.description: 管理整个文档的浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统：记住用户的选择，跟随系统偏好变化，并把结果写到 <html> 上。在应用根部挂载一次，用 useTheme 读写。
metadata.descriptionEn: Remember the user's choice of light, dark, or system mode for the whole document. ThemeProvider follows system preference changes and applies the resolved mode to <html>. Mount it once at the app root and use useTheme to read or change the mode.

api.name: ThemeProvider
api.description: 主题上下文。在 <html> 上切换 .dark / .light 类（或 data-theme 属性），并同步 color-scheme。
api.descriptionEn: Theme context switches html .dark/.light classes or data-theme and synchronizes color-scheme.

props.name: defaultTheme
props.description: 没有保存过选择时使用。
props.descriptionEn: Used when no choice was saved.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: 保存到 localStorage 的键；传 null 不保存。其他标签页修改后会自动同步。
props.descriptionEn: The localStorage key; null disables persistence. Other tabs' changes synchronize automatically.

props.name: attribute
props.description: 写入方式：.dark 类，或 data-theme="dark"。两者样式都已支持。
props.descriptionEn: Write .dark classes or data-theme=dark; styles support both.

props.name: disableTransitionOnChange
props.description: 切换瞬间暂停过渡，所有表面同时变色，而不是以不同速度渐变。
props.descriptionEn: Pause transitions during switching so surfaces change together rather than fading at different speeds.

props.name: nonce
props.description: 严格 CSP（style-src 无 'unsafe-inline'）下，给切换时临时注入的 <style> 带上这个 nonce。首屏 <script> 由你自己渲染，同样要带 nonce。
props.descriptionEn: Under a strict CSP (style-src without 'unsafe-inline'), the nonce applied to the temporary <style> injected while the theme flips. You render the first-paint <script> yourself; give it the same nonce.

api.name: useTheme
api.description: 返回 { theme, resolvedTheme, setTheme }。theme 是用户的选择（可能为 system），resolvedTheme 是实际生效的 light 或 dark。必须在 ThemeProvider 内使用。
api.descriptionEn: Returns {theme,resolvedTheme,setTheme}. theme is the user's choice, possibly system; resolvedTheme is the actual light/dark mode. Requires ThemeProvider.

api.name: themeScript
api.description: 生成首屏前执行的内联脚本源码，参数与 ThemeProvider 相同（storageKey、attribute、defaultTheme）。
api.descriptionEn: Creates inline pre-paint script source with the same storageKey, attribute, and defaultTheme as ThemeProvider.

notes: 防止首屏闪烁：React 挂载前页面已经绘制，需要在 <head> 里、样式表之前放一段内联脚本先应用主题。单页应用把 themeScript() 的输出粘贴进 index.html 的 <script>；服务端渲染用 <script dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: themeScript() }} />。脚本参数必须与 ThemeProvider 一致。
严格 CSP：把请求的 nonce 同时传给 <ThemeProvider nonce={nonce}> 与首屏 <script nonce={nonce} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: themeScript() }} />；themeScript() 只返回脚本正文。没有 nonce 时切换用的临时样式被浏览器丢弃，各表面渐变而不是同时变色。
主题选择的文案用语言包中的 theme、lightTheme、darkTheme、systemTheme。
选择“跟随系统”后，操作系统切换深浅色时页面立即跟随，无需刷新。
只在根部挂载一个 ThemeProvider；局部强制深色可在容器上加 .dark 类。
服务端与客户端首渲染保持 defaultTheme，挂载后读取真实选择。存储不可用仍可改变外观；卸载清理媒体/存储监听和临时过渡样式。
默认 yq-theme 保留已有真实偏好；跨标签页删除或 clear 恢复 defaultTheme。
notesEn: Prevent first-paint flashing with an inline head script before stylesheets, since painting precedes React mounting. In SPAs paste themeScript() into index.html script; SSR uses script dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html:themeScript()}}. Options must match ThemeProvider.

Strict CSP: pass the request nonce to both <ThemeProvider nonce={nonce}> and the first-paint <script nonce={nonce} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: themeScript() }} />; themeScript() returns only the script body. Without a nonce the browser drops the temporary transition style and surfaces fade instead of changing together.
Theme choice labels use locale theme/lightTheme/darkTheme/systemTheme.
System choice follows OS light/dark changes immediately without reloading.
Mount one root ThemeProvider. Local forced-dark content may add a .dark container class.
Server/client first renders retain defaultTheme, then read actual choices after mount. Appearance can change without storage; unmount cleans media/storage listeners and temporary transition styles.
The default yq-theme key retains actual existing preferences. Cross-tab deletion/clear restores defaultTheme.
metadata.decisions: ThemeProvider 把 data-theme 留给 light 和 dark；项目的品牌标记写在 data-brand，写进 data-theme 的品牌会在切换明暗时被覆盖。
metadata.decisionsEn: ThemeProvider reserves data-theme for light and dark. Store the project's brand identifier in data-brand; if ThemeProvider uses data-theme, it overwrites any brand identifier in that attribute when the mode changes.

whenToUse: 全应用共同选择浅色、深色或跟随系统，并在首屏一致应用。
avoid: 把品牌写进 data-theme；多个 Provider 竞争同一 html；Script 与 Provider 的持久化键不同。
composition: 根部一个 Provider 与同选项 themeScript 配对；useTheme 分别展示用户选择与实际 resolvedTheme。

library: 明暗应用、存储容错、系统偏好和跨标签页同步。
application: 品牌 data-brand、密度 data-density、主题选择入口与集中主题。

responsive: 主题切换保持对象、输入和焦点；真实控件、浮层与表面都检查明暗组合。
customization: attribute 只选 class 或明暗 data-theme，storageKey 决定偏好范围，品牌单独配置。

whenToUse: The whole application shares light/dark/system choices applied consistently at first paint.
avoid: Brand in data-theme, multiple Providers competing for html, or differing Script/Provider persistence keys.
composition: One root Provider paired with identically configured themeScript; useTheme distinguishes chosen theme from actual resolvedTheme.

library: Applying appearance, storage tolerance, system preferences, and cross-tab synchronization.
application: Brand data-brand, density data-density, choice entries, and the central theme.

responsive: Theme switching retains objects, inputs, and focus; check actual controls, popups, and surfaces in both modes.
customization: attribute selects class or appearance data-theme; storageKey sets preference scope and brand stays separate.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 时间输入 TimeField
metadata.description: 只填一个时刻，按时、分、秒分段输入。
metadata.descriptionEn: Fill in a time of day alone, segment by segment: hour, minute, second.
metadata.decisions: value 是与原生 input[type=time] 同形的无时区文本（HH:mm 或 HH:mm:ss），空为 null。每一段都填了才有值：还差几段的中间态不上报，把已有的完整时间清掉时上报 null。越界的值照常上报，只把分段标为无效并让表单提交被拦下，说明文字由应用用 FieldError 给出。
metadata.decisionsEn: The value is zone-free text shaped like native input[type=time] (HH:mm or HH:mm:ss); empty is null. A value exists only when every segment is filled: in-between states are not reported, and clearing a complete time reports null. Out-of-range values are still reported; they only mark the segments invalid and block form submission, and the application states the reason with FieldError.

api.name: TimeField
api.description: 一组分段的 spinbutton 加一个提交用的隐藏输入；整组由 Field 的标签命名。
api.descriptionEn: A group of segmented spinbuttons plus a hidden input for submission; the Field label names the whole group.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.type: string | null / string | null / (value: string | null) => void
props.description: 传了 value 属性（含 value={null}，表示空）即受控：调用方接受回调才改变事实；调用方不接受时，分段回到已接受的值。不传 value 则非受控，defaultValue 是初值，原生表单 reset 回到它。
props.descriptionEn: Passing the value prop (including value={null} for empty) makes it controlled: only an accepted callback changes the value, and a rejected change snaps the segments back. Without it the component is uncontrolled, defaultValue is the initial value, and native form reset returns to it.

props.name: granularity
props.description: 分到哪一段为止。minute 的值是 HH:mm，second 的值是 HH:mm:ss。
props.descriptionEn: The last segment. minute yields HH:mm; second yields HH:mm:ss.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: 12 小时制多一个上午/下午分段，小时为 1–12；值始终是 24 小时文本。省略时取当前 locale 的习惯。
props.descriptionEn: 12-hour adds an AM/PM segment and hours run 1–12; the value is always 24-hour text. When omitted, the current locale decides.

props.name: min / max
props.description: 最早 / 最晚时刻（同形文本）。越界的值分段标 aria-invalid，并让所在表单的提交被拦下；不修正、不拒绝键入。不支持跨午夜的区间（min 晚于 max）。
props.descriptionEn: Earliest and latest time (same text shape). A value outside marks the segments aria-invalid and blocks submission of its form; typing is neither corrected nor refused. Ranges that cross midnight (min later than max) are not supported.

props.name: name / form
props.description: 隐藏输入参与原生 FormData，提交 ISO 文本；未填完整时提交空串。Field 的 name 可代为命名。
props.descriptionEn: The hidden input joins native FormData and submits the ISO text; an incomplete time submits an empty string. A Field name can supply the name.

props.name: disabled / readOnly / required
props.description: disabled 的分段离开 Tab 序且值不提交（Field 与 fieldset 的禁用同样生效）；readOnly 的值仍可聚焦、读取、提交，但不能编辑；required 让空值拦下提交。
props.descriptionEn: Disabled segments leave the tab order and do not submit (Field and fieldset disabling apply too). Read-only values stay focusable, readable and submitted but cannot be edited. required blocks submission while empty.

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby / className / style / ref
props.description: 属于整组的外壳。字段外使用时必须自带 aria-label 或 aria-labelledby，缺名称会抛错；在 Field 里由 FieldLabel 命名。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the group shell. Outside a Field one of aria-label or aria-labelledby is required and a missing name throws; inside a Field the FieldLabel names it.

keyboard.description: 当前段加一 / 减一，越界回绕，不进位到相邻段；空段按上从最小、按下从最大开始。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Step the segment by one with wrap-around and no carry into its neighbour; an empty segment starts from its minimum on up and maximum on down.

keyboard.description: 直接输入数字；填满或再添一位必然越界时自动跳到下一段。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Type digits; the focus jumps ahead once the segment is full or cannot grow further.

keyboard.description: 清空当前段。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Clear the current segment.

keyboard.description: 在分段间移动。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move between segments.

keyboard.description: 当前段取最小 / 最大值。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Set the segment to its minimum or maximum.

keyboard.description: 上午 / 下午段直接选择（也认当前语言的首字）。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Choose AM or PM directly (the first letter in the current language also works).

keyboard.description: 整组只占一个 Tab 位，离开整组。
keyboard.descriptionEn: The group takes one tab stop and Tab leaves it.

notes: 只填时刻用 TimeField；日期和时间一起用 DateTimePicker。
分段是 div 而不是原生输入，所以没有软键盘唤起；触屏上的输入走键盘事件，尚未单独适配。
granularity 为 minute 时，已有值里的秒不显示，编辑后的值不再带秒。
没有弹层：时刻的取值空间很小，直接分段填比从列表里选更快。
notesEn: Use TimeField for a time of day alone; use DateTimePicker for date and time together.
Segments are divs, not native inputs, so no soft keyboard is raised; touch entry goes through key events and has not been adapted separately.
With granularity minute, seconds in an existing value are not shown and an edited value no longer carries them.
There is no popup: a time of day has a small value space, and filling segments is faster than choosing from a list.

composition: Field + FieldLabel + TimeField + FieldDescription / FieldError

library: 分段草稿、键入缓冲、焦点所在段
application: 时间值、约束、错误说明、提交结果

responsive: 与 Input 同一套外壳，一套几何，跟随密度轴；粗指针使用库内触摸目标
customization: 根 className / style / ref 和现有主题角色；granularity、hourCycle、min / max

composition: Field + FieldLabel + TimeField + FieldDescription / FieldError

library: Segment draft, typing buffer, and the focused segment.
application: The time value, constraints, error text, and submission outcomes.

responsive: The same shell as Input with one geometry that follows the density axis; coarse pointers use the library's touch target.
customization: Root className, style and ref, existing theme roles, granularity, hourCycle, and min / max.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 时间序列 Timeline
metadata.description: 保留输入顺序与真实时间。
metadata.descriptionEn: Preserve input order and actual times.
metadata.decisions: ol/li 表达传入序列，time 保存可解析时间；不排序、不补事件、不伪造时间。
metadata.decisionsEn: ol/li express the input sequence; time preserves machine time. No sorting or invented events and times.

whenToUse: 呈现输入的时间事件序列。
avoid: 可执行的有序过程用 Steps；二维比较用 Table。

library: 序列、time 与内容关系。
application: 事件、输入顺序、时间格式与未知事实。

responsive: 内容完整换行，未知时间保持文字表达。

whenToUse: Present an input sequence of time events.
avoid: Use Steps for actionable ordered processes and Table for two-dimensional comparison.

library: Sequence, time elements, and content relationships.
application: Events, input order, time formatting, and unknown facts.

responsive: Content wraps fully and unknown times remain explicit text.

api.name: Timeline / TimelineItem
api.description: ol / li 按 children 顺序呈现。
api.descriptionEn: ol / li render in children order.

props.name: children / aria-label / render / ref / native props
props.description: 名称和事件由应用提供，未知时间可用文字。
props.descriptionEn: The caller supplies names and events; unknown times may use text.

api.name: TimelineTime
api.description: 原生 time。
api.descriptionEn: A native time element.

props.name: dateTime / children / render / ref
props.description: 机器时间与显示文本独立，应用负责真实性。
props.descriptionEn: Machine time and display text are independent application facts.

api.name: TimelineTitle / TimelineDescription
api.description: div / p 内容槽。
api.descriptionEn: div / p content slots.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 不推断成功、失败或业务对象。
props.descriptionEn: Infers no result or business object.

notes: 正序、逆序和相同时间输入都原样保留；空序列不补占位事件。
notesEn: Ascending, descending and tied times keep input order; an empty sequence generates no entries.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 通知 Toast
metadata.description: 补充可恢复、非关键的操作事实，保持当前工作不中断。
metadata.descriptionEn: Report recoverable, non-critical facts while the current work continues.

api.name: ToastProvider
api.description: 同一通知通道挂载一次。
api.descriptionEn: Mount once per notification channel.

props.name: position
props.description: 通知区域的位置。
props.descriptionEn: Notification region placement.

props.name: timeout
props.description: 普通通知与成功的阅读时限，0 为持续显示。
props.descriptionEn: Reading duration for ordinary/success notices; zero keeps them visible.

props.name: limit
props.description: 限制同时显示的条数。超额的一般通知收起并 inert，视口里给出「另有 N 条通知」，点开后全部显示；失败、未知、进行中、带动作或 timeout 为 0 的通知不会被收起，也不计入这个数。
props.descriptionEn: Limits how many notices show at once. Surplus ordinary notices are collapsed and inert behind a visible “N more notifications” control that reveals them all; failed, unknown, in-progress, action-bearing or timeout-0 notices are never collapsed or counted.

props.name: toastManager
props.description: 可选的独立通知通道；省略时用导出的全局 manager。
props.descriptionEn: Optional independent notification channel; omission uses the exported global manager.

props.name: portalProps
props.description: 自定义 Portal 容器、方向和语言等属性。
props.descriptionEn: Custom Portal containers, direction, language, and other attributes.

api.name: toastManager.add(options)
api.description: 返回 id。相同 id 原位更新。
api.descriptionEn: Returns an id. Reusing an id updates in place.

props.name: title / description
props.description: 对象、结果与必要恢复依据。
props.descriptionEn: Objects, outcomes, and necessary recovery context.

props.name: type
props.description: waiting / in-progress / unknown / failed / success；保留 loading（进行中）、error（失败）、info 与 warning。
props.descriptionEn: waiting/in-progress/unknown/failed/success; retains loading as in-progress, error as failed, info, and warning.

props.name: timeout
props.description: 失败/未知/等待/进行中强制持续显示，其他类型按指定时限关闭。
props.descriptionEn: Failure/unknown/waiting/in-progress remain persistent; other types close after their specified duration.

props.name: priority
props.description: low 使用礼貌 status；high 使用原语 alert。失败不自动打断播报。high 时原语在通知区域之外另放一份视觉隐藏的 alert 副本供读屏立即播报，标题与说明因此在 DOM 里各有两份。
props.descriptionEn: low uses polite status; high uses primitive alert. Failure never automatically interrupts announcements. For high the primitive adds a visually hidden alert copy outside the notification region for immediate announcement, so the title and description each exist twice in the DOM.

props.name: actionProps
props.description: 应用提供操作与真实处理器，只执行一次；恢复落点仍留在页面。
props.descriptionEn: Applications supply actions and actual handlers, invoked once; recovery entries remain on the page.

props.name: data.rootProps
props.description: 透传 id、ARIA、事件、style、render 与 ref，不接管 children/className/toast/swipeDirection。
props.descriptionEn: Forward id, ARIA, events, style, render, and refs, excluding children/className/toast/swipeDirection.

api.name: toastManager.update(id, options)
api.description: 用真实结果更新同一对象。离开持续状态时显式指定 timeout；Promise 成功自动恢复 Provider 时限。
api.descriptionEn: Update the same object with actual outcomes. Specify timeout when leaving a persistent state; Promise success automatically restores Provider duration.

api.name: toastManager.promise(promise, { loading, success, error })
api.description: 进行中→真实成功/失败，更新同一条。通知不设期限、不推断结果：等多久都保持进行中，直到 Promise 落定或应用更新。响应丢失时由应用把这一条改为 unknown，不能将网络拒绝当业务失败。
api.descriptionEn: In-progress becomes actual success/failure on the same notice. The notice sets no deadline and infers no outcome: it stays in progress however long it takes, until the promise settles or the application updates it. When a response is lost the application changes the notice to unknown; network rejection is not a business failure.

api.name: toastManager.close(id?)
api.description: 关闭指定/全部通知，不取消或撤销业务任务。
api.descriptionEn: Close a specified notice or all notices without canceling or undoing business tasks.

api.name: AnchoredToastProvider / anchoredToastManager
api.description: 局部通知单独通道；positionerProps.anchor 指向关联元素。data.tooltipStyle 收紧内缘，完整说明与关闭仍保留。
api.descriptionEn: A separate channel for local notices; positionerProps.anchor identifies the associated element. data.tooltipStyle tightens internal spacing while retaining complete explanation and closing.

api.name: ToastPrimitive
api.description: Base UI Toast 原语命名空间；useToastManager 可管理所在 Provider 通道。
api.descriptionEn: Base UI Toast primitive namespace; useToastManager manages the owning Provider channel.

keyboard.description: 主动进入通知区域。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Deliberately enter the notification region.

keyboard.description: 到达通知操作与关闭，聚焦时暂停消失计时。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach notice actions/closing; focus pauses disappearance timing.

keyboard.description: 关闭聚焦通知并返回原焦点。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Close the focused notice and return to the original focus.

notes: 悬停、聚焦与窗口失焦暂停自动消失。
通知只呈现应用给出的类型，不做推测：没有超时转未知，等待、进行中、未知与失败一直留到应用更新或用户关闭。loadingTimeout 已移除；需要期限时由应用计时并调用 toastManager.update(id, { type: "unknown" })。
测试里按文字查找通知时限定在通知区域内（role=region）或用 data-slot=toast-title：priority=high 的通知另有一份视觉隐藏的播报副本，焦点进入通知区域后副本移除。
带动作（如「撤销」）的通知同样不自动消失，动作需要时间；它们和失败、未知、进行中的通知一样不会被数量上限收起。锚定通知没有统一的通知区，超限的一般通知只收起、不显示数量。
普通成功默认短暂；失败/未知持续但仍可关闭。重要事实和恢复入口必须留在对象页面。
Viewport 与锚定通知消费共享 notification 层级，低于文档候选与 modal 关键动作。
notesEn: Hover, focus, and window blur pause automatic disappearance.

A notice only presents the type the application gives it and infers nothing: no timeout turns it into unknown, and waiting, in-progress, unknown and failed notices stay until the application updates them or the user closes them. loadingTimeout is removed; when a deadline is needed the application times it and calls toastManager.update(id, { type: "unknown" }).

In tests, scope text queries to the notification region (role=region) or use data-slot=toast-title: a priority=high notice also has a visually hidden announcement copy, removed once focus enters the region.

Action-bearing notices (for example Undo) do not auto-dismiss either, because acting takes time; like failed, unknown and in-progress notices they are never collapsed by the limit. Anchored notices have no shared region, so surplus ordinary ones are collapsed without a count.
Ordinary success is brief by default; failure/unknown stay but can close. Important facts and recovery entries remain on the object's page.
Viewport and anchored notices consume shared notification layers, below document candidates and critical modal actions.
metadata.decisions: 通知不抢焦点。未知表示结果未确认，失败表示已有失败事实；关闭只关闭通知。字段错误、不可逆后果和需决策的失败留在工作面或确认结构，不能只用 Toast。
metadata.decisionsEn: A notification does not take focus. Unknown means no reliable result; failed means a confirmed failure. Dismissal only closes the notification. Keep field errors, irreversible consequences and decisions on the task surface or in a confirmation structure.

whenToUse: 非关键、可恢复、无需打断当前工作的补充事实。
avoid: 所有错误都用通知；关键后果只留在可关闭消息里；请求发出就宣布完成。
composition: 同一 id 连接等待和结果；对象页面保留失败、未知与核对入口。

library: 可访问原语、呈现、关闭、暂停与长期状态的持续显示。
application: 对象、真实结果、等待期限与何时算未知、优先级、业务取消、核对和重试。

responsive: 组件保留已有控件 narrow token；本次页面验证仅桌面≥1100px。
customization: 样式使用既有角色；时限与位置是选择/预设。入场由 motion.css 原位淡入、退出即时，减少动态效果后文字仍成立。

whenToUse: Supplementary noncritical, recoverable facts without interrupting current work.
avoid: Notifications for every error, critical consequences only in closable messages, or completion declared when a request is merely sent.
composition: One id connects waiting and outcomes; object pages retain failure, unknown, and verification entries.

library: Accessible primitives, presentation, closing, pauses, and keeping persistent states on screen.
application: Objects, actual outcomes, any waiting deadline and when a result counts as unknown, priority, business cancellation, verification, and retry.

responsive: Retains existing narrow control tokens; this page acceptance checked desktop ≥1100px only.
customization: Existing style roles; duration/placement are choices or presets. motion.css fades in at the same position and exits immediately; text remains meaningful with reduced motion.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 阅读目录 Toc
metadata.description: 本页内几个段落之间走动的纵向目录：当前位置把一条清墨基线上自己那一段加深为焦墨，不新增形状。
metadata.descriptionEn: A vertical in-page table of contents for moving between sections; the current location deepens its own segment of an existing thin line instead of adding a new shape.
metadata.decisions: Toc 不读路由、不做平滑滚动：<a href="#id"> 是原生锚点跳转，吸顶偏移、路由集成这类页面细节留给项目。当前位置（current）由调用方传入，组件不猜测滚动位置；useTocScrollSpy 是可选工具，不是 Toc 的隐藏依赖。
metadata.decisionsEn: Toc neither reads routing nor performs smooth scrolling: <a href="#id"> is a native anchor jump; sticky-header offsets and router integration stay with the project. The current location is supplied by the caller — the component never guesses scroll position — and useTocScrollSpy is an optional utility, not a hidden dependency of Toc.

whenToUse: 一篇长文或文档页需要在几个段落间快速定位，并看到自己读到了哪一节。
avoid: 少于两个目的地时目录没有意义，由调用方决定是否渲染（Toc 本身只在 items 为空时不渲染）。
跨页面的目的地用 Breadcrumb 或 NavigationMenu；Toc 只表达同一页内的位置。
composition: items 可以手写，也可以用 useTocHeadings 从容器里扫描 h2/h3[id]（Prose 渲染的标题天然满足）。
current 可以手动受控，也可以用 useTocScrollSpy 按滚动位置计算；两者都是可选项，不用也能渲染一份纯目录。
纵向导航线复用 src/nav-line.ts 的机制（与 Tabs、NavigationMenu 的横向导航线同源，只换轴向）。

library: 目录的排版、层级缩进、当前项的视觉表达。
application: 标题的真实 id、滚动容器、吸顶偏移、是否需要目录（少于两项时渲染与否）。

responsive: 条目纵向紧排，不加 touch-target（会盖住上下条目），用内边距撑开命中区。
customization: 使用公开 render/ref/className/style 与原生属性；不混用主题三轴。

whenToUse: A long article or documentation page needs quick movement between sections, with visible confirmation of the current one.
avoid: A single destination makes no table of contents; the caller decides whether to render one (Toc itself only withholds rendering when items is empty).
Use Breadcrumb or NavigationMenu for destinations across pages; Toc only expresses position within the current page.
composition: items can be written by hand, or scanned from a container's h2/h3[id] with useTocHeadings (headings Prose renders already satisfy this).
current can be controlled manually or computed from scroll position with useTocScrollSpy; both are optional — a plain table of contents renders without either.
The vertical nav line reuses src/nav-line.ts's mechanism (the same source as Tabs' and NavigationMenu's horizontal nav line, just a different axis).

library: The table of contents' layout, level indent, and the current item's visual expression.
application: Headings' actual ids, the scroll container, sticky-header offsets, and whether a table of contents is needed at all.

responsive: Items sit in a tight vertical stack without touch-target (it would cover adjacent items); padding alone widens the hit area.

api.name: Toc
api.description: 目录容器；渲染为 nav，没有条目时不渲染。
api.descriptionEn: The table of contents container; renders as nav, and renders nothing when there are no items.

props.name: items
props.description: 目的地列表；id 对应页面上真实存在的锚点。
props.descriptionEn: The destination list; id must match an anchor that actually exists on the page.

props.name: current
props.description: 当前所在目的地的 id；缺省时没有条目带 aria-current。
props.descriptionEn: The id of the current destination; omitted means no item carries aria-current.

props.name: render / ref / className / style / 原生属性
props.nameEn: render / ref / className / style / native props
props.description: 属性、事件与 ref 透传实际元素。
props.descriptionEn: Forward attributes, events and refs to the actual element.

api.name: scanTocHeadings(root, selector?)
api.description: 从一段已渲染内容里直接读出标题，不是 React hook；selector 默认 ":is(h2,h3)[id]"。
api.descriptionEn: Reads headings directly from already-rendered content; not a React hook. selector defaults to ":is(h2,h3)[id]".

api.name: useTocHeadings(containerRef, selector?)
api.description: scanTocHeadings 的 React 封装：内容变化（含异步加载）时用 MutationObserver 重新扫描。
api.descriptionEn: A React wrapper around scanTocHeadings: rescans via MutationObserver when content changes, including asynchronous loads.

api.name: useTocScrollSpy(items, { container?, offset? })
api.description: 按滚动位置计算当前目的地；container 缺省为 window，组件不猜测页面用了哪个滚动容器。
api.descriptionEn: Computes the current destination from scroll position; container defaults to window — the hook never guesses which element actually scrolls.

keyboard.description: 在原生锚点之间移动焦点。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move focus between the native anchors.

keyboard.description: 跳转到对应锚点。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Jump to the corresponding anchor.

notes: 当前项不改字重，只加深线段与文字墨色，避免整排因变宽而跳动。
强制颜色（高对比度）下当前项另加一道下划线：边线被系统统一着色后不再区分当前项。
二级目录到基线 = 组内间隔；三级在此基础上再加层级缩进（--qy-level-indent），两个既有关系相加，不是新值。
notesEn: The current item does not change font weight; only the line segment and text ink deepen, so the row never shifts width.
In forced colors (high contrast) the current item also gets an underline: once the system recolors every border, the line no longer tells the current item apart.
Level 2 sits one relationship gap from the baseline; level 3 adds the existing level indent on top — two existing relationships added together, not a new value.

metadata.title: 切换组 ToggleGroup
metadata.description: 关联一组单选或多选的切换按钮：选项保持切换状态。
metadata.descriptionEn: A shared single or multiple set of toggles whose pressed fact persists.

api.name: ToggleGroup
api.description: 单选与多选都使用数组；单选允许取消成 []。
api.descriptionEn: Both single/multiple modes use arrays; single permits clearing to [].

props.name: multiple
props.description: false 为 single，最多切换一项；true 为 multiple，可切换多项。
props.descriptionEn: false is single with at most one pressed item; true permits multiple pressed items.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: 两种模式都是值数组，single 不是 string。[] 表示全部松开。
props.descriptionEn: Both modes hold value arrays; single is not a string. [] means all released.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: 传出完整切换值数组；支持 details.cancel()。
props.descriptionEn: Supplies the complete pressed-value array; supports details.cancel().

props.name: orientation / loopFocus
props.description: 方向键焦点轴与是否在末项循环。焦点移动本身不改变值。
props.descriptionEn: Arrow focus axis and end wrapping; moving focus alone never changes values.

props.name: disabled / size
props.description: 禁用全组；size 默认 md，供项继承，可由项显式改写。
props.descriptionEn: Disable the whole group. size defaults to md and items may explicitly override it.

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby / render / ref
props.description: 共同名称与根部位，透传样式与原生事件。
props.descriptionEn: Shared name/root composition; forward styles and native events.

api.name: ToggleGroupItem
api.description: 有唯一 value 的 Toggle，继承组的尺寸与原语状态。
api.descriptionEn: A uniquely valued Toggle inheriting group size and primitive states.

props.name: value
props.description: 组内唯一标识，必填。
props.descriptionEn: Required unique group identifier.

props.name: disabled / shape / size / render / ref
props.description: 项的限制、几何及公共组合入口。
props.descriptionEn: Item restrictions, geometry, and public composition.

api.name: ToggleGroupPrimitive
api.description: Base UI 切换组原语；项原语由 TogglePrimitive 导出。
api.descriptionEn: Base UI pressed-group primitive; TogglePrimitive exports the item primitive.

keyboard.description: 保留组的一个焦点停靠点。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Retain one group tab stop.

keyboard.description: 沿 orientation 移动焦点，跳过禁用项；loopFocus 决定是否循环。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move along orientation, skip disabled items, and wrap according to loopFocus.

keyboard.description: 改变当前项的切换事实。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Change the current item's pressed fact.

notes: 没有 name 或隐藏表单值；需要提交的互斥值使用 SegmentedControl。
single 允许全部松开；不能用它冒充必选 radio。
notesEn: No name or hidden form value. Use SegmentedControl for submitted mutually exclusive values.
Single allows all items to be released; it cannot impersonate required radio selection.
metadata.decisions: 按下项是选中面（清染）加焦墨字，未按下项字为浓墨，字重不变；它不用主操作的填充，所以品牌覆写 --qy-primary 不会改变它。要调整，改系统的选中面 --qy-surface-selected（全库的选中一起变；--qy-track-selected 只是它的别名）与 --qy-track-selected-foreground。
metadata.decisionsEn: A pressed item is a light ink wash with ink text and unpressed items use muted ink, with the same weight. It does not use the primary action fill, so overriding --qy-primary does not change it. To adjust it, change the system selected surface --qy-surface-selected (every selected state follows; --qy-track-selected is only its alias) and --qy-track-selected-foreground.

whenToUse: 同一范围的二态工具按钮
允许全部取消的单选或多选切换
avoid: 表单互斥值用 SegmentedControl
面板视角用 Tabs
composition: ToggleGroup + ToggleGroupItem；组的名称必须说明共同范围

library: 非受控值数组、roving focus、切换
application: 受控数组、选项、相关内容

responsive: 水平方向可以换行，纵向沿上下轴导航；浏览器布局未在本批验证
customization: 按下项读 --qy-track-selected 与 --qy-track-selected-foreground（默认清染 + 焦墨），不借用 --qy-primary；未按下项字为浓墨；既有同名五档

whenToUse: Binary tool buttons in a shared scope.
Single/multiple pressed selection permitting all items to be released.
avoid: Use SegmentedControl for mutually exclusive form values.
Use Tabs for panel views.
composition: ToggleGroup + ToggleGroupItem; its name identifies the shared scope.

library: Uncontrolled value arrays, roving focus, and pressed states.
application: Controlled arrays, options, and associated content.

responsive: Horizontal layouts may wrap; vertical navigation follows up/down. Browser layout was not verified in this batch.
customization: Pressed items read --qy-track-selected and --qy-track-selected-foreground (light ink wash and ink text by default), not --qy-primary; unpressed items use muted ink; existing five matching profiles.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 切换按钮 Toggle
metadata.description: 保持名称的二态切换按钮：按下后保持，直到再次切换。
metadata.descriptionEn: A two-state toggle that holds its pressed fact until toggled again, with a stable name.

api.name: Toggle
api.description: 独立的 pressed 布尔事实。
api.descriptionEn: An independent pressed boolean fact.

props.name: pressed / defaultPressed
props.description: 受控事实或非受控初值。默认未切换（未按下）。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled state or uncontrolled initial value; un-toggled by default.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: 提供切换事实，可用 details.cancel() 取消。
props.descriptionEn: Supplies pressed facts, cancelable through details.cancel().

props.name: size
props.description: 五档 control 与同名 text-control，窄屏 +4px。
props.descriptionEn: Five matching control/text-control profiles with narrow-screen +4px.

props.name: shape
props.description: 文字与图标几何；纯图标按钮必须有可访问名称。
props.descriptionEn: Text/icon geometry; icon-only buttons need an accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: 原生禁用，无法改变 pressed。
props.descriptionEn: Native disabling prevents pressed changes.

props.name: value
props.description: 仅在 ToggleGroup 内标识该项；独立 Toggle 的状态仍是 boolean，不是表单值输入。
props.descriptionEn: Identifies an item only within ToggleGroup. Standalone Toggle still holds a boolean rather than a form value.

props.name: render / nativeButton / ref / className / style
props.description: 保留元素、ARIA、事件和原语样式回调。
props.descriptionEn: Retain element, ARIA, events, and primitive style callbacks.

api.name: TogglePrimitive
api.description: Base UI 切换原语公共出口。
api.descriptionEn: Public Base UI pressed-state primitive.

keyboard.description: 到达可用按钮。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach available buttons.

keyboard.description: 在 pressed 与 unpressed 之间切换。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Toggle pressed/unpressed.

notes: 名称不随 pressed 改写，aria-pressed 表达状态。
pressed 不表示保存、请求或持久化已完成。
布尔表单值用 Checkbox，即时开关用 Switch。
notesEn: Names stay stable; aria-pressed expresses state.
Pressed does not establish saved, requested, or persisted completion.
Use Checkbox for boolean form values and Switch for immediate settings.
metadata.decisions: 按下的 Toggle 在线内填选中面（清染）、字为焦墨，不用主操作的填充，所以品牌覆写 --qy-primary 不会改变它；要调整按下的样子，改系统的选中面 --qy-surface-selected（全库的选中一起变；--qy-track-selected 只是它的别名）与 --qy-track-selected-foreground。
metadata.decisionsEn: A pressed Toggle fills light ink inside its line with ink text and does not use the primary action fill, so overriding --qy-primary does not change it. To adjust how pressed looks, change the system selected surface --qy-surface-selected (every selected state follows; --qy-track-selected is only its alias) and --qy-track-selected-foreground.

whenToUse: 稳定名称的二态工具按钮
avoid: 单次动作使用 Button
表单布尔值使用 Checkbox
异步结果不由 Toggle 推断
composition: 可组合进 ToggleGroup；图标必须给 aria-label

library: 非受控 pressed、切换、焦点
application: 受控 pressed、相关内容、持久化

responsive: 既有 control 五档和 touch-target；实际命中未在本批浏览器验证
customization: 未切换与已切换都是 bordered（线不变）；已切换在线内填 --qy-track-selected、字为 --qy-track-selected-foreground（默认清染 + 焦墨），不借用 --qy-primary；复用 Button 的几何与焦点角色

whenToUse: Binary tool buttons with stable names.
avoid: Use Button for one-time actions.
Use Checkbox for boolean form values.
Toggle cannot infer asynchronous outcomes.
composition: Can compose in ToggleGroup; icons require aria-label.

library: Uncontrolled pressed state, activation, and focus.
application: Controlled pressed state, associated content, and persistence.

responsive: Existing five control profiles and touch-target; actual hit areas were not browser-verified in this batch.
customization: Both states are bordered with an unchanged line; pressed fills inside the line with --qy-track-selected and ink text from --qy-track-selected-foreground (light ink wash by default), not --qy-primary; shares Button geometry and focus roles.

metadata.title: 工具组 Toolbar
metadata.description: 真实分组、方向键焦点与可执行操作。
metadata.descriptionEn: Actual groups, arrow-key focus and operable actions.
metadata.decisions: Base UI Toolbar 接管 roving focus 与组禁用；按钮默认组合当前 Button，链接保留导航，应用提供操作名称与选中事实。
metadata.decisionsEn: Base UI Toolbar owns roving focus and group disabling. Buttons compose current Button; links retain navigation; action names and selection facts belong to the application.

whenToUse: 持续的相关操作需要一个键盘进入点与方向键导航。
avoid: 普通并列按钮用 ButtonGroup；目的地集合用导航链接。

library: Base UI roving focus、方向、组禁用与事件保护。
application: 操作名称、真实选中/禁用状态及执行结果。

responsive: 横向操作可换行，垂直方向使用对应方向键。

whenToUse: Persistent related actions need one keyboard entry with arrow navigation.
avoid: Use ButtonGroup for ordinary adjacent actions and links for destinations.

library: Base UI roving focus, orientation, group disabling, and event guards.
application: Action names, actual selected/disabled states, and execution outcomes.

responsive: Horizontal actions may wrap; vertical layouts use corresponding arrows.

api.name: Toolbar
api.description: Base UI Toolbar.Root。
api.descriptionEn: Base UI Toolbar.Root.

props.name: orientation / loopFocus / disabled / aria-label / render / ref
props.description: 应用为工具组命名；方向决定键盘移动轴。
props.descriptionEn: The application names the toolbar; orientation sets the arrow-key axis.

api.name: ToolbarGroup
api.description: 命名与禁用一组相关操作。
api.descriptionEn: Name and disable related actions together.

props.name: disabled / aria-label / render / ref / native props
props.description: 禁用事实传给组内真实操作。
props.descriptionEn: Disabled state reaches actual controls inside the group.

api.name: ToolbarButton
api.description: 真实命令；默认组合 Button。
api.descriptionEn: An actual command that composes Button by default.

props.name: size / variant
props.description: 复用基础层尺寸和表面预设。
props.descriptionEn: Reuse foundation size and surface presets.

props.name: disabled / focusableWhenDisabled / render / ref / nativeButton
props.description: 自定义 render 时提供合法按钮或成熟触发器，保留焦点与事件链。
props.descriptionEn: Custom renders must supply a valid button or mature trigger and retain the focus and event chain.

api.name: ToolbarLink / ToolbarSeparator
api.description: 真实 a 与方向相关组分界。
api.descriptionEn: A real anchor and orientation-aware group separator.

props.name: href / orientation / render / ref / primitive props
props.description: 链接导航；分隔符不生成操作。
props.descriptionEn: Links navigate; separators generate no command.

keyboard.description: 进入或离开整个工具组。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Enter or leave the whole toolbar.

keyboard.description: 由 Base UI 按方向移动焦点。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Base UI moves focus along the toolbar orientation.

keyboard.description: 执行实际命令。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Activate the actual command.

notes: 只为持续的相关操作使用 Toolbar；普通多个按钮可以用 ButtonGroup。
notesEn: Use Toolbar for persistent related operations; ordinary button collections may use ButtonGroup.

metadata.title: 文字提示 Tooltip
metadata.description: 悬停或聚焦时阅读快捷键、格式与短解释。
metadata.descriptionEn: Read shortcuts, formats and brief context on hover or focus.
metadata.decisions: 名称来自控件自己的文字或 aria-label；提示只补充。关键后果、禁用原因与失败后的恢复说明留在可见内容中。
metadata.decisionsEn: Controls supply their own text or aria-label. Hints supplement it. Keep consequences, disabled reasons and recovery instructions visible.

api.name: TooltipProvider
api.description: 共享指针延迟。键盘聚焦立即展开。
api.descriptionEn: Share pointer delays. Keyboard focus opens immediately.

props.name: delay
props.description: 首次悬停等待毫秒数，原语预设，可由应用覆盖。
props.descriptionEn: Initial hover delay in milliseconds; an overridable primitive preset.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: 离开触发者和提示后的等待时间。
props.descriptionEn: Delay after leaving both trigger and hint.

props.name: timeout
props.description: 连续提示立即展开的共享窗口，原语预设。
props.descriptionEn: Shared instant-opening window in milliseconds, a primitive preset.

api.name: Tooltip
api.description: 非阻断打开状态。提示可被悬停，不接收交互内容。
api.descriptionEn: Non-modal open state. Hints remain hoverable and contain no interactive controls.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: 受控 / 非受控打开。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled / uncontrolled open state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: 接收实际请求与原因；受控值由应用决定。
props.descriptionEn: Receive requests and reasons; the application owns controlled state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: 停用提示，不停用触发控件的动作。
props.descriptionEn: Disable hints while leaving the trigger's action available.

props.name: disableHoverablePopup
props.description: 类型保留兼容；包装始终使用 false，满足可悬停约束。
props.descriptionEn: Retained in the type for compatibility; the wrapper always uses false to keep hints hoverable.

props.name: trackCursorAxis
props.description: both 归一为 none，以保留指针移入提示的通路；其余取值透传。
props.descriptionEn: both is normalized to none to preserve pointer access to the hint; other values are forwarded.

props.name: handle / triggerId / defaultTriggerId
props.description: 关联共享触发者及受控或初始展开。
props.descriptionEn: Associate shared triggers and controlled or initial opening.

api.name: TooltipTrigger
api.description: 支持 render、ref、事件、ARIA 和按状态求值的 className。
api.descriptionEn: Supports render, refs, events, ARIA and state-based classes.

props.name: render
props.description: 必填：被提示的那个控件本身（Button、链接、菜单触发器）。提示只附在它上面，children 成为它的内容。
props.descriptionEn: Required: the control being hinted (a Button, link, or menu trigger). The hint attaches to it and children become its content.

props.name: delay / closeDelay
props.description: 覆盖当前触发者的指针延迟。
props.descriptionEn: Override pointer delays for this trigger.

props.name: disabled
props.description: 仅停用提示。原生禁用动作通过 render 的控件声明。
props.descriptionEn: Disable hints only. Set native action disabling on the rendered control.

api.name: TooltipPopup / TooltipContent
api.description: 提示正文与定位。可换行；入退由 motion.css 管理。
api.descriptionEn: Hint text and positioning with wrapping. motion.css owns entry and exit.

props.name: side / align
props.description: 原语默认位置，空间不足时自动翻转。
props.descriptionEn: Primitive positioning defaults with collision handling.

props.name: sideOffset / alignOffset / anchor
props.description: 相对锚点的显式位置关系。
props.descriptionEn: Explicit positioning relative to the anchor.

props.name: portalProps
props.description: container 可保留局部语言、方向和密度。默认挂到 body。
props.descriptionEn: Set container to retain local language, direction and density; default portal target is body.

props.name: positionerProps
props.description: 自身公开定位层透传 render/ref/事件及状态样式；共享 popup 层级先合并，调用方 style 后合并。
props.descriptionEn: Forward render, refs, events and state styles to its own Positioner, merging caller styles after shared popup layers.

api.name: TooltipCreateHandle / TooltipPrimitive
api.description: 共享触发者的类型化 handle 与 Base UI 公共原语。
api.descriptionEn: Typed shared-trigger handles and the public Base UI namespace.

keyboard.description: 聚焦即显示，离开时关闭；不困住焦点。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Show on focus and close on leaving without trapping focus.

keyboard.description: 收起提示，焦点保持当前触发者。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Dismiss while retaining focus on the trigger.

notes: 纯图标按钮自带 aria-label；打开时 aria-describedby 关联提示，保留已有说明。
提示只承载短文本。需要点击帮助或交互内容时用 Popover，需要持续依据时用正文。
直接 render 的 disabled 控件同时停用提示；render 函数/自定义控件内部禁用须同步 Trigger.disabled。禁用原因直接可见。
触发器不自带控件：提示附在调用方给出的控件上。该控件必须能获得键盘焦点，所以不是 span。
notesEn: Icon buttons supply aria-label. While open, aria-describedby links the hint and preserves existing descriptions.
Use short text only. Use Popover for click help or interactive content, and visible text for persistent information.
Directly rendered disabled controls also disable hints. Synchronize Trigger.disabled for disabling inside render functions or custom controls. Keep the reason visible.
The trigger brings no control of its own: the hint attaches to the caller's control, which must be keyboard focusable, so it is not a span.

whenToUse: 在已可辨认的对象或动作旁补充快捷键、格式或简短上下文。
avoid: 唯一名称、唯一关键后果、禁用原因、失败恢复或可交互内容。
composition: 控件自带名称；Tooltip 关联补充文字；持续结果放在对象旁。

library: 聚焦/悬停展开、关联、延迟、定位与 Esc。
application: 补充内容与受控 open。

responsive: 按原语可用宽度换行；控制文字保留窄屏角色，必要信息始终可见。
customization: 应用根共享延迟；使用已有表面、阴影和圆角 token。

whenToUse: Add shortcuts, format information, or brief context beside an identifiable object/action.
avoid: Sole names, sole critical consequences, disabled reasons, failure recovery, or interactive content.
composition: Controls have their own names; Tooltip associates supplementary text. Persistent outcomes stay beside objects.

library: Focus/hover opening, associations, delays, positioning, and Escape.
application: Supplementary content and controlled open state.

responsive: Wrap within primitive available width; control text retains narrow roles and necessary information stays visible.
customization: Shared root delays and existing surface/shadow/radius tokens.
