metadata.title: 树形选择 TreeSelect
metadata.description: 在弹层里的树上选一个节点，或勾选若干叶子。
metadata.descriptionEn: Choose one node, or check several leaves, on a tree inside a popup.

api.name: TreeSelect
api.description: 触发器、弹层里的 Tree 与表单值。触发器与 Select、Cascader 同一套几何；弹层用 Popover 的面板。
api.descriptionEn: Trigger, the Tree inside the popup, and the form value. The trigger shares Select and Cascader's geometry; the popup uses Popover's panel.

props.name: nodes
props.description: 沿用 Tree 的节点：id 全树唯一、label 非空；disabled 的节点不可选。
props.descriptionEn: Tree's own nodes: ids are unique across the tree and labels are nonempty; disabled nodes cannot be chosen.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: 单选是所选节点的 id（分支也可被选），null 是未选择；选中即提交并关闭，重选同一节点只关闭。多选是已勾选的叶子 id，勾选不关闭，回调里的 ids 按树的顺序。回调的 details 与 Tree 同形，cancel() 后不提交（单选时弹层也保持打开）。
props.descriptionEn: Single holds the chosen node's id (a branch can be chosen) and null is no selection; choosing commits and closes, and choosing the same node only closes. Multiple holds the checked leaf ids; checking does not close, and the ids in the callback follow the tree's order. The callback's details have Tree's shape; after cancel() nothing is committed (and in single mode the popup stays open).

props.name: multiple
props.description: 为 true 时使用 Tree 的 checkable：勾选分支会勾上它启用的叶子，部分勾选显示 mixed，禁用的叶子保持原状。
props.descriptionEn: With true the Tree is checkable: checking a branch checks its enabled leaves, a partial state shows mixed, and disabled leaves keep their state.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: 仅未选择时显示；不能替代 FieldLabel。
props.descriptionEn: Shown only without selection; cannot replace FieldLabel.

props.name: disabled / readOnly / required
props.description: 只读保留当前值且不打开弹层；禁用的字段不提交；required 参与原生校验并标 aria-required。invalid 跟随 Field。
props.descriptionEn: Read-only keeps the value and never opens the popup; a disabled field is not submitted; required joins native validation and sets aria-required. invalid follows Field.

props.name: name / form
props.description: 隐藏输入的名称与所属表单。单选提交所选 id，未选择提交空字符串；多选每个已选 id 一条同名值，未选择不提交（required 时拦下提交）。
props.descriptionEn: Name and owning form of the hidden input. Single submits the chosen id, or an empty string when nothing is chosen; multiple submits one value per chosen id and nothing when empty (required blocks submission).

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby / id / className
props.description: 触发器与弹层里树的名称、触发器的样式入口。没有名称会抛错：用 aria-label、aria-labelledby，或放进带 FieldLabel 的 Field。
props.descriptionEn: Name of the trigger and of the tree in the popup, and the trigger's styling entry. A missing name throws: use aria-label, aria-labelledby, or place it in a Field with a FieldLabel.

keyboard.description: 在触发器上打开弹层，焦点落在已选节点（多选是第一个已勾选的叶子，都没有则是第一个节点），其祖先已展开。
keyboard.descriptionEn: On the trigger, open the popup with focus on the chosen node (the first checked leaf in multiple mode, otherwise the first node) and its ancestors expanded.

keyboard.description: 同 Tree：在可见节点间移动，← → 收起、展开或进出父子，键入标签开头跳转。
keyboard.descriptionEn: As in Tree: move between visible nodes, ← → collapse, expand or move to parent and child, and typing the start of a label jumps to it.

keyboard.description: 单选：选中并关闭，焦点回触发器。多选：Space 勾选或取消勾选，弹层保持打开。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Single: choose and close with focus back on the trigger. Multiple: Space checks or unchecks and the popup stays open.

keyboard.description: 关闭并回到触发器，保留原值。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Close and return to the trigger, retaining the value.

notes: 不做搜索与异步加载：键入标签开头可跳转，节点由调用方一次给全。
触发器是 combobox，弹出的是 tree（aria-haspopup="tree"）。多选时触发器列出已选叶子的名称，超过两项写成「首项及其余 N 项」，其余仍在树里可见。
notesEn: No search and no async loading: typing the start of a label jumps to it, and the caller provides all nodes at once.

The trigger is a combobox and the popup a tree (aria-haspopup="tree"). In multiple mode the trigger lists the checked leaves; beyond two it reads "first and N more", and the rest stay visible in the tree.
metadata.decisions: 单选的值是节点 id，分支也可以被选；多选的值只含叶子 id，分支的勾选是派生显示，与 Tree 的 checkable 同一约定，所以「勾一个分支」不会被多计成 N+1 项。展开状态由 TreeSelect 持有并在每次打开时按已选节点重算，因为弹层关闭会卸载 Tree。
metadata.decisionsEn: The single value is a node id and a branch can be chosen; the multiple value holds leaf ids only, and a branch's check is a derived display, the same convention as Tree's checkable, so checking one branch is never miscounted as N+1 items. TreeSelect owns the expansion and recomputes it from the chosen nodes on every open, because closing the popup unmounts the Tree.

whenToUse: 候选天然成层、值是其中某个节点或若干叶子：部门、组织、类目
avoid: 只有一层候选用 Select，候选很多需过滤用 Combobox
沿一条路径逐级选择、要把整条路径作为值时用 Cascader
树本身就是页面内容、不需要收进触发器时直接用 Tree
composition: FieldLabel + TreeSelect + FieldDescription + FieldError

library: 焦点、展开状态、未受控值
application: 受控值、节点数据、invalid 与保存事实

responsive: 弹层跟随可用高度滚动；本批只做桌面检查
customization: 触发器 className、Popover 的面板与定位

whenToUse: Candidates that naturally nest and the value is one node or several leaves: departments, organizations, categories.
avoid: Use Select for a single level and Combobox when many candidates need filtering.
Use Cascader when choosing level by level and the whole path is the value.
Use Tree directly when the tree is itself page content and need not fold into a trigger.
composition: FieldLabel + TreeSelect + FieldDescription + FieldError.

library: Focus, expansion, and the uncontrolled value.
application: Controlled values, node data, invalid and save facts.

responsive: The popup scrolls with the available height; this batch checked desktop only.
customization: Trigger className, Popover's panel and positioning.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 层级集合 Tree
metadata.description: 稳定节点的层级、展开、焦点、独立单选与可选的级联勾选。
metadata.descriptionEn: Hierarchy, expansion, focus, independent single selection, and an optional cascading checkable mode for stable nodes.
metadata.decisions: expandedIds 与 selectedId 分开；聚焦不选择，隐藏节点不强行清除既有选择。checkable 与 selectable 的点击不组合：checkable 为 true 时行点击与 Space 勾选，不再单选，避免同一次点击承担两种互相冲突的意图。checkedIds 只含叶子节点 id；分支的勾选是派生显示（true / false / mixed），从不写回值，避免「勾一个分支」被多计成 N+1 项。级联只触达启用的叶子：禁用节点保留给定的勾选事实，不被祖先的勾选/取消改变；分支在其启用的叶子后代全部勾选时显示为已勾选，即使存在未勾选的禁用后代。
metadata.decisionsEn: Expanded IDs and selected ID are separate; focus never selects, and hidden nodes do not automatically clear selection. Checkable and selectable clicks do not combine: when checkable is true, row clicks and Space toggle the check instead of selecting, so one click never carries two conflicting intents. checkedIds holds only leaf ids; a branch's checked state is a derived display (true / false / mixed) and is never written back into the value, so checking one branch cannot be miscounted as N+1 items. Cascade only touches enabled leaves: a disabled node keeps the checked fact it was given and cascade from an ancestor never changes it; a branch displays as fully checked once every one of its enabled leaf descendants is checked, even with unchecked disabled descendants remaining.

api.name: Tree
api.description: 完整层级集合。
api.descriptionEn: A complete hierarchical collection.

props.name: nodes
props.description: id/label 必须非空且 id 全树唯一；disabled 与 children 显式提供。
props.descriptionEn: IDs and labels must be nonempty; IDs are unique across the tree. Disabled and children are explicit.

props.name: expandedIds / defaultExpandedIds / onExpandedChange
props.description: 展开独立于选择；details.cancel() 不提交。
props.descriptionEn: Expansion is independent of selection; details.cancel() prevents commit.

props.name: selectedId / defaultSelectedId / onSelectionChange
props.description: 单选独立于焦点，可取消；不猜测业务状态。
props.descriptionEn: Single selection is independent of focus and cancellable; no business state is inferred.

props.name: selectable / disabled / emptyContent
props.description: 默认 selectable=true；空树可聚焦，内容由调用方或 locale 提供。
props.descriptionEn: Selectable defaults to true; empty trees remain focusable with caller or locale content.

props.name: checkable
props.description: 开启级联多选勾选模式；默认 false。为 true 时行点击与 Space 勾选当前节点，selectable 的单选点击不再生效。
props.descriptionEn: Turns on cascading checkable mode; defaults to false. When true, row clicks and Space toggle the checked state instead of selectable's single-select click.

props.name: checkedIds / defaultCheckedIds / onCheckedChange
props.description: 只含叶子节点 id；details.cancel() 不提交。勾选一个分支会把它启用的叶子后代一并加入或移出集合；禁用的叶子保留给定事实，不被级联改变。
props.descriptionEn: Holds only leaf ids; details.cancel() prevents commit. Checking a branch adds or removes its enabled leaf descendants together; a disabled leaf keeps the fact it was given and cascade never changes it.

props.name: defaultFocusedId
props.description: 首次渲染时 roving 入口所在的节点，默认是第一个可用节点；节点不可见或不可用时退回最近的可见可用祖先。展开其祖先由调用方通过 expandedIds 负责。TreeSelect 用它让弹层打开时焦点落在已选节点上。
props.descriptionEn: The node holding the roving entry on first render, the first enabled node by default; a hidden or disabled node falls back to its nearest visible enabled ancestor. Expanding its ancestors is the caller's job through expandedIds. TreeSelect uses it to land focus on the chosen node when its popup opens.

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby
props.description: 必填其一：树的名称，落在 role=tree 的根上；缺失或为空时抛错。各节点的名称来自节点自己的 label。
props.descriptionEn: One is required: the name of the tree, on the role=tree root. A missing or blank name throws. Each item is named by its own label.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

notes: 移除焦点节点回到可用节点；清空回到拥有焦点的容器，不抢走外部焦点。
notesEn: Removing a focused node finds an enabled fallback; clearing returns owned focus to the container without stealing outside focus.

whenToUse: 真实层级需要键盘定位和独立选择。
avoid: 平面比较用 DataTable；不内置懒加载或请求。收进触发器的选择用 TreeSelect。
同一棵树里混用 checkable 与 selectable 的点击语义：一次点击只承担一种意图。

library: roving focus、稳定 key 与焦点恢复。
application: 节点、展开、选择、禁用与空/未知语义。

responsive: 桌面保持真实结构；菜单受可用空间限制，表格保留完整比较列。
customization: 控件档案、间距和浮层表面消费现有角色；具体外观是预设。

whenToUse: An actual hierarchy needs keyboard positioning and independent selection.
avoid: Use DataTable for flat comparison; no built-in lazy loading or requests. Use TreeSelect for a choice folded into a trigger.
Mixing checkable and selectable click semantics on the same tree; one click carries one intent.

library: Roving focus, stable keys, and focus recovery.
application: Nodes, expansion, selection, disabled, and empty/unknown semantics.

responsive: Keep actual desktop structure; menus fit available space and tables retain complete comparison columns.
customization: Control profiles, spacing, and popup surfaces consume existing roles; their appearance is a preset.

keyboard.description: 在可见且可用节点间移动。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move between visible enabled nodes.

keyboard.description: 关闭/展开或移动到父/子节点；RTL 相反。展开与收起由方向键承担；行首的展开图标只供指针使用，不进 Tab 序列，也不进可访问树。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Collapse/expand or move to parent/child; reversed in RTL. Expansion belongs to the arrow keys; the chevron at the row start is for pointers only and is outside both the Tab sequence and the accessibility tree.

keyboard.description: 单选当前节点，或键入标签开头定位：连续键入的字符（间隔 500ms 内，预设）累积成前缀；重复键入同一个字符则在以它开头的节点间循环。checkable 模式下 Space 改为勾选/取消勾选当前节点及其启用的叶子后代，Enter 不触发单选。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Select the current node, or type the start of a label to move: characters typed in quick succession (within 500ms, a preset) accumulate into a prefix, and repeating one character cycles through nodes starting with it. In checkable mode, Space toggles the current node and its enabled leaf descendants instead, and Enter does not select.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 排版 Typography
metadata.description: 标题层级、正文、辅助文字与数值共用已有文字档；语义标签与视觉档独立选择。
metadata.descriptionEn: Headings, body copy, supporting text and numbers use the existing text steps. Semantics and visual size are independent.
metadata.decisions: level 决定 h1–h6，step 决定视觉档。render 改变实际语义；中文依 lang 使用正常字距，numeric 不格式化值。
metadata.decisionsEn: level determines h1–h6 and step selects appearance. render changes actual semantics; language controls CJK tracking and numeric does not format values.

api.name: Code
api.description: 正文里的一段代码：等宽字，字号为所在文字的 0.875 倍并取整像素，墨的柔底，跟随所在那一行。
api.descriptionEn: Code within running text: monospace at 0.875 of the surrounding size rounded to whole pixels, on the ink soft fill, following its line.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 属性与 ref 透传原生 code 元素。
props.descriptionEn: Forward attributes and refs to the native code element.

api.name: Heading
api.description: 真实标题，层级与字号分离。
api.descriptionEn: A real heading with independent outline level and visual step.

props.name: level
props.description: 文档大纲中的标题级别。
props.descriptionEn: Heading level in the document outline.

props.name: step
props.description: src/text-steps.ts 中已有档；不由 level 推断。
props.descriptionEn: An existing TextStep, independent of level.

props.name: numeric
props.description: 应用既有等宽数字规则。
props.descriptionEn: Apply the existing tabular figure utility.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 最终标签决定可访问语义；透传 lang、事件和样式。
props.descriptionEn: The final tag determines semantics; language, events and styles are forwarded.

api.name: Text
api.description: 正文、辅助说明或数值；默认 p。
api.descriptionEn: Body copy, supporting text or numbers; defaults to p.

props.name: step
props.description: 如 reading、support、caption、metric；不新增文字档。
props.descriptionEn: For example reading, support, caption or metric; no additional ramp.

props.name: numeric
props.description: 等宽数字；未知与空值由应用如实呈现。
props.descriptionEn: Tabular figures; the application preserves unknown and empty values.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 内联文字 render 成 span。颜色默认继承。
props.descriptionEn: Render as span for inline text. Color inherits by default.

notes: 字号、行高、字重和字距是当前主题预设，不是由理念唯一推导。
标题档（display-xl、display-lg、display、title、chapter、heading）带 text-wrap: balance，折行时各行长度相近、不留孤字；正文与说明不加（pretty 尚未被各浏览器普遍支持，留作观察），不支持的浏览器回落为普通换行。PageHeaderTitle、EmptyTitle 同样均衡。
中文容器标记 lang=zh-CN；混排与长词保留内容并换行。
辅助文字仍按普通文字验证对比；numeric 不把待核实变成 0。
notesEn: Font size, leading, weight and tracking are theme presets, not unique deductions.

Heading steps (display-xl, display-lg, display, title, chapter, heading) use text-wrap: balance so wrapped lines are of similar length without a lone last word; body and supporting copy do not (pretty is not yet broadly supported and stays under observation), and unsupported browsers fall back to ordinary wrapping. PageHeaderTitle and EmptyTitle balance too.
Mark Chinese containers with lang=zh-CN; mixed content and long words wrap without losing text.
Supporting copy still needs normal text contrast; numeric never replaces unknown with zero.

whenToUse: 复用文字档同时保留真实标题大纲、正文或数值语义。
avoid: 通过字号推断标题层级；把未知写成零；裁切关键后果。
composition: Heading + Text + Layout 形成内容关系；内联文字 render 成 span。

library: 文字档接线、正常换行与数字表现。
application: 标题大纲、内容、语言与数值事实。

customization: 集中主题修改文字档；特殊职责才单项覆写。
responsive: support/dense/control 继续接已有 mobile 档；页面按裁决仅验桌面。

whenToUse: Reuse text profiles while retaining actual heading outlines, prose, or numeric semantics.
avoid: Heading levels inferred from size, unknown as zero, or clipped critical consequences.
composition: Heading + Text + Layout establish content relationships; render inline text as span.

library: Text profiles, ordinary wrapping, and number presentation.
application: Heading outlines, content, language, and numeric facts.

customization: The central theme owns text profiles; override individual roles only for specific responsibilities.
responsive: support/dense/control retain existing mobile profiles; page checks were desktop only by decision.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 虚拟列表 VirtualList
metadata.description: 以稳定项身份呈现等高或动态高度长集合，保留阅读位置与正在编辑的内容。
metadata.descriptionEn: Window fixed or measured-height collections while retaining the reading position and active editing.

api.name: VirtualList<Item>
api.description: 集合渲染边界，真实 list/listitem，不提供选择、请求或业务列。
api.descriptionEn: Collection rendering boundary with actual list/listitem semantics, without selection, requests, or business columns.

props.name: items / getKey / renderItem
props.description: 真实集合、稳定唯一 key 与内容；重复 key 显式报错。插入、排序时用持久身份，不用位置。
props.descriptionEn: Actual collection, stable unique keys, and content; duplicate keys throw. Use persistent identities across insertion and reordering, rather than positions.

props.name: itemSize / height
props.description: 项外高与视口高，CSS px，均为有限正数。默认固定高度；动态模式中 itemSize 是未测量行的估计值，不限制内容高度。
props.descriptionEn: Outer item height and viewport height in CSS px, both finite and positive. Rows are fixed by default; in dynamic mode itemSize estimates unmeasured rows without constraining their content height.

props.name: measurement
props.description: dynamic 用 ResizeObserver 测量已挂载行的实际 border-box 高度；整行高度应由正常内容流决定，外部 margin 不计入测量。
props.descriptionEn: dynamic uses ResizeObserver to measure each mounted row's actual border-box height. Let normal content flow determine row height; external margins are excluded.

props.name: actionsRef
props.description: 独立动作出口：scrollToIndex(index, { align?: 'auto' | 'start' | 'center' | 'end' }) 与 scrollToEnd()。立即滚动，不转移焦点。非法或越界 index 抛 RangeError；空集合 scrollToEnd 无操作。
props.descriptionEn: Separate actions: scrollToIndex(index, { align?: 'auto' | 'start' | 'center' | 'end' }) and scrollToEnd(). Scroll instantly without moving focus. Invalid or out-of-bounds indices throw RangeError; scrollToEnd is a no-op for empty collections.

props.name: followEnd
props.description: 显式尾部跟随。仅原先停在底部（1 CSS px 容差）时跟随追加项；向上阅读后保持阅读位置，不在初次挂载时跳到底部。
props.descriptionEn: Explicit end following. Follow appended items only when previously at the bottom (within 1 CSS px). Reading history keeps its position, and initial mounting never jumps to the end.

props.name: overscan
props.description: 窗口两侧的渲染预算预设，非负整数；不是视觉尺寸。
props.descriptionEn: A nonnegative integer rendering-budget preset on both window edges, rather than a visual dimension.

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby
props.description: 必填其一：集合的可识别名称，落在 role=list 的滚动视口上；缺失或为空时抛错。
props.descriptionEn: One is required: the identifiable name of the collection, on the role=list scroll viewport. A missing or blank name throws.

props.name: render / ref / style / className / events / ARIA
props.description: ref 仍是原生滚动视口。显式 height 承担视口高度；初始服务端窗口使用它。浏览器默认滚动锚定关闭，由组件统一维持阅读位置。给集合可识别名称。
props.descriptionEn: ref remains the native scroll viewport. Explicit height owns its height and supplies the initial server-rendered window. Browser scroll anchoring is disabled so the component owns reading continuity. Give the collection an identifiable name.

keyboard.description: 到达集合视口与已挂载的内部操作。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach the collection viewport and mounted internal actions.

keyboard.description: 从视口或行本身到相邻/首末真实行，跨窗口滚动挂载；内嵌编辑/按钮键位不被接管。
keyboard.descriptionEn: From the viewport or row, reach adjacent/first/last actual rows across windows. Embedded editing/button keys remain intact.

notes: 固定模式保持 itemSize 契约；内容会换行、展开或流式增长时显式选 dynamic，并给未测量行合理估计。动态跳转可随实际测量修正位置，不承诺平滑滚动。
稳定 key 在前插和排序后保留同一可见项及项内像素偏移；视口上方整行高度变化会补偿滚动。尾部跟随不代替应用的未读计数或加载状态。
键只在 items 或 getKey 变化时派生。滚动时只处理窗口和最多一个保留焦点行，不重新遍历 50,000 项；数据变化或测量更新仍可能更新尺寸缓存。
聚焦行即使离屏也保留挂载；真实移除后焦点回到视口。aria-posinset/setsize 表达完整集合位置。搜索、打印或需要全量辅助技术遍历时改用普通集合或 ScrollArea。
窗口示例的 48px 等高、动态示例的 72px 估计及视口高度均是消费示例选择，修改入口为 itemSize/height；未新增库 token。
notesEn: Fixed mode retains the itemSize contract. Explicitly choose dynamic for wrapping, expanding, or streaming content and provide a reasonable estimate. Dynamic jumps may correct their position as measurements arrive; smooth scrolling is not promised.

Stable keys retain the visible item and within-item pixel offset across prepends and reorders. Height changes of rows entirely above the viewport compensate the scroll offset. Following does not own unread counts or loading state.

Keys are derived only when items or getKey change. Scrolling processes the window and at most one retained focused row, without rewalking 50,000 items. Data changes or measurements can still update the size cache.

Focused rows remain mounted offscreen; actual removal returns focus to the viewport. aria-posinset/setsize express complete collection positions. Use ordinary collections or ScrollArea for search, printing, or complete assistive-technology traversal.
The fixed demo's 48px rows, dynamic demo's 72px estimate, and viewport heights are consumer choices adjusted through itemSize/height. No library token was added.
metadata.decisions: VirtualList 只拥有窗口、测量、阅读锚点与焦点连续性。集合、稳定 key、未读状态及是否跟随由消费项目决定；默认保持固定高度和手动滚动。
metadata.decisionsEn: VirtualList owns windowing, measurement, reading anchors, and focus continuity. The consumer owns the collection, stable keys, unread state, and following policy; fixed heights and manual scrolling remain the defaults.

whenToUse: 具有稳定身份的等高或动态高度长集合
avoid: 需要完整 DOM 的内容、业务表格
composition: 视口 + 总高空间 + 当前窗口/保留焦点项 + 可选应用滚动入口

library: 窗口、测量、真实位置、阅读与焦点连续性
application: 集合、稳定 key、内容、估计尺寸、尾部跟随策略

customization: itemSize / height / measurement / overscan / actionsRef / followEnd 与公开内容出口

whenToUse: Long fixed or measured-height collections with stable identities.
avoid: Content requiring complete DOM, or business tables.
composition: Viewport + total-height space + current window/retained focused item + optional consumer scroll controls.

library: Windowing, measurement, actual positions, and reading/focus continuity.
application: Collections, stable keys, content, estimated sizes, and following policy.

customization: itemSize / height / measurement / overscan / actionsRef / followEnd and public content composition.

metadata.title: 工作面 Workspace
metadata.description: 应用外壳：底纸上的侧栏旁放一张工作面，顶栏在工作面里，下面是唯一的滚动区。
metadata.descriptionEn: An application shell: a sidebar on the page ground beside one work surface, with the header inside the surface and the only scroll container below it.
metadata.decisions: 页面的名称、摘要与页面级操作在顶栏里，正文不再立第二个大标题。工作面四周一个 2 分的外边距，紧挨侧栏的一侧不另加：那道间隔是侧栏的内缘，侧栏与工作面之间读来只有一个间隔。窄屏工作面贴满视口，去掉外边距、圆角、线与阴影。路由页面用 WorkspaceHeaderPortal 把自己的标题与操作送进顶栏；顶栏在 DOM 里先于内容区，送上去的操作在 Tab 顺序里也先于正文。
metadata.decisionsEn: A page's name, summary and page-level actions live in the header, so the body has no second large title. The surface keeps a 2-unit margin all round except on the side facing the sidebar: that gap is the sidebar's own inset, so sidebar and surface read as one gap apart. At narrow width the surface fills the viewport, with no margin, radius, line or shadow. A routed page sends its title and actions to the header with WorkspaceHeaderPortal; the header precedes the content in the DOM, so those actions also precede the body in tab order.

whenToUse: 后台类应用的外壳：长期导航在侧，一张工作面承载当前页面。
avoid: 文档、落地页这类以阅读为主、整页滚动的页面不用；正文里的一段内容用 Section，独立对象用 Card。
顶栏只放这一页的标题、摘要与页面级操作；全局搜索、通知等应用级入口由应用决定位置，不挤占标题的宽度。
工作面里不再套第二张同样的纸。
composition: Workspace 的子级是 Sidebar 与 WorkspaceSurface；WorkspaceSurface 里依次是 WorkspaceHeader 与 WorkspaceContent。
内容区的内缘由页面给：取 --qy-page-gutter 时与顶栏标题同一条左缘；整幅的表格可以贴边。
页面在 WorkspaceContent 里用 WorkspaceHeaderPortal 包住 WorkspaceTitle、WorkspaceSummary、WorkspaceActions。
列表参考组合见 /examples/records：Stack 放筛选与 DataTablePattern，关闭详情即为列表；展开时用 minmax(0,…) 网格放列表与详情。WorkspaceContent 唯一拥有纵向滚动，TableContainer 只承接横向溢出。分页随列表滚动，顶栏固定。
活动记录与批量选择独立；筛选或翻页保留活动记录和以稳定 ID 保存的备注。示例详情在 xl 以上并排，以下堆叠；2:1 比例是此任务的容量选择。

library: 外壳的几何、顶栏的行高与中线、顶栏留给页面的位置、内容区的滚动与焦点落点。
application: 路由、当前项、页面标题与摘要的内容、操作的真实目标、换页后把焦点移到内容区。

responsive: 窄屏（与全库同一个 sm: 点）工作面贴满视口；侧栏是否收起或换成抽屉由应用决定。
customization: className、render 与 ref 属于各自的部件；外壳只读系统角色（底纸、纸、容器线、面板圆角、面板阴影、页边距、行高），不另设组件令牌。

whenToUse: The shell of an admin-style application: persistent navigation at the side, one work surface for the current page.
avoid: Do not use it for reading-first pages that scroll as a whole, such as documentation or landing pages; use Section for a stretch of body content and Card for an independent object.
The header holds only this page's title, summary and page-level actions; the application places global entries such as search or notifications without taking the title's width.
Do not nest a second identical sheet inside the surface.
composition: Workspace holds a Sidebar and a WorkspaceSurface; the surface holds WorkspaceHeader then WorkspaceContent.
The page sets the content inset: --qy-page-gutter lines it up with the header title; a full-width table may run to the edge.
Inside WorkspaceContent a page wraps WorkspaceTitle, WorkspaceSummary and WorkspaceActions in WorkspaceHeaderPortal.

See /examples/records: Stack holds filters and DataTablePattern; hide detail for a list, or use a minmax(0,…) grid for list and detail. WorkspaceContent owns vertical scrolling; TableContainer handles horizontal overflow. Pagination scrolls with the list; the header stays fixed.

The active record is independent from batch selection. Filtering and paging retain the active record and notes keyed by stable ID. Detail sits alongside the list at xl and stacks below it otherwise; 2:1 is a capacity choice for this task.

library: The shell geometry, the header's row height and midline, the header's slot for the page, and the content's scrolling and focus target.
application: Routing, the current item, the page title and summary, the real targets of actions, and moving focus to the content after navigation.

responsive: At narrow width (the library's single sm: point) the surface fills the viewport; whether the sidebar collapses or becomes a drawer is the application's choice.
customization: className, render and ref belong to each part; the shell reads only system roles (ground, paper, container line, panel radius, panel shadow, page gutter, row height) and adds no component tokens.

api.name: Workspace
api.description: 外壳根：底纸上横向排布侧栏与工作面，填满所在容器的高度。
api.descriptionEn: The shell root: the sidebar and the surface side by side on the page ground, filling its container's height.

props.name: render / ref / children / native props
props.description: 给直接子级 Sidebar 一圈 2 分的内缘（零特异度，Sidebar 上写的内缘与收起时的内缩优先）；有顶栏时侧栏第一行与顶栏控件同一条中线。
props.descriptionEn: Gives a direct Sidebar child a 2-unit inset (zero specificity, so padding on the Sidebar and its collapsed inset win); with a header, the sidebar's first row shares the header controls' midline.

api.name: WorkspaceSurface
api.description: 工作面：纸本色、清墨容器线、面板圆角、面板阴影；裁切内部的顶栏与滚动区。
api.descriptionEn: The work surface: paper, a light container line, panel radius and panel shadow; it clips the header and scroller inside.

props.name: render / ref / children / native props
props.description: 四周外边距 2 分，紧挨 Sidebar 的一侧为 0；窄屏贴满视口。
props.descriptionEn: A 2-unit margin all round, 0 on the side next to the Sidebar; full-bleed at narrow width.

api.name: WorkspaceHeader
api.description: 工作面里的顶栏，原生 header；高度为一行（--qy-row-default，默认 48、紧凑 44），下缘一道容器线。
api.descriptionEn: The header inside the surface, a native header; one row tall (--qy-row-default: 48 by default, 44 compact) with a container line below.

props.name: render / ref / children / native props
props.description: children 在前，页面经 WorkspaceHeaderPortal 送来的内容排在其后。页面另有 banner 时可 render 为 div。
props.descriptionEn: Its children come first; what a page sends through WorkspaceHeaderPortal follows. Render a div when the page already has a banner.

api.name: WorkspaceTitle
api.description: 页面标题，复用 Heading，单行截断。
api.descriptionEn: The page title, built on Heading, truncated to one line.

props.name: level / step / render / ref / Heading props
props.description: chapter（20/28）是放得进一个填值控件高的最大标题档；level 只改大纲层级。
props.descriptionEn: chapter (20/28) is the largest heading step that fits one fill-control height; level changes only the outline level.

api.name: WorkspaceSummary
api.description: 标题旁的一句摘要：辅助字号、浓墨、单行，空间不够时先截断它。
api.descriptionEn: A one-line summary beside the title in support size and muted ink; it truncates first.

props.name: render / ref / children / native props
props.description: 紧跟标题时间隔收回到组内间隔。
props.descriptionEn: Directly after the title, the gap tightens to the in-group gap.

api.name: WorkspaceActions
api.description: 页面级操作，靠行尾；与 SectionActions 同一规则。
api.descriptionEn: Page-level actions at the end of the row, under the same rule as SectionActions.

props.name: render / ref / children / native props
props.description: 以有名称的 quiet 按钮（md 或 sm）收尾时整组抵消它的横向留白，文字压在内容右缘。
props.descriptionEn: When a labelled quiet button (md or sm) ends the group, the group offsets its inline padding so the text meets the content's right edge.

api.name: WorkspaceContent
api.description: 唯一的滚动容器，原生 main。放得下时 tabIndex=-1，只作焦点落点；内容溢出时 tabIndex=0，键盘可停下滚动，获焦时盒内一道细线。
api.descriptionEn: The only scroll container, a native main. With room to spare it has tabIndex=-1 and is only a focus target; when its content overflows it has tabIndex=0 so the keyboard can stop and scroll, with a thin inset line on focus.

props.name: render / ref / children / native props
props.description: ref 指向滚动元素，跟随滚动的部件（目录、虚拟列表）从这里取容器。
props.descriptionEn: The ref points at the scrolling element; scroll-following parts (a table of contents, a virtual list) take their container from it.

api.name: WorkspaceHeaderPortal
api.description: 把子级渲染进顶栏留给页面的位置；页面卸下时随之卸下。
api.descriptionEn: Renders its children into the header's slot for the page; they unmount with the page.

props.name: children
props.description: 不产生自己的元素。没有顶栏、在服务端或首次提交之前时什么也不渲染。
props.descriptionEn: Renders no element of its own. Renders nothing without a header, on the server, or before the first commit.

keyboard.description: 侧栏、顶栏（含页面送上来的操作）、内容区，按 DOM 顺序；内容溢出时内容区本身也是一站。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Sidebar, header (including actions a page sent up), then content, in DOM order; when the content overflows, the content area itself is a stop.

keyboard.description: 焦点在内容区时滚动它。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Scroll the content area while it has focus.

notes: 顶栏是一个 header；不在 main、section 或 article 里时，它是页面的 banner 地标。内容区是 main，一页只放一个 Workspace。
Workspace 自带跳过链接（「跳到主要内容」）：键盘第一次 Tab 时出现，回车把焦点交给 WorkspaceContent；内容区的 id 由外壳生成，传入 id 时以传入的为准。换页后由应用把焦点移到 WorkspaceContent；调用方显式传入的 tabIndex 优先。
送进顶栏的内容在首次提交后出现（服务端渲染时不在 HTML 里）；需要首屏就有标题时，直接写在 WorkspaceHeader 的 children 里。
强制颜色下阴影被移除，工作面的范围由容器线承担，不需要额外补线。
WorkspaceTitle 是页面唯一的 h1；内容区里不要再放 PageHeader 的标题，需要分段时用 level 2 起的标题。
notesEn: The header is a header element; outside main, section and article it is the page's banner landmark. The content is main, so place one Workspace per page.

Workspace carries its own skip link ('Skip to main content'): it appears on the first Tab and Enter moves focus to WorkspaceContent; the shell generates the content's id, and an id you pass wins. After navigation the application moves focus to WorkspaceContent; an explicit tabIndex from the caller wins.
Content sent to the header appears after the first commit (it is not in server HTML); write the title directly as WorkspaceHeader's children when it must be there on first paint.
In forced colors the shadow is removed and the container line carries the surface's boundary; no extra line is needed.
WorkspaceTitle is the page's only h1; do not add a PageHeader title inside the content, and start sections at level 2.
